Freaks (2019) is a horror film directed by Zach Cregger, not Bloomgarden Films. The movie follows a group of outcasts who are forced to participate in a twisted game show where they must fight each other for the chance to win.

The main themes of Freaks (2019) include:

1. Social commentary: The film critiques societal norms and expectations, particularly those related to appearance and behavior. It highlights the struggles faced by individuals who don't conform to traditional standards.
2. Toxic masculinity: The movie explores the dangers of toxic masculinity, as embodied by the game show's host, who uses violence and intimidation to control the contestants.
3. Survival and resilience: The characters must use their wits and resourcefulness to survive in a hostile environment, showcasing their ability to adapt and thrive in the face of adversity.
4. Satire and absurdity: Freaks employs satire and absurdity to comment on modern society's obsession with reality TV and competition shows.

Overall, Freaks (2019) is a dark comedy-horror film that uses humor and irony to critique societal norms and expectations, while also exploring themes of survival, resilience, and the dangers of toxic masculinity.

original_title: ワンピース フィルム ストロングワールド
overview: 20 years after his escape from Impel Down, the legendary pirate Shiki, the Golden Lion, reappears causing massive upheaval to the Marines. During his long seclusion, he was able to come up with a scheme to bring the World Government to his knees. On his way to execute the plan, Shiki crosses paths with the Straw Hat Pirates and becomes so impressed with Nami's knowledge of meteorology that he abducts her to forcedly enlist her into his crew. Luffy and the gang end up on a strange land populated with monstrous beasts as they desperately search for Shiki and Nami.
tagline: There's gonna be a rumble in the jungle!
title: One Piece: Strong World
plot:
One Piece Film: Strong World is a 2009 Japanese animated fantasy adventure film directed by Munehisa Sakai from a screenplay by Hirohiko Kamisaka, and the tenth feature film based on Eiichiro Oda's manga One Piece. Oda served as executive producer and created the original story and character designs, a first for the franchise. Mayumi Tanaka voices Monkey D. Luffy, with Kazuya Nakai, Akemi Okamura, Kappei Yamaguchi and Hiroaki Hirata, and actor Naoto Takenaka voices the villain Shiki. It was released in Japan on 12 December 2009.

Shiki, the legendary pirate known as the Golden Lion, who escaped from the prison Impel Down twenty years earlier, uses his Devil Fruit power to make objects float and destroys a fleet of Navy ships, sending a warning to Vice Admiral Garp and Fleet Admiral Sengoku. Days earlier, the Straw Hat Pirates read news of attacks in the East Blue, their home sea, and Luffy vows to protect it, just as Shiki's flying ship appears above them. During a storm, Nami's skill as a navigator impresses Shiki, who learns that she warned of the danger. He offers to take the crew to the East Blue, but instead abducts Nami and scatters the rest of the Straw Hats across his floating islands.

The islands are inhabited by monstrous animals created through genetic experiments by Shiki's eccentric scientist, Doctor Indigo. Luffy fights his way through the beasts, while the crew, split into groups, struggles to survive. Shiki tries to persuade Nami to become his navigator, revealing his plan to use the evolved creatures to conquer the East Blue as a demonstration of his power against the World Government. To protect her friends and the villagers of the islands, Nami pretends to accept, while secretly trying to sabotage his plan. With the help of a small electric bird named Billy, whom Shiki rejected, Luffy and the reunited crew storm Shiki's fortress to rescue Nami, leading to a climactic battle between Luffy and the Golden Lion.

Strong World received praise for its story, animation and action, and was a major box-office success in Japan, grossing over 4.8 billion yen and becoming the highest-grossing One Piece film at the time.

overview: Advice columnist, Dan Burns is an expert on relationships, but somehow struggles to succeed as a brother, a son and a single parent to three precocious daughters. Things get even more complicated when Dan finds out that the woman he falls in love with is actually his brother's new girlfriend.
tagline: Something's happening to Dan. It's confusing. It's awkward. It's family.
title: Dan in Real Life
plot:
Dan in Real Life is a 2007 American romantic comedy-drama film that explores the complexities of family relationships, love, and self-discovery. The movie delves into the theme of finding one's true identity amidst the chaos of family dynamics.

The story revolves around Dan Burns (played by Steve Carell), a widowed father who takes his three daughters on a family vacation to Santa Fe, New Mexico. As Dan navigates his relationships with his daughters and their mothers, he finds himself drawn to a free-spirited woman named Marie (played by Juliette Binoche) who is also traveling alone.

Through Dan's journey, the film highlights the importance of embracing one's true self and letting go of societal expectations. Dan's character is torn between his desire for stability and security, as well as his need to reconnect with his own desires and sense of purpose.

The movie also explores the theme of love in all its forms, including romantic love, familial love, and self-love. As Dan navigates his relationships with Marie and his daughters, he comes to realize that true love is not just about finding someone else, but also about learning to love oneself.

Ultimately, Dan in Real Life is a heartwarming film that celebrates the complexities of human relationships and the power of self-discovery. The movie's themes of identity, love, and acceptance make it a relatable and engaging watch for audiences.

overview: When Josh gets the opportunity of a lifetime to audition for Rainbow Puppy’s Broadway musical, Josh and Blue skidoo to NYC for the very first time where they meet new friends and discover the magic of music, dance, and following one’s dreams.
tagline: All They Need is You.
title: Blue's Big City Adventure
plot:
Blue's Big City Adventure, previously titled Blue's Broadway Dreams, is a 2022 American live-action and animated musical comedy directed by Matt Stawski. The second film in the Blue's Clues series and a stand-alone sequel to Blue's Big Musical Movie (2000), it is based on the Nick Jr. series Blue's Clues and its revival Blue's Clues & You!. Traci Paige Johnson voices the puppy Blue, with Josh Dela Cruz as host Josh, and original hosts Steve Burns and Donovan Patton returning as Steve and Joe. Broadway performer Ali Stroker and singer Taboo appear as themselves. It was released on Paramount+ on 18 November 2022.

Josh has dreamed of singing in a Broadway musical since he was a child. One day he receives a letter from Rainbow Puppy, a friend of Periwinkle, inviting him to come to New York City that very day to audition for her new Broadway show, Happiness Is Magic. Excited but nervous, Josh is encouraged by his friends at the Blue's Clues house, and Mr. Salt writes the theater's address in Josh's Handy Dandy Notebook. Josh and Blue set off for the city aboard the Skidoo Express.

Arriving in New York, Josh realizes that his notebook is missing, and without it he has no idea where the audition is taking place. Blue suggests they play Blue's Clues, with the audience's help, to find the theater. Along the way they meet Ali Stroker, who teaches them that practice makes a big challenge feel less overwhelming, and Taboo, who shows them how music can build confidence. They find all three clues, a piano, rainbow curtains and a stage, and deduce that they must find a theater containing all three. Back at the Blue's Clues house, their friends discover the forgotten notebook and set out to help. As Josh and Blue explore the city's neighborhoods and street art, Steve and Joe, the show's previous hosts, reappear to offer support, and Josh must overcome his stage fright in time to audition, in a grand musical finale celebrating friendship and following one's dreams.

Blue's Big City Adventure received positive reviews, with an 83 percent rating on Rotten Tomatoes based on six reviews. Marco Vito Oddo of Collider gave it a "B," describing it as a movie aimed at preschoolers that adults can also enjoy, with exciting musical numbers and a tribute to New York's street art. Critics particularly appreciated the reunion of the franchise's three hosts.

original_title: ワンピース カラクリ城のメカ巨兵
overview: The Straw Hats visits an island, known as Mecha Island, where a fisherman sings an old folk song about a Golden Crown. Searching for that mysterious treasure, they find a hidden entrance into the island. The island's leader, Ratchet, impressed with the find and in search of the Golden Crown himself, invites the crew to join him in his search and the crew along with Ratchet and his henchmen enter the cave. As it turns out, the islands true form, is that of a giant turtle. Ratchet, who had known this all along, uses his mechanical castle to take control of the turtle, in order to use it, to take over the world. Now the Straw Hats have to stop not only Ratchet, but also the helpless turtle, from crashing into a nearby island.
title: One Piece: Giant Mecha Soldier of Karakuri Castle
plot:
One Piece: Giant Mecha Soldier of Karakuri Castle (ワンピース カラクリ城のメカ巨兵, Wan Pīsu Karakuri-jō no Meka Kyohei) is a 2006 Japanese animated adventure film directed by Kōnosuke Uda and produced by Toei Animation, the seventh feature based on Eiichiro Oda's manga One Piece. Written by Masahiro Itō with music by Kohei Tanaka and Fuminori Iwasaki, it opened in Japanese cinemas on 4 March 2006 and fits into the anime's continuity between the Davy Back Fight and Water 7 story arcs.

While salvaging a wrecked pirate ship, the Straw Hat Pirates open a treasure chest and find an old woman, Roba, hiding inside. In exchange for a ride home to Mecha Island, she tells them of a legendary golden crown that only the king of the sea may wear. As they approach, an old folk song drifts across the water, and the island's defence machines open fire. The island's lord is Roba's son, Dr. Ratchet, a gaunt, highly strung young inventor with a lifelong dream of world domination, who had been trying in vain to decipher the song's riddle. When he sees that Luffy and his crew have already begun to crack it by instinct, he invites them to his castle and proposes they search together.

Guided by the song, the group enters a cave beneath the island and, after solving a series of puzzles, discovers that Mecha Island is actually the back of a gigantic turtle. Ratchet reveals that this was his goal all along: from his castle he binds the creature with cables, intending to use it to conquer the world. The turtle tells Chopper that it wakes only once every thousand years to lay its eggs, and cannot do so while restrained. The Straw Hats battle Ratchet's bumbling henchmen, General Maji and Colonel Honki, and their machines, while Luffy faces the inventor's series of fighting robots, ending with a giant mechanical tortoise. Discovering Gear Second by accident for the first time, Luffy defeats Ratchet and wrecks the castle, freeing the turtle, and the crew learns that the golden treasure is in fact the shell of its eggs.

The regular voice cast includes Mayumi Tanaka as Luffy, Kazuya Nakai as Zoro, Akemi Okamura as Nami, Kappei Yamaguchi as Usopp, Hiroaki Hirata as Sanji, Yuriko Yamaguchi as Robin and Kazue Ikura standing in as Chopper. Gorō Inagaki makes a special guest appearance as Ratchet, with Takeshi Aono as the family butler, and the theme song "Sayaendō" is performed by NEWS. The film was later released on DVD in Germany and France.

overview: Two rival politicians compete to win an election to represent their small North Carolina congressional district in the United States House of Representatives.
tagline: May the best loser win.
title: The Campaign
plot:
The Campaign is a satirical comedy film that revolves around the theme of ambition and the lengths people will go to achieve power. The movie follows the story of Marty Huggins, a naive and well-meaning politician who becomes the target of his opponent's ruthless campaign tactics.

At its core, The Campaign explores the darker aspects of human nature, revealing how quickly people can become consumed by their own ambition and desire for success. As the film progresses, it becomes clear that both Marty and his opponent are willing to do whatever it takes to win, including resorting to underhanded tactics and manipulating others.

The movie also touches on the theme of identity and how it is shaped by our surroundings and relationships. Marty's character, in particular, serves as a commentary on the American Dream and the idea that anyone can become a politician with enough charm and charisma. However, as the film progresses, it becomes clear that this facade hides a more complex and nuanced individual.

Furthermore, The Campaign critiques the way politics is often portrayed in media, highlighting the absurdity and superficiality of campaign rhetoric. The film's use of satire allows it to poke fun at the excesses of modern politics, revealing the hypocrisy and double standards that often accompany it.

Overall, The Campaign is a commentary on the human condition, exploring themes of ambition, identity, and the darker aspects of human nature.

original_title: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows: Part 2
overview: Harry, Ron and Hermione continue their quest to vanquish the evil Voldemort once and for all. Just as things begin to look hopeless for the young wizards, Harry discovers a trio of magical objects that endow him with powers to rival Voldemort's formidable skills.
tagline: It all ends here.
title: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows: Part 2
plot:
Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows – Part 2 is a fantasy adventure film directed by David Yates, based on the seventh and final book in J.K. Rowling's Harry Potter series by Warner Bros. Pictures.

The story begins with Harry (Daniel Radcliffe), Ron (Rupert Grint), and Hermione (Emma Watson) on a perilous journey to find and destroy the Horcruxes created by Lord Voldemort (Ralph Fiennes). The trio, now in their early twenties, is determined to put an end to the Dark Lord's reign of terror once and for all.

As they navigate through the wilderness, they are pursued by Death Eaters and face numerous challenges. Along the way, they encounter old friends and foes, including Dobby (Toby Jones), a loyal house-elf who helps them on their quest.

The trio eventually reaches Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry, where they plan to launch a final attack on Voldemort's stronghold, the Ministry of Magic. However, things become complicated when Harry learns that he himself is one of the Horcruxes, making him a target for Voldemort's killing curse.

In a climactic battle at Hogwarts, Harry faces off against Voldemort in an epic duel. Meanwhile, Ron and Hermione work together to disable the Death Eaters' defenses and protect their friends. The film culminates in a heart-wrenching confrontation between Harry and Voldemort, which ultimately leads to the Dark Lord's downfall.

Throughout the film, themes of love, sacrifice, and the power of friendship are woven throughout the narrative. The characters' emotional journeys come full circle as they confront their pasts and make sacrifices for the greater good.

The film features stunning visual effects, impressive action sequences, and a poignant conclusion to the beloved Harry Potter series. With its richly detailed world-building and memorable performances, Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows – Part 2 is a fitting finale to the magical saga that has captivated audiences worldwide.

overview: When a hapless but dedicated talent manager signs his first client who actually has talent, his career finally starts to take off.
title: Sandy Wexler
plot:
Sandy Wexler is a 2017 American comedy film directed by Josh Greenbaum and starring Adam Sandler as the titular character. The movie follows the story of Sandy Wexler, a talent agent in Los Angeles during the 1990s who specializes in representing eccentric celebrities.

The main theme of Sandy Wexler revolves around the struggle for identity and self-discovery. Sandy is a complex character who is both confident and insecure at the same time. He has built his career on managing other people's lives, but deep down, he wants to find his own purpose and meaning in life. The film explores how Sandy navigates through various relationships and experiences that challenge his sense of self.

Another significant theme present in the movie is the power of friendship and loyalty. Throughout the story, Sandy forms strong bonds with his clients and colleagues, who become like a surrogate family to him. These relationships help him grow as a person and provide a support system when he needs it most.

The film also touches on the theme of nostalgia and the passing of time. As Sandy looks back on his life and career, he realizes that he has been living in the past and hasn't taken enough risks to pursue his true passions. This realization sparks a journey of self-discovery and growth for Sandy, as he tries to find his place in the world.

Overall, Sandy Wexler is a heartwarming comedy-drama that explores themes of identity, friendship, loyalty, and personal growth, all set against the backdrop of 1990s Los Angeles.

overview: Dr. Ryan Stone, a brilliant medical engineer on her first Shuttle mission, with veteran astronaut Matt Kowalsky in command of his last flight before retiring. But on a seemingly routine spacewalk, disaster strikes. The Shuttle is destroyed, leaving Stone and Kowalsky completely alone-tethered to nothing but each other and spiraling out into the blackness of space. The deafening silence tells them they have lost any link to Earth and any chance for rescue. As fear turns to panic, every gulp of air eats away at what little oxygen is left. But the only way home may be to go further out into the terrifying expanse of space.
tagline: Don't Let Go
title: Gravity
plot:
Gravity is a 2013 science fiction thriller film directed by Alfonso Cuarón and produced by Warner Bros. Pictures. The movie follows the story of two astronauts, Dr. Ryan Stone (played by Sandra Bullock) and Lieutenant Matt Kowalski (played by George Clooney), who are on a space mission to repair the Hubble Space Telescope.

The film begins with a stunning visual representation of the Earth from space, showcasing the beauty and fragility of our planet. We then see Dr. Ryan Stone, a medical engineer who is part of a three-person crew sent to the International Space Station (ISS) to perform routine maintenance tasks. However, during the mission, an explosion occurs on the ISS, killing two of the astronauts and leaving only Stone and Kowalski stranded in space.

The movie then shifts to a thrilling sequence where Stone and Kowalski try to navigate their way back to the ISS using a damaged shuttle. Unfortunately, they soon realize that their ship is malfunctioning, and they are drifting further away from Earth with each passing minute. The tension builds up as they face numerous challenges, including a catastrophic failure of their life support systems.

As the story unfolds, we see Stone's emotional struggle to cope with the loss of her husband, who died in a car accident just before she left for space. Her grief and sense of isolation are palpable, making her character even more relatable and human. Kowalski, on the other hand, is portrayed as a seasoned astronaut who tries to keep Stone's spirits up despite his own growing concern about their situation.

The plot development in Gravity is expertly handled by Cuarón, who uses stunning visuals and clever editing to create an immersive experience for the audience. The film's cinematography is breathtaking, capturing the vastness of space and the fragility of human existence. The sound design is equally impressive, with a haunting score that complements the on-screen action.

As the story reaches its climax, Stone and Kowalski find themselves hurtling towards a massive asteroid field, where they must use all their skills to survive. In a heart-stopping sequence, they narrowly avoid being crushed by debris and eventually manage to escape the asteroid field using a makeshift solution.

The ending of Gravity is both poignant and uplifting. After a harrowing journey, Stone finally finds herself back on Earth, where she is reunited with her daughter. The film's final shot is of Stone looking up at the sky, symbolizing her newfound appreciation for life and her connection to the universe.

Overall, Gravity is a masterclass in storytelling, visuals, and performances. It's a thrilling ride that will keep you on the edge of your seat from start to finish. With its stunning cinematography, clever editing, and outstanding performances, Gravity is a must-see film that will leave you breathless and inspired.

overview: Picking up right where the original ended, Marybeth escapes the clutches of the swamp-dwelling killer Victor Crowley. After learning the truth about her family’s connection to the hatchet-wielding madman, Marybeth returns to the Louisiana swamps along with an army of hunters to recover the bodies of her family and exact the bloodiest revenge against the bayou butcher.
tagline: Victor Crowley Lives.
title: Hatchet II
plot:
Hatchet II is an American slasher film that explores the theme of revenge and redemption. The story revolves around Victor Crowley, a vengeful spirit who seeks to punish those responsible for his death in the first film.

The movie delves into the idea of how past traumas can shape our present and future actions. Victor's backstory reveals a complex web of emotions, including anger, hurt, and a desire for revenge against those who wronged him. As he wreaks havoc on a group of college students, it becomes clear that his actions are motivated by a twisted sense of justice.

The film also touches on the theme of survival and the human condition. The characters must navigate their way through the Louisiana bayou, facing numerous challenges and obstacles as they try to outsmart Victor and escape alive. This serves as a metaphor for the human struggle against adversity, highlighting our capacity for resilience and resourcefulness in the face of danger.

Furthermore, Hatchet II critiques societal norms and expectations, particularly those related to masculinity and femininity. The characters are often stereotyped and reduced to simplistic archetypes, which serves to highlight the artificial nature of these constructs. This commentary on social norms adds depth to the film's exploration of revenge and redemption.

Overall, Hatchet II is a gruesome and entertaining horror film that uses its over-the-top violence and gore to explore complex themes related to trauma, survival, and societal expectations.

overview: At the dawn of the space-race, two radio-obsessed teens discover a strange frequency over the airwaves in what becomes the most important night of their lives and in the history of their small town.
tagline: There’s something in the sky.
title: The Vast of Night
plot:
The Vast of Night is a 2019 American supernatural mystery film directed by Kevin Kölsch and Chris Kerouac. The movie takes place in the 1950s in a small town in New Mexico, where a young radio DJ named Fay and her co-worker, Jerry, stumble upon an otherworldly occurrence that challenges their perceptions of reality.

The main theme of The Vast of Night is the struggle to find meaning and connection in a seemingly mundane world. The film's protagonist, Fay, is a lonely and isolated individual who finds solace in her work as a radio DJ. As she navigates the complexities of small-town life, she begins to question the nature of reality and her place within it.

The movie also explores the theme of isolation and disconnection in rural America during the 1950s. The town where Fay and Jerry live is depicted as a tight-knit community where everyone knows each other's business, but beneath this façade lies a sense of loneliness and disconnection. The characters' struggles to form meaningful relationships and find their place in the world serve as a backdrop for the supernatural events that unfold.

Furthermore, The Vast of Night touches on the theme of the unknown and the unexplained. As Fay and Jerry delve deeper into the mystery, they begin to realize that there are forces beyond human understanding at work in their town. This serves as a metaphor for the mysteries of life itself, which can be both fascinating and terrifying.

Ultimately, The Vast of Night is a film about the power of human connection and the importance of seeking meaning in a seemingly meaningless world. Through its exploration of themes such as isolation, disconnection, and the unknown, the movie creates a sense of tension and unease that keeps viewers on the edge of their seats until the very end.

overview: An estranged family gathers together in New York for an event celebrating the artistic work of their father.
title: The Meyerowitz Stories (New and Selected)
plot:
The Meyerowitz Stories (New and Selected) is a 2017 American comedy-drama written and directed by Noah Baumbach. Adam Sandler, Ben Stiller and Elizabeth Marvel star as the adult children of a self-absorbed artist played by Dustin Hoffman, with Emma Thompson as his fourth wife and Grace Van Patten as Sandler's daughter. The film competed for the Palme d'Or at the 2017 Cannes Film Festival and was released in theaters and on Netflix in October 2017.

After separating from his wife, the unemployed musician Danny Meyerowitz moves in with his father, Harold, a retired Bard College art professor and sculptor, and Harold's fourth wife, Maureen, a pleasant but scatterbrained hippie. Danny is close to his daughter, Eliza, a freshman film student at Bard whose provocative short films embarrass the family. Danny's sister, Jean, lives a quiet, solitary life, while their younger half-brother, Matthew, is a successful financial adviser in Los Angeles.

Harold, who believes the art world has unjustly forgotten him, refuses to take part in a group faculty show at Bard. He and Danny attend a retrospective at the Museum of Modern Art for Harold's more successful contemporary, L.J. Shapiro, where Harold feels so uncomfortable that he runs off down the street, and Danny chases after him, cutting short a promising encounter with Shapiro's daughter, Loretta. In town on business, Matthew meets Harold for lunch and tries to persuade him to sell his Manhattan house and his sculptures, provoking resentment. When Harold suffers a serious health crisis and is hospitalized, the three siblings are forced to come together, confronting old grievances, their father's favoritism and the ways in which his ego has shaped their lives. Jean reveals a painful secret from her youth, Danny and Matthew finally air their rivalry, and the family prepares for the Bard exhibition honoring Harold's work.

The film received positive reviews, with a 92 percent rating on Rotten Tomatoes, whose consensus praised Baumbach's bittersweet view of family dynamics and the remarkable cast, and a Metacritic score of 79. Sandler's performance was especially praised as one of the best of his career. At Cannes the film also won the Palm Dog award for its canine performer.

overview: When Charlotte, 27, meets her brother Henrik, 35, for the first time as an adult, it becomes an encounter without boundaries, between two people who don't know what a normal family is. How does sibling love manifest itself if you have never experienced it before? Homesick is an unusual family drama about seeking a family, and breaking every rule to be one.
title: Homesick
plot:
Homesick (Norwegian: De nærmeste, literally "The Nearest") is a 2015 Norwegian drama directed by Anne Sewitsky, her third feature after Happy, Happy, which won the World Cinema Grand Jury Prize for drama at Sundance in 2011. Produced by Maipo Film, it stars Ine Marie Wilmann as Charlotte and Simon J. Berger as Henrik, with Anneke von der Lippe as their mother Anna, Silje Storstein as Charlotte's best friend Marte and Oddgeir Thune as her boyfriend Dag. Daniel Voldheim was the cinematographer and Christoffer Heie the editor.

Charlotte is a 27-year-old dance teacher in Oslo who seems to lead a happy life, teaching young children, with a musician boyfriend and a best friend in whom she confides. Behind her smile, however, she is deeply needy. Her alcoholic father is dying of cirrhosis, and her self-centered mother Anna, about to leave on a trip to fulfil her dreams, shows her little affection. When Henrik, Anna's son from her first marriage, whom Charlotte has never known, moves with his wife and son from Sweden to Oslo, she grows curious and spies on him, even turning up unannounced at his home. Henrik's wife encourages the half-siblings to spend an evening together to clear the air, and after a night of drinking and fooling around they develop an attraction that turns into an incestuous affair. Two people who have never known what a normal family is try to work out what sibling love can be, breaking every rule in the process. Dag ends their relationship after finding explicit messages on her phone, while Marte furiously accuses Charlotte of draining the life out of everyone she meets.

Homesick premiered at the 2015 Sundance Film Festival, was nominated for the Dragon Award for Best Nordic Film at the Göteborg Film Festival, screened in the Contemporary World Cinema section in Toronto, and was shortlisted as Norway's Oscar submission before The Wave was chosen. Reviews were mixed. Ben Umstead of ScreenAnarchy called it a complex, humane drama that treats the taboo relationship as a romance rather than judging it, and praised Wilmann's nuanced, surprising performance. For FIPRESCI, Ulrich Wimmeroth admired Wilmann's outstanding debut but found the film cold and distant, since the affair seems to carry no real consequences.

overview: A group of unlikely heroes from across the Korean peninsula try to save the day after a volcano erupts on the mythical and majestic Baekdu Mountain.
tagline: Only one chance to save the nation.
title: Ashfall
plot:
Ashfall (Korean: 백두산; Baekdusan), also known as Mount Paektu, is a 2019 South Korean disaster film directed by Lee Hae-jun and Kim Byung-seo. It stars Lee Byung-hun, Ha Jung-woo, Ma Dong-seok, Jeon Hye-jin and Bae Suzy, and imagines the catastrophic eruption of the volcano on the border between China and North Korea.

When Paektu Mountain suddenly erupts, powerful earthquakes devastate both North and South Korea, and more eruptions are predicted. To prevent a final, even greater disaster, Jeon Yoo-kyung organizes an operation based on the theory of Professor Kang Bong-rae, who has long studied the volcano: detonating a nuclear bomb in a mine near the mountain to release the pressure building beneath it. Captain Jo In-chang is put in charge of a special forces team, leaving his pregnant wife, Choi Ji-young, to fend for herself in a ravaged Seoul. After their plane malfunctions and they parachute into the North, the team frees Lee Joon-pyeong, a spy within the North Korean army now held in prison, whose knowledge is needed to find the right mine.

Joon-pyeong, who wants to reach his daughter, leads them to a power station, where they extract uranium from a nuclear missile, drawing the attention of the American military and of Chinese gangsters to whom he has promised the material. In the South, Ji-young survives a tsunami and, with Professor Kang, stays behind to help when the evacuees cannot board a ship to the United States; Yoo-kyung steals military documents from the American-controlled base so they can stay in contact with In-chang. In the North, In-chang and Joon-pyeong reach the town of Bocheon, where Joon-pyeong finds his frightened daughter, Soon-ok. As another eruption scatters the gangsters and the Americans, Kang tells In-chang where the final eruption will occur. Joon-pyeong carries the bomb deep into the mine, sacrificing himself, while In-chang escapes with Soon-ok. The explosion stops the earthquakes, saving countless lives. A year later, the two Koreas jointly oversee reconstruction, and In-chang and Ji-young raise their newborn son alongside Soon-ok.

The film was released in South Korea on 19 December 2019 and in the United States the next day. It passed two million admissions in four days, ultimately grossing about $61.3 million against a budget of about $17.7 million, and received a 73% approval rating on Rotten Tomatoes.

belongs_to_collection.name: How to Train Your Dragon Collection

original_title: How to Train Your Dragon: The Hidden World
overview: As Hiccup fulfills his dream of creating a peaceful dragon utopia, Toothless’ discovery of an untamed, elusive mate draws the Night Fury away. When danger mounts at home and Hiccup’s reign as village chief is tested, both dragon and rider must make impossible decisions to save their kind.
tagline: The friendship of a lifetime
title: How to Train Your Dragon: The Hidden World
plot:
How to Train Your Dragon: The Hidden World is a 2019 American computer-animated adventure comedy film directed by Dean DeBlois and Chris Sanders. It is the third installment in the How to Train Your Dragon trilogy.

The movie takes place five years after the events of the previous film, where Hiccup Horrendous Haddock III (voiced by Jay Baruchel) has become the chief of Berk, a Viking village that has transformed into a utopia for dragons and humans. However, a new threat emerges in the form of Grimmel, a ruthless dragon hunter who seeks to destroy all dragons.

Grimmel is revealed to be the son of a powerful dragon hunter named Viggo (voiced by F. Murray Abraham), who was thought to have been killed by Hiccup's father, Stoick the Vast (voiced by Gerard Butler). Grimmel's presence sets off a chain reaction that puts the entire dragon population in danger.

As Hiccup and his friends try to stop Grimmel, they also face an internal conflict within Berk. The village is struggling with its identity, as some of its members want to return to their traditional Viking ways, while others want to maintain the peace and harmony between humans and dragons that Hiccup has established.

Meanwhile, Toothless, Hiccup's loyal dragon companion, begins to exhibit strange behavior, suggesting that he may be developing his own identity. As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that Toothless is not just a pet, but a wild dragon who has been living in secret among humans.

In the end, Hiccup and Grimmel engage in an epic battle, with Hiccup using all his skills and knowledge to defeat the ruthless hunter. However, instead of killing Grimmel, Hiccup chooses to spare his life, realizing that there may be a way to redeem him and bring peace to both humans and dragons.

The movie concludes with Hiccup and Toothless embarking on a journey to find a new home for the dragons, as Berk is no longer suitable for them. Along the way, they encounter new challenges and adventures, but ultimately, they find a hidden valley where the dragons can live in peace and harmony.

Throughout the film, the characters undergo significant development, particularly Hiccup, who must come to terms with his own identity and the weight of responsibility that comes with being the chief of Berk. The movie also explores themes of identity, community, and acceptance, as the characters navigate their relationships with each other and the world around them.

Overall, How to Train Your Dragon: The Hidden World is a heartwarming and action-packed film that brings closure to the trilogy while leaving room for new adventures in the future.

overview: An exploration of the United States of America's war on drugs from multiple perspectives. For the new head of the Office of National Drug Control Policy, the war becomes personal when he discovers his well-educated daughter is abusing cocaine within their comfortable suburban home. In Mexico, a flawed, but noble policeman agrees to testify against a powerful general in league with a cartel, and in San Diego, a drug kingpin's sheltered trophy wife must learn her husband's ruthless business after he is arrested, endangering her luxurious lifestyle.
tagline: No one gets away clean
title: Traffic
plot:
Traffic is a 2000 American crime drama directed by Steven Soderbergh and written by Stephen Gaghan, adapted from the 1989 British Channel 4 miniseries Traffik. It examines the illegal drug trade from the viewpoints of users, enforcers, politicians and traffickers through three interwoven stories whose characters rarely meet. The ensemble includes Michael Douglas, Benicio del Toro, Catherine Zeta-Jones, Don Cheadle, Luis Guzmán, Dennis Quaid, Erika Christensen, Topher Grace, Tomas Milian and Benjamin Bratt, with dialogue in both English and Spanish.

In Mexico, police officer Javier Rodriguez (del Toro) and his partner Manolo Sanchez are recruited by General Salazar to capture Francisco Flores, a hitman for the Tijuana cartel of the Obregón brothers. Their campaign cripples the Obregóns, but Javier discovers that Salazar secretly works for the rival Juárez cartel. After Salazar has Manolo murdered, Javier helps the DEA expose him in exchange for electricity for a neighbourhood baseball park.

In Ohio, conservative judge Robert Wakefield (Douglas) is appointed the nation's drug czar, despite warnings that the war on drugs cannot be won, while his teenage daughter Caroline is sinking into addiction. When she runs away, Robert searches the streets of Cincinnati and finds her being exploited by a dealer. Faltering in the middle of a speech presenting his anti-drug plan, he declares that he cannot wage a war on his own family, and later joins Caroline at a support meeting.

In San Diego, DEA agents Montel Gordon (Cheadle) and Ray Castro (Guzmán) arrest a dealer who agrees to testify against the distributor Carl Ayala. Ayala's pregnant wife Helena (Zeta-Jones), discovering her husband's real business, takes matters into her own hands. She hires Flores to kill the witness, an attack that kills Castro instead, and then strikes a deal with the cartel that frees her husband, though Gordon quietly plants a listening device in Ayala's home.

Soderbergh, who shot the film himself under a pseudonym, gave each storyline a distinctive colour treatment. Released in December 2000, Traffic was acclaimed for its direction, complexity and performances, especially del Toro's, and earned over $200 million worldwide. It won four Academy Awards, for Best Director, Best Supporting Actor for del Toro, Best Adapted Screenplay and Best Film Editing.

overview: Unjustly accused of staging a spooky practical joke complete with ghosts, Daphne, Velma, Fred and Shaggy are suspended from Coolsville High. To clear their names, they team up to solve the supernatural mystery…and head straight into nonstop laughs and adventure.
tagline: The greatest mystery is how it all began.
title: Scooby-Doo! The Mystery Begins
plot:
Scooby-Doo! The Mystery Begins is a 2009 animated mystery comedy film that serves as a prequel to the original Scooby-Doo series. The movie follows the adventures of four teenagers, Shaggy Rogers, Fred Jones, Daphne Blake, and Velma Dinkley, who form a detective agency called Mystery Inc.

The main themes of Scooby-Doo! The Mystery Begins include:

1. Friendship: The film highlights the strong bond between the four main characters, showcasing their camaraderie, trust, and loyalty to each other.
2. Teamwork: As they work together to solve mysteries, the gang learns to rely on each other's strengths and weaknesses, demonstrating the importance of collaboration and communication in achieving success.
3. Bravery: The movie encourages viewers to face their fears and stand up for what is right, even if it means confronting the unknown or overcoming personal anxieties.
4. Mystery-solving: The film celebrates the thrill of the chase, as the gang uses their collective skills and ingenuity to unravel the mysteries they encounter.

The plot follows the gang as they travel to Coolsville, where they meet a new friend, Scooby-Doo, who becomes an integral part of their team. Together, they must solve a series of spooky mysteries that threaten the town's reputation and safety.

Throughout the movie, the characters learn valuable lessons about responsibility, empathy, and the importance of using their unique skills to make a positive impact. The film's lighthearted tone and comedic moments add to its appeal, making it an enjoyable watch for both children and adults.

Overall, Scooby-Doo! The Mystery Begins is a heartwarming and entertaining movie that explores themes of friendship, teamwork, bravery, and mystery-solving, setting the stage for the beloved franchise's enduring popularity.

overview: Meryl Streep stars as Ricki Rendazzo, a guitar heroine who made a world of mistakes as she followed her dreams of rock-and-roll stardom. Returning home, Ricki gets a shot at redemption and a chance to make things right as she faces the music with her family.
tagline: Get Ready for Ricki.
title: Ricki and the Flash
plot:
Ricki and the Flash is a 2015 American musical drama film directed by Jonathan Demme. The movie follows the story of Ricki Rendazzo, a rock musician who has been estranged from her family for many years. As she prepares to reunite with her children, Ricki must confront her past and the choices she made that led to her separation.

The main theme of the film is the power of forgiveness and redemption. Through Ricki's journey, the movie explores the complexities of mother-daughter relationships and the sacrifices that are often made for the sake of love and family. The film also touches on themes of identity, creativity, and the struggle to balance personal ambitions with familial responsibilities.

Ricki's character is a complex and multifaceted one, driven by a deep-seated desire to be loved and accepted by her children. As she navigates her complicated past, Ricki must confront her own flaws and weaknesses in order to rebuild her relationships with those around her. The film ultimately suggests that it's never too late to make amends and start anew, and that the bonds of family can be both a source of strength and a source of pain.

The movie features a strong performance from Meryl Streep as Ricki Rendazzo, who brings depth and nuance to the character. The film's music, which features a mix of rock and country styles, adds to the emotional impact of the story, highlighting Ricki's passion and creativity. Overall, Ricki and the Flash is a heartwarming and thought-provoking drama that explores the complexities of family relationships and the power of forgiveness and redemption.

overview: Ancient Korea, 17th century. The powerful Khan of the Jurchen tribe of Manchuria, who fights the Ming dinasty to gain China, becomes the first ruler of the Qing dinasty and demands from King In-jo of Joseon to bow before him; but he refuses, being loyal to the Mings. On December 14th, 1636, the Qing horde invades Joseon, so King In-jo and his court shelter in the mountain fortress of Namhan and prepare to defend the kingdom.
tagline: The fate of the nation is in their hands
title: The Fortress
plot:
The Fortress is a 2017 South Korean war drama film directed by Yang Woo-suk. The movie tells the story of a group of North Korean soldiers who take refuge in a small South Korean fortress, and their interactions with the South Korean villagers.

At its core, The Fortress explores themes of humanity, empathy, and understanding between two vastly different cultures and ideologies. As the North Korean soldiers struggle to survive in the harsh environment of the fortress, they are forced to confront their own identities and the true nature of their mission. Through their interactions with the South Korean villagers, who are initially wary of their presence, the soldiers begin to see the humanity in each other and challenge their preconceived notions about good and evil.

The film also delves into the psychological effects of war on individuals and society, highlighting the emotional toll that conflict takes on those caught in its midst. The Fortress is a powerful exploration of the complexities of human nature, encouraging viewers to consider the perspectives of those who may be perceived as enemies or outsiders.

Ultimately, The Fortress is a thought-provoking film that challenges its audience to question their assumptions and biases, promoting a deeper understanding of the human experience and the importance of empathy in breaking down cultural and ideological barriers.

overview: When three redneck brothers agree to help a woman save her son from an abusive father, they become targets on the run from an odd cast of characters.
tagline: A Southern Whip-Ass Extravaganza!
title: The Baytown Outlaws
plot:
The Baytown Outlaws is a 2012 American action comedy film directed by Barry Battles and written by Battles and David W. Egan. 

The movie revolves around three brothers, Jake, Wyatt, and Chet, who are former outlaws trying to leave their outlaw past behind them. However, when they discover that the corrupt sheriff of Baytown is embezzling funds meant for the town's children, they decide to take matters into their own hands.

As the story unfolds, themes of redemption, family, and loyalty become apparent. The film explores how the brothers' complicated relationships with each other and their desire to make amends for past mistakes drive them to confront the corrupt sheriff and fight for justice in Baytown.

Throughout the movie, there is also a strong emphasis on the consequences of violence and the cyclical nature of crime. The characters are forced to confront the harsh realities of their own actions and the impact they have had on those around them.

Ultimately, The Baytown Outlaws is a story about finding redemption and making amends through selfless acts of bravery and loyalty, as the brothers put aside their differences and work together to protect the people and town they care about.

overview: Newlywed Jennifer is brutally attacked at a dark rest stop. While healing from her injuries, she can’t recall anything from her past, including the ordeal. Her husband, Russell , is just thankful she’s alive and eager to get her home. As he reintroduces her to their secluded mountain estate, Detective Page  pursues Jennifer’s assailant — his own daughter went missing and was never found. The same fate now awaits Jennifer, unless someone realizes that her loving caretaker is actually her captor.
tagline: He’s there to take care of her.
title: Secret Obsession
plot:
Secret Obsession is a 2019 American thriller film directed by Steven R. Monroe and produced by Hybrid Films. The movie follows a woman named Jessica who becomes obsessed with her husband's new girlfriend, leading to a downward spiral of jealousy and violence.

The main theme of Secret Obsession revolves around the destructive nature of unchecked emotions, particularly jealousy and possessiveness. As Jessica's obsession grows, she becomes increasingly consumed by her own paranoia and delusions, causing her to lose sight of reality. The film expertly explores how these emotions can escalate into violent behavior, highlighting the devastating consequences for all parties involved.

The movie also touches on the theme of toxic relationships and the blurred lines between love and obsession. Jessica's fixation on her husband's new girlfriend serves as a catalyst for her downward spiral, illustrating how an unhealthy attachment can lead to destructive behavior. The film raises questions about the nature of love, loyalty, and commitment, leaving the audience to ponder the complexities of human emotions.

Ultimately, Secret Obsession is a gripping thriller that delves into the darker aspects of human psychology, serving as a cautionary tale about the dangers of allowing our emotions to consume us.

original_title: Το Κακό: Στην Εποχή των Ηρώων
overview: The story begins at the end of the first Kako movie. The survivors meet up with a group of other barricaded survivors and must take care of the zombies as well as other random Greeks that have taken advantage of the chaos, while shooting random moving targets (zombie or not). Throughout we take small flashback visits into ancient Greece where the zombie apocalypse has also happened and we learn how they faced them.
title: Evil - In the Time of Heroes
plot:
Evil: In the Time of Heroes (Greek: Το Κακό: Στην Εποχή των Ηρώων) is a 2009 Greek zombie horror comedy directed by Yorgos Noussias and the sequel to his 2005 film Evil, often described as the first Greek zombie film. Billy Zane appears as a mysterious figure known as the Prophet, with Dinos Avgoustidis, George Hraniotis, Orfeas Avgoustidis and Apostolis Totsikas.

The story begins shortly after the events of the first film, as a zombie outbreak spreads through Athens. An ancient evil power has transformed ordinary people into bloodthirsty undead, and the city descends into chaos. A small group of survivors, including characters from the first film, tries to escape the devastated capital, while armed gangs and marauders exploit the collapse of order and the authorities prepare drastic measures to contain the epidemic.

The film reveals that the struggle between humans and the undead is far older than the modern outbreak. Flashbacks to ancient Greece show a warrior who confronted the same evil in the distant past, linking the present-day survivors to an age of heroes, and suggest that the war between the living and the dead has recurred across millennia. The enigmatic Prophet, who appears to understand the history of the curse, searches for a chosen hero capable of ending it once and for all, as foreign powers threaten to bomb the country to stop the infection. As the survivors fight their way through hordes of zombies in increasingly outrageous battles, the stories of past and present converge, and they must discover whether one of them is destined to defeat the ancient evil.

The film combines gory splatter effects, slapstick humor and references to Greek history and mythology. Reviewers who saw it at genre festivals praised its energy, inventive gore and sense of fun, but criticized its incoherent plot, thin characterization and confusing mythology. Zane's casting gave the low-budget Greek production a measure of international recognition, and the film screened at several European genre festivals, including Grimm Up North in Britain.

overview: Legendary martial artist Bruce Lee is the subject of this thoughtful documentary by Lee aficionado John Little. Using interviews, behind-the-scenes footage and action sequences from Lee's last (unfinished) film, Game of Death, Little paints a textured, complex portrait of the world's most famous action hero
tagline: You know the legend. Now meet the man.
title: Bruce Lee: A Warrior's Journey
plot:
Bruce Lee: A Warrior's Journey is a 2000 documentary written and directed by John Little, an author and long-time researcher of Bruce Lee's life and writings, about the martial artist, his philosophy of Jeet Kune Do and his unfinished final film, Game of Death. Produced by Concord Productions with Warner Bros. and Media Asia, it premiered in San Francisco on 22 October 2000 and was released on VHS and DVD by Warner Home Video.

The film is divided into five parts. The first three trace Lee's life and the development of his ideas about combat and self-expression through archive material, rare behind-the-scenes footage and interviews with people who knew him, among them his widow Linda Lee Cadwell, his early student Taky Kimura, his friend and student Dan Inosanto, the hapkido grandmaster Ji Han-jae and the basketball star Kareem Abdul-Jabbar, Lee's student and co-star in Game of Death. Jackie Chan, Sammo Hung and Chuck Norris are also among those credited.

The last two parts turn to Game of Death itself. Lee had shot the climactic fight sequences in 1972, in which his character battles his way up the levels of a pagoda against a different martial arts master on each floor, but interrupted filming to star in Enter the Dragon and died in 1973 before he could complete it. In 1978 Golden Harvest released a Game of Death built around roughly eleven minutes of his footage, filling out the rest with look-alikes and a new story. Some twenty-three further minutes of Lee's original material, long thought lost, were rediscovered in 1999 by Bey Logan, and Little edited them according to Lee's own script notes and outlines to present the pagoda finale much as Lee had intended, with his original English and Cantonese dialogue.

The music is by Wayne Hawkins, and Raymond Chow is among the producers. The DVD also included The Story, a short film shot in South Korea under Little's direction that dramatises the storyline Lee had planned for the full film. The documentary was later included as a bonus feature on the 2004 special edition DVD of Enter the Dragon, and it has been dubbed and broadcast in several countries, including Italy, where it aired on Discovery Channel and Rai 4.

original_title: A Babysitter's Guide to Monster Hunting
overview: Recruited by a secret society of babysitters, a high schooler battles the Boogeyman and his monsters when they nab the boy she's watching on Halloween.
title: A Babysitter's Guide to Monster Hunting
plot:
A Babysitter's Guide to Monster Hunting is a 2020 American dark fantasy comedy horror film directed by Rachel Talalay and distributed by Netflix. It was written by Joe Ballarini, who adapted his own book trilogy of the same name, and stars Tamara Smart, Oona Laurence, Indya Moore and Tom Felton, with Alessio Scalzotto and Ian Ho in supporting roles.

Kelly Ferguson, a high school freshman in Rhode Island, has been cruelly nicknamed "Monster Girl" ever since she claimed to have been attacked by a monster as a small child. On Halloween night, instead of going to a senior's party, she is roped into babysitting Jacob, the son of her mother's boss, Ms. Zellman. Jacob shows her drawings of the monsters that haunt his dreams, and Kelly reassures him, checks under the bed and gives him a small light. Minutes later she finds three little creatures carrying him off. Unable to get help from 911, she meets Liz Lerue, a member of a secret society of babysitters who protect children, who identifies the creatures as Toadies, servants of the Boogeyman.

The Boogeyman, also known as the Grand Guignol, a stealer of dreams and bringer of nightmares, plans to raise a monster army by extracting nightmares from Jacob's unusually vivid imagination. At the headquarters of the Rhode Island Order of Babysitters, hidden at Brown University, Kelly uses a magic dust to recover a memory of the Boogeyman telling her as a five-year-old that she could bring dreams to life. The trainee sitters, all of whom bear scars from childhood encounters with boogeymen, learn that the villain can be defeated by delivering a potion called Angel Hair with a "monster punch," while their ally Curtis gathers the ingredients and equips Kelly with gadgets. A tracking plan backfires, leading the girls into a trap at the Halloween party, and the Boogeyman captures and hypnotizes Liz. Kelly breaks into a condemned lighthouse, outwits the Toadies, snaps Liz out of her trance and strikes the Boogeyman with the Angel Hair, while the awakened Jacob makes the nightmare creatures vanish. Kelly gets Jacob home before his mother returns, is asked to babysit again, is recommended to the Order and is asked out by her crush, Victor.

The film premiered on Netflix on October 15, 2020. It received mixed reviews, with a 65% approval rating on Rotten Tomatoes and a Metacritic score of 31.

overview: Town residents must band together after a devastating alien invasion. As they struggle to survive, they realize they must stay one step ahead of their attackers and work together for a chance to strike back.
tagline: The conquest begins.
title: Occupation
plot:
Occupation is a 2018 Australian science fiction action film written and directed by Luke Sparke, with additional dialogue by Felix Williamson, and produced by Carly and Carmel Imrie of SparkeFilms. Dan Ewing stars as Matt Simmons, a local footballer, with Stephanie Jacobsen, Temuera Morrison as the ex-convict Peter Bartlett, Rhiannon Fish and Jacqueline McKenzie. Saban acquired North American rights in 2018, and the film was released in Australia and New Zealand by Pinnacle Films. A sequel, Occupation: Rainfall, followed in 2020.

In a small country town in Australia, the residents are gathered for a local football match when an alien armada suddenly arrives and attacks. The town is devastated, and many of its inhabitants are killed or taken prisoner as the extraterrestrial forces occupy the area and enslave the survivors. Matt, a footballer whose career has stalled, escapes with his girlfriend Amelia and a handful of others, including his rival Jackson and Peter Bartlett, a hardened former prisoner whose skills prove valuable.

Fleeing into the surrounding bush, the survivors band together and gradually form a guerrilla resistance. Over the following months they recruit more people and build a small hidden community, learning how to fight the invaders and how to survive without the comforts of modern life. Tensions develop within the group, especially between Matt and Jackson, and over how far they should go in fighting back, with Amelia urging restraint. As the occupation tightens and the aliens hunt down the rebels, the resistance links up with remnants of the Australian Defence Force for a final battle, one that will have consequences not only for their community but for humanity and the future of the planet.

Occupation received mixed reviews. Critics praised its energetic action, its ambition on a modest budget and its distinctly Australian setting and humor, describing the production as fueled by chutzpah, but faulted its uneven dialogue, plot logic and visual effects.

overview: Will Hunting has a genius-level IQ but chooses to work as a janitor at MIT. When he solves a difficult graduate-level math problem, his talents are discovered by Professor Gerald Lambeau, who decides to help the misguided youth reach his potential. When Will is arrested for attacking a police officer, Professor Lambeau makes a deal to get leniency for him if he will get treatment from therapist Sean Maguire.
tagline: For the first 20 years of his life, Will Hunting has called the shots. Now he's about to meet his match.
title: Good Will Hunting
plot:
Good Will Hunting is a 1997 American drama film directed by Gus Van Sant, written by Matt Damon and Ben Affleck, and produced by Lawrence Bender.

The movie follows the story of Will Hunting (played by Matt Damon), a young math prodigy who works as a janitor at MIT. Will's exceptional mathematical abilities are discovered by Professor Gerald Lambeau (played by Stellan Skarsgård), who recognizes his talent and encourages him to pursue a career in mathematics.

However, Will's troubled past and emotional baggage make it difficult for him to accept the attention and praise he receives from others. He is haunted by a traumatic event from his childhood, which has left him with emotional scars and a deep-seated fear of intimacy.

Will's life takes a dramatic turn when he meets Sean Maguire (played by Robin Williams), a therapist who helps him confront his demons and work through his issues. Through their sessions, Will begins to open up about his past and the pain that has been holding him back.

As Will and Sean develop a close relationship, Will is forced to confront the fact that he has been running from his problems for years. He must come to terms with the fact that he can't escape his past forever and that it's time to face his fears and take control of his life.

Meanwhile, Will also meets Skylar (played by Minnie Driver), a Harvard student who becomes infatuated with him. However, Will is hesitant to get close to her due to his fear of intimacy and his fear of being hurt again.

As the story unfolds, Will's relationships with Sean and Skylar serve as catalysts for his growth and self-discovery. Through their interactions, Will begins to understand that he doesn't have to be defined by his past and that he has the power to create a better future for himself.

The film's climax features an emotional confrontation between Will and his abusive father (played by Bruce McGill), which marks a turning point in Will's journey towards healing and redemption. With Sean's guidance, Will is able to find closure and move forward with his life.

In the end, Will comes to terms with his past and learns to accept himself and others. The film concludes on a hopeful note, with Will having found a sense of purpose and belonging, thanks in part to the support and love of those around him.

Good Will Hunting was widely acclaimed by critics and audiences alike, earning several Academy Award nominations, including Best Picture, Best Director, and Best Actor for Robin Williams' iconic performance. The film's success can be attributed to its thought-provoking themes, memorable characters, and outstanding performances from the cast.

overview: The Mystery Inc. gang takes a trip to Japan and finds themselves circling Asia and the Pacific in a treasure hunt, racing against the vengeful Black Samurai and his Ninja warriors to find the legendary Sword of Fate, an ancient blade fabled to possess extraordinary supernatural powers.
title: Scooby-Doo! and the Samurai Sword
plot:
Scooby-Doo! and the Samurai Sword is an animated mystery film that delves into the world of Japanese folklore, blending it with the classic Scooby-Doo formula. The movie's main theme revolves around the idea of cultural exchange and understanding, as the Mystery Inc. gang finds themselves in feudal Japan, where they must navigate a complex web of traditions and superstitions.

At its core, the film is a commentary on the importance of respecting and appreciating different cultures. The characters' initial reactions to Japanese customs and mythology serve as a metaphor for how people often approach unfamiliar cultures with skepticism or even fear. However, through their experiences and interactions with the locals, they come to realize the value of embracing diversity and learning from others.

The movie also explores themes of identity and belonging. Shaggy, in particular, struggles with feeling like an outsider in Japan, where he is seen as a foreigner. His journey is a metaphor for finding one's place in the world and discovering what it means to be part of a community.

Furthermore, Scooby-Doo! and the Samurai Sword touches on the idea of tradition vs. modernity. The film's villain, who seeks to exploit Japan's cultural heritage for personal gain, serves as a foil to the gang's efforts to preserve and respect the country's traditions. This dichotomy highlights the tension between preserving the past and embracing change.

Overall, Scooby-Doo! and the Samurai Sword is a lighthearted, entertaining film that uses its blend of mystery, adventure, and cultural commentary to create an engaging narrative that appeals to both children and adults.

overview: Ambitious artist Jabari attempts to balance success and love when he moves into his dream Manhattan apartment and falls for his next-door neighbor.
tagline: Love will find us all.
title: Entergalactic
plot:
Entergalactic is a 2022 American adult animated musical romantic comedy created by the musician and actor Kid Cudi as a visual companion to his album of the same name. Initially announced as a television series, it was redeveloped as a feature-length special and directed by Fletcher Moules, with Kenya Barris among the producers. Cudi voices Jabari, with Jessica Williams as Meadow, Timothée Chalamet, Ty Dolla Sign, Laura Harrier, Vanessa Hudgens, Christopher Abbott, 070 Shake and Teyana Taylor. It premiered on Netflix on 30 September 2022, the same day the album was released.

Jabari is a charming, streetwear-loving artist in New York City who is on the verge of real success. Mr. Rager, the character he has spray-painted on walls throughout the city, has been chosen to be developed into a comic book, and Jabari moves into a stylish new apartment in Manhattan to celebrate. Shortly after the move he meets his neighbor Meadow, a cool, independent photographer who documents the city's streets.

The two are instantly drawn to each other, and their relationship blossoms through playful encounters, late-night conversations and shared passion for their art. However, Jabari is still entangled with his ex, Carmen, and is uncertain whether he can balance his budding career, the pressure of his new comic and his friendships with the demands of a serious relationship. Meadow, meanwhile, is wary of being hurt again. With advice from his friends, including his stoner neighbor Len, Jabari must decide whether he can make room for love in his life. Throughout the story, the narrative is punctuated by musical sequences set to songs from Cudi's album, in which the characters' emotions are expressed through bold colors, surreal imagery and dreamlike visual effects.

Entergalactic received positive reviews, with critics praising its vibrant animation, which blends 2D and 3D styles in a manner reminiscent of Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse, its soundtrack and its warm portrayal of a Black romance in New York. Some found the story slight compared with its visual ambition. Its release alongside the album made it one of the most ambitious music-driven animated projects of the year.

overview: In a world where supervillains are commonplace, two estranged childhood best friends reunite after one devises a treatment that gives them powers to protect their city.
tagline: Newly super. Almost heroes.
title: Thunder Force
plot:
Thunder Force is a 2021 American superhero comedy film directed by Susan Johnson and written by Jason Sudeikis, Bill Block, and Brendan Hay. The movie stars Melissa McCarthy, Octavia Spencer, Jason Bateman, and Bobby Moynihan.

The story follows two childhood friends, Elsa (Melissa McCarthy) and Bobbi (Octavia Spencer), who were inseparable as kids but drifted apart after high school. Elsa, a brilliant scientist, has spent her life studying the properties of gamma radiation, which she believes holds the key to unlocking ultimate power. Bobbi, on the other hand, is a struggling single mother working multiple jobs to make ends meet.

One day, while experimenting with gamma radiation in her lab, Elsa accidentally exposes herself to an enormous dose, granting her incredible superhuman strength and agility. However, this transformation comes at a terrible cost: she loses her sense of identity and becomes increasingly paranoid and isolated.

Meanwhile, Bobbi is struggling to provide for her young daughter, who suffers from a rare genetic disorder that requires expensive treatment. Desperate for a solution, Bobbi turns to Elsa's lab, where she discovers the gamma radiation that transformed her friend. Intrigued by the potential benefits, Bobbi decides to undergo a similar transformation.

As both women begin to explore their newfound powers, they realize that their abilities are not just physical but also emotional and psychological. They must navigate the challenges of their new identities while confronting the darker aspects of their own psyches.

The movie takes a turn when Elsa's lab is attacked by a rival scientist, played by Bobby Moynihan, who seeks to exploit the gamma radiation for his own gain. Bobbi, now empowered with similar abilities, joins forces with Elsa to stop him and protect her daughter.

Throughout the film, Jason Bateman plays James, a wealthy tech mogul who becomes entangled in the women's lives. He is initially portrayed as a villain but eventually reveals himself to be a complex character with his own motivations and desires.

As the story unfolds, Thunder Force explores themes of female empowerment, friendship, and the complexities of identity. The film features plenty of humor, action, and heart, making it an entertaining ride for audiences.

Ultimately, Elsa and Bobbi must confront their inner demons and learn to work together to save each other and themselves from the consequences of their newfound powers. In the end, they emerge stronger, wiser, and more connected than ever before.

Overall, Thunder Force is a fun, action-packed comedy that celebrates female friendship and empowerment. With its talented cast, witty script, and engaging storyline, it's a movie that will leave you smiling long after the credits roll.

original_title: ลุงบุญมีระลึกชาติ
overview: Suffering from acute kidney failure, Boonmee has chosen to spend his final days surrounded by his loved ones in the countryside. Surprisingly, the ghost of his deceased wife appears to care for him, and his long lost son returns home in a non-human form. Contemplating the reasons for his illness, Boonmee treks through the jungle with his family to a mysterious hilltop cave—the birthplace of his first life.
production_companies: Foundation for Art and Creative Technology (FACT)
title: Uncle Boonmee Who Can Recall His Past Lives
plot:
Uncle Boonmee Who Can Recall His Past Lives (Thai: Lung Bunmi Raluek Chat) is a 2010 Thai fantasy drama written, produced and directed by Apichatpong Weerasethakul. It stars Thanapat Saisaymar as Boonmee, a farmer in his final days, with Jenjira Pongpas as his sister-in-law Jen, Sakda Kaewbuadee as his nephew Tong, Natthakarn Aphaiwong as the ghost of his wife Huay and Jeerasak Kulhong as his lost son Boonsong. The film was the final part of Primitive, a multi-platform art project by the director, and is steeped in ideas of reincarnation and memory.

Boonmee, who is dying of kidney failure, lives on his farm in northeastern Thailand with Jen and Tong, cared for by his Laotian assistant Jaai, who gives him dialysis. One evening at dinner, Huay, who died more than a decade earlier, quietly materializes at the table, having heard the prayers said for her. Soon a hairy figure with glowing red eyes joins them: Boonsong, who vanished years earlier after becoming obsessed with a creature he had photographed, a monkey ghost, and who has since mated with one and taken on its form.

The family accepts these visitors with calm and curiosity. Boonmee wonders whether his illness is the result of karma, a consequence of killing communists while serving in the army and of killing insects on his farm. Interwoven with these scenes is a mysterious episode about a princess who, seeing a more beautiful version of herself reflected in a forest pool, gives herself to a talking catfish. As death approaches, Huay leads Boonmee, Jen and Tong through the jungle at night to a cave, where Boonmee senses he was born in a past life he cannot remember, and he recounts a dream of a future in which people from the past are made to disappear.

Unfolding at a slow, meditative pace, the film blends folklore, Buddhist belief, political memory and the history of cinema itself, and was partly inspired by a 1983 book by the Buddhist abbot Phra Sripariyattiweti about a man who could recall his past lives.

Uncle Boonmee premiered at the 2010 Cannes Film Festival, where it won the Palme d'Or, the first Thai film to do so. It was released in the United States by Strand Releasing in March 2011. It received near-universal acclaim, with 90 percent approval on Rotten Tomatoes and a Metacritic score of 87, and is regarded by many critics as one of the greatest films ever made.

overview: The lone surviving thief of a violent armored car robbery is sprung from a high security facility and administered an experimental drug.
tagline: Some crimes never let you go
title: Backtrace
plot:
Backtrace is an action-thriller film that delves into the darker aspects of human nature and the blurred lines between good and evil. The movie follows a former special forces operative, Mike Randall, who seeks redemption after a traumatic event in his past.

The main theme of Backtrace revolves around the concept of trauma and its lasting impact on individuals. Mike's troubled past is slowly unraveled throughout the film, revealing a complex web of emotions that drive him to seek revenge against those responsible for his pain. As he navigates through a series of intense confrontations, it becomes clear that his quest for vengeance is not only driven by a desire for justice but also by a deep-seated need for self-punishment.

The film also explores the theme of morality and the gray areas that exist between right and wrong. Mike's actions become increasingly erratic as he struggles to distinguish between good and evil, leading him down a path of destruction that threatens to consume him entirely. This moral ambiguity serves as a commentary on the human condition, highlighting the complexities and nuances that make us who we are.

Furthermore, Backtrace touches on the idea of redemption and the possibility of personal growth. Despite his troubled past, Mike is given the opportunity to start anew and find a sense of purpose in life. However, this newfound chance at redemption is constantly threatened by his own demons, leaving the audience wondering whether he will ultimately be able to overcome his inner turmoil.

Overall, Backtrace is a gripping thriller that delves into the darker aspects of human nature, exploring themes of trauma, morality, and redemption in a thought-provoking and intense manner.

overview: A kindly occupational therapist undergoes a new procedure to be shrunken to four inches tall so that he and his wife can help save the planet and afford a nice lifestyle at the same time.
tagline: We are meant for something bigger.
title: Downsizing
plot:
Downsizing is a 2017 American satirical science fiction comedy film directed by Alexander Payne. The movie stars Matt Damon, Kristen Wiig, Rinko Kikuchi, and Christoph Waltz.

The main themes of Downsizing can be summarized as follows:

1. **Environmentalism and Consumerism**: The film critiques the excesses of modern consumer culture and the environmental degradation caused by human activities. The story takes place in a world where overpopulation and climate change have become catastrophic, prompting scientists to discover a way to shrink humans to a tiny size, allowing them to live in luxurious communities built into natural environments.

2. **Social Class and Inequality**: Downsizing explores the theme of social class and inequality through the characters' experiences. The wealthy elite can afford to downsize and live in luxury, while the working class is left behind. This highlights the disparities in wealth and privilege in society.

3. **Identity and Human Connection**: As the characters navigate their new lives in the downsized communities, they must confront their own identities and relationships. The film shows how people form connections with each other despite their physical size, highlighting the importance of human relationships in a world where material possessions are no longer relevant.

4. **Existentialism and Mortality**: Downsizing also explores existential themes, particularly mortality. The characters' experiences force them to confront their own mortality and the meaning of life. This is reflected in Paul Safranek's (Matt Damon) journey as he navigates his new life and grapples with the consequences of his choices.

5. **Critique of Capitalism**: The film critiques the excesses of capitalism, particularly in the way it prioritizes profit over people and the environment. The downsized communities are built on a model of luxury and consumption, highlighting the absurdity of a system that values material wealth above all else.

Overall, Downsizing is a thought-provoking satire that uses humor and wit to critique various aspects of modern society, from environmentalism and consumerism to social class and existentialism.

overview: A documentary on the life of Amy Winehouse, the immensely talented yet doomed songstress. We see her from her teen years, where she already showed her singing abilities, to her finding success and then her downward spiral into alcoholism and drugs.
tagline: The girl behind the name.
title: Amy
plot:
Amy is a 2015 British documentary directed by Asif Kapadia, the filmmaker behind Senna, and produced by James Gay-Rees. It traces the life of the English singer-songwriter Amy Winehouse, from her teenage years through her rise to fame to the addiction that led to her death from alcohol poisoning at her Camden home in July 2011, at the age of 27. Billed as the singer in her own words, it was instigated by Universal Music UK, whose chief executive David Joseph announced the project in early 2015.

The film opens with a 1998 home video of a 14-year-old Winehouse singing with her friend Juliette Ashby at a birthday party in Southgate, London, and then follows her story chronologically: her childhood, her breakthrough with the albums Frank (2003) and Back to Black (2006), her turbulent relationships, including her marriage to Blake Fielder-Civil, and her struggles with self-harm, bulimia, drugs, alcohol and relentless media scrutiny. Kapadia built the narrative from more than 100 interviews with friends, family and collaborators, laid over a wealth of previously unseen archive footage and unreleased recordings. Among the material are her Island Records audition in 2003, a cover of "Moon River" recorded when she was 16 with the National Youth Jazz Orchestra, home movies and holiday tapes, television interviews, her 2008 Grammy Awards performance, beamed live from London, where she won Record of the Year, and her 2011 recording of "Body and Soul" with Tony Bennett, her last session. The film also includes outtakes from her chaotic final concert in Belgrade a month before she died, and closes with Ashby recalling their last phone call, footage from the aftermath of her death and her funeral, and a montage set to Antonio Pinto's "Amy Forever".

Amy premiered in the Midnight Screenings section at Cannes in May 2015 and was released in the UK on 3 July, setting a record for the biggest opening weekend of a British documentary. It earned wide acclaim, with 95% approval on Rotten Tomatoes and a Metacritic score of 85, and won 30 awards, among them the Academy Award for Best Documentary Feature, the BAFTA for Best Documentary, the European Film Award for Best Documentary and the Grammy for Best Music Film. Winehouse's father, Mitch, objected to his portrayal and called the film misleading, while still praising its footage of his daughter.

overview: Two young lovers rob their way across the southland, posting their exploits to social media, and gaining fame and followers as a result.
tagline: Viral fame is a dangerous game.
title: Infamous
plot:
Infamous is a 2020 American crime thriller written and directed by Joshua Caldwell. Bella Thorne stars as Arielle, a young woman obsessed with social media fame, with Jake Manley as her boyfriend Dean, Amber Riley, Michael Sirow and Marisa Coughlan. The film was released by Vertical Entertainment on 12 June 2020.

Arielle lives in a small Florida town with her mother, Janet, and Janet's deadbeat boyfriend, Bobby. She dreams of escaping to Hollywood and becoming famous, but her social media accounts have few followers.
