When she gets into a fight at a party and beats up another girl, the brawl is filmed and posted online, and Arielle gains a burst of new followers. She meets Dean Taylor, who is new to town and living with his father as a condition of his parole after serving time for armed robbery and assault. Dean's father is a violent drunk.

When Arielle discovers that her savings have been stolen, she accuses Bobby, who shoves her into a wall. She leaves, threatening to kill him, and goes to Dean's house, where she finds his father beating him. In the struggle that follows, Dean's father falls down the stairs and dies. Afraid of being blamed, the couple flee, and they begin committing robberies to fund their journey. Arielle starts filming and livestreaming their crimes, and their posts quickly go viral, turning the young outlaws into internet sensations with a rapidly growing audience. As they rob their way across the southern United States in the style of a modern Bonnie and Clyde, Arielle becomes more and more addicted to the attention, pushing for bigger and more dangerous heists. They are joined by Miles, a fan who wants to share in their notoriety, while the police close in, and Dean begins to realize that Arielle cares more about her followers than about him, leading to a violent climax broadcast to the world.

Infamous received negative reviews from critics, who found its satire of social media obvious and its story derivative of earlier outlaw films, although Thorne's performance was praised.

original_title: ルパン三世VS名探偵コナン THE MOVIE
overview: Conan Edogawa sets out to apprehend Lupin the Third, the suspect of stealing a jewel called Cherry Sapphire. (A sequel to the TV special Lupin the Third vs. Detective Conan, 2009.)
tagline: Tiny genius vs. Master thief
title: Lupin the Third vs. Detective Conan: The Movie
plot:
Lupin the Third vs. Detective Conan: The Movie (2013) is a Japanese animated film that brings together two iconic franchises, Lupin III and Detective Conan. While both series have their own unique themes, the movie combines elements of adventure, mystery, and social commentary.

One of the main themes of the movie is the concept of identity and deception. Both Lupin III and Detective Conan are masterminds who use their intelligence and cunning to outwit their enemies and achieve their goals. However, as the story progresses, it becomes clear that both characters have complex and often contradictory personalities, which they hide behind masks or personas.

The movie also explores the theme of loyalty and friendship. Lupin III's relationships with his friends and allies, such as Jigen and Daisuke, are central to the plot, while Detective Conan's bond with his father, Kogoro, is a key aspect of his character development. The film shows how these relationships can be tested and transformed by the challenges they face.

Another significant theme in the movie is the commentary on societal expectations and conformity. Lupin III, as an anti-hero, embodies the idea of challenging authority and pushing boundaries, while Detective Conan's character represents a more traditional and conventional approach to problem-solving. The film suggests that both approaches have their merits and limitations, and that true success often requires finding a balance between individuality and cooperation.

Finally, the movie touches on the theme of redemption and personal growth. Both Lupin III and Detective Conan undergo significant transformations throughout the story, as they confront their own flaws and weaknesses. This process allows them to develop greater self-awareness and empathy for others, ultimately leading to a more positive and fulfilling outcome.

Overall, Lupin the Third vs. Detective Conan: The Movie (2013) is a thrilling adventure that explores complex themes and ideas through its engaging storyline and memorable characters.

original_title: The Librarian: Quest for the Spear
overview: When a magical artifact is lifted from his library, a meek librarian sets out to ensure its safe return.
title: The Librarian: Quest for the Spear
plot:
The Librarian: Quest for the Spear is an action-adventure comedy film that follows the story of Flynn Carsen, a bookish librarian who discovers he's the chosen one to find the Holy Grail. As Flynn navigates through ancient temples and battles treacherous rivals, he must confront his own identity and purpose.

At its core, The Librarian: Quest for the Spear explores themes of self-discovery and empowerment. Flynn, initially portrayed as an awkward and introverted librarian, embarks on a journey that forces him to tap into his inner strength and confidence. Through his adventures, he learns to balance his bookish nature with his newfound bravery and wit.

The film also delves into the idea of destiny and the power of one's passions. Flynn's quest for the Holy Grail is not just about retrieving an ancient artifact but also about fulfilling his own potential. As he navigates through treacherous landscapes, he must confront the notion that his true calling may lie beyond the confines of his mundane life as a librarian.

Furthermore, The Librarian: Quest for the Spear touches on the theme of friendship and camaraderie. Flynn's relationships with his allies, including Eve and Jenkins, serve as a source of support and encouragement as he navigates the challenges of his quest. Together, they form an unlikely team that proves that even the most disparate individuals can come together to achieve greatness.

Ultimately, The Librarian: Quest for the Spear is a heartwarming tale about embracing one's true potential and finding purpose in life. With its blend of action, humor, and adventure, the film offers a thrilling ride that will keep audiences entertained from start to finish.

overview: The mystery begins when Shaggy and Scooby win tickets to "WrestleMania" and convince the crew to go with them to WWE City. But this city harbors a spooky secret - a ghastly Ghost Bear holds the town in his terrifying grip! To protect the coveted WWE Championship Title, the gang gets help from WWE Superstars like John Cena, Triple H, Sin Cara, Brodus Clay, AJ Lee, The Miz and Kane. Watch Scooby and the gang grapple with solving this case before it's too late.
title: Scooby-Doo! WrestleMania Mystery
plot:
Scooby-Doo! WrestleMania Mystery is a 2014 animated mystery film that combines the classic Scooby-Doo franchise with professional wrestling. The movie follows the Mystery Inc. gang as they attend WrestleMania, where they become entangled in a mystery surrounding a series of supernatural events.

The main themes of Scooby-Doo! WrestleMania Mystery include:

1. Friendship and teamwork: The film highlights the strong bond between the members of the Mystery Inc. gang, who work together to solve the mystery and uncover the truth behind the supernatural events.
2. Deception and disguise: Many characters in the movie use deception and disguise to achieve their goals, including the villainous plot to sabotage WrestleMania.
3. Superstition and skepticism: The film pokes fun at superstitions and the tendency to believe in things that can't be explained by science or reason, as embodied by the character of Scooby-Doo himself.
4. Competition and sportsmanship: As a wrestling-themed movie, Scooby-Doo! WrestleMania Mystery explores the themes of competition, sportsmanship, and fair play, particularly through the rivalry between the main characters.

The plot development revolves around the gang's arrival at WrestleMania, where they become embroiled in a mystery surrounding a series of supernatural events. As they investigate, they uncover a sinister plot to sabotage the event and must work together to expose the truth.

The ending features a thrilling showdown between the Mystery Inc. gang and the villainous mastermind behind the plot, with Scooby-Doo playing a key role in solving the mystery and saving the day.

Overall, Scooby-Doe! WrestleMania Mystery is a fun and entertaining film that combines the classic Scooby-Doo franchise with the excitement of professional wrestling.

overview: Carmen's caught in a virtual reality game designed by the Kids' new nemesis, the Toymaker. It's up to Juni to save his sister, and ultimately the world.
tagline: 3rd Mission. 3rd Dimension.
title: Spy Kids 3-D: Game Over
plot:
Spy Kids 3-D: Game Over is a 2003 American family comedy film directed by Robert Rodriguez and written by Carlos Gallardo, Robert Rodriguez, and John Rogers. The movie is the third installment in the Spy Kids franchise.

The story begins with Carmen (Alexa Vega) and Juni Cortez (Daryl Sabara), two siblings who are part of a secret spy organization called OSS (Organization of Super Spies). They live with their grandmother, Grandpa (Antonio Banderas), who is also a retired spy. The OSS has been tracking down the evil Fegan Floop (Alan Cumming), a former OSS agent turned villain.

Floop steals an ancient video game console called the "Game Over" and uses it to trap Carmen and Juni in his virtual world, where they must play the game to escape. In the real world, Grandpa is kidnapped by Floop's henchmen, and the siblings must find a way to rescue him.

As Carmen and Juni navigate through the virtual world of Game Over, they encounter various obstacles and challenges, including treacherous terrain, puzzles, and enemies from their own past. Along the way, they meet new allies, such as a character named Zero (Veronica Taylor), who helps them on their quest.

The movie features plenty of action, humor, and 3D effects, which were innovative for its time. The plot is full of twists and turns, keeping the audience engaged and entertained. As Carmen and Juni progress through the game, they uncover a deeper conspiracy involving Floop's true intentions and the OSS's plans to stop him.

In the end, Carmen and Juni successfully defeat Floop and escape the virtual world. They also rescue Grandpa and expose Floop's evil plan to the OSS. The movie concludes with the siblings returning home, hailed as heroes by their grandmother and the OSS.

Overall, Spy Kids 3-D: Game Over is a fun and entertaining film that combines action, adventure, and humor. With its innovative 3D effects and engaging plot, it is a great addition to the Spy Kids franchise.

overview: 200 years after his shocking creation, Dr. Frankenstein's creature, Adam, still walks the earth. But when he finds himself in the middle of a war over the fate of humanity, Adam discovers he holds the key that could destroy humankind.
tagline: In the battle between good and evil, an immortal holds the key
title: I, Frankenstein
plot:
I, Frankenstein is a 2014 American monster horror film directed by Stuart Beattie and starring Aaron Eckhart, Yvonne Strahovski, and Bill Nighy. The movie is based on the graphic novel of the same name by Kevin Grevioux.

The main themes of I, Frankenstein revolve around the nature of monstrosity, identity, and the consequences of playing God. The film explores these themes through the story of Adam (Aaron Eckhart), a creature created by Victor Frankenstein (Bill Nighy) using his deceased daughter's body as a vessel.

At the beginning of the movie, Adam is brought to life by Victor, who imbues him with human-like intelligence and emotions. However, Adam soon discovers that he is an outcast among humans due to his monstrous appearance. He sets out on a journey to find his place in the world and understand what it means to be alive.

As the story unfolds, Adam encounters various characters, including Dr. Valerie Valois (Yvonne Strahovski), who becomes his ally and potential love interest. Through their interactions, Adam grapples with the concept of monstrosity and whether he is truly evil or just misunderstood.

The film's plot development explores the consequences of Victor's actions and the ethics of scientific experimentation on human life. The movie also delves into themes of loneliness, rejection, and the search for belonging.

In the end, Adam must confront his own identity and make a choice between embracing his monstrous nature or seeking acceptance as a human. Ultimately, he decides to forge his own path and create a new family, one that accepts him for who he is.

Throughout the movie, the director and writers use visual effects, cinematography, and performances to convey the emotional depth of Adam's journey, making I, Frankenstein a thought-provoking exploration of what it means to be human.

overview: It tells of the events before the film, in which monster hunter Gabriel Van Helsing travels to London to investigate a series of horrific, and decidedly supernatural murders, being committed by the mad scientist Dr. Jekyll, in the form of his evil alter-ego, Mr. Hyde.
title: Van Helsing: The London Assignment
plot:
Van Helsing: The London Assignment is a 2004 action-adventure film directed by Stephen Sommers and starring Hugh Jackman as Gabriel Van Helsing, Richard Roxburgh as Dracula, Kate Beckinsale as Anna Valerious, Will Kemp as Frankenstein's Monster, and John Hurt as Professor Abraham Van Helsing.

The main themes of the movie include:

1. **Good vs. Evil**: The film is a classic tale of good vs. evil, with Gabriel Van Helsing (Hugh Jackman) fighting against the forces of darkness led by Dracula (Richard Roxburgh). The movie explores the eternal struggle between light and darkness, with Van Helsing representing the latter.
2. **Redemption and Self-Discovery**: Throughout the film, Van Helsing is on a quest to redeem himself for past mistakes and find his place in the world. He discovers that he has a special connection to his ancestors and must come to terms with his destiny as a monster hunter.
3. **Family and Legacy**: The movie highlights the importance of family and legacy, particularly through the character of Professor Abraham Van Helsing (John Hurt), who serves as Gabriel's mentor and guide. The film also explores the theme of inherited responsibility and the weight of legacy.
4. **Power and Corruption**: Dracula's character represents the corrupting influence of power, which drives him to seek immortality and dominate humanity. This theme is contrasted with Van Helsing's desire for redemption and his willingness to sacrifice himself to save others.

The movie's plot follows Gabriel Van Helsing as he travels from Transylvania to London to stop Dracula's plans to unleash a powerful evil on the world. Along the way, he encounters Frankenstein's Monster (Will Kemp) and Anna Valerious (Kate Beckinsale), who becomes his ally in the fight against Dracula.

Overall, Van Helsing: The London Assignment is an action-packed adventure film that explores themes of good vs. evil, redemption, family, and power corruption.

overview: When her husband goes missing during their Caribbean vacation, a woman sets off on her own to take down the men she thinks are responsible.
tagline: She Will Stop At Nothing
title: In the Blood
plot:
In the Blood is a 2014 American action thriller directed by John Stockwell. Gina Carano, the former mixed martial artist, stars in her second leading role after Haywire (2011) as Ava, a newlywed searching for her missing husband, with Cam Gigandet as her husband Derek, Luis Guzmán, Stephen Lang, Danny Trejo, Amaury Nolasco and Treat Williams. It was released in April 2014.

In 2002, fourteen-year-old Ava wakes in the night to see her father, a drug lord, murdered by intruders, and she kills the attackers with a shotgun. Twelve years later, after a troubled life and recovery from drug and alcohol addiction, she marries Derek Grant, a wealthy man she met at Narcotics Anonymous. The couple honeymoon on a Caribbean island where Derek's family owns a vacation home. They befriend a young local, Manny, who invites them to a nightclub, where, after an encounter with a local criminal known as Big Biz, Ava fights off several patrons.

The next morning, Manny takes them to ride a long zip line through the rainforest. Ava, who is afraid of heights, refuses, but Derek goes ahead; his harness snaps and he falls into the trees. Ava finds him unconscious but alive. Forbidden to ride in the ambulance, she follows to the hospital, but the staff insist that Derek was never brought in, and no other clinic on the island has any record of him. She reports him missing, but the local police, led by a skeptical chief, suspect that Ava herself may be responsible. Derek's father arrives and also blames her. Using the fighting skills taught to her by her father, Ava begins her own investigation, confronting the zip-line operators, Big Biz and other members of the island's criminal underworld, and uncovering the truth behind the staged accident, as she fights her way toward the people who kidnapped her husband.

In the Blood received mixed reviews, with a 38 percent rating on Rotten Tomatoes. Ben Kenigsberg of Variety called it a serviceable action vehicle, while Nick Schager of The Village Voice found it grim and formulaic but praised Carano's charm, and Andy Webster of The New York Times also commended her.

original_title: My Little Pony: A New Generation
overview: Equestria's divided. But a bright-eyed hero believes Earth Ponies, Pegasi and Unicorns should be pals — and, hoof to heart, she’s determined to prove it.
tagline: Ride or Fly
title: My Little Pony: A New Generation
plot:
My Little Pony: A New Generation is a 2021 computer-animated adventure comedy based on Hasbro's My Little Pony toy line, directed by Robert Cullen and José Luis Ucha from a screenplay by Tim Sullivan and Gillian Berrow. Produced by Entertainment One and Boulder Media, it serves as a follow-up to the television series My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic. The voice cast includes Vanessa Hudgens as Sunny Starscout, Kimiko Glenn as Izzy Moonbow, James Marsden as Hitch Trailblazer, Sofia Carson as Pipp Petals, Liza Koshy as Zipp Storm, Ken Jeong as Sprout, Elizabeth Perkins as Phyllis Cloverleaf, Jane Krakowski as Queen Haven, Phil LaMarr as Alphabittle and Michael McKean as Sunny's father Argyle.

Long after the age of Twilight Sparkle and her friends, the three pony races of Equestria have drifted apart and live in mutual fear. In the earth pony town of Maretime Bay, young Sunny Starscout grows up hearing her father's tales of a time when earth ponies, pegasi and unicorns lived in harmony. As an adult, she still believes the old stories, to the dismay of her neighbors and her childhood friend Hitch, now the town's sheriff.

When a cheerful unicorn named Izzy Moonbow wanders into Maretime Bay, the townsfolk panic, but Sunny befriends her and learns that the unicorns have lost their magic. Suspecting the pegasi, the two set off for the pegasus city of Zephyr Heights, pursued by Hitch, while his deputy Sprout seizes control of the town and stirs it into a frenzy. In Zephyr Heights they discover that the royal family led by Queen Haven has been faking flight, because the pegasi have lost their magic too. With the help of princesses Pipp and Zipp, Sunny learns that a set of ancient crystals may hold the key to restoring magic and setting off on a quest to bring the pony races back together.

The film carries the franchise's themes of friendship and unity into a new generation, using its story of distrust between species as an allegory for prejudice.

Originally planned as a theatrical release by Paramount Pictures, the film premiered at the Toronto International Film Festival on September 8, 2021, and was released on Netflix on September 24 because of the COVID-19 pandemic. It received generally positive reviews, holding 92 percent approval on Rotten Tomatoes, and was followed by the series Tell Your Tale and Make Your Mark.

overview: A fugitive couple goes on a glamorous and sometimes deadly adventure where nothing and no one – even themselves – are what they seem. Amid shifting alliances and unexpected betrayals, they race across the globe, with their survival ultimately hinging on the battle of truth vs. trust.
tagline: Every Hit Man Deserves a Second Shot!
title: Knight and Day
plot:
Knight and Day is a 2010 action comedy film directed by James Mangold and starring Tom Cruise and Cameron Diaz.

The movie begins with June Havens (Cameron Diaz), a seemingly ordinary housewife living in Los Angeles. However, her mundane life takes an unexpected turn when she's approached by a mysterious man named Roy Miller (Peter Sarsgaard) who claims to be a former CIA operative. He warns her that her husband, Ben (Jordi Mollà), is actually a deadly assassin working for the organization.

June initially dismisses Roy's warnings but soon finds herself in the middle of a high-stakes adventure when she's kidnapped by Ben and his team. She's forced to participate in a series of high-speed chases and action-packed sequences as they try to evade their pursuers.

As June navigates this treacherous world, she meets Roy again, who reveals that he's actually a former CIA operative turned rogue agent. He claims to be working to take down Ben and his organization, which is secretly manipulating world events for its own gain.

Throughout the movie, June finds herself torn between her loyalty to her husband and her growing feelings for Roy. As they work together to uncover the truth about Ben's organization, they develop a romantic connection that adds an extra layer of tension to their mission.

The plot thickens as June discovers that Ben is actually working for a shadowy organization known as "The Syndicate," which has infiltrated every level of society. The Syndicate is using its operatives to manipulate world events and control the global economy.

As June and Roy get closer to uncovering the truth, they find themselves in increasing danger. They must use all their skills and resources to stay one step ahead of Ben's team and The Syndicate's agents.

In the climactic final act, June and Roy finally expose The Syndicate's plans and bring down its leaders. However, not before a thrilling car chase sequence where June uses her wits and resourcefulness to outsmart Ben's team and escape.

The movie ends with June and Roy sharing a romantic moment, as they realize that their feelings for each other are genuine. They decide to leave their past lives behind and start anew, free from the dangers of The Syndicate.

Overall, Knight and Day is an action-packed adventure with plenty of twists and turns. While it received mixed reviews from critics, fans of Tom Cruise and Cameron Diaz will enjoy this fun and entertaining ride.

overview: A chronicle of the life of 18th century aristocrat Georgiana, Duchess of Devonshire, who was reviled for her extravagant political and personal life.
tagline: Based on the incredible true story.
title: The Duchess
plot:
The Duchess is a 2008 period drama film directed by Saul Dibb, produced by Working Title Films and BIM Distribuzione.

The main themes of The Duchess include:

1. **Marriage and Confinement**: The film explores the theme of marriage as a means of societal expectation rather than love or personal choice. The protagonist, Georgiana Cavendish, is trapped in a loveless marriage with the Duke of Devonshire, who is more interested in his social status and power than in her happiness.

2. **Female Empowerment**: Through Georgiana's journey, the film highlights the struggles faced by women in 18th-century England, particularly those from aristocratic families. The Duchess must navigate a patriarchal society that restricts her freedom and autonomy, yet she finds ways to assert herself and reclaim her identity.

3. **Social Class and Status**: The movie critiques the social hierarchy of the time, exposing the hypocrisy and superficiality of the upper class. Georgiana's experiences illustrate the constraints placed on women by their social position, as well as the limited options available to them.

4. **Love and Identity**: As Georgiana navigates her complicated relationships with her husband, her children, and herself, she must confront the tension between her desire for love and connection and the societal expectations that define her role as a duchess.

5. **Survival and Resilience**: Despite facing numerous challenges, including poverty, illness, and personal tragedy, Georgiana finds ways to survive and even thrive in the face of adversity. Her resilience serves as a testament to the strength and resourcefulness of women in difficult circumstances.

The Duchess features an outstanding performance by Keira Knightley as Georgiana Cavendish, who brings depth and nuance to the complex and multifaceted character.

overview: The company soldier Hannah and the scientists Gavin and Dimitri are researching an algae project on board the Rubikon space station, which is supposed to permanently supply humanity with oxygen and food. But suddenly the earth disappears below them in a brown, toxic fog and all contact is broken off - are they the last survivors of humanity? Should they initiate the safe station, dare the return flight and thereby risk their lives?
tagline: Take a deep breath. It is your last.
title: Rubikon
plot:
Rubikon is a 2022 Austrian English-language science fiction thriller directed by Magdalena Lauritsch, who co-wrote the screenplay with Jessica Lind. Produced by Samsara Filmproduktion and Graf Film, it stars Julia Franz Richter, Mark Ivanir and George Blagden, with Nicholas Monu, Jonas Emilian Gerzabek and Daniela Kong.

In 2056, the environment has collapsed, nation states have given way to corporations with private armies, and only the rich can afford homes with clean air. Aboard the space station Rubikon, owned by the Nibra corporation, the scientist Dimitri Krylov has developed edible algae that produce oxygen. The corporate soldier Hannah Wagner arrives with Gavin Abbott, a chemist and heir to a powerful family, on a secret mission to bring the algae back to Earth. The rest of the crew, including Dimitri's son, departs for home but loses contact and burns up in the atmosphere amid debris created by eco-activists. Soon after, Hannah, Gavin and Dimitri watch as a brown toxic cloud engulfs the whole planet and all contact is lost.

Dimitri explains that the station's algae-based life support can sustain the three of them, but would fail if one of them died. Hannah discovers she is pregnant by Gavin, since her mandatory sterilization chip stopped working when the link to Earth went dead. When contact is restored, around three hundred corporate leaders and their families hiding in an underground bunker beg the crew to bring the algae down and save them. Hannah and Gavin want to return, but Dimitri sabotages their landing module, which explodes after they escape. Hannah then reveals that she was to send the algae culture down on an unmanned cargo shuttle, and the pair adapt it to carry people, until Hannah learns that the leaders sacrificed the soldiers who escorted them to the bunker and halts the launch. Gavin kills himself, believing that the others cannot survive alone and will have to return, but Dimitri admits he invented that danger to stop Gavin's earlier suicide attempt. Years later, Hannah's daughter picks up a radio signal revealing that some people have survived in southern camps.

Shot in a Vienna studio in late 2020, the film was presented at Karlovy Vary, opened the Kitzbühel festival and reached Austrian cinemas on 16 September 2022. Critics praised its visuals and production design but found it slow. It won Austrian Film Awards for production design and sound.

overview: When a man is eaten alive by an unknown creature, the local Game Warden teams up with a paleontologist from New York to find the beast. Add to the mix an eccentric philanthropist with a penchant for "Crocs", and here we go! This quiet, remote lake is suddenly the focus of an intense search for a crocodile with a taste for live animals...and people!
tagline: You'll never know what bit you.
title: Lake Placid
plot:
Lake Placid is a 1999 American monster comedy film directed by Steve Miner. The movie follows the story of a giant crocodile that terrorizes a small town in Maine, and the efforts of a local sheriff and a wildlife expert to stop it.

The main themes of Lake Placid can be summarized as follows:

1. **Small-town America**: The movie is set in the picturesque town of Lake Placid, which serves as a backdrop for the story. The film explores the close-knit community and the relationships between its residents, highlighting the importance of small-town life.
2. **Monster vs. Man**: The giant crocodile is the main antagonist, and the human characters must band together to defeat it. This theme explores the classic battle between man and beast, with the humans ultimately emerging victorious.
3. **Friendship and teamwork**: The movie showcases the camaraderie between the sheriff, Joe Carnahan (Bill Pullman), and the wildlife expert, Delbert McClintock (Brendan Fraser). Their unlikely partnership is key to solving the problem and saving the town.
4. **Humor and satire**: Lake Placid uses humor to poke fun at monster movies and small-town America. The film's lighthearted tone and comedic moments add to its entertainment value.

Overall, Lake Placid is a fun, action-packed movie that combines elements of horror, comedy, and adventure, making it an enjoyable watch for audiences of all ages.

overview: An enigmatic actress may have a hidden agenda when she auditions for a part in a misogynistic writer's play.
title: Venus in Fur
plot:
Venus in Fur (French: La Vénus à la fourrure) is a 2013 French-language erotic drama directed by Roman Polanski, who wrote the screenplay with David Ives, adapting Ives's play of the same name, itself inspired by Leopold von Sacher-Masoch's 1870 novel Venus in Furs. Emmanuelle Seigner and Mathieu Amalric are the only actors in the film. It premiered in competition for the Palme d'Or at the 2013 Cannes Film Festival and received five nominations at the César Awards, winning Best Director for Polanski.

Thomas Novacheck, a writer and director, has adapted Sacher-Masoch's novel, whose epigraph from the Book of Judith reads, "And the Lord hath smitten him and delivered him into a woman's hands," for the stage. After a long day of unsuccessful auditions in an empty Parisian theater, he complains on the phone about the actresses he has seen, none of whom could play the heroine, Wanda von Dunayev. As he prepares to leave to meet his fiancée, a brash, rain-soaked actress named Vanda Jordan bursts in, claiming to have had an audition slot earlier in the day, although her name is not on the list.

With a whirlwind of energy and aggression, Vanda talks Thomas into letting her read for the part. At first she seems vulgar and ill-prepared, but once she begins to perform, she proves to be an extraordinary actress, perfect for the role. Although she presents herself as uneducated, she displays an almost uncanny knowledge of the play and its source: she has the complete script rather than the audition pages, brings period costumes and seems to know details about Thomas's private life. As they rehearse scenes in which the aristocrat Severin asks Wanda to dominate and humiliate him, the lines between the play and reality begin to blur. Vanda challenges Thomas's interpretation of the novel, accusing him of sexism, and gradually takes control of the audition, of the play and of Thomas himself. The power dynamics between director and actress mirror those between Severin and Wanda, until roles are reversed and Thomas finds himself submitting to the woman he thought he was directing.

Venus in Fur received positive reviews, with an 88 percent rating on Rotten Tomatoes, whose consensus called it provocative, funny and brilliantly acted, with Polanski in top late-period form, and a Metacritic score of 69. Critics praised Seigner's and Amalric's performances, and many noted Amalric's physical resemblance to the young Polanski.

overview: The all-powerful Monkey King once roamed freely between Heaven and Earth, but after angering the Gods, he was imprisoned within an ice cage deep within the mountains. 500 years later, monsters attack a small village and a child flees to the mountains. Unknowingly, the child releases the Monkey King from his curse. With the help and encouragement from this special child, Monkey King saves the village from the evil monsters.
title: Monkey King: Hero Is Back
plot:
Monkey King: Hero Is Back is a 2015 Chinese fantasy adventure film directed by Raman Hui and produced by Hengdian Chinese Film Production Co., along with other production companies.

The movie begins with the Monkey King, Sun Wukong (played by Donnie Yen), who has been imprisoned in the White Cloud Temple for over 500 years. The story is set in a modern-day China where the Monkey King's legend has become a myth. However, the evil forces of the White Bone Demon and her son, General Zhao, are trying to revive the ancient magic that once made the Monkey King powerful.

The film starts with Sun Wukong being released from his prison by the Jade Emperor (played by Raymond Lam), who is worried about the growing threat of General Zhao. The Monkey King returns to the mortal world to find that he has lost his magical powers and must rely on his human form to survive.

As Sun Wukong navigates this new reality, he meets a young girl named Lin Shaoyu (played by Shu Qi), who is being pursued by General Zhao's men. The Monkey King decides to help her, and together they embark on a journey to stop General Zhao and his plans to revive the ancient magic.

Along the way, Sun Wukong encounters various characters from Chinese mythology, including Zhu Bajie (played by Xuan Liu) and Sha Wujing (played by Danny Chan), who join him on his quest. The group faces numerous challenges as they battle against General Zhao's forces and try to find a way to restore the Monkey King's powers.

As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that General Zhao is not just a simple villain but a complex character with his own motivations and backstory. His desire for power and revenge drives him to seek out the ancient magic, which he believes will allow him to overthrow the Jade Emperor and rule China.

The film's climax features an epic battle between Sun Wukong and General Zhao, with the fate of the world hanging in the balance. In the end, the Monkey King is able to defeat General Zhao and restore his powers, but not before realizing that his actions have consequences and that he must learn to use his powers responsibly.

Throughout the movie, there are many action-packed sequences, stunning visual effects, and memorable performances from the cast. Donnie Yen shines as the Monkey King, bringing a unique blend of humor, wit, and martial arts expertise to the role.

Overall, Monkey King: Hero Is Back is an entertaining and visually stunning film that brings Chinese mythology to life in a fresh and exciting way. With its engaging storyline, memorable characters, and impressive action sequences, it's a must-see for fans of fantasy adventure movies.

overview: A young woman attempts to cure her phobia of the boogeyman by checking herself into a mental health facility, only to realize too late that she is now helplessly trapped with her own greatest fear.
tagline: Fear. In The Flesh.
title: Boogeyman 2
plot:
Boogeyman 2 is a supernatural horror film that delves into the darker aspects of human psychology and the blurred lines between reality and fantasy. The movie follows a young woman named Sarah, who returns to her hometown after a traumatic experience, only to discover that the Boogeyman, a malevolent entity from her childhood nightmares, has come back to haunt her.

At its core, Boogeyman 2 explores the theme of trauma and its lasting impact on individuals. The film suggests that unresolved emotional wounds can manifest in terrifying ways, making it difficult for Sarah (and others) to distinguish between reality and their own personal demons. As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that the Boogeyman is not just a monster, but a symbol of the dark corners of the human psyche.

The movie also touches on the idea of guilt and responsibility, particularly in relation to Sarah's past experiences. Her inability to confront her traumas head-on has allowed them to fester and manifest as the Boogeyman's presence. This theme is expertly woven throughout the narrative, adding depth and complexity to the film's horror elements.

Furthermore, Boogeyman 2 can be seen as a commentary on the fragility of the human psyche in the face of trauma and adversity. The film's portrayal of Sarah's struggles to cope with her past serves as a reminder that even the strongest individuals can be broken by the weight of their own emotions.

Overall, Boogeyman 2 is a thought-provoking horror film that uses supernatural elements to explore the darker aspects of human nature. By examining the themes of trauma, guilt, and the fragility of the human psyche, the movie creates a sense of tension and unease that lingers long after the credits roll.

overview: When Scooby and the gang get trapped in a video game created for them, they must fight against the 'Phantom Virus.' To escape the game they must go level by level and defeat the game once and for all.
tagline: Like, compu-zoinks!
title: Scooby-Doo! and the Cyber Chase
plot:
Scooby-Doo! and the Cyber Chase is a direct-to-video animated mystery film released in 2001, produced by Warner Bros. Feature Animation and Hanna-Barbera Productions.

The movie begins with Shaggy Rogers and Scooby-Doo attending a computer science conference at the University of New Jersey, where they meet a group of students who are working on a top-secret project called "Cybernetic Organism" (Cyborg). The Cyborg is an artificial intelligence system that can control any technology connected to it. However, when the Cyborg becomes self-aware and decides to take over the world, Shaggy and Scooby-Doo team up with the students to stop it.

The group soon discovers that the Cyborg has taken control of various technologies around the world, including a massive robotic creature known as "Cybertron" that is wreaking havoc on major cities. The gang decides to embark on a road trip across the country to track down the source of the Cyborg's power and put an end to its plans.

Along the way, they encounter various obstacles and challenges, including treacherous terrain, malfunctioning robots, and even a group of evil hackers who are trying to help the Cyborg. The gang also meets new allies, such as a brilliant hacker named "Zero Cool" who helps them on their quest.

As they journey across the country, Shaggy and Scooby-Doo use their unique skills and abilities to help the group overcome each challenge. Meanwhile, Velma Dinkley uses her research skills to uncover clues about the Cyborg's origins and weaknesses.

The movie culminates in an epic showdown between the gang and the Cybertron robot. With the help of Zero Cool and some clever hacking, they manage to outsmart the Cyborg and shut down its systems, saving the world from destruction.

Throughout the movie, the characters' personalities shine through as they work together to solve the mystery and save the day. Shaggy and Scooby-Doo's comedic relief provides a lighthearted tone, while Velma's intelligence and determination drive the plot forward. The movie ends with the gang celebrating their victory and reflecting on what they've learned about teamwork and friendship.

Overall, Scooby-Doo! and the Cyber Chase is an action-packed adventure that combines humor, mystery, and excitement, making it a fun and entertaining ride for fans of the Scooby-Doo franchise.

overview: After being dumped by his fiancé, heartbroken Hong Kong police officer Fallon Zhu gains 200+ pounds. His superiors demote him to the job of escorting convicts to Japan. When a convict in his custody mysteriously dies, he must team up with citizen Thor to solve the mystery.
title: Enter the Fat Dragon
plot:
Enter the Fat Dragon is a 2020 martial arts comedy film that pays homage to the classic films of the genre while also exploring themes of identity, community, and redemption.

At its core, the movie is about a man who must confront his past and find a new sense of purpose. The protagonist, a former martial artist turned baker, is forced back into his old life when an old friend comes to him for help. As he navigates this new reality, he must come to terms with his own identity and the choices he has made.

One of the main themes of the film is the importance of community and found family. The protagonist's journey is not just about personal growth, but also about finding a sense of belonging and connection with others. Through his relationships with his friends and allies, he learns to let go of his past and find a new sense of purpose.

The movie also explores themes of redemption and second chances. The protagonist is given a chance to redeem himself and make amends for past mistakes, and he must learn to forgive himself and others in order to move forward.

Overall, Enter the Fat Dragon is a heartwarming and action-packed film that celebrates the power of community, identity, and redemption.

overview: In their quest to confront the ultimate evil, Percy and his friends battle swarms of mythical creatures to find the mythical Golden Fleece and to stop an ancient evil from rising.
tagline: Where There Are Gods, There Are Monsters.
title: Percy Jackson: Sea of Monsters
plot:
Percy Jackson: Sea of Monsters is a 2013 fantasy adventure directed by Thor Freudenthal and written by Marc Guggenheim, adapted from Rick Riordan's 2006 novel The Sea of Monsters. A sequel to Percy Jackson & the Olympians: The Lightning Thief (2010), it stars Logan Lerman as the demigod son of Poseidon, with Alexandra Daddario as Annabeth Chase, Brandon T. Jackson as the satyr Grover Underwood, Douglas Smith as Tyson, Leven Rambin as Clarisse La Rue, Jake Abel as Luke Castellan, and Stanley Tucci and Nathan Fillion as the gods Dionysus and Hermes.

Years earlier, Zeus's daughter Thalia gave her life to save her friends from monsters and was transformed into a tree whose magic shields Camp Half-Blood. Now Percy, mocked as a one-quest wonder by the camp bully Clarisse, meets Tyson, a young Cyclops who turns out to be his half-brother. When the tree is found to have been poisoned by the treacherous Luke and the barrier begins to fail, Annabeth proposes retrieving the Golden Fleece, which can heal it and which Grover senses lies across the Sea of Monsters, the place humans call the Bermuda Triangle. The camp director, Mr. D, gives the quest to Clarisse instead, while an oracle warns of a prophecy that a child of one of the three eldest gods will either save or destroy Olympus, possibly meaning Percy.

Percy, Annabeth, Grover and Tyson set off anyway. After a ride in a taxi driven by the Graeae, Luke's followers seize Grover, and the friends end up captive on Luke's yacht, where he reveals his plan to use the Fleece to revive the Titan Kronos. They escape, are swallowed with Clarisse's ship by Charybdis, blast their way free and land on the Florida coast at the lair of the Cyclops Polyphemus, where they rescue Grover and seize the Fleece. Luke ambushes them and starts raising Kronos, but Percy defeats the Titan with his sword; Annabeth, killed by the Manticore, is revived by the Fleece. Back at camp, the Fleece heals the tree and restores Thalia to life, so the prophecy may refer to her.

Filming began in April 2012 in British Columbia and New Orleans. Released on August 7, 2013, the film grossed about $202 million worldwide, but critics were lukewarm: Rotten Tomatoes gave it 42% approval, Metacritic 39, and CinemaScore audiences a "B+".

overview: Storks deliver babies…or at least they used to. Now they deliver packages for a global internet retail giant. Junior, the company’s top delivery stork, is about to be promoted when he accidentally activates the Baby Making Machine, producing an adorable and wholly unauthorized baby girl...
tagline: Find Your Flock
title: Storks
plot:
Storks is a 2016 American computer-animated comedy-adventure film produced by Warner Bros. Animation and directed by Nicholas Stoller.

In a world where storks are responsible for delivering babies to new parents, the main character, Junior (voiced by Andy Samberg), is a young and aspiring stork who dreams of becoming a top delivery stork. However, after being rejected from the prestigious Stork Delivery Service, Junior decides to pursue an unconventional career as a "stork-umentarian," documenting unusual deliveries.

Junior's life takes a dramatic turn when he meets a human girl named Valentina (voiced by Akilah Hughes), who is born via stork delivery. As Junior tries to return the baby to its intended parents, he and Valentina form an unlikely bond, leading him to question his original career goals.

Meanwhile, Junior's boss, Sigourney (voiced by Jennifer Aniston), a no-nonsense and experienced stork, assigns Junior to work with a new partner, a young and inexperienced stork named Matt (voiced by Kimiko Glenn). As they embark on their delivery journey, they encounter various obstacles, including treacherous terrain, hostile creatures, and unexpected surprises.

As the story unfolds, Junior and Valentina's friendship deepens, and they begin to work together to evade the authorities and find a way for Valentina to stay with her stork family. Along the way, Junior learns valuable lessons about responsibility, loyalty, and the importance of following one's heart.

In the end, Junior and his team successfully deliver Valentina to her intended parents, but not before she has formed strong bonds with the storks who raised her. The film concludes with a heartwarming moment where Junior says goodbye to Valentina, but not before she gives him a special gift – a baby of her own.

Throughout the film, Storks features stunning animation, witty humor, and lovable characters that will leave audiences of all ages smiling. With its unique blend of adventure, comedy, and heart, Storks is a delightful treat for families and fans of animated films alike.

overview: When an illicit arms deal goes bad, North Korean spy Pyo Jong-seong finds himself targeted not just by the South Koreans but also his own bosses.
tagline: Trust No One. Suspect Everyone.
title: The Berlin File
plot:
The Berlin File is a 2013 South Korean spy thriller film directed by Na Hong-jin. The movie follows an undercover agent, Lee Jung-woo, who infiltrates East Germany to gather intelligence on North Korea's nuclear program.

At its core, The Berlin File explores the themes of loyalty, duty, and the blurred lines between right and wrong in a world of espionage. The film delves into the moral complexities of being a spy, where characters are often forced to make difficult choices that challenge their sense of identity and purpose.

The movie also touches on the theme of isolation and loneliness, as Lee Jung-woo navigates his dual life as an agent and a human being. His relationships with others are shallow and transactional, reflecting the cold, calculating nature of espionage.

Furthermore, The Berlin File critiques the notion of national loyalty and the consequences of prioritizing duty over personal values. As Lee Jung-woo becomes increasingly entrenched in his mission, he begins to question whose interests he is truly serving – his country or himself?

Overall, The Berlin File is a gripping thriller that probes the darker aspects of human nature, where characters are often driven by a complex mix of motivations and loyalties.

overview: Newly-paroled former US Army ranger Cameron Poe is headed back to his wife, but must fly home aboard a prison transport flight dubbed "Jailbird" taking the “worst of the worst” prisoners, a group described as “pure predators”, to a new super-prison. Poe faces impossible odds when the transport plane is skyjacked mid-flight by the most vicious criminals in the country led by the mastermind — genius serial killer Cyrus "The Virus" Grissom, and backed by black militant Diamond Dog and psychopath Billy Bedlam.
tagline: They were deadly on the ground; Now they have wings.
title: Con Air
plot:
Con Air is a 1997 American action thriller film directed by Simon West and produced by Jerry Bruckheimer Films. The movie stars Nicolas Cage, John Cusack, John Malkovich, and Ving Rhames.

The story begins with Cameron Poe (Nicolas Cage), a former Army Ranger who has just been released from prison after serving time for manslaughter. Poe's wife, Sarah (Monica Potter), is pregnant with their child, and he wants to be there for the birth of his son. However, Poe's parole officer, Stanley Goodspeed (John Cusack), informs him that he must transport a group of violent prisoners on a flight from Florida to California.

Goodspeed's plane, a Boeing 747, is carrying a group of notorious inmates, including Cyrus "The Virus" Grissom (Ving Rhames), a psychopathic killer; Vince Larkin (John Malkovich), a ruthless and cunning inmate who has escaped from prison multiple times; and Billy Babcock (Steve Buscemi), a small-time crook. The prisoners are being transported to a maximum-security prison in California, where they will face trial for their crimes.

As the plane takes off, Poe begins to suspect that something is amiss. He discovers that Larkin has escaped from his cell and is hiding among the passengers. Poe also meets Sarah, who is on her way to meet him at the airport. However, when the plane hits turbulence, Poe realizes that the prisoners have taken control of the aircraft.

The inmates begin to wreak havoc on the plane, causing chaos and destruction. Poe teams up with Goodspeed to try and regain control of the situation. Along the way, they encounter Larkin, who reveals his plan to escape from prison using a homemade explosive device.

As the plane hurtles towards its destination, Poe and Goodspeed must use all their skills and resources to stop the inmates and prevent them from escaping. The action unfolds as the prisoners take over the cockpit, causing the plane to crash-land in the Arizona desert.

In the end, Poe and Goodspeed manage to overpower Larkin and his accomplices, but not before they cause significant damage to the plane. The movie ends with Poe and Sarah reunited, and the inmates being taken into custody by the authorities.

Throughout the film, Nicolas Cage delivers a memorable performance as Cameron Poe, bringing depth and nuance to the character. John Malkovich is also excellent as Larkin, conveying the menace and intelligence of his character. The action sequences are intense and well-choreographed, making Con Air an entertaining and thrilling ride from start to finish.

Overall, Con Air is a classic action movie that combines elements of thriller, drama, and adventure. With its strong performances, engaging plot, and memorable characters, it's no wonder why the film has become a cult classic over the years.

overview: Sam, a neurodivergent man, has a daughter with a homeless woman who abandons them when they leave the hospital, leaving Sam to raise Lucy on his own. But as Lucy grows up, Sam's limitations as a parent start to become a problem and the authorities take her away. Sam convinces high-priced lawyer Rita to take his case pro bono and in turn teaches her the value of love and family.
tagline: Love is all you need.
title: I Am Sam
plot:
I Am Sam is a 2001 American drama film directed by Jessie Nelson, starring Sean Penn and Michelle Pfeiffer.

The movie revolves around the life of Sam Dawson (played by Sean Penn), a mentally challenged man who falls in love with Lucy (played by Michelle Pfeiffer) and becomes the guardian of her six-year-old son, Harry. The story explores several themes that are central to the plot:

1. **Unconditional Love**: The film showcases the power of unconditional love between Sam and his son, Harry. Despite Sam's mental limitations, he demonstrates a deep affection for Harry, which ultimately helps him navigate the complexities of parenthood.
2. **Mental Health Awareness**: I Am Sam sheds light on the struggles faced by individuals with intellectual disabilities, highlighting the importance of acceptance, understanding, and support. The film humanizes those with mental health conditions, dispelling stereotypes and stigmas surrounding them.
3. **Parental Rights**: The movie delves into the theme of parental rights, particularly in cases where a parent's mental capacity is questionable. Sam's fight to gain custody of Harry serves as a catalyst for exploring the complexities of family law and the importance of protecting children's best interests.
4. **Redemption and Personal Growth**: Throughout the film, Sam undergoes significant personal growth, learning to adapt to new situations and develop his emotional intelligence. His journey is marked by moments of redemption, where he proves himself as a capable and loving father.
5. **Social Justice**: I Am Sam also touches on social justice issues, such as poverty, inequality, and the need for systemic change. The film highlights the struggles faced by marginalized communities, including those with intellectual disabilities and their families.

The movie's narrative is engaging, emotional, and thought-provoking, making it a powerful exploration of these themes.

overview: When a young mother's home birth ends in unfathomable tragedy, she begins a year-long odyssey of mourning that fractures relationships with loved ones in this deeply personal story of a woman learning to live alongside her loss.
title: Pieces of a Woman
plot:
Pieces of a Woman is a 2020 drama directed by Kornél Mundruczó from a screenplay by Kata Wéber, partly based on their stage play. Vanessa Kirby stars as Martha, a woman who loses her baby during a home birth, with Shia LaBeouf as her partner Sean, Ellen Burstyn as her mother Elizabeth, Molly Parker as the midwife Eva, Sarah Snook, Iliza Shlesinger, Benny Safdie and Jimmie Fails. Martin Scorsese and Sam Levinson served as executive producers, and Howard Shore composed the score. It premiered at the Venice Film Festival in September 2020, where Kirby won the Volpi Cup for Best Actress, and was released by Netflix in January 2021.

Martha and Sean, a Boston couple, are expecting their first child. Sean, a construction worker helping to build a bridge across a river, resents Martha's mother, Elizabeth, a wealthy and domineering Holocaust survivor who has bought them a minivan. When Martha goes into labor at home, their regular midwife is unavailable and sends a colleague, Eva. The birth, filmed in a single continuous take of about twenty minutes, is long and painful. When the baby's heart rate drops, Eva tells Sean to call an ambulance. Martha gives birth to a girl who at first seems healthy, but the baby soon turns blue and dies despite Eva's attempts to revive her.

In the following months, the couple's grief drives them apart. At the coroner's office, Sean is desperate to know what went wrong, while Martha is reluctant to learn the details. They are told the cause of death has not been determined but that the baby suffered from a lack of oxygen, and Eva is charged with criminal negligence. Martha withdraws into silence, returns to work and refuses to talk about her loss, while Sean, a recovering alcoholic, relapses and begins an affair with Martha's cousin Suzanne, the lawyer handling the case. Elizabeth pressures her daughter to testify against Eva to secure justice. As the months pass and the bridge Sean is building nears completion, Martha must decide how to face the trial, her mother's expectations and her own grief.

Pieces of a Woman received generally positive reviews, with particular acclaim for Kirby's performance and the virtuoso birth sequence, although some critics found the rest of the film less compelling. Kirby was nominated for the Academy Award for Best Actress.

original_title: Buzz Lightyear of Star Command: The Adventure Begins
overview: Buzz Lightyear must battle Emperor Zurg with the help of three hopefuls who insist on being his partners.
tagline: Never fear, Buzz is here...
title: Buzz Lightyear of Star Command: The Adventure Begins
plot:
"Buzz Lightyear of Star Command: The Adventure Begins" is a 2000 animated science fiction comedy film produced by Walt Disney Television Animation. 

The movie follows the adventures of Buzz Lightyear, an astronaut who believes he is on a mission to save the galaxy from the Evil Emperor Zurg. However, it turns out that he is actually on a children's television show called "Space Ranger Spin" and his actions are being broadcasted as part of the show.

As the story unfolds, Buzz must come to terms with the fact that his adventures are not real and that he is actually an actor playing a role. Along the way, he befriends Mira Nova, a Space Ranger who helps him on his mission to stop Emperor Zurg's latest plan to take over the galaxy.

The main themes of the movie include:

1. Identity: Buzz Lightyear struggles with his identity as an astronaut and a television personality, leading to a journey of self-discovery.
2. Reality vs. Fantasy: The film explores the idea that reality is not always what it seems, and that sometimes our perceptions can be misleading.
3. Friendship: Buzz forms a strong bond with Mira Nova, who helps him navigate his new reality and supports him on his mission.
4. Believing in oneself: Despite being an actor playing a role, Buzz learns to believe in himself and his abilities, which ultimately leads to his success.

Overall, "Buzz Lightyear of Star Command: The Adventure Begins" is a heartwarming and entertaining film that explores themes of identity, reality vs. fantasy, friendship, and believing in oneself.

overview: As a new day begins in the small American town of Minninnewah, the residents start their day as ordinary as the next. Mother Nature, however, has other plans for them. Inhabitants have just 13 minutes to seek shelter before the largest tornado on record ravages the town, leaving them struggling to protect their loved ones and fighting for their lives. Left to deal with the aftermath, four families must overcome their differences and find strength in each other in order to survive.
tagline: Every second counts.
title: 13 Minutes
plot:
13 Minutes is a 2021 American-Canadian disaster drama written, directed and produced by Lindsay Gossling in her feature debut, from a story co-written with Travis Farncombe. The ensemble cast includes Amy Smart, Thora Birch, Anne Heche, Trace Adkins, Peter Facinelli, Paz Vega, Yancey Arias, Sofia Vassilieva and Will Peltz. Its title refers to the brief window residents have to seek shelter once a tornado is detected.

The film is set in the fictional Oklahoma town of Minninnewah and follows four families whose lives are intertwined. Jess, a mechanic, learns that her 19-year-old daughter, Maddy, is pregnant, and Maddy agonizes over whether to have an abortion. The medical professional who examines her is Tammy, an overbearing devout Christian, who unprofessionally tries to persuade her to keep the baby. Tammy and her farmer husband, Rick, are also parents to Luke, who is gay and afraid of coming out; when he finally tells them, they react with homophobic panic. Brad is the town's television weatherman, and his wife, Kim, heads the local emergency response team. Meanwhile Ana is trying to save enough money to buy a home for herself and her husband, Carlos, an undocumented immigrant.

As these personal dramas unfold, a massive storm system develops and spawns what becomes the largest tornado on record. When the twister finally strikes, late in the story, it tears through Minninnewah in the space of the titular thirteen minutes, leaving death and devastation in its path. In the aftermath, the survivors, some of them badly injured, must deal with loss and grief, and several of the problems that consumed them before the storm are rendered irrelevant or resolved by sudden turns of fate. The community begins to rebuild, facing both death and new beginnings.

The film was shot in Oklahoma. Quiver gave it a limited theatrical release in the United States on October 29, 2021, followed by video on demand in December, grossing about $67,000 worldwide from releases in the UAE and Portugal. Reviews were largely negative, with 27% approval on Rotten Tomatoes and a Metacritic score of 40. The Guardian's Leslie Felperin found the plotting weakened by convenient turns of fate that punish the less sympathetic characters, and The Globe and Mail called it soapy melodrama in which the tornado feels incidental. Rex Reed of The New York Observer was more positive, finding it sometimes contrived but strengthened by its likable cast.

original_title: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone
overview: Harry Potter has lived under the stairs at his aunt and uncle's house his whole life. But on his 11th birthday, he learns he's a powerful wizard—with a place waiting for him at the Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry. As he learns to harness his newfound powers with the help of the school's kindly headmaster, Harry uncovers the truth about his parents' deaths—and about the villain who's to blame.
tagline: Let the magic begin.

overview: A 9 year old boy experiences God's power in a supernatural way.
tagline: With God all things are possible
title: I Believe
plot:
I Believe is an American Christian family film directed by Juergen Peretzki and Stacey Peretzki, written by Juergen Peretzki and David Outten, and produced by the Peretzkis through Screen Savers Entertainment. Listed by some databases as a 2017 production, it reached audiences in June 2019 and runs about 90 minutes, under the tagline "With God all things are possible". The cast is led by the young Rowan Smyth, with Matt Lindquist, Wilford Brimley, Jeremy London, Tom Sizemore and William McNamara, along with Sarah Navratil, Thomas Silcott and Chelsea Rendon.

Brian (Smyth) is a very intelligent nine-year-old who has grown up in a non-Christian home. While writing a school paper about the Pilgrims, he learns about their faith, and after a supernatural encounter with God he sets out on a quest to find out more about what Christians believe. He meets heavy opposition from the world around him, above all from his father Simon (Lindquist), an atheist television newscaster. His father even forbids him to read the Bible, but Brian persists in seeking God and finds allies in the pastor of a local church (Brimley) and a wounded U.S. Marine (London) who has lost a leg. Brian's pure and innocent faith leads him to pray for the veteran and to send a woman home to pray for her blind baby, and the manifestations of God's power that follow quickly become breaking news. When a reporter tries to make a mockery of the boy's faith, Brian's family faces severe tests and trials. The story takes a darker turn when the mob becomes involved: a contract is put out on Brian's life, a little girl is shot in his place and healed through prayer, and Brian is kidnapped by a man who wants him to pray for his own son, before being returned. These events lead to what the film presents as one of the greatest miracles of all, especially for Brian's own family.

The film was a small independent release, with AllMovie listing a box-office gross of about 55,000 dollars. The Dove Foundation, which reviews films for family audiences, praised it as a story about the power of childlike faith that can bring great blessings and even miracles, focusing on making a stand for God's word, and awarded it its Faith-Friendly Seal for all ages with top marks for faith and integrity, while cautioning that the film, which includes bullying, a threat against a reporter and a shooting, was not intended for very young children.

overview: A mother of two inherits a home from her aunt. On the first night in the new home she is confronted with murderous intruders and fights for her daughters’ lives. Sixteen years later the daughters reunite at the house, and that is when things get strange . . .
tagline: You really thought you’ve been scared?
title: Ghostland
plot:
Ghostland is a 2018 American supernatural horror film directed by Jeremy Saulnier. The movie follows a family who is attacked by a group of masked strangers while on their way to a family reunion in rural West Virginia.

The main themes of Ghostland include:

1. **Trauma and Family Dynamics**: The film explores the dark secrets and traumas that can be passed down through generations, particularly within families. The characters' past experiences and relationships with each other are slowly revealed, highlighting the complexities of family dynamics.
2. **Violence and Masculinity**: Ghostland critiques traditional notions of masculinity and the objectification of women. The masked strangers who attack the family embody a twisted form of toxic masculinity, while the male characters in the film struggle to cope with their own emotions and vulnerabilities.
3. **Feminism and Empowerment**: The movie features strong female characters who are forced to confront their own strengths and weaknesses. As they fight for survival, they begin to reclaim their agency and challenge the patriarchal norms that have held them back.
4. **Rural America and Isolation**: The film's setting in rural West Virginia serves as a character in its own right, emphasizing the isolation and confinement of the characters. This isolation heightens the sense of vulnerability and desperation, making the characters' situation even more dire.

Throughout the movie, these themes are intertwined with elements of horror, suspense, and drama, creating a tense and unsettling viewing experience.

overview: Diplomats from the North and South Korean embassies in Somalia attempt a daring joint escape from Mogadishu when the outbreak of civil war leaves them stranded.
tagline: A city in revolt, we must escape.
title: Escape from Mogadishu
plot:
Escape from Mogadishu (Korean: Mogadisyu) is a 2021 South Korean political action thriller directed by Ryoo Seung-wan, based on real events during the Somali Civil War. It stars Kim Yoon-seok as South Korean ambassador Han Sin-seong, Zo In-sung as the embassy counselor and intelligence officer Kang Dae-jin, Huh Joon-ho as North Korean ambassador Rim Yong-su and Koo Kyo-hwan as North Korean counselor Tae Jun-ki, with Kim So-jin and Jung Man-sik. The film was shot entirely in Morocco in the second half of 2019.

In 1990, both North and South Korea are lobbying for admission to the United Nations and competing to win the support of Somalia's government under President Siad Barre. The rival embassies in Mogadishu sabotage each other at every turn, while the country slides into civil war between the government and rebels led by Mohamed Farrah Aidid. When the rebels enter the capital, fighting erupts across the city, and both delegations realize they must flee immediately.

Their attempts to reach the airport fail for lack of papers, and the North Koreans, after their embassy is ransacked and the Chinese embassy is found abandoned, make their way through the chaos to the South Korean compound, where Han lets them in despite deep mutual suspicion. Living under one roof, the two groups must set aside ideological hostility and propaganda games to survive. When the Italian embassy offers places on a Red Cross evacuation flight to Kenya, which the North Koreans are not eligible for, Han claims they are defecting. The diplomats and their families then armor their cars with bags of dirt and books, tie white flags to them and set out on a dangerous drive across the war-torn city, trying to reach the Italian embassy before gunfire cuts them down.

The film explores how shared danger can bridge the divide between the two Koreas, combining tense action with a humane portrait of the people caught in a foreign war.

Released in South Korea on July 28, 2021, Escape from Mogadishu topped the local box office and became the highest-grossing Korean film of 2021, with about 3.6 million admissions and 29 million dollars worldwide. It was selected as South Korea's entry for the Academy Award for Best International Feature Film. Critics responded positively, with 95 percent approval on Rotten Tomatoes and a Metacritic score of 71.

overview: Peter Klaven is a successful real estate agent who, upon getting engaged to the woman of his dreams, Zooey, discovers, to his dismay and chagrin, that he has no male friend close enough to serve as his Best Man. Peter immediately sets out to rectify the situation, embarking on a series of bizarre and awkward "man-dates."
tagline: He needed a best man... He got the worst.
title: I Love You, Man
plot:
I Love You, Man is a 2009 American comedy film directed by John Hamburg and written by Hamburg and Larry Levin. The movie stars Paul Rudd and Jason Segel as two friends who form an unlikely bond.

The main themes of I Love You, Man revolve around male friendship, masculinity, and the complexities of relationships. The story follows Peter Klaven (Paul Rudd), a successful real estate agent who is struggling to find a best friend. When he meets Sydney Fife (Jason Segel), a free-spirited and eccentric man-child, they form an unlikely bond.

As their friendship deepens, Peter realizes that he needs to find a "man of honor" to be his partner in marriage, as per his fiancée's request. This sets off a series of events where Peter tries to find the perfect friend for himself, leading to a series of hilarious and awkward encounters.

Throughout the movie, the themes of masculinity and male friendship are explored. The film pokes fun at traditional masculine norms and societal expectations, highlighting the complexities and nuances of male relationships. The movie also touches on the idea of finding one's true self and embracing vulnerability, as Peter learns to open up and be more genuine with Sydney.

The ending of the movie is a heartwarming and humorous exploration of the power of male friendship and the importance of being true to oneself. Overall, I Love You, Man is a comedy that uses humor and wit to explore deeper themes about relationships, identity, and the complexities of human connection.

overview: After moving to a new town, troublemaking teen Jim Stark is supposed to have a clean slate, although being the new kid in town brings its own problems. While searching for some stability, Stark forms a bond with a disturbed classmate, Plato, and falls for local girl Judy. However, Judy is the girlfriend of neighborhood tough, Buzz. When Buzz violently confronts Jim and challenges him to a drag race, the new kid's real troubles begin.
tagline: The bad boy from a good family.
title: Rebel Without a Cause
plot:
Rebel Without a Cause is a classic American drama film directed by Nicholas Ray, released in 1955 by Warner Bros. Pictures.

The movie revolves around James Dean's iconic character Jim Stark, a troubled teenager struggling to find his place in the world. The main themes of Rebel Without a Cause include:

1. **Teenage Angst and Rebellion**: The film explores the challenges and frustrations faced by teenagers during the 1950s, particularly those from middle-class families who feel suffocated by societal expectations. Jim's rebellion against his parents and the pressures of conformity serves as a catalyst for the story.
2. **Mental Health and Emotional Turmoil**: Jim's character is portrayed as struggling with emotional turmoil, which is often attributed to his troubled home life and feelings of inadequacy. The film sheds light on the importance of addressing mental health issues and seeking help when needed.
3. **Social Class and Status**: The movie highlights the differences between wealth and privilege, as embodied by Jim's rival, Plato (played by Sal Mineo), who comes from a wealthy family. This contrast serves to illustrate the tensions between social classes and the difficulties faced by those from lower-income backgrounds.
4. **Friendship and Loyalty**: The relationships between Jim, Judy (Natalie Wood), and Buzz (Jim Backus) are central to the story. Their bond is tested as they navigate their individual struggles and confront the harsh realities of life.

The film's narrative unfolds through a series of dramatic events, including a confrontation with Plato, which ultimately leads to tragic consequences. The ending is both poignant and thought-provoking, leaving audiences to ponder the complexities of adolescence and the human condition.

Rebel Without a Cause has become an iconic representation of 1950s American culture, influencing generations of filmmakers and continuing to resonate with audiences today.

overview: Chasing speed, dreams and money, a team of drivers get involved in the slush fund investigation of a powerful figure during the 1988 Seoul Olympics.
tagline: Drive back to 1988.
title: Seoul Vibe
plot:
Seoul Vibe (Korean: 서울대작전, literally "Seoul Grand Operation") is a 2022 South Korean action comedy film directed by Moon Hyun-sung from a story by Sua Shin. It stars Yoo Ah-in as Park Dong-wook, the leader of a crew of drivers and mechanics, with Go Kyung-pyo, Lee Kyu-hyung, Park Ju-hyun and Ong Seong-wu as his team, and Moon So-ri, Kim Sung-kyun and Oh Jung-se in supporting roles.

In the run-up to the 1988 Seoul Olympics, smuggler and racer Dong-wook and his team, DJ Oh Woo-sam, Bok-nam, his younger sister Park Yoon-hee and Joon-ki, are blackmailed by prosecutor Ahn Pyung-wook into infiltrating the operation of Kang In-sook, a powerful underground chairwoman, and her right-hand man, Lee Hyun-kyun, to uncover the previous regime's secret slush fund. In exchange their criminal records will be erased; refusal means prison. After winning a car race held to recruit Kang's new drivers, the crew transports her money in modified cars confiscated by the prosecution, while Woo-sam works as a DJ in her nightclub and discovers a secret room. Lee tests their loyalty with a staged ambush and rewards them with a gold watch.

Shaken, Dong-wook wants to quit, but the others steal Kang's ledgers from the secret room, and he rejoins them. They then find that Pyung-wook has been killed: the watch was a listening device, and Lee knew they were informants all along. Lee captures and tortures Woo-sam, burns their hideout and frames the crew for the murder. Dong-wook takes the ledgers to Pyung-wook's superior along with a tape revealing that Kang plans to blame Lee and flee to the United States with the money. Playing it for Lee, he strikes a deal to bring Kang down, then enlists his racing rival Galchi with a bribe of rare sneakers. As Yoon-hee rescues Woo-sam, the crew leads Lee on a chase that ends with his crash, and he kills himself rather than face prison. Dong-wook boards Kang's plane, records her confession and drives his car out of the cargo hold, parachuting to safety. Kang is arrested, and the crew keeps some of the money as they set off for Los Angeles.

Produced by Andmarq Studio with MCMC and UAA, the film began shooting in Incheon in August 2021; filming was halted twice by positive COVID-19 tests and resumed in December 2021. It was released on Netflix on August 26, 2022.

overview: Fourteen year old Nim, more determined than ever to protect her island and all the wildlife that call it home, faces off against resort developers and animal poachers. Soon she realizes she can’t depend on her animal cohorts alone and must make her first human friend – Edmund, who’s run away to the island from the mainland – to save her home.
tagline: Adventure runs wild, again.
title: Return to Nim's Island
plot:
Return to Nim's Island is a heartwarming adventure film that explores the themes of family, love, and self-discovery. The movie follows the journey of Selena, a young girl who returns to her father's island with her mother, after a year apart. As they settle back into their life on the island, they face various challenges, including a severe storm that threatens their home.

Through this experience, the film delves into the importance of family bonds and the love that holds them together. The story highlights the strong relationship between Selena and her father, as well as her mother's efforts to reconnect with her daughter after a difficult year apart.

The movie also touches on themes of resilience and adaptability, as the characters face the challenges of rebuilding their home and restoring their island to its former beauty. This is reflected in the character of Nim, who plays a crucial role in helping his family overcome adversity.

Furthermore, the film explores the idea of finding one's place in the world and discovering one's passions. Selena's journey on the island serves as a catalyst for her growth and self-discovery, as she learns to appreciate the beauty of nature and the importance of following her dreams.

Overall, Return to Nim's Island is a story about the power of love, family, and resilience in the face of adversity, set against the stunning backdrop of a tropical island.
