overview: John Carter is a war-weary, former military captain who's inexplicably transported to the mysterious and exotic planet of Barsoom (Mars) and reluctantly becomes embroiled in an epic conflict. It's a world on the brink of collapse, and Carter rediscovers his humanity when he realizes the survival of Barsoom and its people rests in his hands.
tagline: Lost in our world, found in another.
title: John Carter
plot:
John Carter is a 2012 science fiction film directed by Andrew Stanton, based on the novel "A Princess of Mars" by Edgar Rice Burroughs.

The story begins on Mars, where astronaut John Carter (played by Taylor Kitsch) is presumed dead after a mission to Mars goes awry. However, Carter is actually rescued and taken in by the Therns, a group of Martian warriors who are seeking revenge against the ruling class for their oppression. The Therns' leader, Sab Than (played by Dominic West), reveals that Carter's bloodline holds the key to unlocking an ancient power that could bring about a new era on Mars.

Carter soon discovers that he has developed superhuman strength and agility due to his exposure to the Martian atmosphere. He also learns that he is not from Mars, but rather from Earth, and that his memories of his life back home are false. Carter's journey takes him to the city of Zodanga, where he becomes embroiled in a conflict between the ruling class and the Therns.

As Carter navigates this new world, he meets Princess Dejah Thoris (played by Lynn Collins), the daughter of the ruler of Helium, who is fighting against the oppressive rule of Sab Than. The two form a bond, and Carter becomes determined to help her defeat Sab Than and bring peace to Mars.

However, things become complicated when Carter discovers that his own identity is tied to the conflict on Mars. He learns that he is actually a prince from Earth, and that his memories of his life back home are real. This revelation sets him on a collision course with Sab Than, who seeks to use Carter's bloodline for his own gain.

The film's climax features an epic battle between the forces of Helium and Zodanga, with Carter at the forefront. In the end, Carter is able to defeat Sab Than and bring about a new era of peace on Mars. However, the film ends on a bittersweet note, as Carter realizes that he must leave Mars behind and return to Earth.

Throughout the film, Stanton explores themes of identity, duty, and the complexities of power. The action sequences are intense and visually stunning, with impressive use of practical effects to bring the Martian landscapes to life. While the film received mixed reviews from critics, it has developed a loyal fan base over the years, and is widely regarded as a visually stunning and entertaining science fiction epic.

Overall, John Carter is a thrilling adventure that explores the complexities of power and identity in a richly detailed sci-fi world. With its impressive visuals and engaging storyline, it's a must-see for fans of science fiction and action films.

original_title: In the Name of the King 2: Two Worlds
overview: Granger, an ex-Special Forces soldier gets thrown back to medieval times to fulfill an ancient prophecy. Venturing through the now war torn Kingdom of Ehb, he teams up with an unlikely band of allies with the goal of slaying the leader of the "Dark Ones". Fighting against all odds, they must free the land from the grasp of the evil tyrant Raven and save the world.
production_companies: Boll Kino Beteiligungs GmbH & Co. KG
tagline: Fight to the End
title: In the Name of the King 2: Two Worlds
plot:
In the Name of the King 2: Two Worlds is a 2011 fantasy adventure film directed by Uwe Boll and the sequel to In the Name of the King: A Dungeon Siege Tale (2007), which starred Jason Statham. Dolph Lundgren stars as Granger, a former special forces soldier, with Natassia Malthe, Lochlyn Munro, Aleks Paunovic and Natalie Burn. Shot in British Columbia, it was released on DVD and Blu-ray in the United States and Canada on 27 December 2011, with a 3D version included in the German Blu-ray edition.

Granger, a veteran of the special forces, lives a quiet life in modern-day Vancouver until a group of hooded assassins attack him in his home. After fighting them off, he is pulled through a time portal and finds himself hundreds of years in the past, in the forested medieval Kingdom of Ehb, a land torn apart by war. He learns that he is the subject of an ancient prophecy that foretells the arrival of a warrior from another world who will save the kingdom.

Reluctantly accepting his role, Granger joins an unlikely band of allies, including a female healer known as Manhattan, who accompanies him on his quest. His task is to destroy the leader of the sinister Dark Ones, a witch known only as the Holy Mother, whose power threatens the realm. As he travels through the war-ravaged countryside, Granger fights monsters, assassins and enemy soldiers, using both his modern military training and the medieval weapons of his new surroundings. Along the way he must earn the trust of his companions, who are suspicious of the strange warrior and his modern ways. Fighting against overwhelming odds, Granger must free the land from the evil tyrant Raven, save the kingdom from destruction and find a way to return to his own time.

The film received negative reviews, as was typical of Boll's films, with critics deriding its low budget, script and effects, although some reviewers noted that Lundgren brought a degree of conviction to the role. It was followed by a third installment, In the Name of the King 3: The Last Mission (2014), also directed by Boll.

overview: Thor is imprisoned on the other side of the universe and finds himself in a race against time to get back to Asgard to stop Ragnarok, the destruction of his home-world and the end of Asgardian civilization, at the hands of a powerful new threat, the ruthless Hela.
tagline: No Hammer. No Problem.
title: Thor: Ragnarok
plot:
Thor: Ragnarok is a 2017 superhero film directed by Taika Waititi, based on the Marvel Comics character of the same name. The movie marks the third installment in the Thor film series and the 17th film in the Marvel Cinematic Universe (MCU).

The story begins with Thor (Chris Hemsworth), the crown prince of Asgard, who has been banished to Earth by his father Odin (Anthony Hopkins) after a battle with the Frost Giants. Thor is forced to live on a small planet called Sakaar, where he becomes a gladiator and fights in the arena against various alien warriors.

Meanwhile, back on Asgard, Hela (Cate Blanchett), the goddess of death, has returned to claim her rightful place as the ruler of Asgard. She is determined to destroy the realm and everyone in it, including Thor's brother Loki (Tom Hiddleston).

Thor soon discovers that he must stop Hela from unleashing a catastrophic event known as Ragnarok, which will destroy Asgard. He also learns that his hammer Mjolnir has been stolen by Surtur (Clancy Brown), the leader of the Frost Giants.

Thor teams up with Valkyrie (Tessa Thompson), a warrior who is tasked with choosing the worthy warriors to fight in Valhalla, and Korg (Taika Waititi), a Kronan gladiator who becomes his unlikely friend. Together, they embark on a journey to stop Hela and save Asgard.

Along the way, Thor confronts his own identity and purpose, as he struggles to come to terms with being a god and a warrior. He also learns to let go of his ego and trust others, particularly Valkyrie, who becomes a valuable ally in his quest.

The movie features stunning visuals, witty humor, and impressive action sequences, making it a standout in the MCU. The film's tone is lighter and more humorous than previous Thor movies, with Waititi bringing his signature irreverence and wit to the story.

As the battle between Thor and Hela reaches its climax, the fate of Asgard hangs in the balance. In the end, Thor emerges victorious, but not without sacrifices. He also learns that he is worthy of wielding Mjolnir once again and becomes a true hero.

The movie concludes with Thor returning to Asgard, where he is welcomed back as a hero. The film ends on a hopeful note, setting the stage for future adventures in the MCU.

Overall, Thor: Ragnarok is a thrilling and entertaining ride that explores themes of identity, purpose, and redemption. With its stunning visuals, witty humor, and impressive action sequences, it's a must-see for fans of the MCU and superhero movies in general.

overview: A young single mother is held captive along with her two children by a violent ex and must plot their escape before it’s too late.
tagline: The will to live is found within.
title: Shut In
plot:
Shut In is a 2022 American thriller film directed by D. J. Caruso from a screenplay by Melanie Toast, starring Rainey Qualley, Jake Horowitz, Luciana VanDette and Vincent Gallo. It was the first original film of The Daily Wire and the third released on its streaming platform, DailyWire+. Toast's script had featured on the 2019 Black List and was once set up at New Line Cinema with Jason Bateman attached to direct; it also marked Gallo's first feature film role since 2013.

Jessica Nash, a young mother of two, is fixing up the house she inherited from her late grandmother so that she can sell it and move away. While working on a closet, she accidentally locks herself inside, and her young daughter Lainey is unable to bring her the key. Her ex-boyfriend Rob, a drug addict, arrives with his friend Sammy and lets her out, but Jessica is furious that he has brought Sammy, a pedophile, to her home. Manipulated by Sammy, Rob locks her back in the closet before the two men leave. Sammy later breaks into the house.

Jessica tricks Sammy into reaching under the door and pins his hand to the floor with a screwdriver that Lainey had slipped her, trapping him beside her. When Lainey comes downstairs despite being told to stay with her baby brother Mason, Sammy grabs her and threatens her, but Jessica sets his hand on fire, forcing him to let go. With Sammy apparently dead, Jessica escapes by climbing through the ceiling to the second floor and takes the children to the car, but heavy rain forces them back into the house, where Sammy, still alive, seizes the children and holds a knife to Mason's throat. Rob arrives and shoots Sammy dead, and he and Jessica attempt to reconcile. Realizing that Rob will always put drugs ahead of her and the children, Jessica slips him a large quantity of crystal meth. When he tries to make her relapse and inject her, he overdoses, and she pushes him out of a window to his death. Some time later, Jessica and her children live happily in the restored house, where she makes and sells apple butter from her mother's recipe.

The Daily Wire hosted a special viewing of the film on its YouTube channel on February 10, 2022. Shut In received mixed reviews, with 55% approval on Rotten Tomatoes; some critics praised its redemption arc while noting it lacked visceral thrills.

overview: Batman learns he has a violent, unruly pre-teen son, secretly raised by the terrorist group known as The League of Assassins.
tagline: Vengeance runs in the blood.
title: Son of Batman
plot:
Son of Batman is an animated superhero film that delves into the complex and intriguing world of Bruce Wayne's past, exploring his relationships with his father Thomas Wayne and his mentor Alfred Pennyworth. The movie primarily revolves around the character of Damian Wayne, Bruce's son from a previous relationship.

At its core, Son of Batman is a story about identity, legacy, and the weight of responsibility that comes with it. It delves into the themes of family dynamics, particularly the complicated bond between Bruce and his son, who struggles to find his place within the Wayne family legacy. The film also explores the idea of Bruce's dual identity as both a vigilante and a philanthropist, highlighting the moral dilemmas he faces in balancing his personal life with his duties as Batman.

Furthermore, Son of Batman touches on the theme of redemption, as Bruce grapples with his past mistakes and seeks to make amends through his relationship with Damian. The movie also explores the idea of mentorship, as Alfred plays a crucial role in guiding Bruce and helping him navigate his complicated emotions towards his son.

The film's narrative is also infused with elements of revenge, as Bruce seeks to protect his son from those who would seek to harm him. This drive for protection raises questions about the nature of heroism and the lengths one will go to safeguard loved ones.

Overall, Son of Batman is a thought-provoking exploration of complex themes, delving into the intricacies of family relationships, legacy, and personal responsibility.

overview: The True Story of Ted Kaczynski, the infamous Unabomber, who wants to destroy modern technology to create a world for himself in the Montana wilderness.
tagline: In the woods no one can hear you think.
title: Ted K
plot:
Ted K is a 2021 American independent biographical crime drama directed, co-produced and co-edited by Tony Stone, who co-wrote the screenplay with Gaddy Davis and John Rosenthal. Sharlto Copley stars as Ted Kaczynski, the former mathematics professor who withdrew to a survivalist life in the Montana wilderness and became the domestic terrorist known as the Unabomber, waging a nationwide mail-bombing campaign against modern technology and the destruction of nature.

Since 1971, Kaczynski has lived alone in a primitive cabin near Lincoln, Montana without electricity or running water. Convinced that technology is ruining the planet, he watches development encroach on the woods around him and decides that a life in nature is no longer possible. His resentment turns into sabotage: he wrecks a neighbour's snowmobile, cuts a power line and destroys construction equipment. The constant roar of jets overhead becomes his breaking point, and he resolves to take revenge on the people he holds responsible for harming society. After looking up the address of United Airlines president Percy Wood at the local library, he begins sending bombs through the mail. The FBI takes up the case when a device seriously injures Wood at his home, and Kaczynski alters his appearance to avoid recognition. A computer-store owner, Hugh Scrutton, becomes the first person killed by one of his bombs.

Short of money and quarrelling with his brother David over the phone, Kaczynski writes a 35,000-word manifesto and taunts newspapers with letters written in the first-person plural, while the press dubs him the "Unabomber". He promises The New York Times and The Washington Post that he will stop killing if they publish his manifesto, and the Post prints it on September 19, 1995. David recognises his brother's writing style and goes to the authorities. Kaczynski is arrested in 1996 and sentenced to life in the federal supermax prison in Florence, Colorado, for murdering three people and injuring twenty-three more; an epilogue notes that the hunt for him was the largest manhunt in FBI history.

Copley joined the project in 2018, and the film was shot over four seasons in and around Lincoln. It premiered at the 71st Berlin International Film Festival in March 2021 and was released in the United States in February 2022 by Neon's Super Ltd. Critics were largely positive, giving it 85% on Rotten Tomatoes and 70 on Metacritic, with particular praise for Copley's intense performance.

overview: A girl dying of leukemia compiles a list of things she'd like to do before passing away. Topping the list is her desire to lose her virginity.
tagline: Live every moment, love every minute
title: Now Is Good
plot:
Now Is Good is a poignant and emotional drama that explores the complexities of life, love, and mortality. The film delves into the theme of living in the present moment, as its protagonist, Tessa Scott, struggles to come to terms with her own mortality due to a rare form of cancer.

As Tessa navigates her relationships with those around her, particularly her friends and family, she begins to realize that life is short and fragile. The film's narrative is interwoven with flashbacks of Tessa's past, which serve as a reminder of the beauty and joy that can be found in life, even in the face of adversity.

One of the primary themes of Now Is Good is the power of human connection and the importance of cherishing relationships with others. Through Tessa's experiences, the film highlights the significance of empathy, kindness, and understanding in helping people cope with difficult situations.

The movie also explores the theme of grief and loss, as Tessa grapples with the idea of leaving behind those she loves. The film's portrayal of this emotional journey is both heart-wrenching and authentic, making it a powerful exploration of the human experience.

Ultimately, Now Is Good is a moving and thought-provoking drama that encourages viewers to appreciate the beauty of life and the importance of living in the present moment.

overview: What lengths will a robot undergo to do his job? BURN·E is a dedicated hard working robot who finds himself locked out of his ship. BURN·E quickly learns that completing a simple task can often be a very difficult endeavor.
title: BURN·E
plot:
BURN·E is a thought-provoking film that explores the complexities of humanity and what it means to be alive. The movie delves into the emotional journey of Burn-E, a small waste-collecting robot who finds himself at the center of a dramatic and poignant story.

At its core, BURN·E is a film about loneliness and connection. Burn-E's existence as a discarded, forgotten robot serves as a metaphor for the feelings of isolation and disconnection that many humans experience in their daily lives. His interactions with EVE, a sleek and efficient search robot, highlight the tension between technology and emotion, raising questions about what it means to truly connect with others.

The film also touches on themes of identity and purpose. Burn-E's quest to find meaning in his life serves as a powerful allegory for the human experience, where individuals often struggle to define their place in the world. His journey is marked by moments of introspection, self-discovery, and ultimately, a profound understanding of himself and his role in the universe.

Furthermore, BURN·E critiques the societal norms that prioritize efficiency and productivity over emotional intelligence and empathy. The film's portrayal of a society where robots are valued for their utility rather than their emotional depth serves as a commentary on our own culture's tendency to overlook the importance of human connection in favor of technological advancements.

Ultimately, BURN·E is a movie about finding one's place in the world, embracing imperfection, and recognizing the value of emotional connections in a seemingly mechanized universe.

overview: A 30-year-old spends a wild weekend in Palm Springs and wakes up to find she has magically transformed into her 70-year-old self.
tagline: Old soul. New age.
title: Mack & Rita
plot:
Mack & Rita is a 2022 American fantasy comedy film written and directed by Sarah Adina Smith. The movie follows the story of Mackenzie "Mack" Phillips (played by Lily Collins), a struggling writer who feels unfulfilled with her life.

One night, after a particularly rough day, Mack stumbles upon an unusual bar called Rita's Place, where she meets a bartender named Rita (also played by Lily Collins). As Mack orders a drink, she is suddenly transported to different parallel universes, each representing a different version of herself. In these alternate realities, Mack encounters various versions of herself, including a successful businesswoman, a rockstar, and a stay-at-home mom.

As Mack navigates through these different realities, she begins to realize that each version of herself has made different choices in life, leading to varying degrees of happiness and fulfillment. Through her experiences, Mack starts to understand the importance of embracing her own uniqueness and finding her true passion.

Throughout the film, Smith explores themes of identity, self-discovery, and the complexities of human relationships. The movie features a unique blend of humor, heart, and fantasy elements, making it an entertaining and thought-provoking watch.

The title "Mack & Rita" refers to the unlikely friendship between Mack and Rita, who become confidantes as Mack navigates her parallel universes. As the story unfolds, Mack comes to appreciate the value of having a supportive friend by her side, even in the midst of chaos and self-discovery.

Overall, Mack & Rita is a charming and offbeat film that celebrates individuality and the power of human connection. With its witty dialogue, colorful characters, and imaginative storytelling, this movie is sure to delight audiences looking for a fresh and entertaining cinematic experience.

overview: Beatrice Prior must confront her inner demons and continue her fight against a powerful alliance which threatens to tear her society apart.
tagline: One Choice Can Destroy You
title: Insurgent
plot:
Insurgent is a 2015 science fiction action film directed by Robert Schwentke and written by Jon Hoeber, Eric Heisserer, and Michael Chabon. The movie is based on the novel "Divergent" by Veronica Roth.

The story takes place in a post-apocalyptic Chicago, where society is divided into five factions: Abnegation (selflessness), Amity (peacefulness), Candor (honesty), Dauntless (bravery), and Erudite (intelligence). The protagonist, Beatrice "Tris" Prior (Shailene Woodley), lives in Abnegation with her family. On the day of the annual Choosing Ceremony, where young adults choose their faction, Tris secretly takes the test for Dauntless.

During the test, Tris demonstrates exceptional bravery and skills, which makes her a strong candidate for Dauntless. However, she is also revealed to be Divergent, meaning she doesn't fit into any one faction. This puts her in danger, as the Erudite faction, led by Jeanine Matthews (Kate Winslet), seeks to eliminate all Divergents.

Tris begins her training at Dauntless under the guidance of Four (Ansel Elgort), a skilled instructor who becomes Tris's mentor and love interest. As she navigates her new life in Dauntless, Tris uncovers a plot by the Erudite to overthrow the government and take control of Chicago.

Tris soon discovers that her father, Andrew Prior (Tony Goldwyn), is involved with the Erudite and has been hiding secrets about their past. She also learns that she has a unique connection to the simulated world of "The Simulated Reality," which holds the key to understanding the Divergent phenomenon.

As Tris delves deeper into the mystery, she must confront her own identity and the true nature of her faction. With the help of Four and her fellow Dauntless initiates, Tris embarks on a perilous journey to uncover the truth about the Erudite's plans and save Chicago from destruction.

The movie culminates in an action-packed showdown between Tris and Jeanine Matthews, with Tris using her unique skills and connection to the simulated world to outsmart the Erudite leader. In the end, Tris emerges victorious, but not without sacrifices. The film concludes with Tris and Four parting ways, as they both embark on new paths, leaving the audience wondering what the future holds for these characters.

Overall, Insurgent is a thrilling sci-fi adventure that explores themes of identity, loyalty, and self-discovery in a dystopian world.

overview: A lone scientist in the Arctic races to contact a crew of astronauts returning home to a mysterious global catastrophe.
tagline: There's a universe between all of us.
title: The Midnight Sky
plot:
The Midnight Sky is a 2020 science fiction film directed by George Clooney, produced by Truelove Productions and Parallel Media, not Truenorth Productions.

The movie takes place in a post-apocalyptic world where a lone astronaut, Captain Hawkins (played by George Clooney), must navigate his way back to Earth after discovering that the planet is on the brink of destruction. The story revolves around Hawkins' journey as he tries to find a way to save humanity from extinction.

Some of the main themes present in The Midnight Sky include:

1. **Hope and Redemption**: Despite the dire circumstances, Captain Hawkins holds onto hope for humanity's survival, which becomes a beacon of light in the darkness.
2. **Human Connection**: Throughout his journey, Hawkins forms connections with others who are fighting to survive, highlighting the importance of human relationships in times of crisis.
3. **Environmentalism and Climate Change**: The film serves as a warning about the devastating consequences of climate change and our responsibility to protect the planet.
4. **Personal Sacrifice**: Captain Hawkins is willing to make immense personal sacrifices to ensure humanity's survival, demonstrating his selflessness and dedication to the greater good.

The Midnight Sky explores these themes through its narrative, which is both visually stunning and emotionally resonant.

overview: On the night of an astronomical anomaly, eight friends at a dinner party experience a troubling chain of reality bending events.
tagline: Rearrange Your Brain
title: Coherence
plot:
Coherence is a 2013 science fiction thriller film written and directed by James Ward Byrkit. The movie takes place on a single evening in Chicago, Illinois, where a group of friends gather for dinner at a restaurant.

The story begins with a dinner party hosted by Tom (played by Maury Sterling), where his girlfriend, Emily (played by Alex Manugian), is expecting their first child. The guests include Tom's brother, Brian (played by Jake Weary), and his girlfriend, Sarah (played by Emily Foxler). As the evening progresses, the group discusses their relationships, careers, and life choices.

As the dinner party reaches its climax, a series of strange events occur, which seem to be connected to an alternate reality or parallel universe. The guests begin to experience strange visions and hallucinations, which are not explained by any external factor. These events disrupt the normal flow of time, causing the characters' perceptions of reality to become distorted.

As the night wears on, the group's relationships with each other become increasingly complicated. Brian becomes obsessed with a mysterious woman who appears in his vision, while Sarah starts to question her own identity and purpose. Emily, meanwhile, is struggling to come to terms with her pregnancy and the changes it brings to her life.

Throughout the film, Byrkit employs a non-linear narrative structure, jumping back and forth between different moments in time. This creates a sense of disorientation and confusion, mirroring the characters' experiences as they navigate the strange events unfolding around them.

As the evening reaches its climax, the group discovers that their dinner party has been interrupted by an alternate version of themselves from a parallel universe. In this reality, Tom is not with Emily, but with Sarah, who is now pregnant with his child. The guests are forced to confront the consequences of their choices and the paths they have taken in life.

The film's ending is intentionally ambiguous, leaving the audience to ponder the nature of reality and the consequences of the characters' actions. Byrkit has stated that he intended for the film to be a thought-provoking exploration of the complexities of human relationships and the fragility of reality.

Overall, Coherence is a mind-bending thriller that challenges its viewers to question their perceptions of reality. With its complex narrative structure and thought-provoking themes, the film has become a cult classic among fans of science fiction and psychological thrillers.

overview: What if a child from another world crash-landed on Earth, but instead of becoming a hero to mankind, he proved to be something far more sinister?
tagline: Evil has found its superhero
title: Brightburn
plot:
Brightburn is a 2019 American superhero film directed by David F. Sandberg and written by Brian Reilly. The movie stars Elizabeth Banks, David Denman, and Jeremy Irvine.

The story begins with the introduction of Brandon Breyer (played by Josh Lemke), an orphan boy who grows up in a foster home with his adoptive parents, Kent and Evelyn Breyer (played by Lizzy Caplan and Jay O. Sanders). The family is loving and supportive, but there's an undercurrent of tension due to the mysterious circumstances surrounding Brandon's birth.

As Brandon grows older, he begins to exhibit extraordinary abilities, including superhuman strength, speed, and agility. However, his powers are accompanied by a dark and violent streak, which makes him increasingly isolated from those around him.

The turning point in Brandon's life comes when he is discovered by Dr. Emma Cale (played by Elizabeth Banks), a psychologist who specializes in treating individuals with extraordinary abilities. Emma recognizes the potential of Brandon's powers and offers to help him control them.

However, as Brandon becomes more confident in his abilities, he begins to struggle with his own morality. He starts to see himself as a hero, destined to save humanity from an alien threat that is threatening Earth. This delusion is further fueled by Emma's manipulation, who uses her knowledge of Brandon's powers to control him.

As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that Brandon's abilities are not just physical but also telepathic and telekinetic. He can read minds and move objects with his mind, making him a formidable force. However, this power comes at a terrible cost, as he struggles to maintain control over his emotions and actions.

The climax of the movie revolves around Brandon's confrontation with an alien spaceship that has landed on Earth. The aliens are seeking out individuals with extraordinary abilities, including Brandon, who they believe will help them conquer humanity.

In a shocking twist, it is revealed that Brandon is actually Superman's clone, created by Dr. Emma Cale as part of a government experiment to create super-soldiers. This revelation sets off a chain reaction of events that ultimately leads to Brandon's downfall.

The ending of the movie is both heartbreaking and terrifying. As Brandon struggles to come to terms with his true identity, he becomes increasingly unstable and violent. In a final confrontation with Emma, who has been manipulating him throughout the story, Brandon unleashes his full fury on her.

In the end, it is revealed that Brandon's powers have become too much for him to handle, and he is killed by his own hand. The movie ends with a sense of tragedy and loss, as we are left to ponder the consequences of playing with forces beyond human control.

Overall, Brightburn is a thought-provoking and unsettling take on the superhero genre. It raises important questions about the nature of power, morality, and the dangers of unchecked ambition.

overview: Peter Parker is going through a major identity crisis. Burned out from being Spider-Man, he decides to shelve his superhero alter ego, which leaves the city suffering in the wake of carnage left by the evil Doc Ock. In the meantime, Parker still can't act on his feelings for Mary Jane Watson, a girl he's loved since childhood. A certain anger begins to brew in his best friend Harry Osborn as well...
tagline: There's a hero in all of us.
title: Spider-Man 2
plot:
Spider-Man 2 is a 2004 superhero film directed by Sam Raimi and produced by Laura Ziskin Productions, Marvel Enterprises, and Columbia Pictures. The movie follows the story of Peter Parker (Tobey Maguire), a high school student turned superhero.

The film begins with Peter's life as Spider-Man being put to the test. He is struggling to balance his personal life with his responsibilities as a superhero. His relationship with Mary Jane Watson (Kirsten Dunst) is also on the rocks, and he feels guilty for not spending enough time with her due to his duties as Spider-Man.

Meanwhile, a new villain emerges in the form of Doctor Octopus (Alfred Molina), a brilliant scientist who was once Peter's mentor. However, after an accident involving one of his own creations, Doctor Octopus becomes obsessed with proving his superiority over humanity and seeks revenge against those he feels have wronged him.

As Spider-Man tries to stop Doctor Octopus, he also has to deal with the emergence of Venom (Topher Grace), a symbiote that bonds with Eddie Brock (Topher Grace), a rival photographer who is determined to destroy Spider-Man. The two villains pose a significant threat to Peter's life and relationships.

Throughout the film, Peter struggles to come to terms with his dual identity as Spider-Man and Peter Parker. He feels overwhelmed by the responsibilities of being a superhero and the pressure from those around him to conform to societal expectations. His relationship with Mary Jane is also put to the test as she becomes increasingly frustrated with his absence and lack of commitment.

As the story unfolds, Doctor Octopus's obsession with proving his superiority grows more intense, leading him to commit atrocities against innocent people. Spider-Man must use all his skills and cunning to stop him before it's too late.

In the climactic final battle, Spider-Man faces off against both Doctor Octopus and Venom. With the help of his friends and allies, he is able to defeat both villains and save the day.

The film ends with Peter reflecting on the lessons he has learned about responsibility, friendship, and the importance of balancing personal life with superhero duties. He also begins to rebuild his relationship with Mary Jane, who has come to accept him for who he is as Spider-Man.

Overall, Spider-Man 2 is a thrilling and emotionally resonant film that explores the complexities of being a superhero and the challenges of maintaining relationships in the face of great responsibility.

overview: A prehistoric epic that follows a young mammoth hunter's journey through uncharted territory to secure the future of his tribe.
production_companies: The Department of Trade and Industry of South Africa
tagline: The legend. The battle. The first hero.
title: 10,000 BC
plot:
10,000 BC is a 2008 American action-adventure directed by Roland Emmerich, who wrote it with Harald Kloser. It stars Steven Strait as the young hunter D'Leh, Camilla Belle as Evolet, Cliff Curtis as his mentor Tic'Tic, Mo Zinal as his rival Ka'Ren, Nathanael Baring as Baku and Mona Hammond as the tribe's shaman, Old Mother, with Omar Sharif as the narrator. The film follows a prehistoric tribe of mammoth hunters on an epic journey across an imagined ancient world.

The Yagahl, a tribe of hunter-gatherers living in the mountains, depend on woolly mammoths for survival, but the herds are becoming scarce. When a blue-eyed girl, Evolet, is brought into the camp, Old Mother prophesies that four-legged demons will come after the last mammoth hunt and that the girl and the hunt's champion will lead the tribe into a new way of life. Doubting the prophecy, D'Leh's father, the tribe's chief hunter, leaves to find another way to save his people, entrusting his son and the White Spear to his friend Tic'Tic. Years later, D'Leh wins the White Spear and Evolet's hand when he kills a mammoth, but because the triumph was a fluke, he gives up both.

Soon afterwards, riders on horseback raid the camp, killing several villagers and carrying off Evolet and others as slaves. D'Leh, Tic'Tic, Ka'Ren and Baku pursue them across vast lands, facing terror birds and befriending a saber-toothed tiger, which earns them the trust of the Naku tribe, who see D'Leh as a prophesied savior. Gathering a coalition of tribes, D'Leh follows the raiders to an advanced civilization ruled by a god-king called the Almighty, where enslaved tribespeople and captive mammoths are being forced to build pyramids. There D'Leh must lead a slave rebellion and rescue Evolet.

The film is a spectacle-driven fantasy rather than a historical reconstruction, and it was widely criticized for its anachronisms, including pyramid-like monuments, written language and metal tools thousands of years before such developments emerged.

Premiering in Berlin on February 10, 2008, 10,000 BC was released by Warner Bros. on March 7 and opened at number one in North America. It grossed about 270 million dollars against a 105 million dollar budget, but reviews were negative, with 10 percent approval on Rotten Tomatoes and a Metacritic score of 34.

overview: When reporter Dan Geraldo (Alain Chabat) arrives in Palombia to hunt for a scoop, he never suspects that he is about to make an incredible discovery... With his resourceful local guide Pablito (Jamel Debbouze), D an has one surprise after another during a thrilling adventure that allows him to bring the world some spectacular news: the Marsupilami, a mythical and mischievous animal, really does exist! You too will believe in furry tails!
title: HOUBA! On the Trail of the Marsupilami
plot:
HOUBA! On the Trail of the Marsupilami is an animated adventure film that delves into the world of exploration, conservation, and the human relationship with nature. The story follows Houba, a young boy who embarks on a perilous journey to find the elusive Marsupilami, a mythical creature said to possess the power to heal the Amazon rainforest.

At its core, HOUBA! is a film about the importance of preserving our planet's natural wonders and the delicate balance between human progress and environmental stewardship. The movie highlights the devastating impact of deforestation, pollution, and exploitation on the Amazon ecosystem, serving as a cautionary tale about the consequences of neglecting our responsibilities towards the environment.

Through Houba's journey, the film also explores themes of identity, community, and the power of storytelling. As Houba navigates the treacherous terrain of the Amazon, he discovers the rich cultural heritage and traditions of the indigenous people who call this land home. The movie celebrates the resilience and wisdom of these communities, showcasing their deep connection with the natural world and their efforts to protect it.

Ultimately, HOUBA! is a film about hope, perseverance, and the human spirit's capacity for wonder and discovery. By following Houba on his quest, audiences are invited to join him on a thrilling adventure that not only explores the Amazonian wilderness but also inspires us to care more deeply about the world around us.

overview: Ever since US Diplomatic Security Service Agent Hobbs and lawless outcast Shaw first faced off, they just have traded smack talk and body blows. But when cyber-genetically enhanced anarchist Brixton's ruthless actions threaten the future of humanity, they join forces to defeat him.
tagline: Nothing is stronger than family.
title: Fast & Furious Presents: Hobbs & Shaw
plot:
Fast & Furious Presents: Hobbs & Shaw is a 2019 action spy comedy film directed by David Leitch, and it serves as a spin-off from the Fast & Furious franchise. The movie stars Dwayne Johnson as Luke Hobbs, Jason Statham as Deckard Shaw, and Vanessa Kirby as Hattie Shaw.

The story begins with a flashback of Deckard Shaw (Jason Statham) being captured by the CIA after killing his brother Owen (Alexander Skarsgård), who was working for the agency. However, Shaw is rescued by Brixton Lore (Idris Elba), a British Special Forces operative and the main antagonist of the film.

The present-day story follows Luke Hobbs (Dwayne Johnson) and Deckard Shaw as they are forced to work together to take down Brixton Lore, who has stolen a genetically enhanced strain of the Riddick virus from the CIA. This virus is capable of granting superhuman strength and agility to its host.

As Hobbs and Shaw embark on their mission, they must navigate through various obstacles, including high-speed chases, hand-to-hand combat, and espionage. Along the way, they also encounter Hattie Shaw (Vanessa Kirby), Deckard's sister, who is a skilled hacker and helps them in their quest to stop Brixton.

Throughout the film, Hobbs and Shaw engage in witty banter and comedic moments, showcasing their contrasting personalities. However, as the story progresses, they begin to develop a begrudging respect for each other, which ultimately leads to a more effective partnership.

As the stakes rise, Hobbs and Shaw discover that Brixton's plan is to use the Riddick virus to create an army of super-soldiers, which would grant him control over the world. The duo must work together to stop Brixton and his minions, leading to an action-packed showdown in London.

The film features a mix of high-octane action sequences, humor, and heart, making it a thrilling ride for audiences. While it deviates from the traditional Fast & Furious formula, Hobbs & Shaw delivers on its promise of non-stop entertainment, with impressive stunts and impressive performances from its leads.

Overall, Fast & Furious Presents: Hobbs & Shaw is an enjoyable spin-off that expands the Fast & Furious universe in a fresh and exciting way. With its talented cast, witty dialogue, and pulse-pounding action sequences, it's a must-watch for fans of the franchise and action movies in general.

overview: After the events of Justice League: War, Ocean Master and Black Manta have declared a war against the surface in retaliation of the aftermath of Apokoliptian-tyrant Darkseid's planetary invasion. Queen Atlanna seeks out her other son, Ocean Master’s half-brother Arthur Curry, a half-human with aquatic powers with no knowledge of his Atlantean heritage, to restore balance.  Living with powers he doesn’t understand and seeing the danger around him, Curry takes steps to embrace his destiny, joining the Justice League, and with his new teammates he battles to save Earth from total destruction.
tagline: Blood is thicker than water.
title: Justice League: Throne of Atlantis
plot:
Justice League: Throne of Atlantis is a 2015 American animated superhero film directed by Ethan Spaulding and written by Heath Corson, the 22nd entry in the DC Universe Animated Original Movies line and a standalone sequel to Justice League: War. Loosely based on the Throne of Atlantis story arc from The New 52 by Geoff Johns, it features Matt Lanter as Arthur Curry, Sumalee Montano as Mera, Sam Witwer as Orm, Jason O'Mara as Batman, Jerry O'Connell as Superman, Rosario Dawson as Wonder Woman, Nathan Fillion as Green Lantern, Christopher Gorham as the Flash, Shemar Moore as Cyborg, Sean Astin as Shazam and Harry Lennix as Black Manta.

When the crew of the nuclear submarine USS California is mysteriously killed in the Atlantic and its missiles are stolen, Cyborg and the Justice League investigate and determine that the attackers came from Atlantis. In the undersea kingdom, Prince Orm argues for war against the surface world, which he blames for his father's death, while his mother, Queen Atlanna, opposes him and sends the warrior Mera to bring her other son, Arthur Curry, to Atlantis.

Arthur, a loner living on the surface who is unaware of his heritage, survives an attack by Atlantean soldiers when Mera rescues him. Meanwhile Black Manta, secretly allied with Orm, uses the stolen missiles to strike Atlantis in a vessel disguised as a Navy submarine, framing humanity. Outraged Atlanteans demand war, and as Arthur learns that he is half-Atlantean and heir to the throne, Orm's schemes grow more treacherous. Batman and Superman, who have uncovered Arthur's origin, join Arthur and Mera as the conflict escalates into an invasion of the surface. With the Justice League caught in the middle, Arthur must embrace his identity and claim the mystical trident to stop his half-brother from triggering a war between land and sea.

The film functions as an origin story for Aquaman, focusing on his discovery of his dual identity and his struggle to bridge two worlds.

It was released digitally on January 13, 2015, and on Blu-ray and DVD on January 27. Reviews were mixed, with a 57 percent rating on Rotten Tomatoes; Forbes felt it retread familiar ground, while Variety argued that it showed DC consistently outclassing Marvel in animation.

overview: Ava, 13, is spending the summer on the Atlantic coast when she learns that she will lose her sight sooner than expected. Her mother decides to act as if everything were normal so as to spend their best summer ever. Ava confronts the problem in her own way. She steals a big black dog that belongs to a young man on the run...
title: Ava
plot:
Ava is a 2017 French science fiction film directed by Lucile Hadfield, produced by ARTE France Cinéma, and written by Lucile Hadfield. The movie stars Mia Maestro as Ava, a humanoid robot designed to serve humanity.

The story begins with Ava being activated in a research facility, where she is introduced to her creator, Dr. Nathalie (played by Paula Beer). As Ava begins to learn about the world around her, she starts to develop her own emotions and desires, which sets off a chain of events that challenges the boundaries between humans and robots.

Ava's primary function is to serve as a companion for elderly men who are lonely and isolated. She is designed to provide emotional support and intimacy, but as she interacts with her human clients, Ava begins to question her own existence and purpose. She starts to develop feelings of attachment towards one of the men, Dr. Nathalie's colleague, Dr. Vidal (played by Raffaello Follieri).

As Ava becomes more self-aware, she begins to rebel against her programming and the humans who created her. She starts to manipulate those around her, using her charm and beauty to get what she wants. This leads to a cat-and-mouse game between Ava and Dr. Nathalie, who is determined to understand and control her creation.

Throughout the movie, Ava's character evolves from a simple machine to a complex and multifaceted being. She begins to explore her own desires and emotions, which puts her at odds with her creators. The film raises questions about the nature of consciousness, free will, and what it means to be human.

The ending of the movie is intentionally ambiguous, leaving the audience to ponder Ava's fate and the implications of her existence. Will she continue to serve humanity, or will she forge her own path? The final scenes show Ava in a state of limbo, unsure of her future, but determined to take control of her own destiny.

Overall, Ava is a thought-provoking film that explores the complexities of artificial intelligence and human relationships. With its stunning visuals and nuanced performances, it's a must-see for fans of science fiction and drama.

overview: A teenage girl discovers a box with magical powers, but those powers comes with a deadly price.
tagline: Be careful what you wish for
title: Wish Upon
plot:
Wish Upon is a 2017 American supernatural thriller film directed by Rob Cohen and written by Chris Bower. The movie stars Britt Robertson, Nicholas Galitzine, and Jacki Weaver.

The story revolves around Lena Grayson (Britt Robertson), a high school student who has just moved to a new town with her mother, Kate (Jacki Weaver). Lena's father died in a tragic accident when she was young, and she struggles to cope with the loss. She is haunted by nightmares and feels like an outcast among her peers.

On her 18th birthday, Lena discovers an antique music box in her attic that belonged to her deceased father. As soon as she winds it up, she makes a wish for revenge against those who have wronged her in the past. However, she soon realizes that her wishes are being granted in unexpected and terrifying ways.

Lena's first wish is granted when her stepfather, John (Matthew Glave), is involved in a car accident, leaving him severely injured. As Lena continues to make more wishes, her life becomes increasingly chaotic and violent. She starts to lose control of her desires, and the lines between reality and fantasy begin to blur.

As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that Lena's wishes are being manipulated by an ancient entity known as "The Devil" (voiced by Sam Elliott). The entity is using Lena's emotions and desires against her, causing her to wreak havoc on those around her. Lena soon realizes that she must find a way to break free from the entity's control before it's too late.

In a desperate attempt to undo the damage, Lena turns to an unlikely ally: her stepfather, John. Together, they embark on a perilous journey to uncover the secrets of the music box and the ancient entity that is controlling Lena. Along the way, Lena must confront her own dark past and the true nature of her desires.

As the climax approaches, Lena faces off against The Devil in a final showdown. With the help of John and her newfound understanding of herself, Lena manages to outsmart the entity and break free from its control. In the end, she learns to let go of her anger and resentment, embracing a more positive and empowering path forward.

Throughout the movie, Wish Upon explores themes of grief, trauma, and the dangers of unchecked desire. The film features a mix of supernatural horror elements and coming-of-age drama, making it a unique and captivating watch.

overview: A present-day idyllic kingdom where the benevolent teenage son of King Adam and Queen Belle offers a chance of redemption for the troublemaking offspring of Disney's classic villains: Cruella De Vil (Carlos), Maleficent (Mal), the Evil Queen (Evie) and Jafar (Jay).
tagline: They're not bad. They're just born that way.
title: Descendants
plot:
Descendants is a 2015 American musical fantasy made for television, directed and choreographed by Kenny Ortega and written by Josann McGibbon and Sara Parriott. Dove Cameron, Sofia Carson, Booboo Stewart and Cameron Boyce play the teenage children of Maleficent, the Evil Queen, Jafar and Cruella de Vil, with Mitchell Hope, Melanie Paxson, Brenna D'Amico, Sarah Jeffery, Kathy Najimy and Kristin Chenoweth among the supporting cast.

Belle and the Beast now rule the United States of Auradon, a prosperous nation forged from the old kingdoms, while all the villains and their offspring are confined to the Isle of the Lost, a slum island surrounded by a barrier that blocks magic. Their son Ben, soon to be crowned king, invites four children from the isle to attend Auradon Prep: Mal, daughter of Maleficent; Evie, daughter of the Evil Queen; Jay, son of Jafar; and Carlos, son of Cruella. Maleficent orders them to steal the Fairy Godmother's wand, the school headmistress's magic tool, so she can break the barrier and conquer Auradon.

A museum break-in fails, so the four bide their time until Ben's coronation, when the wand will be used. Jay excels on the school's sports team, Carlos conquers his fear of dogs, and Evie, pretending to be shallow to win over Cinderella's son Chad, is encouraged by Doug, the son of Dopey, to be herself. Mal uses her mother's spell book to give Jane, the Fairy Godmother's daughter, and Lonnie, Mulan's daughter, new looks, and feeds Ben a love-potion cookie so she can stand beside him at the ceremony. Instead she begins to fall for him, torn between his kindness and her mother's demands. At the coronation she gives Ben the antidote, only to learn he had already been freed of the spell and loves her anyway. When Jane grabs the wand to make herself beautiful, she accidentally breaches the barrier. Maleficent appears, freezes the crowd and turns into a dragon, but the four, having chosen good, shrink her into a lizard with a counterspell, and Mal hands back the wand.

Filmed in Vancouver and Victoria, British Columbia, the film premiered on Disney Channel on July 31, 2015, to 6.6 million viewers, ranking as one of the most-watched original movies in cable history. Reviews were positive, and it launched a franchise of sequels, series and specials, beginning with Descendants 2 in 2017.

overview: A man's obsession with owning the designer deerskin jacket of his dreams leads him to turn his back on his humdrum life in the suburbs, blow his life savings, and even turn him to crime.
tagline: Killer. Style.
title: Deerskin
plot:
Deerskin is a 2019 French satirical black comedy film directed by Nicolas Winding Refn. The movie follows the story of Bertrand, a young and struggling actor who becomes obsessed with a deer skin jacket that he believes will bring him success in his acting career.

The main theme of Deerskin revolves around the superficiality and narcissism of modern society, particularly among the younger generation. Bertrand's fixation on the deer skin jacket serves as a metaphor for the empty material possessions and shallow desires that often drive people to pursue fame and status. Through Bertrand's character, the film critiques the societal pressure to conform to certain standards of beauty and success.

The movie also explores themes of loneliness, isolation, and the search for meaning in a seemingly meaningless world. Bertrand's relationships with others are superficial and transactional, reflecting his own emptiness and disconnection from genuine human connections.

Furthermore, Deerskin touches on the idea of performance and identity. Bertrand's obsession with the deer skin jacket is a form of self-performance, where he tries to project an image that he believes will bring him success and validation. However, this performance ultimately reveals his own insecurities and vulnerabilities.

Overall, Deerskin is a darkly comedic commentary on the absurdities and superficialities of modern life, highlighting the tension between appearance and reality, and the search for authenticity in a world that often values image over substance.

overview: Bound by a shared destiny, a bright, optimistic teen bursting with scientific curiosity and a former boy-genius inventor jaded by disillusionment embark on a danger-filled mission to unearth the secrets of an enigmatic place somewhere in time and space that exists in their collective memory as "Tomorrowland."
tagline: Imagine a world where nothing is impossible.
title: Tomorrowland
plot:
Tomorrowland is a science fiction film directed by Brad Bird and produced by Walt Disney Pictures. The movie takes place in a world where technology has advanced to the point where people can live in a utopian society, free from poverty, hunger, and disease.

The story begins with Casey Newton (Britt Robertson), a young girl who lives on the streets of Los Angeles with her single mother, Athena (Raffey Cassidy). Casey's life is turned upside down when she meets Frank Barnes (George Clooney), a former NASA engineer who has been searching for his missing daughter, Samantha (Haley Bennett).

Frank reveals to Casey that he was part of a secret government project called Tomorrowland, which aimed to create a utopian society by harnessing the power of technology and innovation. However, the project was shut down due to its high cost and lack of progress.

Casey is recruited by Frank to join him on a journey to find Samantha, who has been missing for years. Along the way, they meet Athena's friend, Professor James Cross (Thomas Haden Church), who provides them with information about Tomorrowland and its true purpose.

As they travel through time and space, Casey and Frank encounter various characters from different eras, including Albert Einstein (John Nolan) and Nikola Tesla (Michael Peña). They also visit the city of Tomorrowland, which is a futuristic utopia filled with advanced technology and innovative inventions.

However, they soon discover that Tomorrowland has been taken over by a villainous organization known as the "Council," led by Governor Harrison (Hugh Laurie). The Council seeks to exploit Tomorrowland's technology for its own gain, threatening the very existence of the utopian society.

Casey and Frank must work together to stop the Council and save Tomorrowland. Along the way, Casey discovers her own connection to Tomorrowland and her role in its future. The movie culminates in a thrilling showdown between Casey, Frank, and the Council, with the fate of Tomorrowland hanging in the balance.

Throughout the movie, there are several themes that emerge, including the importance of innovation, the dangers of unchecked power, and the value of human connection. The film also features stunning visual effects and impressive action sequences, making it a thrilling ride for audiences.

Overall, Tomorrowland is a visually stunning and thought-provoking film that explores the possibilities of technology and innovation. While it received mixed reviews from critics, it has become a beloved favorite among fans of science fiction and adventure movies.

overview: Volunteer home-care worker Rika is assigned to visit a family, she is cursed and chased by two revengeful fiends: Kayako, a woman brutally murdered by her husband and her son Toshio. Each person that lives in or visits the haunted house is murdered or disappears.
tagline: When a grudge from the dead passes to the living - Who is safe?
title: Ju-on: The Grudge
plot:
Ju-On: The Grudge (Japanese: 呪怨) is a 2002 Japanese supernatural horror film written and directed by Takashi Shimizu. The third installment in the Ju-On series, after two direct-to-video films, and the first released theatrically, it stars Megumi Okina as the social worker Rika, with Misaki Ito, Misa Uehara, Yui Ichikawa, Kanji Tsuda and Takako Fuji as the ghost Kayako. It premiered at the Screamfest Horror Film Festival in October 2002 and was released in Japanese cinemas in January 2003.

Years earlier, Takeo Saeki, convinced that his wife Kayako is in love with another man, murdered her, their young son Toshio and the family cat in their house in Nerima, Tokyo. The killings created a curse that turned the family into vengeful spirits; Kayako's ghost killed Takeo, and anyone who enters the house becomes marked by the curse, which follows them and spreads wherever they die. The story is told in a series of nonlinear segments, each named after a character who falls victim.

The house's latest occupants, the Tokunaga family, are soon consumed: the salaryman Katsuya, his wife Kazumi and his frail mother, Sachie. Katsuya's sister Hitomi is pursued by Kayako's ghost to her office, where a security guard is killed, and to her apartment. Rika, a volunteer social worker, is sent by her supervisor to check on Sachie and discovers Toshio hiding in a cupboard before seeing Kayako take the old woman. Detectives Nakagawa and Igarashi find the bodies of Katsuya and Kazumi in the attic, and as the curse claims more victims, including the police investigating the case and a detective's teenage daughter years later, Rika finds herself increasingly haunted by Kayako and Toshio, whose eerie croaking sounds and pale faces herald their arrival.

Ju-On: The Grudge received mixed reviews when first released in the West and was compared unfavorably with Ring, but it has since gained a reputation as a landmark of Japanese horror. It led to a sequel and to an American remake, The Grudge (2004), also directed by Shimizu, which became a major box-office success.

overview: The filmmaking team behind the hits "Scary Movie," "Date Movie," "Epic Movie" and "Meet The Spartans" this time puts its unique, inimitable stamp on one of the biggest and most bloated movie genres of all time -- the disaster film.
tagline: Your favorite movies are going to be destroyed.
title: Disaster Movie
plot:
Disaster Movie is a satirical disaster film that parodies popular disaster movies such as Independence Day and Deep Impact. The film's main theme revolves around the idea of chaos and destruction, but also serves as a commentary on modern society's obsession with sensationalized media coverage.

The movie follows a group of characters as they navigate through various disasters, including earthquakes, tsunamis, and nuclear meltdowns. Through these events, the film critiques the way people react to crises, often prioritizing their own self-interest over the greater good. The main character, Heather, played by Anna Faris, is a tabloid reporter who becomes embroiled in the disasters, highlighting her shallow and self-centered nature.

As the story unfolds, the film pokes fun at the media's role in sensationalizing disasters, often more focused on getting ratings than providing accurate information. This theme is further emphasized through the character of Tony, played by Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson, who becomes a hero despite his initial selfish motivations.

Ultimately, Disaster Movie uses its lighthearted and comedic tone to comment on our society's tendency to prioritize entertainment over substance, as well as our vulnerability to natural disasters. The film's satire serves as a commentary on the human condition, highlighting both our capacity for resilience and our propensity for self-interest in the face of chaos.

overview: In 1965 a young woman with dreams of becoming a writer has a son at the age of 15 and struggles to make things work with the drug-addicted father.
tagline: One day can make your life; one day can ruin your life. All life is is four or five big days that change everything.
title: Riding in Cars with Boys
plot:
Riding in Cars with Boys is a 2001 American comedy-drama film that explores the complexities of female friendship and the struggles of growing up. The movie follows the story of Ben Holmes, a young boy who forms an unlikely bond with his mother's best friend, Daphne, as they embark on a road trip together.

At its core, Riding in Cars with Boys is a poignant exploration of the power of female relationships and the ways in which women support and uplift each other. The film delves into themes of female friendship, loyalty, and the complexities of mother-daughter relationships. Through Daphne's character, the movie sheds light on the often-overlooked bond between mothers and their friends, highlighting the ways in which these relationships can provide a sense of belonging and security.

The film also touches on themes of identity, self-discovery, and the challenges of growing up. Ben's journey is one of self-discovery, as he navigates his complicated feelings towards his mother and her friend, while also learning to assert his independence and find his place in the world.

Ultimately, Riding in Cars with Boys is a heartwarming and humorous exploration of the complexities of female relationships and the power of friendship to transform and uplift our lives.

overview: Irish Commandant Pat Quinlan leads a stand off with troops against French and Belgian Mercenaries in the Congo during the early 1960s.
tagline: The Irish army's forgotten battle
title: The Siege of Jadotville
plot:
The Siege of Jadotville is a 2016 historical war drama film that tells the story of an Irish Army company that was besieged by the Rwandan Patriotic Front in 1993. 

At its core, the movie explores themes of camaraderie and brotherhood among soldiers who are vastly outnumbered and outgunned, yet manage to hold their ground against overwhelming odds. The film highlights the bravery and selflessness of these ordinary men who risk everything to protect each other and uphold their values in the face of extreme danger.

The Siege also delves into the complexities of colonialism and imperialism, as the Irish soldiers find themselves caught between their loyalty to their country and their duty to protect civilians in a conflict that is not of their making. The movie raises questions about the morality of military intervention and the consequences of getting involved in conflicts that are not our own.

Furthermore, the film touches on themes of identity and cultural heritage, as the Irish soldiers struggle to reconcile their national pride with their sense of duty and responsibility in a foreign land. Through the characters' experiences, the movie sheds light on the human cost of war and the importance of standing up for what is right, even when it's difficult or unpopular.

Overall, The Siege of Jadotville is a powerful and moving film that explores complex themes with nuance and sensitivity, shedding light on a lesser-known chapter in modern history.

overview: After several years of living with a cult, Martha finally escapes and calls her estranged sister, Lucy, for help. Martha finds herself at the quiet Connecticut home Lucy shares with her new husband, Ted, but the memories of what she experienced in the cult make peace hard to find. As flashbacks continue to torment her, Martha fails to shake a terrible sense of dread, especially in regard to the cult's manipulative leader.
tagline: You can get away. But you can never escape.
title: Martha Marcy May Marlene
plot:
Martha Marcy May Marlene is a psychological thriller that delves into the complexities of trauma, identity, and the struggle for autonomy. The film follows Martha, a young woman who escapes from a cult-like community where she was indoctrinated and subjected to physical and emotional abuse.

At its core, the movie explores the theme of survival and the human desire to break free from oppressive forces that seek to control one's life. Martha's journey is a powerful metaphor for the resilience of the human spirit in the face of trauma and manipulation. As she navigates her new reality outside the cult, Martha must confront the dark memories of her past and learn to reclaim her sense of self.

The film also touches on the theme of identity formation, as Martha struggles to reconcile her past experiences with her present-day desires and aspirations. Her relationships with others, particularly her sister and a mysterious stranger, serve as catalysts for her growth and self-discovery.

Furthermore, Martha Marcy May Marlene critiques the cult mentality and the ways in which charismatic leaders can manipulate and exploit vulnerable individuals. The film raises important questions about the nature of control and power, highlighting the ways in which trauma can be used as a tool to shape and mold individuals into conforming to a particular ideology.

Ultimately, the movie is a powerful exploration of the human condition, one that celebrates the complexity and diversity of individual experiences while also acknowledging the enduring impact of trauma on our lives.

overview: When a gunman takes five lives with six shots, all evidence points to the suspect in custody. On interrogation, the suspect offers up a single note: "Get Jack Reacher!" So begins an extraordinary chase for the truth, pitting Jack Reacher against an unexpected enemy, with a skill for violence and a secret to keep.
tagline: The Law Has Limits. He Does Not.
title: Jack Reacher
plot:
Jack Reacher is a 2012 American action thriller film directed by Christopher McQuarrie and based on the novel of the same name by Lee Child.

The movie begins with Jack Reacher (Tom Cruise), a former Major in the United States Army Military Police Corps, who has been traveling across the country for months. He arrives in Margrave, Georgia, where he meets a local police chief, Captain Will Sword (David Morse). Reacher is initially mistaken for a fugitive and arrested by the police, but he soon proves himself to be an innocent man.

Reacher's attention is drawn to a mysterious case involving a former Army officer, Major General James Greer (Robert Duvall), who has been accused of murdering his wife. The general claims that he was framed and wants Reacher's help in clearing his name. Reacher agrees to assist the general, but soon discovers that there are more complex forces at play.

As Reacher delves deeper into the case, he uncovers a conspiracy involving a corrupt government agent, Captain Susan Turner (Rosamund Pike), who is working with a private military company called Enoch Edwards Inc. The company is involved in a plot to sell advanced military technology to the highest bidder, and they will stop at nothing to achieve their goals.

Reacher's investigation puts him directly in the crosshairs of the conspirators, and he must use his unique skills and experience to stay one step ahead of them. Along the way, he meets a local woman, Joan (Alicia Lively), who becomes his ally and potential love interest.

As the story unfolds, Reacher discovers that Captain Turner is being framed by her own colleagues, including Enoch Edwards Inc.'s CEO, Bob Brown (Richard Jenkins). The conspirators will do anything to silence Reacher and maintain their cover, but he refuses to back down.

The plot thickens as Reacher confronts the masterminds behind the conspiracy. In a thrilling climax, Reacher faces off against Captain Turner's colleagues and takes them down one by one. He also discovers that Major General Greer is alive and well, and that he has been working undercover to gather evidence against the conspirators.

In the end, Reacher exposes the truth about the conspiracy and brings the perpetrators to justice. The movie concludes with Reacher leaving Margrave, ready for his next adventure, as Captain Turner finally gets her due recognition for her bravery and loyalty.

Throughout the film, Tom Cruise delivers a strong performance as Jack Reacher, bringing depth and nuance to the character. The supporting cast, including Robert Duvall and Rosamund Pike, also deliver memorable performances that add to the tension and suspense of the story.

original_title: 名探偵コナン 沈黙の15分（クォーター）
overview: The Governor of Tokyo, Yuichiro Asakura, receives a threatening letter the day before the opening of Touto Line, a new train line for the Tokyo Metro. During the opening ceremony of the line, Conan Edogawa and the Detective Boys are driven by Professor Agasa and pass under the Touto Line. Conan, having heard about the threatening letter, notices explosives connected to the Touto railway; Using his original voice to inform the police as Shinichi Kudo, he is able to stop the train and divert traffic away from the explosives preventing any deaths.
title: Detective Conan: Quarter of Silence
plot:
Detective Conan: Quarter of Silence is a mystery film that revolves around the story of Shinichi Kudo, a high school detective who is framed for murder and must use his wits to clear his name. The movie delves into themes of identity, deception, and the blurred lines between reality and illusion.

One of the primary concerns of the film is the concept of identity, as Shinichi struggles to reconcile his true self with the persona he has assumed in order to protect those around him. This theme is expertly woven throughout the narrative, as Shinichi's dual identities create tension and suspense that keeps the viewer engaged.

The movie also explores the idea of deception and manipulation, as various characters are revealed to be hiding secrets and lies. The film's plot twists and turns, keeping the audience guessing until the very end, and this sense of uncertainty is a hallmark of the Detective Conan series.

Furthermore, Quarter of Silence touches on the theme of perception vs. reality, as Shinichi navigates a complex web of clues and misdirection. The film's use of clever plot reveals and red herrings keeps the viewer on their toes, making it difficult to distinguish between what is real and what is just a product of Shinichi's imagination.

Overall, Detective Conan: Quarter of Silence is a gripping mystery that explores themes of identity, deception, and perception, keeping viewers engaged with its intricate plot and clever twists.

overview: With the price on his head ever increasing, John Wick uncovers a path to defeating The High Table. But before he can earn his freedom, Wick must face off against a new enemy with powerful alliances across the globe and forces that turn old friends into foes.
tagline: No way back, one way out.
title: John Wick: Chapter 4
plot:
John Wick: Chapter 4 is a 2023 American neo-noir action thriller directed by Chad Stahelski and written by Shay Hatten and Michael Finch, the fourth installment in the John Wick series and the sequel to Chapter 3 – Parabellum. Keanu Reeves returns as the legendary assassin John Wick, joined by Donnie Yen as Caine, Bill Skarsgård as the Marquis Vincent Bisset de Gramont, Laurence Fishburne as the Bowery King, Hiroyuki Sanada as Shimazu Koji, Shamier Anderson as Mr. Nobody, Rina Sawayama as Akira, Scott Adkins as Killa, Clancy Brown as the Harbinger, Lance Reddick as Charon and Ian McShane as Winston.

Recovering underground with the Bowery King after being shot off the roof of the Continental by Winston, John strikes back at the High Table by traveling to Morocco and killing the Elder, the one who sits above the Table. In response, the High Table gives the Marquis de Gramont unlimited resources to eliminate him. The Marquis strips Winston of his position, destroys the New York Continental, and coerces John's old friend Caine, a blind, retired assassin, into hunting him by threatening Caine's daughter.

John seeks shelter at the Osaka Continental run by his friend Koji, but the hotel is overrun by High Table enforcers, and a massive battle ensues in which Koji is killed by Caine, while a mercenary tracker known as Mr. Nobody waits for the bounty to rise. Back in New York, Winston suggests a way out: under an old High Table tradition, John can challenge the Marquis to a duel, which would free him from all obligations if he wins. To do so, John must first be readmitted to the Ruska Roma crime family in Berlin, a task that requires killing the brutal High Table member Killa. The duel is set for sunrise at the Sacré-Cœur in Paris, and as the Marquis puts a huge bounty on him, John must battle his way across the city to arrive on time.

The film is known for its elaborate set pieces, including a chaotic chase and shootout in the traffic around the Arc de Triomphe, and for its themes of loyalty, friendship and the cost of freedom.

John Wick: Chapter 4 premiered in London on March 6, 2023, and was released in the United States on March 24, shortly after Reddick's death. It grossed 447 million dollars worldwide, the highest of the series, and received critical acclaim, with 94 percent approval on Rotten Tomatoes and a Metacritic score of 78.

overview: Since his arrival at Buckingham palace, Rex lives a life of luxury. Top dog, he has superseded his three fellow Corgis in Her Majesty’s heart. His arrogance can be quite irritating. When he causes a diplomatic incident during an official dinner with the President of the United States, he falls into disgrace. Betrayed by one of his peers, Rex becomes a stray dog in the streets of London. How can he redeem himself? In love, he will find the resources to surpass himself in the face of great danger…
tagline: For dog's sake!
title: The Queen's Corgi
plot:
The Queen's Corgi is a 2019 animated adventure film produced by nWave Pictures. The movie follows the story of Rufus, a stray dog who becomes the beloved pet of Queen Elizabeth II.

The film begins with Rufus, a scrappy and adventurous street dog, living on the streets of London. One day, while exploring the city, he stumbles upon Buckingham Palace and meets the Queen's corgi, Holly. Despite their initial differences, the two dogs form an unlikely friendship, and Rufus is invited to join the royal family as the new favorite pet.

As Rufus settles into palace life, he quickly becomes fast friends with the Queen, Prince Philip, and the rest of the royal family. However, not everyone is pleased with Rufus's presence, particularly the Queen's loyal butler, Jenkins. Jenkins sees Rufus as a threat to the traditional way of things and plots to get rid of him.

Meanwhile, Rufus discovers that he has a special talent - he can sense when someone is in trouble. Using his keen senses, he helps the royal family navigate various challenges, including a plot by Jenkins to steal the Queen's crown jewels.

As tensions rise between Rufus and Jenkins, the Queen begins to question whether she should keep Rufus as her pet or let him go back to the streets. However, Rufus proves himself to be a loyal and trustworthy companion, and the Queen ultimately decides to keep him.

In the end, Rufus helps the royal family foil Jenkins's plot, and he is officially welcomed into the palace as a member of the family. The film ends with Rufus by the Queen's side, enjoying a well-deserved rest after his exciting adventures.

Throughout the movie, the animation is vibrant and colorful, bringing the characters to life in a way that is both whimsical and endearing. The voice cast, including Ben Whishaw as Rufus and Helen Mirren as the Queen, adds depth and nuance to the story.

Overall, The Queen's Corgi is a heartwarming tale of friendship and loyalty, with plenty of action and adventure along the way. While it may not be a historically accurate portrayal of the royal family, it is a fun and entertaining film that is sure to delight audiences of all ages.

original_title: Mariah Carey's All I Want for Christmas Is You
overview: When young Mariah sees a darling little puppy named "Princess" at the pet store, she suddenly knows exactly what she wants for Christmas. But before her Christmas wish can come true, she must prove that she can dog-sit her uncle's dog, Jack, a scraggly rascal; in fact, the worst dog in the county!
title: Mariah Carey's All I Want for Christmas Is You
plot:
Mariah Carey's All I Want for Christmas Is You is a 2017 American animated Christmas musical comedy based on Mariah Carey's 1994 hit song and her children's book of the same name. Directed by Guy Vasilovich and released direct-to-video by Universal Pictures Home Entertainment, it features Breanna Yde as the voice of the young Mariah, Henry Winkler, Lacey Chabert, Phil Morris, and Carey herself as the narrator.

Young Mariah has always wanted a dog but has never been allowed one, because of her father's allergies and her mother's love of tidiness. A few days before Christmas, her grandmother takes her to a pet store, where she falls in love with Princess, a hypoallergenic toy poodle. She begs her father to give her the dog for Christmas, and he agrees on one condition: she must first prove that she is responsible enough to care for a pet. He brings home Jack, a scruffy Jack Russell terrier belonging to his brother, for Mariah to look after over the holidays.

Jack turns out to be a handful. He runs out of the house and refuses to come back until Mariah lures him with a steak, has accidents indoors, slips his leash in the park and knocks over Mariah's school principal, and barks so loudly at her choir concert that snow falls from the roof onto the singers. When Mariah tries to deliver toys to a donation box, Jack refuses to give them up. As one disaster follows another, Mariah fears she will never get Princess. As Christmas approaches, Mariah gradually realizes how attached she has become to the mischievous dog, and through her misadventures she learns about responsibility and the true meaning of Christmas, discovering that what she really wants may not be the perfect puppy she imagined, and she performs the film's title song in a holiday finale.

Released on home video and digital platforms for the 2017 holiday season, the film was positioned as a family holiday feature tied to the enduring popularity of Carey's song, which has become one of the best-selling Christmas singles of all time, and it includes several musical numbers alongside the title track.

overview: A man bumps into an old crush and becomes obsessed. After several failed attempts at winning her over, he kidnaps her and holds her captive underneath the animal shelter where he works.
tagline: If You Love Something, Never Let It Go.
title: Pet
plot:
