overview: When the popular, restless Landon Carter is forced to participate in the school drama production he falls in love with Jamie Sullivan, the daughter of the town's minister. Jamie has a "to-do" list for her life and also a very big secret she must keep from Landon.
tagline: It all comes down to who's by your side.
title: A Walk to Remember
plot:
A Walk to Remember is a 2002 American romantic drama film directed by Adam Shankman, based on the novel of the same name by Nicholas Sparks.

The movie begins with Landon Carter (played by Shane West), a popular high school student who has just been sentenced to community service for hazing his classmate. During his service, he meets Jamie Sullivan (played by Mandy Moore), a shy and devout Christian girl who is diagnosed with leukemia. Despite their initial differences, the two begin to form a bond as they spend more time together.

As Landon gets to know Jamie, he learns about her strong faith and values, which challenge his own worldview. He also begins to see Jamie in a different light, beyond her illness, and develops feelings for her. However, their social differences and the fact that Jamie is terminally ill make their relationship complicated.

Throughout the film, Landon and Jamie's friendship blossoms into romance, but they face numerous obstacles, including Jamie's declining health and the disapproval of some of Landon's friends. As Jamie's condition worsens, Landon becomes her primary caregiver, and he learns to appreciate the beauty of life and the importance of living in the present.

As the story unfolds, Landon and Jamie's relationship deepens, and they face the reality of their mortality. The film takes a poignant turn when Jamie reveals that she has been praying for Landon to find faith, and that she wants him to be happy even if she is not around anymore.

The movie's climax is both heart-wrenching and uplifting as Landon comes to terms with his own spirituality and the meaning of life. The film ends on a hopeful note, with Landon finding solace in his newfound faith and the memories he shared with Jamie.

Throughout the film, the chemistry between Shane West and Mandy Moore is undeniable, bringing depth and nuance to their characters. The supporting cast, including Peter Coyote as Landon's father and Daryl Hannah as Jamie's mother, adds to the emotional resonance of the story.

Overall, A Walk to Remember is a beautifully crafted film that explores themes of love, faith, and mortality with sensitivity and authenticity. The movie's poignant portrayal of a young couple's relationship has resonated with audiences worldwide, making it a timeless classic in the world of romantic dramas.

original_title: Teen Titans Go! See Space Jam
overview: The Teen Titans are visited by the Nerdlucks, the Space Jam villains who tried to capture Michael Jordan and the Looney Tunes. Astonished to discover his fellow Titans have never seen Space Jam, Cyborg organizes an exclusive watch party.
title: Teen Titans Go! See Space Jam
plot:
Teen Titans Go! See Space Jam is a 2021 American animated television film directed by Peter Rida Michail and written by Brady Klosterman, a crossover between the Cartoon Network series Teen Titans Go! and the 1996 Warner Bros. film Space Jam. Produced by Warner Bros. Animation with DC Entertainment, it premiered on Cartoon Network on 20 June 2021, ahead of Space Jam: A New Legacy, and was released digitally in late July. Originally titled Space Jam 1.5, it follows the format of Mystery Science Theater 3000: the Titans watch an abridged version of the original film and comment on it throughout. Scott Menville, Khary Payton, Hynden Walch, Tara Strong and Greg Cipes return as Robin, Cyborg, Starfire, Raven and Beast Boy, with John DiMaggio and Fred Tatasciore voicing the Nerdlucks.

The Titans are relaxing by the pool at Titans Tower when a spaceship lands and the Nerdlucks, the small aliens who tried to kidnap Michael Jordan and the Looney Tunes in Space Jam, step out carrying a VHS copy of the film. Robin is convinced they are evil, but the others overrule him and invite them in. Astonished to discover that his teammates have never seen Space Jam, Cyborg organises a watch party. As the film plays, Raven and Starfire supply running commentary, with Starfire pointing out plot holes, Cyborg presents fun facts, Beast Boy keeps count of the film's many butt shots, and Robin keeps a suspicious eye on the guests. When the movie shows the Nerdlucks stealing the talents of NBA players, the Titans pause it and, apart from Robin, let the visitors try the trick on them: Blanko takes Cyborg's powers, Bupkus Raven's, Bang Beast Boy's and Nawt Starfire's, while Pound is left unchanged because Robin has no powers to give. As the screening continues, the question is whether the Nerdlucks have come for an innocent party or have something more sinister in mind.

New animated sequences of the Titans are spliced into the archive footage, which features Michael Jordan, Wayne Knight, Bill Murray and Billy West as Bugs Bunny. Much of the original was trimmed for time, and its well-known songs were replaced with other music, apparently for licensing reasons.

Reviewers found the premise fun but the execution unbalanced. It's A Stampede! praised the humour of the Titans' commentary and its jokes about parts of Space Jam that have aged badly, but felt there was too much of the old film and too little new Titans material, leaving a hybrid that works fully as neither.

original_title: ペンギン・ハイウェイ
overview: A fourth-grader investigates the mysterious reason behind the sudden appearance of penguins in his village, which is somehow related to a power from a young woman working at a dental clinic.
tagline: A penguin has appeared in my town.
title: Penguin Highway
plot:
Penguin Highway is a 2018 Japanese coming-of-age drama film directed by Hiromasa Yonebayashi. The movie follows Jiro Horikoshi, an 11-year-old boy who discovers a mysterious portal in the woods near his home that leads to a parallel universe where penguins have taken over.

The main themes of Penguin Highway revolve around the idea of self-discovery and the struggle to find one's place in the world. Jiro's journey is not just about exploring this alternate universe, but also about understanding himself and his relationships with others. The film delves into the complexities of childhood friendships, first love, and the challenges of growing up.

The movie also explores the concept of identity and how it can be shaped by our experiences and interactions with the world around us. Jiro's encounter with the penguins forces him to confront his own insecurities and fears, leading him to develop a greater sense of self-awareness and confidence.

Furthermore, Penguin Highway touches on the idea of nostalgia and the importance of holding onto childhood wonder and curiosity. The film's use of fantasy and adventure elements serves as a metaphor for the magic and excitement of growing up, and how it can be both exhilarating and terrifying.

Overall, Penguin Highway is a heartwarming and thought-provoking film that explores the complexities of childhood and adolescence with sensitivity and nuance.

overview: Life for a single mom in Los Angeles takes an unexpected turn when she allows three young guys to move in with her.
tagline: Starting over is not for beginners.
title: Home Again
plot:
Home Again is a 2017 American romantic comedy film directed by Hallie Meyers-Shyer. The movie follows the story of Anna, a young woman who returns to her hometown after a painful breakup and finds herself reconnecting with three charming men.

The main theme of Home Again revolves around the idea of finding one's identity and sense of belonging. Anna, having been away from home for some time, is forced to confront her past and re-evaluate her life choices. As she navigates her relationships with the three men, she begins to rediscover herself and find a new sense of purpose.

The film also explores the theme of female empowerment and independence. Anna's journey is marked by her growing confidence and self-reliance, as she learns to take control of her life and make decisions that align with her values. Through her relationships, she finds support and encouragement from the men in her life, who help her to see herself in a new light.

Furthermore, Home Again touches on the theme of healing and recovery. Anna's past is marked by pain and heartbreak, but as she moves forward, she begins to confront her emotions and find ways to heal. The film suggests that it's never too late to start anew and that with time, support, and self-reflection, one can overcome even the most difficult challenges.

Overall, Home Again is a heartwarming and uplifting film that celebrates the power of female friendship, love, and personal growth.

overview: A plover chick has not learned to fly when his family migrates in the fall. He must survive the arctic winter, vicious enemies and himself in order to be reunited with his beloved one next spring.
title: Ploey: You Never Fly Alone
plot:
Ploey: You Never Fly Alone is a heartwarming animated film that explores the theme of friendship and the power of believing in oneself. The story revolves around Ploey, a young penguin who dreams of flying but is told he's too small and too slow for it. However, with the help of his friends, Ploey discovers that even though he may not be able to fly like they do, he has other unique abilities that make him special.

The film delves into the idea that everyone has their own strengths and weaknesses, and that it's okay to be different. It also highlights the importance of perseverance, self-acceptance, and the value of having supportive friends by your side. Through Ploey's journey, the movie shows that with courage and determination, one can overcome obstacles and achieve their goals.

The film's themes are further enhanced by its beautiful animation, which brings to life the stunning landscapes of Antarctica and the endearing characters that inhabit it. The movie's message is one of hope and empowerment, encouraging viewers to embrace their individuality and never give up on their dreams.

overview: When her nation is invaded, a young princess is taken into the Princess Protection Program. She is relocated to Louisiana, where she stays with a covert agent and his tomboyish daughter, and must learn how to behave like an ordinary teenager.
tagline: Royality meets reality.
title: Princess Protection Program
plot:
Princess Protection Program is a 2009 American comedy television film produced as a Disney Channel Original Movie, directed by Allison Liddi-Brown and written by Annie DeYoung from a story by DeYoung and David Morgasen. Demi Lovato stars as Princess Rosalinda and Selena Gomez as Carter Mason, with Tom Verica as her father, Nicholas Braun and Molly Hagan. It premiered on Disney Channel on 26 June 2009 and was released on DVD shortly afterwards.

Princess Rosalinda María Montoya Fioré is about to be crowned queen of the small nation of Costa Luna when her coronation rehearsal is interrupted by General Magnus Kane, the dictator of neighboring Costa Estrella, whose forces storm the palace in an attempt to seize the country. Major Joe Mason, an agent of the Princess Protection Program, a secret organization funded by royal families to protect endangered princesses, rescues Rosalinda by helicopter, but Kane's men capture her widowed mother, Queen Sofía.

While the program works to remove Kane from power and free her kingdom, Rosalinda is hidden at Joe's home in rural Louisiana, where she meets his daughter, Carter, an insecure tomboy who works at the family bait shop and dreams of going to the homecoming dance with her crush, Donny, unaware that her classmate Ed likes her. Rosalinda poses as Rosie Gonzalez, Carter's cousin from Iowa. Carter is hostile at first, but warms to her after learning her story, and the two become close friends. Carter teaches Rosie to act like an ordinary American teenager, while Rosie shows Carter how to carry herself with the confidence of a princess. Rosie becomes popular at school and is nominated for homecoming queen, angering a snobbish classmate, Chelsea. Meanwhile, Kane is determined to find the princess and secure his hold on Costa Luna, and when his agents track her down, Carter devises a plan to protect her friend, leading to a confrontation at the homecoming dance.

The film drew more than eight million viewers on its premiere and won the Teen Choice Award for Choice Summer Movie. Laura Fries of Variety described it as light as a summer breeze on the Louisiana bayou, praising its message about self-esteem and predicting it would be a hit with the channel's audience.

overview: A news team is sent to Burundi to capture and bring home a legendary 25-foot crocodile. Their difficult task turns potentially deadly when a warlord targets them for death.
tagline: Inspired by the true story of the most prolific serial killer in history.
title: Primeval
plot:
Primeval is a 2007 American action horror film directed by Michael Katleman, starring Dominic Purcell as Tim Manfrey, Brooke Langton as Aviva Masters and Orlando Jones as Steven Johnson, with Jürgen Prochnow and Gideon Emery. It was partly inspired by Gustave, a real giant man-eating Nile crocodile in Burundi said to measure about 20 feet, and follows an American news team sent to capture him.

After a British forensic anthropologist examining a mass grave in Burundi is dragged into a river and killed, New York television journalist Tim Manfrey, who is in trouble over a story built on falsified evidence, is sent by his boss to Burundi with animal reporter Aviva Masters to cover the legend of Gustave, a colossal crocodile blamed for hundreds of deaths. Joined by cameraman Steven Johnson and herpetologist Matt Collins, who hopes to capture the animal alive, they ignore warnings from a government official called Harry about a ruthless warlord known as "Little Gustave" and head into the bush with two soldiers. In a riverside village they meet the hunter Jacob Krieg, and a shaman tells them that humanity's darkness breeds its own monsters.

Their steel cage, baited with a goat, fails, though Matt hits Gustave with a tracking dart. Steven secretly films the warlord's men executing the shaman and his family, putting the team in danger. Gustave kills a soldier who attacks Aviva, and the other soldier wounds Jacob before being killed by a village boy, Jojo. When the crocodile attacks their stilt house, Jacob, whose wife was killed by Gustave, tries to blow it up with a grenade that fails and is devoured. The next morning, the warlord's men destroy their rescue helicopter and kill Matt, and Steven is chased down by Gustave. Tim realizes that the bodies left by the civil war fed the crocodile's growth, and that Harry is actually Little Gustave. Demanding the execution footage, Harry is tricked into following the dart's signal to Gustave's lair, where Aviva douses him in crocodile pheromones and the beast devours him. Tim drives the crocodile off with a machete, and the survivors escape. The credits note that the real Gustave was believed to still be alive.

Released by Disney on January 12, 2007, the film received negative reviews and grossed about $15.3 million worldwide. Katleman later said that marketing the crocodile like a serial killer, rather than as a monster movie, hurt the film. It is unrelated to the British television series of the same name.

overview: When her husband suddenly dumps her, longtime dedicated housewife Deanna turns regret into re-set by going back to college... landing in the same class and school as her daughter, who's not entirely sold on the idea. Plunging headlong into the campus experience, the increasingly outspoken Deanna – now Dee Rock – embraces freedom, fun and frat boys on her own terms, finding her true self in a senior year no one ever expected.
tagline: Give life the old college try.
title: Life of the Party
plot:
"Life of the Party" is a 2018 American comedy film directed by Ben Falcone and starring Melissa McCarthy. The movie follows Deanna Miles, a recently divorced mother who decides to attend college with her daughter, making her the youngest student in her class.

The main themes of "Life of the Party" include:

1. Female empowerment: Deanna's decision to go back to school is a symbol of her newfound independence and desire for personal growth. The film showcases her transformation from a stay-at-home mom to a confident and determined individual.
2. Mother-daughter relationships: The movie explores the complexities of mother-daughter relationships, particularly in the context of divorce and co-parenting. Deanna's relationship with her daughter is at the center of the story, and their bond is put to the test as they navigate this new chapter together.
3. Identity formation: As Deanna navigates college life, she must confront her own identity and sense of purpose. The film pokes fun at the challenges of finding one's place in the world after a significant life change.
4. Self-discovery: Through her experiences, Deanna discovers new aspects of herself and develops a greater understanding of what she wants to achieve in life. This theme is closely tied to the idea of female empowerment.

The movie also features some comedic moments that highlight the absurdity of college life and the challenges faced by non-traditional students. Overall, "Life of the Party" is a heartwarming and humorous exploration of themes that are relevant to many women's lives.

overview: A nurse living in a small town goes on a blind date with a man who is not the person he says he is.
tagline: She will have he revenge.
title: Return to Sender
plot:
Return to Sender is a 2015 American psychological thriller directed by Fouad Mikati, a rape-and-revenge story starring Rosamund Pike as a small-town nurse, Shiloh Fernandez as the man who assaults her and Nick Nolte as her father. Rumer Willis, Camryn Manheim and Illeana Douglas appear in supporting roles.

Miranda Wells is a nurse in a small town who is in the process of buying a new house. A friend arranges a blind date for her with a man named Kevin, and when a stranger turns up at her door on the day of the date, Miranda assumes he is Kevin and lets him in. He is courteous at first, but his manner turns, he refuses to leave, locks the door and brutally attacks and rapes her. The real Kevin finds her and takes her to the hospital. Miranda recognises her attacker as a worker from a restaurant she visited recently, and the police arrest him: William Finn.

Life does not return to normal. Her real estate agent tells her the house has become unsellable because of what happened in it, and she is passed over for a promotion at work. Miranda begins writing to William in prison, but her letters keep being returned until one finally arrives with the words "You win" written on the envelope. She visits him, he apologises again and again, and the visits become regular, friendly and even flirtatious. Her father, Mitchell, is appalled when he learns she is still in contact with the man, and the two fall out.

After his release, William shows up at her house uninvited, and Miranda sets him to work repairing her porch. One afternoon she brings him a glass of lemonade; he soon feels unwell, asks to lie down inside and collapses. He wakes strapped to a bed in her basement, where Miranda reveals that she has been planning her revenge from the start and has poisoned him with antifreeze. Later she amputates one of his hands and then castrates him, telling him that he was right and that she has won. The film closes with Miranda visiting her father and telling him that William will not be coming around again.

The film was released in the United Kingdom in May 2015 and in limited release in the United States in August by Image Entertainment. Critics were largely negative, giving it 14% on Rotten Tomatoes and 23 on Metacritic, although Mark Kermode of The Observer gave it three stars and praised Pike's icy zeal.

overview: Abandoned by her father, a young woman embarks on a thousand-mile odyssey through the backroads of America where she meets a disenfranchised drifter. But despite their best efforts, all roads lead back to their terrifying pasts and to a final stand that will determine whether their love can survive their otherness.
title: Bones and All
plot:
Bones and All is a 2022 romantic horror film directed by Luca Guadagnino and written by David Kajganich, adapted from Camille DeAngelis's 2015 novel Bones & All. Set in the late 1980s, it stars Taylor Russell as Maren Yearly and Timothée Chalamet as Lee, two young cannibals who fall for each other on a road trip across America, with Mark Rylance, Michael Stuhlbarg, André Holland and Chloë Sevigny in support.

In 1988, teenage Maren sneaks out to a sleepover in Virginia and bites off part of a classmate's finger. She and her father, Frank, flee to Maryland, and soon after her 18th birthday he abandons her, leaving money, her birth certificate and a cassette in which he recounts how she killed her babysitter as a small child and how he covered for her through years of similar incidents. Maren sets out for Minnesota, where her unknown mother, Janelle, was born. In Ohio she meets Sully, an odd older "eater" who found her by scent, and after joining him in feeding on a dead woman she runs away. At an Indiana store she meets Lee, another eater, who kills a man who had been harassing a customer and offers her a ride in the dead man's truck.

On the road they fall in love. In Lee's Kentucky hometown, Maren sees how he avoids talking about his absent father, while his younger sister Kayla, unaware of what he is, scolds him for always leaving. They meet two more men, Jake and Brad, whose casual relish for eating people disturbs Maren, and after Lee kills a carnival worker, she is wracked with guilt to learn the man had a family. Maren tracks down her adoptive grandmother, Barbara, and then Janelle, who has committed herself to a psychiatric hospital in Fergus Falls and has eaten her own hands; Janelle's letter says Maren would be better off dead. Maren leaves Lee, rebuffs Sully, who has been following her, and later returns to Kentucky, where she learns about the night Lee's abusive father vanished. Reunited, Lee admits that his father was also an eater and that he consumed him. The couple try to build an ordinary life in Ann Arbor until Sully breaks in and attacks Maren; they kill him, but Lee is mortally wounded and asks her to eat him "bones and all", which she does.

The film premiered at the 79th Venice International Film Festival in September 2022, winning the Silver Lion for direction and the Marcello Mastroianni Award for Russell. Reviews were positive, with 82% on Rotten Tomatoes, but grossed only $15.2 million worldwide against a $16–20 million budget.

overview: Gru and his wife Lucy must stop former '80s child star Balthazar Bratt from achieving world domination.
tagline: Oh brother.
title: Despicable Me 3
plot:
Despicable Me 3 is a 2017 American computer-animated comedy film produced by Illumination Entertainment and Universal Pictures. The movie is directed by Kyle Balda, Pierre Coffin, and Cinco Paul.

The story begins with Gru (voiced by Steve Carell), a supervillain who has retired from his life of crime after marrying Lucy (voiced by Kristen Wiig) and having three girls: Margo (voiced by Miranda Cosgrove), Edith (voiced by Dana Gaier), and Agnes (voiced by Nev Scharrel). Gru is now a suburban father, trying to balance his family life with his desire for adventure.

However, Gru's past comes back to haunt him when he discovers that his long-lost twin brother, Dru (also voiced by Steve Carell), has been kidnapped by the Anti-Villain League (AVL). The AVL is a secret organization that deals with supervillains who have retired from their life of crime. Gru sets out on a mission to rescue Dru and uncover the truth about his family's past.

As Gru delves deeper into his family's history, he discovers that his parents were part of a villainous duo known as Vector (voiced by Steve Carell) and Agnes' mother, who was also a supervillain. Vector is now working with the AVL to take down Gru and Dru.

Gru soon learns that Dru has been brainwashed by Vector and is now working for him. Gru must use his skills as a supervillain to rescue Dru and stop Vector's evil plans. Along the way, he also learns more about his family's past and the secrets that have been hidden from him.

The movie features plenty of action-packed sequences, including a thrilling chase scene through the streets of Paris and a showdown with Vector at the AVL headquarters. The film also explores themes of family, identity, and redemption as Gru comes to terms with his past and finds a new sense of purpose.

In the end, Gru is able to rescue Dru and stop Vector's plans, but not before learning that he has a long-lost sister named Lucy (voiced by Jenny Slate), who was also a supervillain. The movie ends on a heartwarming note as Gru reconciles with his family and finds a new sense of belonging.

Overall, Despicable Me 3 is a fun and action-packed animated film that explores themes of family, identity, and redemption. With its lovable characters, witty humor, and exciting plot twists, it's a must-see for fans of the Despicable Me franchise.

overview: Gunning for revenge, outlaw Nat Love saddles up with his gang to take down enemy Rufus Buck, a ruthless crime boss who just got sprung from prison.
tagline: A new day is dawning.
title: The Harder They Fall
plot:
The Harder They Fall is a 2021 American Western film directed by Jody Lee Lipes and written by Rafe Judkins, based on the 1956 novel "Ride Lonesome" by Dwight Babcock. The movie stars Idris Elba, Regina King, Zazie Beetz, Delroy Lindo, LaKeith Stanfield, Edi Gali, Byron Bowers, and Riley Keough.

The film is set in 1895 Texas during the final days of the American Old West. The story follows Nat Lovett (Idris Elba), a notorious outlaw who has been on the run for years after killing several men, including a sheriff. Lovett is being pursued by a group of bounty hunters led by Rufus Buck (Delroy Lindo), a ruthless and cunning tracker.

As Lovett navigates the treacherous landscape, he encounters a young woman named Mary-Belle (Zazie Beetz) who has been forced to marry a man she doesn't love. When her husband is killed by a group of outlaws, Lovett offers to protect her in exchange for her help in finding his missing brother, Billy (LaKeith Stanfield), who was also an outlaw.

As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that Lovett's past and present are intertwined with those of Rufus Buck, who has a personal vendetta against him. The two men engage in a cat-and-mouse game, with Lovett using his wits and cunning to evade capture.

Meanwhile, Mary-Belle finds herself drawn to Lovett, despite the danger he poses. She begins to question her own morality and the choices she's made in life. Through her interactions with Lovett, she starts to see the world from a different perspective and begins to challenge the societal norms that have held her back.

As the stakes grow higher, Lovett and his allies launch a final attack on Rufus Buck and his men. The ensuing battle is intense and violent, with many lives lost on both sides. In the end, only one man emerges victorious: Nat Lovett.

Throughout the film, there are themes of redemption, loyalty, and the struggle for survival in a harsh and unforgiving world. Idris Elba delivers a powerful performance as the titular character, bringing depth and nuance to a complex and multifaceted individual. The supporting cast is equally impressive, with standout performances from Regina King and Zazie Beetz.

Overall, The Harder They Fall is a gripping and intense Western that explores the complexities of human nature in the face of adversity. With its strong performances, engaging storyline, and stunning cinematography, it's a must-see for fans of the genre.

overview: Rebecca must unlock the terror behind her little brother's experiences that once tested her sanity, bringing her face to face with a supernatural spirit attached to their mother.
tagline: You were right to be afraid of the dark.
title: Lights Out
plot:
Lights Out is a 2016 American supernatural horror film directed by David F. Sandberg and written by David F. Sandberg and Derek Kolstad. The movie stars Teresa Palmer, Gabriel Bateman, and Alexander DiLeo.

The story begins with Rebecca (Teresa Palmer), a young woman who returns to her childhood home in rural Ohio after a long absence. She is haunted by memories of her mother's death when she was just eight years old. As a child, Rebecca would often play with her brother Martin (Gabriel Bateman) and their friends, but one night, a mysterious figure known as "Daddy" appeared, causing terror and ultimately leading to the death of their mother.

Years later, Rebecca is now an adult, working as a photographer in New York City. She has been avoiding her family's past and the memories that come with it. However, when she receives news that her brother Martin is coming home from college for summer break, she decides to return to Ohio to spend time with him.

Upon arrival, Rebecca discovers that Martin is struggling with his own demons, including a fear of the dark and an inability to sleep without the help of a device called "Daddy's Light." As the days go by, strange occurrences begin to happen around the house, and Rebecca starts to suspect that something supernatural is at play.

As the tension builds, it becomes clear that the mysterious figure from Rebecca's childhood is back, and this time, it's more powerful than ever. The entity, known as "Daddy," begins to manipulate Martin, using his deepest fears against him. Rebecca tries to help her brother, but she soon realizes that she may be the only one who can stop Daddy.

The climax of the movie takes place in a dark and abandoned house, where Rebecca confronts the entity head-on. In a desperate bid to save her brother, Rebecca uses her own memories and experiences to weaken Daddy's hold on Martin. As the battle between good and evil reaches its peak, Rebecca manages to outsmart the entity and free her brother from its grasp.

In the end, Rebecca is able to find closure with her past and her family, but not without scars. The movie ends with a sense of hope and renewal, as Rebecca begins to rebuild her life and move forward from the traumatic events of her childhood.

Overall, Lights Out is a tense and suspenseful horror film that explores themes of trauma, grief, and the power of memories. With its clever plot twists and well-developed characters, it's no wonder that this movie has become a modern horror classic.

overview: It's one giant step for dog-kind as Scooby-Doo and the Gang blast off for an epic, other-worldly adventure in this all-new original movie! After winning the last 5 seats in a lottery, Scooby-Doo, Shaggy, Fred, Daphne and Velma are off to space in billionaire Sly Baron's brand new ship, the Sly Star One. It's all gravity-free fun until a mysterious alien begins destroying the ship! As the ship breaks down, the crew is forced to land on Sly Baron's base... on the dark side of the moon! Will the gang unravel this alien mystery? Will Scooby-Doo and Shaggy find snacks on the moon? Will Fred ever take his space helmet off?! Journey to the outer limits with Scooby-Doo to find out!
title: Scooby-Doo! Moon Monster Madness
plot:
Scooby-Doo! Moon Monster Madness is an animated mystery film that revolves around the gang's adventures on the moon, where they encounter a mysterious alien creature known as the "Moon Monster." The movie delves into themes of friendship and teamwork as the gang works together to unravel the mystery behind the Moon Monster.

The story also explores the idea of being true to oneself and embracing one's uniqueness. Shaggy, in particular, struggles with feeling like an outsider among his friends, but ultimately finds a way to contribute to the team and prove himself. This theme is woven throughout the narrative, as the gang learns to appreciate each other's strengths and weaknesses.

Furthermore, the movie touches on the idea of perseverance and determination. The gang faces numerous obstacles and setbacks as they try to solve the mystery, but they never give up, relying on their collective skills and ingenuity to overcome each challenge.

Overall, Scooby-Doo! Moon Monster Madness is a lighthearted, entertaining film that celebrates the power of friendship, self-acceptance, and determination.

overview: Ex-Federale agent Machete is recruited by the President of the United States for a mission which would be impossible for any mortal man – he must take down a madman revolutionary and an eccentric billionaire arms dealer who has hatched a plan to spread war and anarchy across the planet.
tagline: Trained to kill. Left for dead. Back for more.
title: Machete Kills
plot:
Machete Kills is an action-packed film that delves into various themes, primarily revolving around the consequences of violence and the blurred lines between good and evil.

The movie follows Machete, a Mexican federale, as he navigates a complex web of corruption, politics, and power struggles. As Machete fights his way through the story, he encounters a range of characters, from politicians to revolutionaries, each with their own motivations and agendas.

One of the primary themes of Machete Kills is the exploration of the cyclical nature of violence. The film depicts how violence begets more violence, creating an endless cycle that can only be broken by confronting the root causes of conflict. This theme is exemplified through Machete's character arc, as he grapples with his own morality and the true nature of his actions.

Another significant theme in Machete Kills is the critique of capitalism and the corrupting influence of power. The film portrays a world where politicians and business leaders are willing to do whatever it takes to maintain their grip on power, even if it means sacrificing innocent lives. This commentary on the darker aspects of human nature serves as a warning about the dangers of unchecked ambition and greed.

Furthermore, Machete Kills touches on the theme of identity and self-discovery. As Machete navigates his way through the story, he is forced to confront his own past and the circumstances that have shaped him into the person he is today. This journey of self-discovery serves as a metaphor for the human search for meaning and purpose.

Overall, Machete Kills is a thought-provoking film that explores complex themes and ideas through its action-packed narrative.

overview: The Zoosters are back in an all-new holiday adventure. When Santa and his reindeer crash onto the island of Madagascar it's up to Alex, Marty, Gloria, Melman and those wacky penguins to save Christmas. Get ready for a sleigh full of laughs in this hilarious new holiday classic.
title: Merry Madagascar
plot:
Merry Madagascar is an American animated Christmas television special produced by DreamWorks Animation, first broadcast on NBC on November 17, 2009. Set between the first two Madagascar films, it was the studio's second holiday special after Shrek the Halls. It features Ben Stiller as Alex the lion, Chris Rock as Marty the zebra, David Schwimmer as Melman the giraffe and Jada Pinkett Smith as Gloria the hippo, with Danny Jacobs as King Julien XIII, Cedric the Entertainer as Maurice, Andy Richter as Mort, Tom McGrath as Skipper, Carl Reiner as Santa Claus, Nina Dobrev as the reindeer Cupid and Willow Smith as a little girl named Abby.

Still stranded on Madagascar, Alex, Marty, Melman and Gloria try to return to New York for Christmas in a hot air balloon. Their escape is ruined by the lemurs, who mistake them for the Marauding Red Night Goblin, a figure that visits the island every year and pelts it with coal. When the real goblin appears, Alex shoots it down, only to discover that it is actually Santa Claus, who has been throwing lumps of coal at King Julien for being naughty.

The crash leaves Santa with amnesia, unable to remember who he is or what he is supposed to do. Hoping to deliver the presents and then use the sleigh to fly home, the friends take over Santa's job, but the reindeer will only obey Santa, so the penguins use his magic dust to make the sleigh fly. Their first deliveries are disastrous, and they consider simply dumping the gifts at post offices, until they accidentally crash into an apartment and see the joy a present brings to a little girl. Meanwhile, back on the island, Santa rediscovers his talent for making toys during King Julien's own holiday, Julianuary, and the self-centered lemur learns something about giving. With their magic dust running low, the animals must choose between going home and helping Santa.

The special combines the franchise's slapstick humor with a classic Christmas message about generosity and friendship.

Merry Madagascar was nominated for six Annie Awards, winning one for storyboarding in a television production. It was released on DVD in the United States in 2009 through Walmart stores, with a wider release in 2011 and later holiday compilations.

overview: It has taken 10 years, two little Fockers with wife Pam and countless hurdles for Greg to finally get in with his tightly wound father-in-law, Jack. After the cash-strapped dad takes a job moonlighting for a drug company, Jack's suspicions about his favorite male nurse come roaring back. When Greg and Pam's entire clan descends for the twins' birthday party, Greg must prove to the skeptical Jack that he's fully capable as the man of the house.
tagline: Kids bring everyone closer, right?
title: Little Fockers
plot:
Little Fockers is a 2010 American comedy film directed by Paul Weiland and written by Larry Charles, Jeff Schaffer, and Barry Fanaro. The movie stars Robert De Niro, Ben Stiller, Owen Wilson, Teri Polo, Blythe Danner, Barbra Streisand, and Dustin Hoffman.

The story begins with Greg Focker (Ben Stiller), a male nurse who is still trying to win over his future in-laws, the Fockers. Greg's relationship with Pam Byrnes (Teri Polo) has been going well, but he knows that he needs to prove himself as a worthy partner for her family.

Meanwhile, Jack Byrnes (Robert De Niro), Pam's father and Greg's mother-in-law's husband, is still being his usual overbearing self. He is determined to keep an eye on Greg and ensure that he doesn't mess up the relationship between him and Pam.

As the story progresses, Greg becomes increasingly frustrated with Jack's constant meddling in his life. However, things take a turn when Jack reveals that he has been diagnosed with prostate cancer, which makes Greg feel guilty for not being able to help him more.

The plot thickens when Jack starts to suspect that Greg is having an affair with a woman named Andi Garcia (Jessica Alba), who is actually working undercover as a seductress hired by Pam's mother, Dina Byrnes (Blythe Danner). The situation becomes even more complicated when it is revealed that Andi has feelings for Greg.

As the story unfolds, Greg must navigate his relationships with Pam and Jack while also dealing with the consequences of his own mistakes. In the end, he learns a valuable lesson about being honest and open with those around him.

The movie ends on a positive note, with Greg and Pam's relationship stronger than ever, and Jack finally coming to terms with his diagnosis and accepting that Greg is a good man who deserves to be happy.

Overall, Little Fockers is a heartwarming comedy that explores the complexities of family relationships and the importance of communication in any relationship. The movie features a talented ensemble cast, witty dialogue, and plenty of laughs, making it a fun and entertaining watch for audiences of all ages.

overview: Born into a tight-knit wrestling family, Paige and her brother Zak are ecstatic when they get the once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to try out for the WWE. But when only Paige earns a spot in the competitive training program, she must leave her loved ones behind and face this new cutthroat world alone. Paige's journey pushes her to dig deep and ultimately prove to the world that what makes her different is the very thing that can make her a star.
tagline: A comedy about a family that fights a little differently.
title: Fighting with My Family
plot:
Fighting with My Family is a 2019 American sports comedy-drama film directed by Stephen Merchant. The movie follows the story of Wade, a young wrestler who lives with his family in a small town in England.

The main themes of Fighting with My Family revolve around:

1. **Family and Loyalty**: The film highlights the strong bond between Wade and his family, particularly his mother, Linda (played by Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson), who is his wrestling coach and manager. The movie showcases their unwavering support for each other, even in the face of adversity.
2. **Following Your Passion**: Wade's journey to become a professional wrestler serves as a metaphor for pursuing one's passion, despite the challenges and setbacks that come with it. The film encourages viewers to stay true to themselves and chase their dreams, no matter how impossible they may seem.
3. **Self-Discovery**: As Wade navigates the world of professional wrestling, he must also confront his own identity and sense of purpose. The movie explores themes of self-discovery, as Wade learns to balance his personal life with his career ambitions.
4. **Overcoming Adversity**: The film features several challenges that Wade faces, including injuries, criticism from others, and the pressure to perform. However, through his determination and resilience, he is able to overcome these obstacles and achieve success.

Overall, Fighting with My Family is a heartwarming and inspiring movie that celebrates the importance of family, following your passion, and staying true to yourself.

overview: Flight 7500 departs Los Angeles International Airport bound for Tokyo. As the overnight flight makes its way over the Pacific Ocean during its ten-hour course, the passengers encounter what appears to be a supernatural force in the cabin.
tagline: At 30,000 feet. There's Nowhere to Run.
title: Flight 7500
plot:
Flight 7500 is a supernatural thriller film directed by Robert Schwentke, not Vertigo Entertainment. The movie was released in 2009, not 2014.

The main themes of Flight 7500 include:

* The struggle for survival: The film's protagonist, Todd Griffin (played by Jesse Williams), must navigate the mysterious and deadly events on board the plane to ensure his own survival.
* Human psychology: As the passengers and crew experience strange and terrifying occurrences, they are forced to confront their deepest fears and psychological vulnerabilities.
* Faith and spirituality: The movie explores themes of faith, spirituality, and the supernatural, as Todd begins to question the existence of a higher power and the nature of reality.

The film's plot is driven by a series of unexplained events that occur on board Flight 7500, including mysterious noises, ghostly apparitions, and an eerie atmosphere. As the story unfolds, Todd discovers that the plane has been cursed, and he must find a way to lift the curse before it's too late.

Overall, Flight 7500 is a tense and suspenseful thriller that explores themes of survival, human psychology, and faith in the face of supernatural terror.

overview: The story of the two unnamed men who were crucified alongside Jesus and how they came to be beside him on the cross that fateful day. Dismas and his brother Jotham, along with Gestas, another young man who will share their fate, suffer tragedy and injustice at the hands of a band of thieves and a ruthless Roman centurion. Theirs is a story of survival against the odds, but they cannot outrun their destiny.
title: The Penitent Thief
plot: The story of the two unnamed men who were crucified alongside Jesus and how they came to be beside him on the cross that fateful day. Dismas and his brother Jotham, along with Gestas, another young man who will share their fate, suffer tragedy and injustice at the hands of a band of thieves and a ruthless Roman centurion. Theirs is a story of survival against the odds, but they cannot outrun their destiny.

overview: Dedicated environmental lawyer Lucy Kelson goes to work for billionaire George Wade as part of a deal to preserve a community center. Indecisive and weak-willed George grows dependent on Lucy's guidance on everything from legal matters to clothing. Exasperated, Lucy gives notice and picks Harvard graduate June Carter as her replacement. As Lucy's time at the firm nears an end, she grows jealous of June and has second thoughts about leaving George.
tagline: Over. Done. Finished. A comedy about love at last glance.
title: Two Weeks Notice
plot:
Two Weeks Notice is a romantic comedy that explores the theme of self-discovery and personal growth through the character of Lucy Kelson, a young lawyer who finds herself at a crossroads in her life. The movie delves into the idea of finding one's true purpose and passion, as Lucy navigates her career and personal relationships.

The film also touches on the theme of social responsibility and activism, as Lucy becomes involved with a community development project in Harlem, which serves as a catalyst for her to re-evaluate her priorities and values. Through her experiences, Lucy learns to balance her desire for personal fulfillment with her sense of duty to make a positive impact on the world.

Furthermore, the movie explores the theme of love and relationships, particularly in the context of Lucy's blossoming romance with her boss, George Wade. The film raises questions about whether it's possible to reconcile personal and professional goals with emotional connections, and whether true happiness can be found through compromise or sacrifice.

Overall, Two Weeks Notice is a heartwarming story that celebrates the importance of finding one's own path in life, while also acknowledging the complexities and challenges that come with making choices that align with one's values.

overview: Peter Rabbit's feud with Mr. McGregor escalates to greater heights than ever before as they rival for the affections of the warm-hearted animal lover who lives next door.
tagline: Who said the countryside was peaceful?
title: Peter Rabbit
plot:
Peter Rabbit (2018) is a live-action/CGI comedy film directed by Will Gluck, based on the classic children's stories by Beatrix Potter.

The main themes of Peter Rabbit (2018) include:

1. **Rebellion and Independence**: The story revolves around Peter Rabbit's desire for independence and his willingness to challenge authority. He is a free-spirited rabbit who refuses to follow the rules set by Mr. McGregor, a grumpy farmer.
2. **Consequences of Actions**: As Peter navigates the consequences of his actions, he learns valuable lessons about responsibility, obedience, and the importance of considering others' feelings.
3. **Family and Loyalty**: The film highlights the strong bond between Peter and his family, particularly his mother, who encourages him to be brave and think for himself.
4. **Growing Up and Maturity**: Peter's adventures serve as a metaphor for growing up and learning to navigate the complexities of life. He must confront his own flaws and weaknesses, ultimately emerging wiser and more mature.

The film features a talented voice cast, including James Corden as Peter Rabbit, Domhnall Gleeson as Mr. McGregor, and Sia as Mrs. Tiggy-Winkle. The movie received mixed reviews from critics but was a commercial success, grossing over $350 million worldwide.

Overall, Peter Rabbit (2018) is a heartwarming and entertaining film that explores themes of self-discovery, responsibility, and the importance of family and loyalty.

overview: Peter Highman must scramble across the US in five days to be present for the birth of his first child. He gets off to a bad start when his wallet and luggage are stolen, and put on the 'no-fly' list. Peter embarks on a terrifying journey when he accepts a ride from an actor.
tagline: Leave your comfort zone.
title: Due Date
plot:
Due Date is a comedy film released in 2010, directed by Todd Phillips and starring Robert Downey Jr. and Zach Galifianakis.

The movie begins with Peter Highman (played by Robert Downey Jr.), a successful architect who is on his way to Los Angeles for a medical procedure that will save the life of his pregnant wife, Audrey (played by Michelle Monaghan). However, due to a series of unfortunate events, including a flight cancellation and a missed connection, Peter's plans are derailed.

As he tries to find an alternative route to Los Angeles, Peter meets two men who claim to be traveling to the same destination: Dwayne (played by Zach Galifianakis), a slacker on his way to meet his son for the first time, and Ethan (played by Juliette Lewis's brother Owen Wilson was initially cast but dropped out due to scheduling conflicts), a pregnant woman's husband.

Initially, Peter is frustrated with the duo's antics and lack of motivation, but as they embark on their journey together, he begins to see them in a different light. Dwayne, who has never met his son before, is struggling to come to terms with his new role as a father, while Ethan is trying to prepare himself for the arrival of his child.

As they travel across the country, the trio faces various challenges, including run-ins with eccentric characters, traffic jams, and unexpected detours. Along the way, Peter learns valuable lessons about life, love, and the importance of family. He also begins to see Dwayne as a surrogate son figure, who reminds him of his own father.

As they near their destination, the group encounters a series of comedic misadventures, including a wild night in Albuquerque and a disastrous encounter with a group of bikers. However, despite the setbacks, Peter's bond with Dwayne grows stronger, and he begins to see the world through his friend's eyes.

In the end, Peter finally reaches Los Angeles and reunites with Audrey, who has been waiting anxiously for her husband's return. As they prepare to welcome their new baby, Peter reflects on the journey he shared with Dwayne and realizes that it was a transformative experience that taught him the value of friendship and family.

Throughout the movie, Downey Jr.'s wit and charm shine through as he brings Peter to life, while Galifianakis's deadpan humor provides plenty of comedic moments. The chemistry between the two leads is undeniable, making their unlikely friendship one of the film's most memorable aspects.

Overall, Due Date is a heartwarming comedy that explores themes of family, friendship, and redemption. With its talented cast, witty dialogue, and hilarious antics, it's no wonder this movie became a box office hit.

overview: A newborn monkey and its mother struggle to survive within the competitive social hierarchy of the Temple Troop, a dynamic group of monkeys who live in ancient ruins found deep in the storied jungles of South Asia.
tagline: Adventure is in Full Swing.
title: Monkey Kingdom
plot:
Monkey Kingdom is a 2015 documentary film directed by Mark Linfield and produced by Disneynature. The film follows the lives of a troop of rhesus macaques in India, exploring their social dynamics, behavior, and struggles.

At its core, Monkey Kingdom delves into the themes of community, cooperation, and the complexities of social hierarchy within the troop. The documentary showcases how these intelligent primates work together to survive, often putting the needs of the group above individual desires. This is exemplified through the character of Akbar, a dominant male who must balance his own ambitions with the well-being of his troop.

The film also touches on the theme of environmentalism, highlighting the impact of human activities on the monkeys' habitat and way of life. The destruction of their forest home due to deforestation and urbanization serves as a stark reminder of the delicate balance between nature and humanity.

Furthermore, Monkey Kingdom explores the concept of identity and individuality within the troop. As the characters navigate their social roles and relationships, they must also contend with their own desires and aspirations. This is particularly evident in the character of Akbar's daughter, who begins to assert her independence and challenge the traditional norms of her family.

Throughout the film, these themes are woven together to create a nuanced portrayal of life within a primate troop. The documentary offers a thought-provoking examination of the intricate social dynamics at play, inviting viewers to reflect on their own relationships with others and the natural world.

overview: After settling in Green Hills, Sonic is eager to prove he has what it takes to be a true hero. His test comes when Dr. Robotnik returns, this time with a new partner, Knuckles, in search for an emerald that has the power to destroy civilizations. Sonic teams up with his own sidekick, Tails, and together they embark on a globe-trotting journey to find the emerald before it falls into the wrong hands.
tagline: Welcome to the next level.
title: Sonic the Hedgehog 2
plot:
Sonic the Hedgehog 2 is a 2022 American live-action/animated musical comedy-adventure film directed by Jeff Fowler and written by Pat Casey, Josh Miller, and John Whittington. The movie serves as a sequel to the 2020 film Sonic the Hedgehog.

The story takes place after the events of the first film, where Sonic (Ben Schwartz) is living in Green Hills with Tom Wachowski (James Marsden). However, their peaceful life is disrupted by Dr. Robotnik's (Jim Carrey) latest scheme: to steal the Master Emerald from Mobius and use its power to conquer the world.

Meanwhile, a new villain emerges in the form of Knuckles the Echidna (Idris Elba), who is tasked with protecting the Master Emerald on Angel Island. Sonic and Tom team up once again to stop Dr. Robotnik's plan, but they soon discover that Knuckles is not what he seems.

As Sonic navigates his new friendship with Knuckles, he also learns about the history of the Master Emerald and the ancient bond between the echidnas and the island. The movie features a mix of action, humor, and heartwarming moments as Sonic and Tom face off against Dr. Robotnik's robotic army.

Throughout the film, Idris Elba brings his signature charm to Knuckles, making him a compelling and complex character. His chemistry with Ben Schwartz is undeniable, and their banter adds a lot of comedic relief to the movie.

The movie also explores themes of identity, friendship, and the importance of understanding and respecting different cultures. The animation in the film is stunning, blending seamlessly with the live-action elements to create a visually stunning world that fans of the franchise will love.

Overall, Sonic the Hedgehog 2 is an entertaining and action-packed sequel that expands on the characters and world introduced in the first film. With its blend of humor, heart, and excitement, it's sure to delight both old and new fans of the Sonic franchise.

overview: In 1980, Queens, New York, a young Jewish boy befriends a rebellious African-American classmate to the disapproval of his privileged family and begins to reckon with growing up in a world of inequality and prejudice.
tagline: The end of an era. The beginning of everything.
title: Armageddon Time
plot:
Armageddon Time is a 2022 American coming-of-age drama film written and directed by Jonathan Glazer. The film stars Ansel Elgort, Jayne Houdyshell, Ayelet Zurer, and Christopher Abbott.

The story revolves around Paul (Ansel Elgort), an 11-year-old boy growing up in Brooklyn in the late 1990s. His life is marked by his complicated relationship with his father, Tzvi (Ayelet Zurer), a Holocaust survivor who struggles to connect with his son due to his own traumatic past.

As Paul navigates the challenges of pre-teen life, he begins to form close bonds with his friends, including his best friend Jake (Jayne Houdyshell) and his neighbor, Tony (Christopher Abbott). The group spends their summer days exploring the city, getting into mischief, and trying to find their place in the world.

However, Paul's father is increasingly distant, and his mother, Eva (Sari Lennick), tries to mediate between them. As tensions rise, Paul becomes more withdrawn, struggling to understand his family's dynamics and his own identity.

The film takes a dramatic turn when Tzvi announces that he will be leaving for Israel, citing the need to reconnect with his roots and find closure. The news sends shockwaves through the family, and Paul is left feeling lost and uncertain about his future.

As the summer draws to a close, Paul's relationships with his friends and family are put to the test. He must confront the complexities of his own identity and the weight of his father's past in order to find a sense of belonging and purpose.

Throughout the film, Glazer explores themes of trauma, identity, and the complexities of family relationships. The title "Armageddon Time" refers to the idea that certain moments in life are apocalyptic, marking a turning point from which there is no return.

The film features stunning cinematography, capturing the vibrant colors and textures of 1990s Brooklyn. The performances are also noteworthy, with Elgort delivering a nuanced and sensitive portrayal of Paul's struggles.

Ultimately, Armageddon Time is a poignant and powerful coming-of-age story about the challenges of growing up and finding one's place in the world. With its thoughtful exploration of family dynamics and identity, the film offers a nuanced and thought-provoking look at the complexities of human relationships.

overview: It was a chance meeting started by one of Sol’s friends trying to chat up Jennifer. However, in the end, it was those two who hit it off. Sol enjoyed Jen’s smile, her effort, and how silly she could be. Jen enjoyed Sol’s cooking, his athleticism, and that he would join her in fun moments. As you can imagine, love bloomed, and things got serious. Jen’s investment in Sol led to her pushing him to follow his dreams and even move in to save money. Sol’s investment in Jen well, it led to him proposing. But what started as a liver tumor grew into full-on cancer, so with a diagnosis of 6 months to live, Sol and Jennifer try to make the best of it.
tagline: Based on a true love story.
title: All My Life
plot:
All My Life is a 2020 American romantic drama film directed by Chris Collett and written by David Iserson. The movie follows the story of a young couple, Charlie (played by Charlie Plummer) and Liz (played by Zoe Kravitz), who are deeply in love but face an unexpected challenge when Charlie is diagnosed with a terminal illness.

The main theme of All My Life revolves around the complexities of love, mortality, and the human experience. The film explores the ways in which love can both bring people together and tear them apart, as Charlie and Liz navigate their relationship amidst the uncertainty of Charlie's impending death. Through their story, the movie delves into the emotional depths of grief, loss, and the search for meaning in the face of mortality.

The film also touches on the theme of acceptance and the importance of living in the present moment. As Charlie's condition worsens, he and Liz are forced to confront the reality of their situation and make difficult choices about how to spend their remaining time together. The movie ultimately becomes a poignant exploration of the human spirit, highlighting the resilience of love and the power of human connection in the face of adversity.

Overall, All My Life is a heart-wrenching and thought-provoking film that explores the complexities of love, mortality, and the human experience with sensitivity and nuance.

belongs_to_collection.name: Why Did I Get Married Collection

overview: The film is about the difficulty of maintaining a solid relationship in modern times. Eight married college friends plus one other non-friend (all of whom have achieved middle to upper class economic status) go to Colorado for their annual week-long reunion, but the mood shifts when one couple's infidelity comes to light. Secrets are revealed and each couple begins to question their own marriage
tagline: Because we complete each other's sentences.
title: Why Did I Get Married?
plot:
Why Did I Get Married? is a thought-provoking film that delves into the complexities of marriage and relationships. The movie masterfully weaves together several key themes, including the struggle for identity, the fragility of relationships, and the quest for personal growth.

At its core, Why Did I Get Married? explores the tension between individuality and conformity within marriages. The characters are forced to confront their own insecurities and desires, which often lead them to question whether they have made the right choices in their lives. This theme is skillfully intertwined with the idea of identity, as each character grapples with who they are outside of their relationships.

The film also sheds light on the fragility of relationships, highlighting how even the most seemingly strong bonds can be tested by the pressures of everyday life. The characters' interactions and conflicts serve as a catalyst for introspection, revealing the cracks that can form in even the most loving partnerships.

Ultimately, Why Did I Get Married? is a movie about personal growth and transformation. Through their experiences, the characters are forced to confront their own flaws and weaknesses, leading them on a journey of self-discovery and healing. The film's exploration of these themes serves as a powerful reminder that relationships require effort, communication, and a willingness to grow and evolve together.

Overall, Why Did I Get Married? is a nuanced and thought-provoking film that offers a candid look at the complexities of marriage and relationships.

overview: An apocalyptic story set in the furthest reaches of our planet, in a stark desert landscape where humanity is broken, and most everyone is crazed fighting for the necessities of life. Within this world exist two rebels on the run who just might be able to restore order.
tagline: What a Lovely Day.
title: Mad Max: Fury Road
plot:
Mad Max: Fury Road is an action-adventure film directed by George Miller, released in 2015 by Village Roadshow Pictures. The movie takes place in a post-apocalyptic world where resources are scarce and violence is rampant.

The story begins with Imperator Furiosa (Charlize Theron), a tough and skilled warrior who works for the tyrannical leader Immortan Joe (Hugh Keays-Byrne). Furiosa is tasked with escorting five wives, including the young and innocent Capable (Nicholas Hoult), to a distant location where they will be sacrificed to appease Immortan Joe's followers.

However, Furiosa has other plans. She secretly loads the wives into her vehicle, a heavily modified 1973 Ford Falcon XB GT, and sets out on a journey to escape from Immortan Joe's stronghold. Unbeknownst to Furiosa, she is being pursued by Max Rockatansky (Tom Hardy), a former cop who was captured by Immortan Joe's followers and forced to participate in the tyrant's brutal games.

As Furiosa and her wives flee across the desert, they are ambushed by Immortan Joe's gang. In the ensuing battle, Furiosa kills several of the gang members and escapes with the wives. Max, who has been watching from a distance, decides to join forces with Furiosa, and together they embark on a perilous journey to take down Immortan Joe.

The duo faces numerous challenges as they navigate through the treacherous landscape, including treacherous terrain, deadly creatures, and rival factions vying for power. Along the way, Max and Furiosa develop a complex and intense relationship, with Max struggling to reconcile his past traumas with his growing feelings for Furiosa.

As they near Immortan Joe's stronghold, Max and Furiosa hatch a plan to infiltrate the fortress and take down the tyrant. The final confrontation is intense and brutal, with Max and Furiosa facing off against Immortan Joe and his followers in a desperate bid for survival.

In the end, Max and Furiosa succeed in defeating Immortan Joe, but not without great cost. The movie ends with Max and Furiosa driving away from the stronghold, ready to face an uncertain future together. The film's climax is both exhilarating and emotionally resonant, leaving the audience on the edge of their seats as they wonder what will become of these two complex and fascinating characters.

Throughout the movie, George Miller's direction is masterful, using a combination of stunning stunts, breathtaking cinematography, and a pulsating score to create an immersive and thrilling experience. The cast delivers outstanding performances, with Charlize Theron and Tom Hardy delivering standout roles as Furiosa and Max.

Overall, Mad Max: Fury Road is a gripping and visually stunning film that explores themes of survival, redemption, and the power of human connection in the face of overwhelming adversity.

overview: A period drama set in the 1970s, KGF follows the story of a fierce rebel who rises against the brutal oppression in Kolar Gold Fields and becomes the symbol of hope to legions of downtrodden people.
tagline: From The Streets Of Mumbai...To The Bloody Gold Mines Of Kolar
title: K.G.F: Chapter 1
plot:
K.G.F: Chapter 1 is a 2018 Indian Kannada-language action film that delves into the world of underground boxing and the struggles of its protagonist, Adheera. The movie's narrative revolves around Adheera's journey from being an orphaned child to becoming a skilled boxer, who seeks revenge against those who wronged him.

At its core, K.G.F: Chapter 1 explores themes of redemption, perseverance, and the unrelenting pursuit of justice. Adheera's character is driven by a desire for vengeance against those who destroyed his life, and he will stop at nothing to achieve his goal. This relentless drive serves as a catalyst for the film's exploration of the human condition, highlighting the complexities of revenge and its consequences.

The movie also touches upon the theme of identity, as Adheera navigates his place in the world and grapples with his own sense of self-worth. His journey is marked by moments of vulnerability and introspection, which serve to humanize him and make his character more relatable.

Furthermore, K.G.F: Chapter 1 critiques the societal norms that perpetuate violence and exploitation. The film's portrayal of the seedy underbelly of the boxing world serves as a commentary on the darker aspects of human nature, highlighting the ways in which individuals can become complicit in their own oppression.

Overall, K.G.F: Chapter 1 is a gripping narrative that explores complex themes with nuance and depth.

overview: Scooby-Doo and Shaggy must go into the underworld ruled by The Goblin King in order to stop a mortal named The Amazing Krudsky who wants power and is a threat to their pals: Fred, Velma, and Daphne.
title: Scooby-Doo! and the Goblin King
plot:
Scooby-Doo! and the Goblin King is a 2008 animated film that combines the classic Scooby-Doo franchise with elements from the popular children's book series "The Goblin King" by Stephen Lawhead.

The main themes of Scooby-Doo! and the Goblin King revolve around friendship, teamwork, and overcoming fears. The story follows Shaggy and Scooby as they team up with a young boy named Jack to solve a mystery involving the Goblin King, a mythical creature from the book series.

As the plot unfolds, it becomes clear that the Goblin King is not just a simple monster, but rather a symbol of fear and uncertainty for the people in the town. The main characters must work together to uncover the truth behind the Goblin King's existence and put an end to its reign of terror.

Throughout the film, Shaggy and Scooby learn valuable lessons about facing their fears and trusting each other. They also discover that even the most unlikely heroes can make a difference when they work together as a team.

The film's themes are further explored through the character development of Jack, who is initially hesitant to confront his fears but ultimately finds the courage to face them head-on. The movie also touches on the idea of the power of imagination and how it can be both a source of creativity and a tool for escapism.

Overall, Scooby-Doo! and the Goblin King is a heartwarming and entertaining film that celebrates the importance of friendship, teamwork, and facing one's fears.

overview: Survivors of a nuclear attack are grouped together for days in the basement of their apartment building, where fear and dwindling supplies wear away at their dynamic.
tagline: The lucky ones died in the blast
title: The Divide
plot:
The Divide is a 2011 American post-apocalyptic drama film directed by Xavier Gens and starring Demián Bichir, Rosamund Pike, and Michael Ealy. 

The movie takes place in an underground bunker where a group of survivors are trying to stay safe from the nuclear war that has devastated the surface world. The story revolves around the tensions and conflicts within the group as they struggle to survive and make decisions about their future.

One of the main themes of The Divide is the breakdown of social order and the collapse of human relationships in the face of catastrophic circumstances. As resources become scarce, the group's dynamics begin to deteriorate, revealing underlying tensions, prejudices, and power struggles that were previously hidden beneath the surface.

The film also explores the theme of survival at any cost, highlighting the moral compromises and brutal decisions that individuals are forced to make when their basic needs are threatened. The characters' actions become increasingly desperate and violent as they fight for survival, raising questions about the true meaning of humanity in the face of extreme adversity.

Furthermore, The Divide touches on the idea of class struggle and social inequality, as the group's dynamics reveal deep-seated divisions between those who have access to resources and those who do not. This theme is particularly evident in the character of Stephen (played by Michael Ealy), a former soldier who becomes increasingly ruthless as he struggles to maintain his position within the group.

Overall, The Divide is a gripping and thought-provoking film that explores the darker aspects of human nature in the face of catastrophic collapse.

original_title: The People We Hate at the Wedding
overview: A dysfunctional family that can't seem to get along and get it together reluctantly reunites for a family wedding. As their many skeletons are wrenched from the closet, it turns out to be just what this singular family needs to reconnect.
tagline: Save the hate.
title: The People We Hate at the Wedding
plot:
The People We Hate at the Wedding is a 2022 American romantic comedy directed by Claire Scanlon from a screenplay by the Molyneux sisters, based on the 2016 novel of the same name by Grant Ginder. It stars Kristen Bell as Alice, Ben Platt as her brother Paul, Allison Janney as their mother Donna and Cynthia Addai-Robinson as their older half-sister Eloise, with Karan Soni, Dustin Milligan, Tony Goldwyn, Isaach de Bankolé, Jorma Taccone and Julian Ovenden.

Alice and Paul are struggling American siblings who live far from their family. Paul, who works at a rehab center, is anxious about his partner Dominic's wish to open their relationship, while Alice, an executive assistant at an architecture firm, is having an affair with her married boss, Jonathan. Both are estranged from their mother Donna and from Eloise, Donna's daughter from her first marriage to a wealthy French-British playboy named Henrique, who spent her childhood summers with her father in Britain and never truly bonded with her half-siblings.

When Eloise, now wealthy, becomes engaged and invites her American family to her wedding in England, the widowed Donna happily accepts, while Alice and Paul reluctantly agree to go, still resentful of their mother's ties to Henrique and of Eloise's privileged life. Once in England, the trip quickly turns chaotic: Paul's relationship with Dominic unravels, Donna rekindles her romance with her ex-husband, and Alice embarks on a fling with Dennis, a friendly Nebraskan she met on the plane, while hiding her own entanglement. As old grudges, secrets and misunderstandings resurface in the days before the ceremony, the family's simmering conflicts threaten to ruin the wedding, and the siblings must face what really drove them apart.

The film is a comedy about dysfunctional families, sibling rivalry and the misunderstandings that can poison relationships over the years.

The People We Hate at the Wedding was released on Amazon Prime Video on November 18, 2022. It received mostly negative reviews, with 31 percent approval on Rotten Tomatoes, whose consensus called it intriguingly cast but largely laugh-free, and a Metacritic score of 42; The New York Times praised the casting while finding the script uneven.

overview: Ralphie is now all grown up and must deal with Christmas and all that comes with it…as a dad.
tagline: Ralphie comes home.
title: A Christmas Story Christmas
plot:
A Christmas Story Christmas is a 2022 American Christmas comedy directed by Clay Kaytis from a screenplay by Nick Schenk, a direct sequel to the 1983 classic A Christmas Story that ignores the later sequels My Summer Story and A Christmas Story 2. Peter Billingsley reprises his role as Ralphie Parker, now grown up, with Erinn Hayes as his wife Sandy, Julie Hagerty as his mother, and River Drosche and Julianna Layne as his children. Ian Petrella, Scott Schwartz, R. D. Robb and Zack Ward return as Randy, Flick, Schwartz and the former bully Scut Farkus.

In December 1973, thirty-three years after the original story, Ralph Parker lives in Chicago with Sandy and their children, Mark and Julie. He has taken a year off work to write his first novel, but publishers keep rejecting it as far too long. When his mother calls to say that his father, the Old Man, has died, the family travels back to Ralph's hometown of Hohman, Indiana, to spend Christmas with her. She gives Ralph two tasks: to write his father's obituary and to take over his father's role of making Christmas special for everyone.

Ralph reconnects with his old friends Flick, who now runs his father's tavern, and Schwartz, who still lives with his mother and owes Flick a large bar tab. But his efforts to deliver the perfect holiday keep going wrong. Sandy sprains her ankle on the ice, his children are bullied by a pair of snowmobiling kids, he accidentally hits Julie in the eye during a snowball fight, and the family's presents are stolen from their car outside the hospital. With little money left, rejection letters piling up and the obituary unwritten, Ralph struggles under the weight of his father's legacy, and as Christmas Eve arrives, he must find a way to give his family a holiday worthy of the Old Man's memory.

The film echoes the structure, voice-over narration and nostalgic humor of the original, ending with a nod to Jean Shepherd's narration from the first film, while focusing on grief, fatherhood and the passing of traditions to a new generation.

A Christmas Story Christmas was released on HBO Max in November 2022. It received generally positive reviews, with 79 percent approval on Rotten Tomatoes, whose consensus joked that it was not as much fun as a Red Ryder air rifle but still a sequel worth celebrating.

overview: The nightmare isn't over as unstoppable killer Michael Myers escapes from Laurie Strode's trap to continue his ritual bloodbath. Injured and taken to the hospital, Laurie fights through the pain as she inspires residents of Haddonfield, to rise up against Myers. Taking matters into their own hands, the Strode women and other survivors form a vigilante mob to hunt down Michael and end his reign of terror once and for all.
tagline: Evil dies tonight.
title: Halloween Kills
plot:
Halloween Kills is a 2021 American slasher film from director David Gordon Green, who wrote it with Danny McBride and Scott Teems. It is the sequel to Halloween (2018) and the twelfth entry in the Halloween franchise. Jamie Lee Curtis returns as Laurie Strode alongside Judy Greer as her daughter Karen, Andi Matichak as granddaughter Allyson, Will Patton as Frank Hawkins and Anthony Michael Hall as Tommy Doyle, with James Jude Courtney and Nick Castle sharing the role of Michael Myers.

The story resumes on Halloween night 2018, moments after the previous film. Deputy Hawkins, stabbed and left for dead, is rescued and vows to finish Michael off; a flashback to 1978 shows a young Hawkins accidentally killing his own partner and stopping Dr. Loomis from shooting the captured Michael. While Laurie is rushed into surgery at Haddonfield Memorial Hospital, Michael escapes her burning house, slaughters the firefighters sent to put out the blaze and murders more locals as he heads back into town. At a bar, Tommy and fellow survivors of 1978, Marion Chambers, Lindsey Wallace and Lonnie Elam, are marking the anniversary of his capture when they learn of the killings. Tommy whips up a mob of vengeful townspeople to hunt Michael down, and Allyson joins them with her ex-boyfriend Cameron to avenge her father.

The mob realises Michael is heading for his childhood home, where he kills the current owners. At the hospital, the hysteria turns lethal when the crowd mistakes Lance Tivoli, an escaped mental patient, for Michael and chases him until he leaps to his death, despite Karen's efforts to stop them. Lonnie and Cameron are killed in the Myers house, but Karen stabs Michael with a pitchfork, takes his mask and lures him into the waiting mob, which appears to kill him. Michael rises and massacres them all, including Tommy and former sheriff Leigh Brackett, then kills Karen in his old house as Laurie watches from her hospital window.

Delayed a year by the COVID-19 pandemic, the film premiered at the Venice Film Festival in September 2021 and was released in October simultaneously in theatres and on Peacock. It grossed $133.4 million worldwide, but reviews were mixed, with 38% on Rotten Tomatoes and 42 on Metacritic. It was followed by Halloween Ends.

overview: Looking for an escape from her recurring nightmares, 18-year-old Sarah submits to a university sleep study, but soon realizes she's become the conduit to a frightening new discovery.
title: Come True
plot:
Come True is a 2020 Canadian drama film directed by Tamara Koteas. The movie revolves around a young woman who embarks on a journey to find her missing sister, which leads her to confront her own dark past and the complexities of human relationships.

The main theme of Come True is the exploration of trauma, grief, and the long-lasting impact it has on individuals and their loved ones. Through the protagonist's search for her sister, the film delves into the emotional scars that can be left behind by traumatic experiences and how they shape our perceptions of ourselves and others.

Another significant theme present in Come True is the fragility of human connections and the ways in which they can be both a source of comfort and a catalyst for pain. The protagonist's relationships with her family members, particularly her sister, are central to the narrative, highlighting the intricate web of emotions that can bind people together while also causing them harm.
