Recovering with her eyes bandaged and dependent on a caregiver, she becomes increasingly vulnerable to the presence she has been hunting, and must uncover the identity of the invisible man before she loses her sight completely.

Julia's Eyes received mostly positive reviews, with 90 percent of 39 critics on Rotten Tomatoes giving it a favorable review; the consensus called it a smart, suspenseful and visually distinctive Spanish thriller. Philip French of The Guardian commented on its use of blindness as both a plot device and a metaphor, and critics praised Rueda's performance and Morales's stylish direction.

overview: A man ahead of his time, Cyrano de Bergerac dazzles whether with ferocious wordplay at a verbal joust or with brilliant swordplay in a duel. But, convinced that his appearance renders him unworthy of the love of a devoted friend, the luminous Roxanne, Cyrano has yet to declare his feelings for her—and Roxanne has fallen in love, at first sight, with Christian.
tagline: Have you ever loved someone?
title: Cyrano
plot:
Cyrano is a 2021 romantic musical drama film directed by Joe Wright from a screenplay by Erica Schmidt, adapted from her 2018 stage musical, itself based on Edmond Rostand's 1897 play Cyrano de Bergerac. Peter Dinklage and Haley Bennett reprise their stage roles as Cyrano and Roxanne, alongside Kelvin Harrison Jr. as Christian and Ben Mendelsohn. The songs were written by members of the band the National, and the vocals were recorded live on set in Sicily.

Roxanne, a beautiful orphan of modest means, attends the theater with the vain Duke De Guiche, who is determined to marry her, though she longs to marry for love. As she takes her seat, she and Christian de Neuvillette, a newly recruited soldier, are instantly smitten with each other. Her childhood friend Cyrano de Bergerac, a highborn cadet with dwarfism, drives the lead actor off the stage with rhyming insults and then wins a duel against a man who mocks his appearance. Roxanne has no idea that Cyrano is desperately in love with her, and she asks him to arrange a meeting with Christian. Heartbroken, Cyrano finds that Christian cannot express his feelings, and so he writes passionate letters to Roxanne that Christian delivers as his own.

When Roxanne meets Christian in person, his clumsy words disappoint her, until Cyrano, hiding in the shadows, whispers to him what to say. De Guiche sends word that he will have Roxanne one way or another, so she and Christian marry in haste, and the furious duke sends Cyrano and Christian's unit to the front. At war, Cyrano writes to Roxanne daily in Christian's name and risks his life to keep Christian safe. When De Guiche orders the unit on a suicide mission, Christian sees Cyrano's tear-stained farewell letter and realizes that Roxanne truly loves the man who wrote it. Urging Cyrano to tell her the truth, he charges the enemy guns and is killed. Three years later, Cyrano is poor and ailing from unhealed wounds. Sensing the end, he visits Roxanne and recites Christian's last letter from memory, revealing that he wrote them all. They declare their love before he dies in her arms.

Cyrano premiered at the Telluride Film Festival on September 2, 2021, and was released widely in the US and UK on February 25, 2022. Although it grossed only $6.4 million on a $30 million budget, critics praised Dinklage's and Bennett's performances and the music; Rotten Tomatoes reported 85% approval. It received Golden Globe nominations including Best Motion Picture.

overview: After botching the capture of a notorious serial killer, idiosyncratic detective Michael Burrows loses his job with the San Francisco Police. He becomes an investigator for an insurance company and joins forces with a cynical field agent to probe suspicious and unusual deaths.
tagline: A comedy... to die for.
title: The Darwin Awards
plot:
The Darwin Awards is a 2006 American adventure comedy written and directed by Finn Taylor and based on the website of the same name. Joseph Fiennes stars as Michael Burrows and Winona Ryder as Siri Taylor, with David Arquette, Juliette Lewis, Wilmer Valderrama, Chris Penn, Julianna Margulies, Robin Tunney, Ty Burrell Adam Savage, Jamie Hyneman and the band Metallica. It premiered at the Sundance Film Festival on January 25, 2006, the day after Penn's death; it was his final film.

The film opens with a car speeding along with a JATO rocket strapped to it, then turns to Michael, a criminal profiler with the San Francisco Police Department. It is presented in documentary style as the thesis project of a film-school graduate who follows Michael with a camera. Michael's fear of blood lets a serial killer escape, and he is fired from the force. After weeks of depression, he finds a way to combine his professional skill with his obsession with the Darwin Awards: he will help insurance companies identify the people most likely to kill themselves through sheer foolishness, so that they can be refused policies.

His profiling talent impresses an insurance executive, who pairs him with Siri, a specialist in bizarre claims. Together they travel the country investigating legendary cases of idiocy, including the rocket-powered car and a pair of ice fishermen who use a stick of dynamite to blast a hole in the ice, only for their dog to fetch the lit explosive and carry it back to their new SUV. Michael tries to find a common thread among the victims, but the only explanation on offer is Siri's rambling theory that insurers who deny claims drive people mad. Michael himself repeatedly comes close to earning a Darwin Award; stranded with Siri on a freezing night, he blows up his car trying to start a fire with gasoline.

By chance, Michael discovers where the killer who escaped him is now living and abseils down the side of the building to film him. The film student, glimpsed for the first time, is dangling on the other end of the same rope, and the heavy stone urn they are tied to starts creeping toward the edge of the roof. Inside, the killer slices the hand of the captive Siri to trigger Michael's fear of blood, but Michael overcomes it and defeats him.

The film was poorly received, with a 25% rating on Rotten Tomatoes; critics found it formulaic and unfunny.

overview: Scooby-Doo and the gang team up with their pals, Bill Nye The Science Guy and Elvira Mistress of the Dark, to solve this mystery of gigantic proportions and save Crystal Cove!
tagline: Scooby-Doo and Shaggy’s favorite holiday is upon us!
title: Happy Halloween, Scooby-Doo!
plot:
Happy Halloween, Scooby-Doo! is a 2020 animated mystery film that serves as a reboot of the classic franchise. The movie follows the Mystery Inc. gang - Fred Jones, Daphne Blake, Velma Dinkley, Shaggy Rogers, and Scooby-Doo - as they embark on a new adventure.

The story begins with the gang attending a Halloween party at the Creepy Carnival, a traveling amusement park that has been revived after being closed for years. The carnival is owned by Mr. Jenkins (voiced by Rob Paulsen), who claims to have found a way to bring back the spirits of his deceased wife and daughter.

However, things take a dark turn when the gang discovers that the carnival's new owner, Mr. Jenkins' nephew, has been using the park as a front for a sinister plot. The nephew, along with his accomplices, is attempting to summon an ancient evil spirit known as "The Carnival King" using a magical artifact.

As the gang delves deeper into the mystery, they uncover a series of clues and puzzles that lead them on a wild goose chase through the carnival. Along the way, they encounter various suspects, including Mr. Jenkins' rival, who is trying to sabotage the carnival's reopening.

Throughout the movie, the gang uses their signature skills to solve the mystery, with Velma using her research skills, Daphne using her fashion sense to gather clues, and Shaggy and Scooby using their... um, unique abilities to sniff out leads. Fred, as usual, takes charge of the group's efforts.

As the story unfolds, the gang discovers that the Carnival King is a vengeful spirit who was wronged by Mr. Jenkins' family in the past. The spirit is seeking revenge on the living and will stop at nothing to claim the carnival as its own.

In the climactic final act, the gang faces off against the Carnival King and its minions in an epic battle of wits and bravery. With Scooby-Doo's help, they manage to outsmart the evil spirits and shatter the magical artifact, freeing the carnival from its curse.

The movie concludes with the gang celebrating their victory at a new Halloween party, this time without any supernatural threats. As they enjoy themselves, Velma reflects on how the mystery was solved, and Shaggy and Scooby share a laugh about their role in uncovering the truth.

Overall, Happy Halloween, Scooby-Doo! is a fun and spooky adventure that stays true to the spirit of the original franchise while introducing new characters and plot twists.

overview: The peaceful realm of Azeroth stands on the brink of war as its civilization faces a fearsome race of invaders: orc warriors fleeing their dying home to colonize another. As a portal opens to connect the two worlds, one army faces destruction and the other faces extinction. From opposing sides, two heroes are set on a collision course that will decide the fate of their family, their people, and their home.
tagline: Two worlds. One home.
title: Warcraft
plot:
Warcraft (also known as Warcraft: The Beginning) is a 2016 American action fantasy film based on Blizzard Entertainment's video game series, directed by Duncan Jones, who co-wrote it with Charles Leavitt. It stars Travis Fimmel as the human commander Anduin Lothar, Paula Patton as the half-orc Garona, Ben Foster as the guardian Medivh, Dominic Cooper as King Llane Wrynn and Toby Kebbell as the orc chieftain Durotan.

Draenor, the orcs' homeworld, is dying, consumed by fel magic. The warlock Gul'dan unites the orc clans into the Horde and opens a portal to the world of Azeroth by draining the life from captives. He leads an advance warband through, including Durotan of the Frostwolf Clan, his pregnant mate Draka and his friend Orgrim Doomhammer, to capture prisoners whose sacrifice will bring the rest of the Horde. On arrival, Gul'dan revives Durotan's dying newborn son, Go'el, with fel magic. As the orcs raid Azeroth, Lothar and the young mage Khadgar find traces of fel magic and are sent by King Llane to the guardian Medivh. A skirmish with the orcs yields a prisoner, Garona, who agrees to serve Stormwind and leads the humans to spy on Gul'dan's camp.

Despite Orgrim's objections, Durotan secretly meets Llane to propose an alliance, but the meeting is ambushed by the warchief Blackhand, who kills Lothar's son Callan. Khadgar discovers that Medivh, corrupted by fel magic, has been helping Gul'dan open the portal. Blackhand wipes out the Frostwolves; Draka sends Go'el down a river in a basket before she is killed. Durotan challenges Gul'dan to a ritual duel, but Gul'dan kills him by cheating with magic. As the humans attack the orc camp to free the prisoners, Lothar and Khadgar mortally wound Medivh, who uses his last strength to close the portal to Draenor and open one to Stormwind for the freed captives. Trapped, Llane orders Garona to kill him so she can win power among the orcs and someday make peace. Lothar kills Blackhand in a duel and is allowed to leave with the king's body. At Llane's funeral, the human nations, elves and dwarves form an alliance led by Lothar, while the infant Go'el is found by a human.

Warcraft premiered in Paris on May 24, 2016, and was released by Universal Pictures. It grossed $439.1 million worldwide, including $225.5 million in China, but was considered a financial disappointment given its $160 million budget. Critics found it visually impressive but derivative; Rotten Tomatoes reported 29% approval.

overview: A teenager’s home video leads to a series of horrifying revelations.
tagline: VHS goes to hell.
title: V/H/S/99
plot:
V/H/S/99 is a 2022 American found footage horror anthology produced by Studio71 and Bloody Disgusting, the sequel to V/H/S/94 and the fifth installment in the V/H/S franchise. Set in 1999, at the end of the VHS era, it contains five segments written and directed by Maggie Levin, Johannes Roberts, Flying Lotus, Tyler MacIntyre, and the duo Vanessa and Joseph Winter. Unlike earlier films in the series, it has no framing narrative; instead, short stop-motion animations of toy soldiers made by a character from one of the stories serve as interludes.

In Levin's "Shredding", members of a young punk band who record their antics for a web show break into the ruins of a music venue where another band died in a fire and stampede, and mock the dead musicians, with grisly consequences. In Roberts's "Suicide Bid", a college freshman desperate to join a prestigious sorority agrees to a hazing ritual in which she is buried overnight in a coffin in a graveyard, re-creating an urban legend about a girl who vanished there two decades earlier.

Flying Lotus's "Ozzy's Dungeon" follows a girl badly injured on a sadistic children's game show and her mother's twisted revenge on the show's host. In MacIntyre's "The Gawkers", a group of teenage boys use a camcorder to spy on an attractive new neighbor whose yard is filled with stone busts, while the younger brother they exclude befriends her, with deadly consequences. In the Winters' "To Hell and Back", two videographers hired to film a coven of witches performing a ritual on New Year's Eve 1999, as the millennium begins, are dragged into Hell by a demon and must find a way back before the night is over.

The film mixes horror with dark comedy and late-1990s nostalgia, using camcorder aesthetics, millennial anxieties and pop culture of the era.

V/H/S/99 premiered at the Toronto International Film Festival on September 16, 2022, and was released on Shudder on October 20, becoming the service's most-viewed premiere. It received generally positive reviews, with 75 percent approval on Rotten Tomatoes, whose consensus said it continued the franchise's creative rebound, and a Metacritic score of 58. A sequel, V/H/S/85, followed in 2023.

original_title: Tenacious D in The Pick of Destiny
overview: In Venice Beach, naive Midwesterner JB bonds with local slacker KG and they form the rock band Tenacious D. Setting out to become the world's greatest band is no easy feat, so they set out to steal what could be the answer to their prayers... a magical guitar pick housed in a rock-and-roll museum some 300 miles away.
tagline: An epic quest. A magical guitar pick. A chance to put the D in Destiny.
title: Tenacious D in The Pick of Destiny
plot:
Tenacious D in The Pick of Destiny is a 2006 musical comedy film directed by Jay Roach and written by Tenacious D, consisting of Jack Black and Kyle Gass. The movie follows the story of two fictionalized versions of the band members, who embark on a quest to become the greatest rock band of all time.

The main themes of the movie are:

1. Friendship: The film showcases the strong bond between Jack Black's character, JB, and Kyle Gass's character, Lord Jack Black. Their friendship is put to the test as they navigate their way through various challenges and obstacles.
2. Rock 'n' Roll: The movie celebrates the spirit of rock music and the power it has to bring people together. Tenacious D's music is a key part of the film, with many original songs that blend humor, satire, and musical prowess.
3. Destiny: The title of the movie refers to the idea that one's destiny is predetermined, but the characters' journey shows that even the most unlikely individuals can achieve greatness through hard work, determination, and a bit of luck.
4. Humor: The film is known for its irreverent humor, wit, and absurdity, which adds to its comedic charm.

The plot development follows JB and Lord Jack Black as they set out on a quest to find the "Pick of Destiny," a magical guitar pick that will make them the greatest rock band in the world. Along the way, they encounter various characters, including a wise old wizard (played by David Koechner) who helps guide them on their journey.

The ending of the movie features Tenacious D performing at the legendary Whisky a Go Go club in Los Angeles, where they finally achieve their dream of becoming rock stars. The film concludes with a sense of triumph and fulfillment, as JB and Lord Jack Black have found success and happiness through their music and friendship.

Overall, Tenacious D in The Pick of Destiny is a lighthearted, entertaining film that celebrates the power of rock 'n' roll and the importance of following one's dreams.

original_title: The Twilight Saga: Breaking Dawn - Part 1
overview: The new found married bliss of Bella Swan and vampire Edward Cullen is cut short when a series of betrayals and misfortunes threatens to destroy their world.
tagline: Forever is just the beginning
title: The Twilight Saga: Breaking Dawn - Part 1
plot:
The Twilight Saga: Breaking Dawn - Part 1 is a 2011 American romantic fantasy film directed by Bill Condon, based on the fourth book in Stephenie Meyer's Twilight Saga. The movie follows Bella Swan (Kristen Stewart) and Edward Cullen (Robert Pattinson), who are now married.

The story begins with Bella and Edward getting married in a private ceremony surrounded by their closest friends and family. However, their happiness is short-lived as Bella soon discovers she is pregnant with a half-human, half-vampire child. The pregnancy poses significant risks to Bella's life, and the Cullens gather allies from around the world to protect her.

As the pregnancy progresses, Bella becomes increasingly ill due to the supernatural nature of the fetus. Meanwhile, Victoria (Rachelle Lefevre), James' (Cam Gigandet) partner in crime, seeks revenge against the Cullens for killing her mate. The Cullens also face a threat from the Volturi, a powerful vampire coven that enforces its own laws and rules.

The movie explores themes of love, sacrifice, and the consequences of immortality. Bella's pregnancy becomes a catalyst for the plot, as she must navigate the challenges of carrying a child that is both human and supernatural. The Cullens' efforts to protect her lead to a series of intense confrontations with Victoria and the Volturi.

Throughout the film, the characters grapple with their own identities and the implications of Bella's pregnancy on their relationships. Edward's desire to save Bella at all costs puts him in conflict with his love for her, while Bella must come to terms with her own mortality and the risks associated with carrying a child that is both human and vampire.

The movie sets the stage for the final installment of the Twilight Saga, Breaking Dawn - Part 2. The ending is intentionally left open-ended, leaving audiences eager to see how the story will unfold in the next film.

Overall, The Twilight Saga: Breaking Dawn - Part 1 is a romantic fantasy film that explores themes of love, sacrifice, and identity. With its stunning visuals, memorable characters, and epic battles, it's no wonder this movie was a box office hit.

overview: Winnie the Pooh, Piglet, Owl, Kanga, Roo, and Rabbit are preparing a suitable winter home for Eeyore, the perennially dejected donkey, but Tigger's continual bouncing interrupts their efforts. Rabbit suggests that Tigger go find others of his kind to bounce with, but Tigger thinks "the most wonderful thing about tiggers is" he's "the only one!" Just in case though, the joyously jouncy feline sets out to see if he can find relatives.
title: The Tigger Movie
plot:
The Tigger Movie is a heartwarming animated film that explores several key themes. At its core, it's a story about self-acceptance and embracing one's uniqueness. Tigger, the titular character, is a bouncy and energetic tiger who struggles to find his place in the Hundred Acre Wood due to his differences from the other animals.

The movie delves into the idea that being different is not something to be ashamed of, but rather something to be celebrated. Tigger's enthusiasm and optimism are contagious, and he brings joy and excitement to those around him. Through Tigger's journey, the film shows that individuality is a strength, not a weakness.

Another significant theme in The Tigger Movie is the importance of friendship and acceptance. The other animals in the Hundred Acre Wood initially reject Tigger due to his differences, but ultimately come to accept and appreciate him for who he is. This serves as a powerful reminder that true friends will accept you for your quirks and flaws.

The film also touches on the theme of perseverance and believing in oneself. Tigger faces numerous challenges and setbacks, but he never gives up on himself or his dreams. His unwavering optimism and determination ultimately lead him to find his place in the Hundred Acre Wood and earn the respect and admiration of those around him.

Overall, The Tigger Movie is a delightful and uplifting film that promotes positive values such as self-acceptance, friendship, and perseverance. Its themes are timeless and continue to resonate with audiences of all ages.

overview: Paris, France, 2001. Octave Parango, a young advertiser working at the Ross & Witchcraft advertising agency, lives a suicidal existence, ruled by cynicism, irresponsibility and debauchery. The obstacles he will encounter in developing a campaign for a new yogurt brand will force him to face the meaning of his work and the way he manages his relationship with those who orbit around his egotistic lifestyle.
title: 99 francs
plot:
"99 Francs" is a thought-provoking drama that delves into the complexities of human relationships and the consequences of our actions. The film tells the story of three men who are wrongly accused of murdering a woman and sentenced to life in prison, with one of them being given a reprieve after serving only 99 days.

At its core, "99 Francs" is a movie about the power of human connection and the ways in which our relationships can both save and destroy us. The film explores the intricate web of emotions and motivations that drive people to make choices that have far-reaching consequences. As the characters navigate their desperate situation, they are forced to confront their own demons and the true nature of their relationships with one another.

The movie also touches on themes of redemption, forgiveness, and the cyclical nature of violence. Through the characters' experiences, the film highlights the ways in which our actions can have a ripple effect, impacting not only ourselves but also those around us. Ultimately, "99 Francs" is a powerful exploration of the human condition, one that challenges viewers to consider the complexities of human relationships and the devastating consequences of our choices.

The film's title, "99 Francs," serves as a poignant reminder of the arbitrary nature of justice and the ways in which our lives can be shaped by seemingly insignificant events. The movie's use of this title also underscores the idea that even the smallest actions can have profound consequences, highlighting the fragility of human existence.

Overall, "99 Francs" is a gripping drama that explores the darker aspects of human nature, revealing the complexities and nuances of our relationships with one another.

overview: Follows 20-year-old Drea, who reluctantly takes a job babysitting for a professor of a college she hopes to attend. Struggling to entertain the professor's children Trissy and Jake, along with her own little brother Phillip , Drea takes them on a hike, unaware that mysterious alien critters have crash-landed and started devouring every living thing they encounter.
tagline: Everyone is on the menu
title: Critters Attack!
plot:
Critters Attack! is a 2019 American science fiction horror comedy directed by Bobby Miller, the fifth installment of the Critters franchise and a reboot of the 1986 original. Produced for Syfy by New Line Cinema, Warner Bros. Television and Blue Ribbon Content, it stars Tashiana Washington as Drea and Dee Wallace as Aunt Dee, with Jaeden Noel, Jack Fulton, Ava Preston, Stephen Jennings, Leon Clingman, Vash Singh and Ho Chow, while Steve Blum provides the voices of the Critters.

Drea, a twenty-year-old who delivers sushi, dreams of attending the college her late mother went to, but has been rejected for a second time. When she is offered a job babysitting the children of one of the college's professors, she reluctantly accepts in the hope of gaining an advantage. Struggling to entertain Trissy (Preston) and Jake (Fulton), along with her own younger brother Phillip (Noel), she takes them on a hike, unaware that the alien Crites have crash-landed in the nearby forest and begun devouring every living thing they meet, multiplying through the bodies of their victims. The group discovers Bianca, a white female Crite fleeing from her male counterparts and their one-eyed leader, who becomes their ally against the swarm. As the creatures wreak havoc on the town, the children receive help from the mysterious Aunt Dee, armed with futuristic weapons and apparently familiar with the hungry intergalactic beasts, and from Drea's boss, the sushi chef Loong, who knows about them. The final act becomes a full-scale battle in which the Crites are blasted and sliced apart.

Syfy acquired the rights to the franchise in 2018, and the film was shot secretly in South Africa in February 2019 before being announced that spring. Wallace confirmed she was reprising her original role of Helen Brown, renamed Aunt Dee for legal reasons. The film screened at the Fantasia festival and was released on DVD and digital by Warner Bros. Home Entertainment on 23 July 2019, in R-rated and unrated versions because of its increased gore. Reviews were mixed (41% on Rotten Tomatoes): /Film rated it six out of ten, enjoying the goofy puppet gags and female-led story, while Bloody Disgusting criticized its bland characters, poor pacing and lack of campy fun.

overview: When Tragedy Strikes three Families, their Destiny forces them on a coverging path and mercy as the challenges of their fate could also resurrect their beliefs
title: A Question of Faith
plot:
A Question of Faith is a 2017 American drama film directed by Jason McTire and written by Jason McTire and Brian Johnson. The movie follows the story of two families, one Christian and one Muslim, who are brought together when their sons become friends.

The main themes of A Question of Faith include:

1. Interfaith dialogue: The film explores the differences between Christianity and Islam, highlighting the commonalities and misunderstandings that can arise from cultural and religious differences.
2. Friendship and unity: Despite their differences, the two families come to realize that their sons' friendship is stronger than any perceived differences between their faiths.
3. Parental love and sacrifice: The film showcases the unconditional love and sacrifices made by both sets of parents for their children, highlighting the importance of putting one's child's needs before one's own desires.
4. Forgiveness and understanding: As tensions rise between the two families, they are forced to confront their own biases and prejudices, leading to a deeper understanding and forgiveness of each other.

The movie features an ensemble cast, including Lee Tergesen, Kevin Zegers, and Caitlin Carmichael, among others. The film received generally positive reviews from critics, who praised its thoughtful exploration of complex themes and its ability to promote interfaith dialogue and understanding.

Overall, A Question of Faith is a heartwarming and thought-provoking drama that explores the complexities of faith, family, and friendship in a way that is both entertaining and enlightening.

overview: Short in stature but big on love, a bachelor meets two very different women who broaden his horizons and help him find purpose in life.
title: Zero
plot:
Zero is a 2018 Indian Hindi-language romantic comedy-drama directed by Aanand L. Rai and written by Himanshu Sharma, produced by Colour Yellow Productions with Red Chillies Entertainment. It stars Shah Rukh Khan as Bauua Singh, a man with dwarfism from Meerut, Anushka Sharma as Aafia Bhinder, a scientist with cerebral palsy, and Katrina Kaif as Babita Kumari, a troubled film star, with Abhay Deol, R. Madhavan and Mohammed Zeeshan Ayyub. With a budget reported at about two billion rupees, it was the most expensive film of Khan's career.

Bauua, the brash, cheerful son of a wealthy family, has trouble finding a bride because of his height. Through a matrimonial agency he meets Aafia, a brilliant scientist at NSAR, a fictionalized version of NASA, and the two fall in love. But Bauua grows restless, and on their wedding day, after learning he has been shortlisted for a dance competition whose prize is a meeting with his idol, actress Babita Kumari, he abandons Aafia at the altar.

Bauua wins the contest and is hired by Babita, a heartbroken, alcoholic star, as a personal assistant, accompanying her on film sets and award shows and helping her reconcile with her unfaithful ex-boyfriend Aditya. Realizing how badly he has treated Aafia, he travels with his friend Guddu to New York to win her back, only to learn that she had been pregnant with his child and to be rejected. Determined to prove himself, Bauua volunteers for a mission to send a human to Mars, undergoing grueling training while Aafia prepares to marry another scientist, setting up a final emotional reckoning between the two.

The film is a romance about self-worth and redemption that features characters with disabilities in leading roles, combining comedy, melodrama and science fiction elements.

Zero was released on 21 December 2018 and opened strongly in India but declined quickly, ending with a worldwide gross of about 191 crore rupees, well short of expectations. Reviews were mixed, with critics praising its visual effects and Kaif's performance while faulting the aimless second half. It received seven Filmfare nominations.

overview: When Bond's latest assignment goes gravely wrong, agents around the world are exposed and MI6 headquarters is attacked. While M faces challenges to her authority and position from Gareth Mallory, the new Chairman of the Intelligence and Security Committee, it's up to Bond, aided only by field agent Eve, to locate the mastermind behind the attack.
tagline: Think on your sins.
title: Skyfall
plot:
Skyfall is a 2012 British spy action film directed by Sam Mendes and produced by Michael Wilson and Barbara Broccoli. The film stars Daniel Craig, Javier Bardem, Judi Dench, and Raoul Trujillo.

The story begins with James Bond (Daniel Craig), a seasoned secret agent working for MI6, the British intelligence agency. He is haunted by his troubled past, particularly the death of his parents at the hands of Raoul Silva (Javier Bardem), a former MI6 agent turned rogue. The film's opening scene shows an elderly M (Judi Dench) being attacked by Silva, who has escaped from a maximum-security prison.

Bond is tasked with tracking down and capturing Silva, but he soon realizes that his nemesis has a personal vendetta against him. As Bond delves deeper into the mystery, he discovers that Silva was once a brilliant MI6 agent who was betrayed by M, who had been keeping secrets about his past. Silva's plan is to destroy MI6 and everyone in it, starting with M.

As Bond navigates the complex web of espionage, he encounters a new ally, Sévérine (Bérénice Marlohe), a French woman who works for a private security company called Skyfall. However, she is revealed to be working for Silva, who has been manipulating her all along.

Bond's investigation takes him to Turkey, where he encounters a group of mercenaries who are being led by Raoul Silva. He also meets Patrice (Ola Rapace), a Swedish mercenary who becomes an ally in his quest to stop Silva.

As the story unfolds, Bond discovers that Silva has been using a complex system of hacking and surveillance to gather intelligence on MI6 and its agents. He also learns that M's past is shrouded in secrecy, and that she had been keeping secrets about her own life and relationships with other agents.

The film's climax features an intense showdown between Bond and Silva at Skyfall Lodge, the Scottish estate of James Bond's family. In a thrilling sequence, Bond faces off against Silva, who has rigged the lodge with explosives and is determined to destroy it.

In the end, Bond manages to defeat Silva, but not before he reveals that M had been keeping secrets about her own past and relationships with other agents. The film ends with M being forced to retire from MI6 due to the damage caused by Silva's actions, and Bond reflecting on his own past and the weight of his responsibilities as a secret agent.

Overall, Skyfall is a gripping and intense spy thriller that explores themes of loyalty, betrayal, and redemption. The film features stunning action sequences, memorable characters, and a complex plot that keeps viewers on the edge of their seats until the very end.

overview: Vincent, an artist with unresolved inner demons, meets a mysterious girl who helps him come to terms with his creative legacy… and eventual death.
title: DC Showcase: Death
plot:
DC Showcase: Death is a poignant and introspective animated short film that explores the complexities of mortality, grief, and the human experience. The story delves into the emotional turmoil of a young girl who struggles to cope with the loss of her mother, personified as Death herself.

At its core, the film grapples with the universal theme of mortality, examining how it affects individuals and families. Through the character of Death, the film presents a nuanced portrayal of this concept, moving beyond the traditional depiction of death as a somber and intimidating figure. Instead, Death is shown to be a multifaceted entity that embodies both the inevitability of loss and the cyclical nature of life.

The film also explores the theme of grief and its various forms, highlighting the ways in which it can manifest differently for each individual. The young girl's emotional journey serves as a powerful metaphor for the human experience, capturing the pain, sadness, and ultimately, the acceptance that comes with confronting mortality.

Furthermore, DC Showcase: Death touches on the idea of legacy and the impact that our loved ones have on us. Through the character of Death, the film suggests that even in death, there is a profound connection to those who remain behind, and that their memories and love can continue to shape us long after they are gone.

Overall, DC Showcase: Death is a thought-provoking and emotionally resonant film that invites viewers to reflect on the complexities of mortality, grief, and the human experience.

overview: At the height of the Cold War, a mysterious criminal organization plans to use nuclear weapons and technology to upset the fragile balance of power between the United States and Soviet Union. CIA agent Napoleon Solo and KGB agent Illya Kuryakin are forced to put aside their hostilities and work together to stop the evildoers in their tracks. The duo's only lead is the daughter of a missing German scientist, whom they must find soon to prevent a global catastrophe.
tagline: Saving the world never goes out of style.
title: The Man from U.N.C.L.E.
plot:
The Man from U.N.C.L.E. is a 2015 spy film directed by Guy Ritchie, who wrote it with Lionel Wigram, based on the 1964 MGM television series created by Norman Felton and Sam Rolfe. Henry Cavill plays the CIA agent Napoleon Solo and Armie Hammer the KGB agent Illya Kuryakin, with Alicia Vikander as Gaby Teller, Elizabeth Debicki as Victoria Vinciguerra, Luca Calvani as her husband Alexander and Hugh Grant as Alexander Waverly.

In 1963, Solo smuggles Gaby, the daughter of the missing nuclear scientist Udo Teller, out of East Berlin. Gaby barely knows her father, having been raised by a mechanic since early childhood. Solo, a former soldier turned master thief who was recruited by the CIA in lieu of prison, is then ordered to team up with his Soviet rival to stop Alexander and Victoria Vinciguerra, wealthy Nazi sympathisers, from using Teller to build a private atomic bomb. Kuryakin, who has been briefed on Solo's past, is secretly told to keep Gaby from escaping and to kill his partner if necessary.

In Rome, where Gaby's uncle Rudi works for the Vinciguerras, Kuryakin poses as her fiancé to get close to the couple. The agents break into a Vinciguerra shipyard and find traces of uranium; during the escape, Solo saves Kuryakin from drowning. Gaby then seemingly betrays them, and Rudi tortures Solo until Kuryakin rescues him and forces Rudi to reveal that the bomb is being built on an island fortress, where Gaby has been reunited with her father. After Teller completes the weapon, Victoria kills him. Waverly, of British intelligence, reveals that Gaby has been his undercover agent all along, and the team infiltrates the island. Alexander is killed fleeing with what turns out to be a decoy warhead, and Solo recovers the disc containing Teller's research. While Solo keeps Victoria talking over the radio, Waverly launches a homing missile, destroying the real bomb and killing her. Each agent admits he had orders to kill the other and seize the disc, so they burn it instead. Waverly then announces that Solo, Kuryakin and Gaby have been assigned to his new international organisation, codenamed U.N.C.L.E.

Davis Entertainment and RatPac-Dune produced the film after years of development, with George Clooney and Tom Cruise both attached to the lead before Cavill was cast. Released in August 2015, it grossed $109.8 million worldwide on a $75 million budget and drew mixed reviews, with 68% on Rotten Tomatoes.

overview: A collection of key events mark Bruce Wayne's life as he journeys from beginner to Dark Knight.
tagline: Get Ready... to Rage Against Evil.
title: Batman: Gotham Knight
plot:
Batman: Gotham Knight is an animated thriller that delves into the darker aspects of Bruce Wayne's psyche and the city he has sworn to protect. The film explores the blurred lines between heroism and vigilantism, as Bruce navigates his dual identity and grapples with the moral implications of his actions.

At its core, Batman: Gotham Knight is a movie about the psychological toll of trauma and the weight of responsibility that comes with power. Bruce Wayne's origin story serves as a catalyst for the film's themes, as he struggles to reconcile his past traumas with his present-day crusade against crime.

The movie also delves into the concept of identity and how it is shaped by our experiences and relationships. Bruce's relationships with his allies, such as Alfred Pennyworth and Lucius Fox, serve as a counterpoint to his isolationist tendencies, highlighting the tension between his desire for connection and his need for secrecy.

Furthermore, Batman: Gotham Knight touches on the theme of chaos and anarchy, as embodied by the Joker, who serves as a symbol of the unpredictable nature of evil. The film's portrayal of the Joker's cunning and unpredictability raises questions about the limits of heroism and the effectiveness of Bruce's methods in maintaining order in Gotham City.

Ultimately, Batman: Gotham Knight presents a nuanced exploration of the complexities of heroism, identity, and morality, inviting viewers to ponder the gray areas between right and wrong.

original_title: An American Tail: The Treasure of Manhattan Island
overview: Fievel and his friend Tony Toponi find a map that they believe points to a treasure buried somewhere beneath Old New York, and the plucky rodent is determined to find it. However, what he discovers under the city is a tribe of Native American mice who were driven underground by prejudiced European immigrants.
tagline: Meet Fievel. In his search to find his family, he discovered America.
title: An American Tail: The Treasure of Manhattan Island
plot:
An American Tail: The Treasure of Manhattan Island is an animated adventure film that revolves around the story of Fievel Mousekewitz, a young Jewish mouse who immigrates to America with his family in search of a better life. As Fievel navigates through the challenges of his new surroundings, he discovers hidden treasures and uncovers secrets about his family's past.

The main theme of this movie is the struggle for identity and belonging. Fievel, as an immigrant mouse, faces numerous obstacles as he tries to find his place in a new country. He must confront his own insecurities and learn to adapt to his new environment while staying true to his roots. The film explores the idea that home is not just a physical location but also a sense of belonging and connection to one's heritage.

Another significant theme present in this movie is the power of family and love. Fievel's relationships with his parents, brothers, and friends serve as a source of strength and motivation for him throughout his journey. The film highlights the importance of family bonds and the sacrifices that must be made to protect and care for one another.

The movie also touches on the theme of perseverance and determination. Fievel faces numerous challenges, from navigating the dangers of New York City to overcoming personal doubts and fears. Through his experiences, he learns valuable lessons about courage, resilience, and the importance of never giving up on one's dreams.

Overall, An American Tail: The Treasure of Manhattan Island is a heartwarming tale that celebrates the values of family, identity, and perseverance in the face of adversity.

overview: A single mom and her child are carjacked by a bank robber who has no intention of letting them go.
tagline: It's her car. Don't tell her what to do with it.
title: Carjacked
plot:
Carjacked is a 2011 American thriller directed by John Bonito, whose previous feature was the action film The Marine, from a screenplay by Michael and Sherry Compton. Produced by Hollywood Media Bridge and released direct to video, it stars Maria Bello as Lorraine Burton and Stephen Dorff as Roy, with Connor Hill as Lorraine's young son Chad, Joanna Cassidy as an irascible member of a therapy group. The film runs 89 minutes.

Lorraine is a recently separated single mother with a low-paying job, struggling to make ends meet while raising her ten-year-old son. She buys gas a few dollars at a time, settles for frozen convenience-store snacks instead of pizza, attends group therapy sessions where she is encouraged to stand up for herself, and has to fend off her estranged husband, a soldier, who is seeking sole custody of Chad. One night, during a stop at a gas station, mother and son are carjacked by Roy, a charismatic bank robber on the run, who takes over the car and orders Lorraine to drive toward an uncertain destination, with no intention of letting them go. Much of the story unfolds inside the vehicle as the two adults trade barbs, alternate between moments of uneasy rapport and failed escape attempts, and engage in a power struggle over her and the boy's fate. Lorraine misses several chances to alert others, including at a police roadblock, and resorts to writing her license plate number and a plea for help in a diner restroom and to bouts of reckless driving. In the final stretch, the film turns into an action thriller, as Lorraine, who has finally had enough, takes up a shotgun and the chase ends in a massive pile-up.

Released on DVD in the United States in November 2011, Carjacked received largely negative reviews, with critics complaining that the promising premise and capable leads were wasted on a flat, implausible script. David Nusair of Reel Film Reviews gave it one star out of four, finding no menace or suspense, unconvincing dialogue and a heavy-handed self-empowerment subplot. Jason Rugaard of Movie Mavericks likened it to a lesser version of A Perfect World, praising Dorff's screen presence but faulting the static staging and a laughable script, with action arriving only after an hour. Jim McLennan of Film Blitz considered Bello and Dorff well cast and some of their conversations almost engaging, and enjoyed the outlandish climax, but wished the rest of the film had shared its energy.

original_title: ชัตเตอร์ กดติดวิญญาณ
overview: A young photographer Thun and his girlfriend Jane discover mysterious shadows in their photographs after fleeing the scene of an accident. As they investigate the phenomenon, they find other photographs contain similar supernatural images, that Thun's best friends are being haunted as well, and Jane discovers that her boyfriend has not told her everything. It soon becomes clear that you can not escape your past.
tagline: The most terrifying images are the ones that are real.
title: Shutter
plot:
Shutter (Thai: ชัตเตอร์ กดติดวิญญาณ, roughly "Shutter: Press to Capture Ghosts") is a 2004 Thai supernatural horror film directed by Banjong Pisanthanakun and Parkpoom Wongpoom. It stars Ananda Everingham as the photographer Tun, Natthaweeranuch Thongmee as his girlfriend Jane, and Achita Sikamana, and follows a couple who begin to experience paranormal events after a hit-and-run accident.

Driving home after a party, Jane runs over a young woman on a dark road. Tun stops her from getting out, and they flee, leaving the victim behind. Soon Tun, a professional photographer, finds mysterious white shadows and faces in his pictures, and Jane suspects they are the ghost of the girl they hit. Tun has suffered severe neck pain since the accident, and a doctor finds that he weighs twice his normal weight. Although he dismisses talk of a haunting, his college friends are also being disturbed by a strange presence. Jane learns that the girl was Natre, a shy student from Tun's college, and Tun admits that he had a secret relationship with her and that she threatened to kill herself when he ended it.

Tun witnesses his friend Tonn commit suicide and learns that two other college friends have also killed themselves. Convinced Natre's ghost is behind the deaths, he and Jane visit Natre's mother and find the girl's decomposing body in her bedroom: Natre had killed herself, and her mother could not bear to cremate her. After a proper funeral, Natre's ghost still confronts Tun, who falls from a fire escape. Back in Bangkok, Jane develops photographs that lead her to a hidden set of negatives behind Tun's bookcase, showing his dead friends sexually assaulting Natre. Tun admits that he took the photos and did nothing to stop the attack because of peer pressure, and Jane leaves him. Alone, Tun photographs every room of his apartment in search of Natre. When his camera goes off by accident, the picture reveals her sitting on his shoulders, the cause of his pain and extra weight. She covers his eyes and he falls from a window. Later, Jane visits Tun in hospital, where he sits slumped and unresponsive, and a reflection shows Natre still perched on his shoulders.

Shutter was a box office success. It was remade in English in 2008 under the same title, unofficially remade three times in India, as Photo in Telugu, Sivi in Tamil and Click in Hindi, and officially remade in Indonesia in 2025. Rotten Tomatoes reported 63% approval from critics.

overview: A dramatic thriller based on the incredible true David vs. Goliath story of American immigrant Dr. Bennet Omalu, the brilliant forensic neuropathologist who made the first discovery of CTE, a football-related brain trauma, in a pro player and fought for the truth to be known. Omalu's emotional quest puts him at dangerous odds with one of the most powerful institutions in the world.
tagline: Even Legends Need a Hero
title: Concussion
plot:
Concussion is a 2015 American biographical sports drama film directed by Peter Landesman, based on the life of Dr. Bennet Omalu, a Nigerian-American forensic pathologist who discovered that professional football player Mike Webster suffered from chronic traumatic encephalopathy (CTE), a degenerative brain disease caused by repeated head trauma.

The main theme of Concussion revolves around the struggle for truth and justice in the face of powerful interests. The film highlights the courageous stand of Dr. Omalu, who defied the NFL's attempts to silence him and cover up the dangers of CTE, in order to expose the truth about the long-term effects of head injuries on football players.

At its core, Concussion is a story about the human cost of ambition and the pursuit of success. The film portrays the NFL as an institution that prioritizes profits over player safety, and Dr. Omalu's determination to speak out against this culture of silence and complicity serves as a powerful indictment of the system.

The movie also explores themes of identity, community, and the complexities of cultural heritage. As a Nigerian-American, Dr. Omalu navigates two worlds: his African roots and his American upbringing. This tension between cultures is reflected in the film's portrayal of the NFL's predominantly white, male culture, which is contrasted with Dr. Omalu's experiences as an outsider.

Ultimately, Concussion is a powerful call to action, urging viewers to consider the human impact of their choices and to demand greater accountability from institutions that wield significant power.

overview: In December 2004, close-knit family Maria, Henry and their three sons begin their winter vacation in Thailand. But the day after Christmas, the idyllic holiday turns into an incomprehensible nightmare when a terrifying roar rises from the depths of the sea, followed by a wall of black water that devours everything in its path. Though Maria and her family face their darkest hour, unexpected displays of kindness and courage ameliorate their terror.
tagline: Nothing is more powerful than the human spirit.
title: The Impossible
plot:
The Impossible is a 2012 disaster drama film directed by Juan Antonio Bayona, based on the true story of a family's survival during the 2004 Indian Ocean tsunami. The film stars Ewan McGregor and Naomi Watts as the parents, Henry and Maria Bennett, and their three children.

The movie begins with the Bennett family - Henry (Ewan McGregor), Maria (Naomi Watts), and their three children, Lucas (Tom Holland), Thomas (Samuel Joslin), and Simon (Oaklee Pendergast) - on vacation in Thailand. The family is enjoying a relaxing day at the beach when the tsunami hits, catching them off guard.

The film's opening scenes show the devastating effects of the tsunami, with widespread destruction and chaos. The Bennett family finds themselves separated from each other as they try to survive the disaster. Maria (Naomi Watts) manages to find her children, but Henry is nowhere to be found.

As the story unfolds, we see flashbacks of the events leading up to the tsunami, including a conversation between Henry and his wife about their decision to take their children on vacation. We also see glimpses of the family's life before the disaster, showcasing their love for each other and their struggles as parents.

The majority of the film takes place in the aftermath of the tsunami, with Maria (Naomi Watts) desperately searching for her husband and trying to care for her injured children. The scenes are intense and emotional, capturing the fear, panic, and desperation that the characters experience during this traumatic event.

As Maria navigates the treacherous waters and debris-filled streets, she encounters other survivors who have lost loved ones or are struggling to cope with their new reality. Along the way, she meets a kind-hearted stranger (Martin McCann) who helps her on her journey.

Meanwhile, Henry (Ewan McGregor) is shown to be trapped under a pile of rubble, desperately trying to free himself and find his family. The scenes are intense and suspenseful, keeping the audience on the edge of their seats as they wonder if Henry will survive.

As the story reaches its climax, Maria finally finds her husband, but not before he has suffered severe injuries. The film's final act is a heart-wrenching portrayal of the family's reunion, with Maria nursing her injured husband and caring for their children.

The Impossible ends on a hopeful note, with the Bennett family slowly rebuilding their lives together. The film's conclusion is both poignant and uplifting, leaving the audience with a sense of hope and resilience in the face of adversity.

Overall, The Impossible is a powerful and emotional drama that captures the true story of one family's survival during the 2004 Indian Ocean tsunami. The film features outstanding performances from its cast, particularly Naomi Watts and Ewan McGregor, who bring depth and nuance to their characters.

overview: Tara Markov is a girl who has power over earth and stone; she is also more than she seems. Is the newest Teen Titan an ally or a threat? And what are the mercenary Deathstroke's plans for the Titans?
title: Teen Titans: The Judas Contract
plot:
Teen Titans: The Judas Contract is a 2017 American animated superhero film directed by Sam Liu from a screenplay by Ernie Altbacker, based on the storyline by Marv Wolfman and George Pérez. The 29th DC Universe Animated Original Movie and a sequel to Justice League vs. Teen Titans (2016), it features Miguel Ferrer as Deathstroke, in his final film role, and Christina Ricci as Terra, with Stuart Allan, Jake T. Austin, Taissa Farmiga and Brandon Soo Hoo.

In a flashback set five years earlier, the original Teen Titans, led by Dick Grayson as Robin, rescue the alien princess Starfire from captors sent by her sister Blackfire and offer her a home on Earth, and Dick falls for her. In the present, Dick, now Nightwing, rejoins the Titans as they pursue Brother Blood, the leader of a terrorist cult who plans to capture the team and absorb their powers with a machine. Blood hires the mercenary Deathstroke to deliver them, and Deathstroke, who still wants revenge on Damian Wayne, the new Robin, monitors the team through a double agent: Terra, whom he rescued after her village turned against her, and who joined the Titans a year earlier. Although she initially keeps her distance, Terra warms to the team and begins a relationship with Beast Boy. When Damian grows suspicious of her, she captures him.

Deathstroke and Terra then abduct Beast Boy at a convention where he is recording a podcast with Kevin Smith, Blue Beetle at a soup kitchen, Starfire at her apartment and Raven at Titans Tower. Nightwing escapes an ambush by faking his death. Terra reveals her betrayal to her captive teammates, but because the machine needs a sixth Titan, Deathstroke hands her over to Blood as well. Nightwing interrupts the ritual and frees the team, and Terra, enraged by Deathstroke's betrayal, turns against him and Blood. Raven depowers Blood by unleashing her demonic side, Terra buries Deathstroke under rocks, and Blood is shot dead by his lover, Mother Mayhem, to prevent his capture. Ashamed, Terra brings down the fortress on herself and dies in Beast Boy's arms. Later, Beast Boy tells Kevin Smith that he will always miss her, and a post-credits scene reveals that Jericho survived being shot by Mother Mayhem.

The film premiered at WonderCon on March 31, 2017, and was released digitally on April 4 and on home media on April 18 by Warner Home Video, three months after Ferrer's death. Reviews were generally positive, with 83% approval on Rotten Tomatoes from a small sample.

overview: A group of friends think they found the perfect easy score - an empty house with a safe full of cash. But when the elderly couple that lives there comes home early, the tables are suddenly turned. As a deadly game of cat and mouse ensues, the would-be thieves must fight to save themselves from a nightmare they could never have imagined.
tagline: Respect your elders... or else.
title: The Owners
plot:
The Owners is a 2020 horror thriller film directed by Julius Berg in his feature debut, which he co-wrote, adapted from the graphic novel Une nuit de pleine lune by Hermann Huppen and Yves H. Maisie Williams stars as Mary, with Sylvester McCoy and Rita Tushingham as the elderly Dr. Richard Huggins and his wife, Ellen, and Jake Curran, Ian Kenny and Andrew Ellis as three young criminals. An international co-production between the United States, the United Kingdom and France, set in rural England in the 1990s, it was released in the United States in September 2020 by RLJE Films.

Three young men, Gaz, Nathan and Terry, plan to break into the remote country home of Dr. Huggins and his wife, believing that it contains a safe full of cash. Nathan's girlfriend, Mary, reluctantly becomes involved when she arrives to collect her car to drive to work and is persuaded to come along. When the young men fail to open the safe, Mary enters the house, and she tells Nathan that she is pregnant. When the elderly couple return home, the intruders tie them up and threaten them to make them open the safe, but Richard recognizes Nathan and Terry from their childhood, and Nathan begins to lose his nerve.

Tension within the group explodes when Gaz, trying to take control, stabs Nathan and then threatens Ellen with a circular saw after Richard twice gives a false combination; Mary kills Gaz with a sledgehammer. Mary and Terry free the couple, and Richard offers to operate on the wounded Nathan while Ellen tends to Terry's injured foot. But the couple's behavior grows increasingly strange, and Mary begins to suspect that the seemingly harmless pensioners are far more dangerous than the criminals who invaded their home. As the night wears on, the tables turn completely, and Mary finds herself trapped in a house of horrors, fighting to survive and escape from the couple who have their own sinister plans for her.

The Owners received mixed reviews. Much of the attention focused on the casting of McCoy and Tushingham, veteran British actors best known for genial roles, as the sinister couple, and on Williams in one of her first film leads after Game of Thrones, while the film's escalating violence and twists divided reviewers.

overview: It tells the story of Saro, a man seeking for greener pasture, but unfolding events and his affair with the king's wife, he encounters his untimely death and with Akala, a mystical bird believed to give and take life.
tagline: He who has death in his pouch.
title: Aníkúlápó
plot:
Aníkúlápó is a 2022 Nigerian drama film directed by Kunle Afolayan. The movie revolves around the life of a young boy named Aníkúlápó, who is born with albinism and faces various challenges due to his condition.

The main theme of the movie explores the struggles faced by individuals with disabilities, particularly those with albinism, in a society that often stigmatizes and marginalizes them. The film delves into the emotional and psychological impact of Aníkúlápó's experiences, showcasing the difficulties he faces in navigating his daily life, finding acceptance, and discovering his place in the world.

Throughout the movie, Afolayan sheds light on the societal pressures and expectations that can lead to feelings of isolation and low self-esteem. The film also touches upon themes of identity, culture, and community, highlighting the importance of inclusivity and understanding in breaking down barriers between different groups.

Ultimately, Aníkúlápó is a powerful exploration of resilience, hope, and the human spirit, as it follows Aníkúlápó's journey towards self-discovery, acceptance, and ultimately, finding his place within his community.

overview: Deaf-mute Sergey enters a specialized boarding school for the deaf-and-dumb. In navigating through the school's hierarchy, he encounters a corrupt underbelly of criminality, known as The Tribe. By participating in several robberies, he gets propelled higher into the organization, when he meets one of the Chief’s concubines Anya, and unwittingly breaks all the unwritten rules of the group.
tagline: Love and hate need no translation.
title: The Tribe
plot:
The Tribe (2014) is a thought-provoking film that delves into the complexities of human relationships and societal norms. Set in an isolated Ukrainian village, the movie tells the story of a young woman named Lena who becomes embroiled in a world where men are forbidden from speaking.

At its core, The Tribe explores themes of isolation and disconnection. The village, where women live in silence, serves as a microcosm for the societal pressures that can lead to emotional numbness and disconnection. Through Lena's journey, the film highlights the consequences of a society that values conformity over individuality and freedom.

The movie also touches on the theme of power dynamics and control. The men in the village, who are forced to communicate through sign language, hold significant power over the women, who are relegated to silence. This dynamic raises questions about consent, agency, and the ways in which societal norms can be used to manipulate and oppress individuals.

Furthermore, The Tribe critiques the notion of a "utopian" society, where certain ideals are presented as perfect but ultimately reveal themselves to be flawed and oppressive. The film's portrayal of a community that values silence over expression serves as a commentary on the dangers of groupthink and the importance of individuality in a world that often seeks to conform.

Ultimately, The Tribe is a powerful exploration of the human condition, one that challenges viewers to think critically about the societal norms that shape our lives.

overview: A five-year-old Indian boy gets lost on the streets of Calcutta, thousands of kilometers from home. He survives many challenges before being adopted by a couple in Australia; 25 years later, he sets out to find his lost family.
tagline: The search begins
title: Lion
plot:
Lion (2016) is a biographical drama film directed by Garth Davis, produced by The Weinstein Company, and based on the 2009 memoir "A Long Way Home" by Saroo Brierley.

The main themes of Lion (2016) include:

1. **Identity and Belonging**: The film explores Saroo's journey to find his birth family in India after being adopted by an Australian couple. He struggles with his identity, feeling like a part of him is missing, until he discovers his roots.
2. **Loss and Grief**: Saroo experiences immense loss when he is separated from his family at the age of five. The film portrays his emotional journey as he grapples with the trauma of being abandoned and later finds solace in reconnecting with his birth family.
3. **Hope and Redemption**: Despite facing numerous challenges, Saroo perseveres and eventually reunites with his family. This reunion brings him a sense of hope and redemption, allowing him to find closure and start anew.
4. **Family and Belonging**: The film highlights the importance of family in our lives. Saroo's journey is not just about finding his biological family but also about understanding the complexities of family relationships and the power of love and connection.
5. **Self-Discovery**: Through his experiences, Saroo learns to navigate his past, present, and future, ultimately discovering who he is and where he belongs.

The film features a powerful performance by Dev Patel as Saroo Brierley, with supporting performances from Nicole Kidman, Sunny Pawar, and David Wenham. The movie received widespread critical acclaim for its emotional storytelling, stunning cinematography, and outstanding performances.

overview: When the local FBI office receives a letter from a terrorist known only as 'The Citizen', it's quickly determined that he's planning his next act at the Miss America beauty pageant. Because tough-as-nails Gracie Hart is the only female Agent at the office, she's chosen to go undercover as the contestant from New Jersey.
tagline: Never Mess With An Agent In A Dress.
title: Miss Congeniality
plot:
Miss Congeniality is a 2000 American comedy film directed by Donald Petrie and produced by Village Roadshow Pictures.

The movie follows the story of Gracie Hart (played by Sandra Bullock), a tomboy FBI agent who specializes in identifying and apprehending terrorists. Gracie's colleagues view her as awkward and uncoordinated, which makes it difficult for her to connect with women, particularly those involved in beauty pageants.

One day, Gracie is assigned to go undercover at the Miss United States beauty pageant to prevent a terrorist attack on the event. She assumes the identity of "Gracie Hart," a clumsy and awkward beauty contestant from Texas. As she navigates the world of beauty queens, Gracie must learn to walk in high heels, cook, and engage in small talk with her fellow contestants.

Initially, Gracie struggles to fit in with the other contestants, but she eventually forms friendships with them, particularly the lovely and kind-hearted Cheryl Frasier (played by Heather Burns). As Gracie becomes more confident in her new persona, she begins to see herself in a different light and discovers that there is more to being a woman than just physical appearance.

However, things take a turn when Gracie's FBI colleagues, including her boss Eric Matthews (played by Benjamin Bratt), begin to suspect that she is not who she claims to be. Meanwhile, the real terrorist threat looms large, and Gracie must use her wits and skills to prevent a disaster.

As the pageant progresses, Gracie finds herself torn between her duty as an FBI agent and her growing feelings for Eric Matthews. In the end, Gracie's true identity is revealed, but she has become so comfortable in her new persona that she decides to stay undercover and continue competing in the pageant.

In a surprising twist, Gracie wins the Miss United States title, and she must navigate the complexities of being a beauty queen while still working as an FBI agent. The movie ends with Gracie embracing her newfound confidence and sense of self, both on and off stage.

Throughout the film, Sandra Bullock shines in her role as Gracie Hart, bringing humor, charm, and vulnerability to the character. Her performance earned her widespread critical acclaim and helped establish her as a leading lady in Hollywood.

overview: Simon and Robyn are a young married couple whose life is going as planned until a chance run-in with Simon's high school acquaintance sends their world into a tailspin.
tagline: Not every gift is welcome.
title: The Gift
plot:
The Gift is a 2015 American psychological thriller film directed by Joel Edgerton, written by Mimi Leder, and starring Jason Bateman, Rebecca Hall, and Joel Edgerton.

The main themes of The Gift include:

1. **Trauma and its lasting impact**: The film explores the long-term effects of traumatic events on individuals and their relationships. The protagonist, Simon (Jason Bateman), is haunted by a dark secret from his past that continues to affect his life in the present.
2. **Deception and manipulation**: The Gift delves into the art of deception and manipulation, as characters use lies and half-truths to control and influence others. This theme is particularly evident in the complex relationships between Simon, Robyn (Rebecca Hall), and Gena (Joel Edgerton).
3. **Family dynamics and secrets**: The film examines the intricate web of family relationships and the secrets that can both bind and destroy them. As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that everyone is hiding something, leading to a complex exploration of loyalty, trust, and betrayal.
4. **The blurred lines between truth and fiction**: The Gift raises questions about what is real and what is fabricated, as characters' perceptions of reality become increasingly distorted. This theme is reflected in the film's use of non-linear storytelling and multiple timelines.
5. **Guilt and redemption**: Throughout the film, Simon grapples with feelings of guilt and responsibility for past actions. His journey towards redemption is a central aspect of the story, as he attempts to make amends and find closure.

Overall, The Gift is a thought-provoking thriller that explores the darker aspects of human nature, relationships, and the consequences of our actions.

overview: A boy haunted by visions of a parallel world aids its disillusioned guardian in preventing the destruction of the nexus of universes known as the Dark Tower.
production_companies: The Department of Trade and Industry of South Africa
tagline: There are other worlds than these
title: The Dark Tower
plot:
The Dark Tower (2017) is a fantasy western film directed by Nikolaj Arcel, based on the novel of the same name by Stephen King.

The main themes of The Dark Tower (2017) include:

1. **The Power of Storytelling**: The film explores the idea that stories have the power to shape reality and create worlds. Roland Deschain's quest to find the Dark Tower is a metaphor for the power of storytelling, as he seeks to understand the nature of his own world and the universe.

2. **Redemption and Sacrifice**: Throughout the film, Roland's character undergoes significant development as he grapples with his past mistakes and the weight of his responsibilities. His journey is marked by moments of sacrifice, particularly in relation to his relationship with Eddie Dean, which serves as a catalyst for his growth.

3. **The Nature of Reality**: The Dark Tower (2017) delves into the concept of multiple universes and the idea that reality is not fixed but rather fluid and malleable. Roland's quest to find the Dark Tower raises questions about the nature of reality, the power of the universe, and the role of individuals within it.

4. **The Struggle between Good and Evil**: The film features a classic battle between good and evil, with Roland representing the forces of good and the Crimson King embodying the forces of darkness. This struggle serves as a backdrop for exploring themes of morality, free will, and the consequences of one's actions.

5. **Identity and Self-Discovery**: As Roland navigates his journey, he is forced to confront his own identity and the nature of his existence. His relationship with Eddie Dean serves as a catalyst for this self-discovery, highlighting the importance of human connection in understanding oneself.

The Dark Tower (2017) is a complex and thought-provoking film that explores multiple themes and ideas, weaving together elements of fantasy, adventure, and science fiction to create a rich and immersive narrative.

overview: The story of mime Marcel Marceau as he works with a group of Jewish boy scouts and the French Resistance to save the lives of ten thousand orphans during World War II.
tagline: The best way to resist is to survive.
title: Resistance
plot:
Resistance is a 2020 biographical war drama film written and directed by Jonathan Jakubowicz, inspired by the early life of the French mime artist Marcel Marceau. Jesse Eisenberg stars as Marceau, with Clémence Poésy as Emma, Matthias Schweighöfer as the Gestapo officer Klaus Barbie, Félix Moati, Géza Röhrig, Karl Markovics, Bella Ramsey, Édgar Ramírez and Ed Harris as General George S. Patton. IFC Films released it in the United States on 27 March 2020, when the COVID-19 pandemic had closed most cinemas.

In 1938, in Berlin, Nazi brownshirts murder the parents of a young Jewish girl, Elsbeth. In 1939, in Strasbourg, the young Marcel works unhappily in his father's butcher shop, dreaming of a career in the arts, particularly mime and painting, and performs impressions of Charlie Chaplin in a local cabaret, to his father's displeasure. He is drawn to Emma, a local young woman. Marcel's cousin, Georges, is involved with Jewish organizations preparing for a possible German invasion, and with Emma he brings a troop of 123 Jewish orphans, among them Elsbeth, to a castle near Strasbourg. The frightened children gradually open up, helped by Marcel's comic talents, and his bond with Emma grows into love.

After the war begins and the Germans occupy France, Marcel, Emma and their companions join the French Resistance, working to protect Jewish children from the Nazis. In Lyon, they come into the sights of Klaus Barbie, the ruthless Gestapo chief known as the "Butcher of Lyon," who is relentlessly hunting Jews and members of the Resistance. As the danger grows, Marcel and his friends undertake a perilous effort to lead the orphans across the Alps to safety in neutral Switzerland, with Marcel using his skills as a mime to keep the children calm and silent. The story is framed by a speech delivered by General Patton to American troops at the end of the war, honoring the bravery of those who resisted.

Resistance received mixed reviews, with a 56 percent rating on Rotten Tomatoes; the consensus described it as flawed but honorable, a sincere tribute to its real-life protagonist despite uneven performances and execution. Because of the pandemic, it opened in only a handful of theaters and was released mainly on demand.

overview: A cat named Blanket has long been living in a high-rise apartment in the city with his son, Cloak. One day, curious about the outside world, Cloak decides to leave home and embarks on an adventure to find the legendary cat's paradise. To find his son, Blanket must overcome his fear and reconcile with his past, with the help of a female Macaw.
title: Cats
plot:
Cats is a 2018 musical fantasy film directed by Tom Hooper, produced by Amblin Entertainment, StudioCanal, and Working Title Films, in association with Warner Bros. Pictures.

The main themes of the movie Cats are:

1. **Identity**: The film explores the theme of identity through the character of Macavity, a mysterious and elusive cat who embodies the idea that one's true nature is not always apparent.
2. **Community**: The story highlights the importance of community and belonging, as the Jellicle cats come together to decide which one of them will ascend to the Heaviside Layer and be reborn.
3. **Mortality**: The film touches on the theme of mortality, as the Jellicle cats face their own mortality and the passing of time, which is reflected in the character of Old Deuteronomy's declining health.
4. **Self-discovery**: Many characters in the movie undergo a journey of self-discovery, as they explore their own strengths, weaknesses, and desires.

The film features an all-star cast, including Idris Elba, Jennifer Hudson, James Corden, Rebel Wilson, and Taylor Swift, among others. The movie's visuals are based on the 2011 West End stage production of Cats, which was adapted from T.S. Eliot's Old Possum's Book of Practical Cats.

Overall, Cats (2018) is a visually stunning film that explores themes of identity, community, mortality, and self-discovery through its unique blend of music, dance, and fantasy elements.

original_title: ドラゴンボールＺ 超戦士撃破!!勝のはオレだ
overview: Jaga Bada, Mr. Satan's old sparring partner, has invited Satan to his personal island to hold a grudge match. Trunks and Goten decide to come for the adventure and Android #18 is following Satan for the money he owes her. Little do they know that Jaga Bada's scientist have found a way to resurrect Broly, the legendary Super Saiyan.
title: Dragon Ball Z: Bio-Broly
plot:
Dragon Ball Z: Bio-Broly is a 1994 Japanese animated science fiction martial arts film directed by Daisuke Nishio and produced by Toei Animation. The movie takes place during the Androids Arc of the Dragon Ball Z series.

The story begins with Goku, Trunks, and Pan traveling to the planet Vagar, where they meet a young boy named Broly, who is being raised by his mother, Paragus. However, their peaceful encounter is disrupted by the arrival of Dr. Gero's androids, led by Android 17 and Android 18.

The androids are searching for Broly, as he possesses a unique genetic makeup that makes him incredibly powerful. The androids plan to capture Broly and use his DNA to create an even more powerful being. Meanwhile, Goku and his friends soon discover that the androids' true intention is to destroy Vagar and harvest its energy.

As the story unfolds, Broly's powers grow stronger, and he becomes a formidable opponent for Goku and his friends. However, despite his incredible abilities, Broly struggles with his own identity and purpose in life. He is torn between his desire to protect those he cares about and his need to assert himself as a powerful warrior.

Throughout the movie, Goku and Broly engage in an epic battle that showcases their incredible strength and martial arts skills. Meanwhile, Trunks and Pan work together to help Paragus defeat Android 17 and Android 18.

As the conflict escalates, Broly's true nature is revealed: he is not just a powerful warrior but also a being with a deep sense of compassion and empathy. He begins to question his own existence and the purpose of his powers.

In the climactic final battle, Goku and Broly face off against each other. Despite their incredible strength, they are evenly matched, and it seems that neither can gain the upper hand. However, in a surprising twist, Broly's compassion and empathy ultimately lead him to spare Goku's life, realizing that his powers could be used for good or evil.

The movie concludes with Broly deciding to leave Vagar and find a new purpose in life, one that does not involve causing destruction and chaos. Goku and his friends bid farewell to Paragus and Broly, who sets off on a new journey, determined to use his powers for the greater good.

Overall, Dragon Ball Z: Bio-Broly is an action-packed and emotionally resonant film that explores themes of identity, compassion, and the responsible use of power. The movie features stunning animation, memorable characters, and epic battles that will keep fans of the Dragon Ball Z series on the edge of their seats.

overview: A bank teller called Guy realizes he is a background character in an open world video game called Free City that will soon go offline.
tagline: Life's too short to be a background character.
title: Free Guy
plot:
Free Guy is a 2021 American science fiction action comedy directed by Shawn Levy from a screenplay by Matt Lieberman and Zak Penn. It stars Ryan Reynolds as Guy, a cheerful bank teller who discovers that he is a non-player character in a massively multiplayer online game, with Jodie Comer as the game developer Millie Rusk, Lil Rel Howery as his best friend Buddy, Joe Keery as programmer Walter "Keys" McKey, Utkarsh Ambudkar as Mouser and Taika Waititi as Antwan Hovachelik, the narcissistic head of a game studio.

In the online game Free City, human players wearing sunglasses spend their time robbing, shooting and causing mayhem, while non-player characters like Guy follow the same daily routine without realizing that their world is a game. Millie, an unemployed developer, plays Free City in search of proof that its publisher, Soonami Studios, stole the code for Life Itself, a game she created with her former partner Keys, who now works for Soonami.

When Guy sees Millie's avatar, MolotovGirl, he becomes infatuated and begins to break from his programming. He takes a player's sunglasses, sees the game as players do, and starts leveling up by doing good deeds instead of committing crimes, becoming a worldwide sensation known as Blue Shirt Guy. As Keys realizes that Guy is an artificial intelligence that has developed self-awareness, and other characters begin to change too, Antwan prepares to launch Free City 2, which will wipe the original game and everyone in it. Guy and Millie race to find evidence hidden in the game's code before the servers are reset, while Guy rallies his fellow characters to stand up for their existence.
