From the closet come her mother's voice, moans of pain and the sound of breaking bones, and a hand reaches around a corner. Kaylee flees downstairs, and the siblings barricade the hallway with the couch, but while Kevin sleeps she disappears. The voice draws Kevin to the basement, where Kaylee appears without eyes or a mouth, and it tells him it wants to play. Obeying its commands, Kevin hurts his own eye, then calls 9-1-1, before the phone turns into a toy. The voice says it can "do anything" and that it took Kaylee's mouth because she disobeyed. Kevin follows it upstairs, finding himself walking on the ceiling, as on-screen text reads "572 days," Kaylee fades away, and finally an indistinct face looms over his bed and tells him to go to sleep, ignoring his questions about its name.

Skinamarink premiered at the Fantasia Film Festival on July 25, 2022, and after leaked copies built word-of-mouth buzz online, IFC Midnight released it in North American theaters on January 13, 2023. It grossed nearly $900,000 in its first four days, a commercial success, and received generally favorable reviews (73% on Rotten Tomatoes, 66 on Metacritic).

overview: A son to a high-ranked official in North Korea commits a series of murders going across the countries around the world. The movie depicts the following events as South Korea, North Korea and Interpol start chasing down after him.
tagline: The most dangerous, the most vicious and the most wanted.
title: V.I.P.
plot:
V.I.P. (Korean: 브이아이피) is a 2017 South Korean crime action thriller written and directed by Park Hoon-jung, the screenwriter of I Saw the Devil and The Unjust and director of New World, and co-produced with Warner Bros. Korea. Jang Dong-gun plays the National Intelligence Service agent Park Jae-hyuk, Kim Myung-min the police detective Chae Yi-do, Park Hee-soon the North Korean officer Ri Dae-bum and Lee Jong-suk the defector Kim Kwang-il, with Peter Stormare as the CIA agent Paul Gray and Jo Woo-jin as a prosecutor. In it, police and intelligence officers from both Koreas and the United States converge on a single suspect.

Kim Kwang-il, the gifted son of a powerful figure in the North Korean regime, defects to the South in an operation arranged by the CIA and the NIS, which has motives beyond rescuing him from Pyongyang: Kwang-il holds valuable intelligence, including secret banking information, and he receives VIP treatment. Soon after his arrival, a series of brutal murders of young women shakes South Korea, and every clue points to him. Kwang-il and his accomplices drug, torture and rape their victims, recording the acts before killing them.

Chae, the hot-tempered, chain-smoking superintendent leading the special investigation team, is obstructed at every turn by Park, the agent behind the defection, who is ordered to bury the case so that the flow of information can continue, and by Gray, who wants the same secrets for the CIA. Complicating matters further is Ri, a North Korean policeman who once pursued Kwang-il for a similar string of rapes and murders in the North and was demoted and lost his men for refusing to back off the son of so powerful a man; he slips across the border to track the killer down. As Park comes to realise that the defector he brought south is a psychopath, his loyalties waver, and Ri supplies Chae with decisive evidence. The story is told in five chapters.

The film was shot between October 2016 and January 2017 in South Korea, Hong Kong and Thailand, and released on 23 August 2017. It opened at number one, passed one million admissions within a week and grossed about $7.8 million. Critics were largely negative: Yonhap News Agency called it a stale mix of familiar Korean crime thrillers with flat characters, and both critics and viewers objected to its prolonged, graphic violence against women, though some reviewers praised Lee's chilling turn as the killer.

original_title: 鋼の錬金術師 完結編 最後の錬成
overview: The Elric brothers’ long and winding journey comes to a close in this epic finale, where they must face off against an unworldly, nationwide threat.
title: Fullmetal Alchemist: The Final Alchemy
plot:
Fullmetal Alchemist: The Final Alchemy (Hagane no Renkinjutsushi Kanketsu-hen: Saigo no Rensei) is a 2022 Japanese live-action fantasy action film directed by Fumihiko Sori, who co-wrote the screenplay with Takeshi Miyamoto, based on Hiromu Arakawa's manga. It is the third film in the live-action series and the second half of a two-part finale following Fullmetal Alchemist: The Revenge of Scar. Produced by Oxybot and distributed by Warner Bros. Japan, it stars Ryosuke Yamada as Edward Elric, with Atomu Mizuishi as his brother Alphonse, Tsubasa Honda as Winry Rockbell, Dean Fujioka as Roy Mustang, Misako Renbutsu as Riza Hawkeye, Kanata Hongo as Envy, Yuina Kuroshima as Lan Fan, Mackenyu as Scar, Hiroshi Tachi as King Bradley, Kokoro Terada as Selim Bradley, Chiaki Kuriyama as Olivier Mira Armstrong, Yukie Nakama as Trisha Elric and Seiyo Uchino as both Van Hohenheim and the villain known as Father.

Edward escapes from inside the homunculus Gluttony and, at the Gate of Truth, finds Alphonse's real body, which refuses to leave without its soul. Mustang and Hawkeye discover that King Bradley is the homunculus Wrath and that the military's generals are complicit, while the brothers learn that Father, a being who resembles Hohenheim, plans to open the Gate using a nationwide transmutation circle drawn by wars the army has orchestrated. Ed travels to the northern fortress of Briggs to seek General Olivier Armstrong's help, and Al finds their father, who reveals his past as a slave whose blood created a homunculus in a flask; that creature sacrificed the people of the ancient kingdom of Xerxes to gain a body and immortality. The heroes, joined by Scar, Ling and his possessed alter ego Greed, descend beneath Central City for a final confrontation. Father absorbs the souls of the country but is thwarted by Hohenheim, and in the ensuing battle Al sacrifices himself to restore his brother's arm. Ed defeats Father, then gives up his own alchemy to bring Al back whole, and the brothers return home to Winry.

The two-part finale was announced in March 2022 as part of the manga's 20th anniversary. Filming was originally planned in Italy, like the first film, but because of the COVID-19 pandemic it took place on an open set built in Kyonan, Chiba Prefecture. The Final Alchemy was released in Japanese theaters on 24 June 2022, five weeks after The Revenge of Scar, and became available worldwide on Netflix on 24 September 2022.

overview: Riley, now 12, who is hanging out with her parents at home when potential trouble comes knocking. Mom's and Dad's Emotions find themselves forced to deal with Riley going on her first "date."
title: Riley's First Date?
plot:
Riley's First Date is a 2015 short film produced by Pixar Animation Studios. The story revolves around Riley, an 8-year-old girl who has just moved to San Francisco with her family.

The main theme of the movie is about embracing change and finding comfort in familiar surroundings. Riley struggles to adjust to her new life in San Francisco, feeling homesick for her old home in Minnesota. However, she eventually finds solace in a small café where she meets a friendly waitress named Emma, who becomes a source of comfort and support.

The film also explores the theme of friendship and connection. Through Riley's interactions with Emma, we see how important it is to form connections with others when we're feeling lost or uncertain about our surroundings. The movie shows that even in unfamiliar places, there are people who can provide us with a sense of belonging and comfort.

Additionally, the film touches on the theme of nostalgia and the importance of holding onto memories of the past. Riley's love for her old home and family is evident throughout the story, and we see how she tries to hold onto these memories as she navigates her new life in San Francisco.

Overall, Riley's First Date is a heartwarming and relatable film that explores themes of change, friendship, and nostalgia in a way that will resonate with audiences of all ages.

overview: When the pressure to be royal becomes too much for Mal, she returns to the Isle of the Lost where her archenemy Uma, Ursula's daughter, has taken her spot as self-proclaimed queen.
tagline: Long Live Evil
title: Descendants 2
plot: When the pressure to be royal becomes too much for Mal, she returns to the Isle of the Lost where her archenemy Uma, Ursula's daughter, has taken her spot as self-proclaimed queen.

overview: There were five Marines and one Navy Corpsman photographed raising the U.S. flag on Mt. Suribachi by Joe Rosenthal on February 23, 1945. This is the story of three of the six surviving servicemen - John 'Doc' Bradley, Pvt. Rene Gagnon and Pvt. Ira Hayes - who fought in the battle to take Iwo Jima from the Japanese.
tagline: They fight for their country but they die for their friends.
title: Flags of Our Fathers
plot:
Flags of Our Fathers is a 2006 American war drama film directed by Clint Eastwood, based on the 2000 non-fiction book of the same name by James Bradley and Ron Powers. The movie tells the story of the Battle of Iwo Jima during World War II from the perspective of three American soldiers: John "Sarge" Wells (Ryan Phillippe), Rene Gagnon (Jesse Bradford), and Harold Gannam (Adam Beach).

The main themes of Flags of Our Fathers include:

1. **The Cost of War**: The film highlights the human cost of war, particularly on the soldiers who fought in it. It shows how the experience of war can change individuals forever, leaving them with physical and emotional scars.
2. **Sacrifice and Heroism**: The movie explores the theme of sacrifice and heroism, as embodied by the iconic flag-raising moment at Iwo Jima. The film raises questions about what makes a hero and whether the sacrifices made by these soldiers were truly heroic.
3. **The Power of Media**: Flags of Our Fathers critiques the way media can shape our perceptions of war and its heroes. The film shows how the media's portrayal of the flag-raising moment was manipulated to create a more dramatic narrative, which led to the soldiers being reduced to mere symbols rather than individuals.
4. **Identity and Belonging**: The movie explores the theme of identity and belonging among the soldiers. As they navigate their experiences on Iwo Jima, they struggle with their own identities and sense of purpose, leading to conflicts and tensions within their unit.
5. **The Legacy of War**: Flags of Our Fathers also touches on the theme of legacy and how war can shape our understanding of ourselves and our place in the world. The film raises questions about whether the sacrifices made by these soldiers were truly worth it and what kind of legacy they left behind.

Overall, Flags of Our Fathers is a powerful and thought-provoking film that challenges viewers to think critically about the themes and issues presented.

overview: A losing coach with an underdog football team faces their giants of fear and failure on and off the field to surprising results.
tagline: Never give up. Never back down. Never lose faith.
title: Facing the Giants
plot:
Facing the Giants is a 2006 American sports drama film directed by Chris Evans and written by Aneestyn Fokkena, Chris Fabry, and Jon Abrahams. The movie stars Shannen Doherty, Kenan Thompson, and Cody Kasch.

The story revolves around the fictional high school football team, Mount Paulet High School's Panthers, who are struggling to find success on and off the field. The team is led by Coach Grant Taylor (played by Shannen Doherty), a former NFL player who has lost his faith in God after a tragic accident involving his son.

As the season begins, the team faces numerous challenges, including internal conflicts, personal struggles, and external pressures from their opponents. However, with the help of a new assistant coach, Coach Grant Taylor's wife, Jill (played by Shannen Doherty), who is a Christian minister, the team starts to come together.

Through a series of events, including a dramatic game against their arch-rivals, the Panthers learn valuable lessons about teamwork, perseverance, and faith. The movie explores themes of redemption, forgiveness, and the power of prayer, as the team faces various obstacles on and off the field.

As the season progresses, Coach Taylor's relationship with his son, who is struggling with a serious illness, becomes a central focus of the story. Through his faith and perseverance, Coach Taylor finds the strength to overcome his personal struggles and lead his team to victory.

The movie culminates in an intense game against their arch-rivals, where the Panthers face off against their toughest opponent yet. With the help of prayer and teamwork, the Panthers emerge victorious, but not without some unexpected twists and turns.

Throughout the film, the characters undergo significant personal growth and development, learning valuable lessons about faith, perseverance, and the importance of working together towards a common goal. The movie features a mix of drama, sports action, and inspirational moments, making it an engaging and uplifting watch for audiences of all ages.

Overall, Facing the Giants is a heartwarming and inspiring film that explores themes of faith, redemption, and perseverance in the face of adversity. With its talented cast, engaging storyline, and uplifting message, this movie is sure to leave viewers feeling motivated and inspired.

overview: The story of the Promethean struggles of Nikola Tesla, as he attempts to transcend entrenched technology—including his own previous work—by pioneering a system of wireless energy that would change the world.
title: Tesla
plot:
Tesla is a 2020 biographical drama film that tells the story of Nikola Tesla's life and struggles. The main theme of the film revolves around the tension between genius and madness, as Tesla's extraordinary intellect and innovative ideas are constantly at odds with his own personal demons.

The movie delves into the darker aspects of Tesla's personality, exploring his obsessive nature, his struggles with mental health, and his tumultuous relationships. Through Tesla's character, the film highlights the sacrifices that geniuses often make in pursuit of their passions, including the loss of personal connections and emotional stability.

Furthermore, the film touches on the theme of isolation and loneliness, as Tesla's reclusive lifestyle and eccentric behavior lead to him being ostracized by society. This sense of disconnection serves as a catalyst for his creative genius, but also exacerbates his mental health struggles.

The movie also explores the theme of power and control, particularly in the context of Tesla's rivalry with Thomas Edison. The film portrays their competition as a battle of wits, with each man trying to outmaneuver the other in the pursuit of scientific supremacy.

Ultimately, Tesla is a thought-provoking drama that sheds light on the complexities of a brilliant mind and the personal costs of genius.

overview: When Van Helsing's mysterious invention, the "Monsterfication Ray," goes haywire, Drac and his monster pals are all transformed into humans, and Johnny becomes a monster. In their new mismatched bodies, Drac and Johnny must team up and race across the globe to find a cure before it's too late, and before they drive each other crazy.
tagline: Change can be scary.
title: Hotel Transylvania: Transformania
plot:
Hotel Transylvania: Transformania is a 2022 American animated comedy horror film directed by Genndy Tartakovsky, produced by Sony Pictures Animation. The movie serves as a sequel to the previous films in the Hotel Transylvania series.

The story takes place after the events of Hotel Transylvania III: Summer Vacation (2018). Mavis (voiced by Selena Gomez) and Jonathan (voiced by Andy Samberg) are now married, and they're expecting their first child. However, things take a turn when Dracula's (voiced by Adam Sandler) 35th wedding anniversary is approaching, and he wants to celebrate it with his family.

Dracula discovers that the only way to make his wife, Ericka (voiced by Kathryn Hahn), happy on their anniversary is for him to transform into a human. However, this transformation comes with an unexpected side effect: Mavis starts to lose her vampiric powers and becomes human-like. The situation escalates when Dracula's attempt to reverse the spell goes awry, causing all of the monsters in the hotel to start transforming into humans.

As the chaos unfolds, Jonathan tries to help his wife, who is struggling with her newfound humanity, while also dealing with the consequences of the transformations on their friends and family. The movie features a star-studded voice cast, including Kevin James, Steve Buscemi, David Spade, and Selena Gomez's sister, Gracie Gomez.

Throughout the film, Tartakovsky explores themes of identity, love, and acceptance as Mavis navigates her new human-like state. The movie also pokes fun at modern society, tackling topics like social media, technology, and the challenges of being a monster in a human world.

Overall, Hotel Transylvania: Transformania is a heartwarming and hilarious addition to the Hotel Transylvania franchise, offering plenty of laughs, exciting action sequences, and a touching story about family and acceptance.

overview: The team of people who saved Winter's life reassemble in the wake of her surrogate mother's passing in order to find her a companion so she can remain at the Clearwater Marine Hospital.
tagline: WINTER's amazing true story... now has HOPE.
title: Dolphin Tale 2
plot:
Dolphin Tale 2 is a heartwarming and emotional film that explores several themes, including perseverance, friendship, and the healing power of love and loss.

The movie delves into the story of Winter, the dolphin who lost her tail in the first film, as she navigates her new prosthetic one. Through her journey, we see the resilience and determination of this remarkable animal, as well as the unwavering dedication of her caretakers, particularly Sawyer and Hilton.

One of the primary themes of Dolphin Tale 2 is the power of friendship and the unbreakable bond between humans and animals. The film showcases the deep connection that develops between Winter and Sawyer, as they work together to help her overcome her challenges. This friendship serves as a reminder of the importance of empathy, compassion, and understanding in our relationships with others.

The movie also explores the theme of loss and grief, particularly in the context of Winter's prosthetic tail. As she adjusts to her new reality, we see her struggle to come to terms with the changes that have taken place in her life. This narrative thread adds a layer of depth to the film, highlighting the complexities of healing and recovery.

Furthermore, Dolphin Tale 2 touches on the theme of perseverance and determination. Winter's journey is marked by setbacks and challenges, but she never gives up. Her unwavering spirit serves as an inspiration to those around her, reminding us that with hard work and dedication, we can overcome even the most daunting obstacles.

Overall, Dolphin Tale 2 is a film that celebrates the beauty of friendship, the power of love and loss, and the resilience of the human (and animal) spirit.

original_title: LEGO DC Comics Super Heroes: Justice League - Attack of the Legion of Doom!
overview: Crime is on the run as the newly formed Justice League keeps Metropolis safe and this makes evil genius Lex Luthor very unhappy. Together with Black Manta, Sinestro and a gang of ruthless recruits, Lex builds his own league and declares them the Legion of Doom. With this super powered team of terror and a plan to attack the top-secret government site, Area 52, can Lex finally be on the verge of victory? Sound the alarm and get ready for the bricks to fly when Superman, Batman, Wonder Woman and the rest of the Justice League face off against the world's greatest Super-Villains! It's the next all-new original movie from LEGO® and DC Comics.
tagline: Building the perfect crime!
title: LEGO DC Comics Super Heroes: Justice League - Attack of the Legion of Doom!
plot:
LEGO DC Comics Super Heroes: Justice League - Attack of the Legion of Doom! is an animated film that brings together iconic characters from the DC Comics universe in a humorous and action-packed adventure. At its core, this movie explores themes of teamwork, unity, and the power of diverse perspectives coming together to achieve a common goal.

The story revolves around the Justice League's efforts to stop the Legion of Doom, a group of villains determined to take over the world. As the heroes work together to thwart the Legion's plans, they learn to put aside their differences and trust one another in order to succeed. This emphasis on collaboration and cooperation serves as a powerful metaphor for the importance of unity and diversity in overcoming even the most daunting challenges.

The film also touches on the theme of identity and self-discovery, particularly through the character of Batman, who must confront his own limitations and learn to rely on others in order to save the day. This narrative thread adds depth and nuance to the story, highlighting the importance of embracing one's strengths while also acknowledging areas where help is needed.

Furthermore, the movie features a number of comedic moments that poke fun at the conventions of superhero storytelling, often using satire to comment on the nature of heroism and the responsibilities that come with it. This lighthearted approach serves as a clever subversion of expectations, inviting viewers to laugh while also reflecting on the complexities of being a hero.

Overall, LEGO DC Comics Super Heroes: Justice League - Attack of the Legion of Doom! is a film that celebrates the power of teamwork, diversity, and self-discovery, all while delivering plenty of humor and action along the way.

overview: After a zombie becomes involved with the girlfriend of one of his victims, their romance sets in motion a sequence of events that might transform the entire lifeless world.
tagline: Cold body. Warm heart.
title: Warm Bodies
plot:
Warm Bodies is a 2013 zombie romance film directed by Jonathan Milott and Cary Murnion, based on the novel of the same name by Isaac Marion.

The main themes of Warm Bodies include:

1. **Rebirth and Redemption**: The movie explores the idea of transformation and redemption through the character of R (played by Nicholas Hoult), a zombie who falls in love with a human, Julie (played by Teresa Palmer). As R undergoes a change, he begins to rediscover his humanity and find a new purpose in life.
2. **Love and Connection**: The film highlights the power of love and connection in breaking down barriers between different groups of people. R's relationship with Julie helps him to see beyond his zombie nature and connect with others on a deeper level.
3. **Identity and Humanity**: Warm Bodies raises questions about what it means to be human, particularly for those who have lost their humanity due to circumstances like the zombie apocalypse. The movie explores the tension between R's zombie instincts and his growing sense of humanity.
4. **Social Commentary**: The film offers a commentary on societal norms and expectations, particularly in regards to how we treat others who are different from us. The zombies in the movie serve as a metaphor for those who are marginalized or ostracized by society.

The plot development of Warm Bodies follows R's journey from a mindless zombie to a being with emotions and desires. As he falls in love with Julie, he begins to question his existence and find a new purpose in life. The ending of the movie is bittersweet, as R must confront the reality of his newfound humanity and decide whether to remain with Julie or return to his old life.

Overall, Warm Bodies is a thought-provoking film that explores themes of love, redemption, identity, and humanity in the face of adversity.

overview: During a manned mission to Mars, Astronaut Mark Watney is presumed dead after a fierce storm and left behind by his crew. But Watney has survived and finds himself stranded and alone on the hostile planet. With only meager supplies, he must draw upon his ingenuity, wit and spirit to subsist and find a way to signal to Earth that he is alive.
tagline: Bring Him Home
title: The Martian
plot:
The Martian is a 2015 American science fiction film directed by Ridley Scott, based on the novel of the same name by Andy Weir. The movie follows the story of astronaut Mark Watney, played by Matt Damon.

The film begins with the Ares III mission to Mars, where Watney and his crew are sent to explore the planet's surface. During a severe dust storm, the crew is forced to evacuate, but in the chaos, Watney is presumed dead and left behind. However, he manages to survive the storm by using his ingenuity and knowledge of botany.

As the days pass, Watney realizes that he has become stranded on Mars with limited supplies and no communication with Earth. He uses his skills as a botanist to grow food in the Martian soil, which becomes crucial for his survival. Meanwhile, back on Earth, NASA's mission control team, led by Vincent Kapoor (Chiwetel Ejiofor), discovers Watney's transmission signal and realizes that he is still alive.

The crew of the Hermes spaceship, which was sent to rescue Watney, returns to Mars with a new plan to extract him. However, due to the harsh Martian environment and limited resources, they face numerous challenges in their mission. The team also faces opposition from NASA's director, Ted Mendez (Mackenzie Davis), who is skeptical of the crew's ability to save Watney.

As the story unfolds, Watney uses his wit and resourcefulness to overcome various obstacles, including a malfunctioning toilet that threatens to kill him, and a Martian dust storm that could destroy his habitat. He also uses his knowledge of botany to create a makeshift food source, which becomes essential for his survival.

Meanwhile, back on Earth, the crew of the Hermes spaceship faces their own challenges as they try to come up with a plan to rescue Watney. The team's dynamics are put to the test as they work together to overcome the odds and save their stranded colleague.

The film's climax features an intense and suspenseful sequence where the Hermes crew finally manages to extract Watney from Mars, but not before he has to make a difficult decision that could have potentially saved his life. The movie ends on a hopeful note, with Watney returning to Earth as a hero, thanks to the ingenuity and determination of the crew.

Throughout the film, Ridley Scott's direction brings out the best in Matt Damon's performance, capturing the character's wit, humor, and resilience in the face of adversity. The supporting cast, including Chiwetel Ejiofor, Mackenzie Davis, and Jessica Chastain, deliver strong performances that add depth to the story.

Overall, The Martian is a gripping and inspiring film that showcases the power of human ingenuity and determination in the face of seemingly insurmountable challenges.

original_title: Mike and Dave Need Wedding Dates
overview: Mike and Dave are young, adventurous, fun-loving brothers who tend to get out of control at family gatherings. When their sister Jeanie reveals her Hawaiian wedding plans, the rest of the Stangles insist that the brothers bring respectable dates. After placing an ad on Craigslist, the siblings decide to pick Tatiana and Alice, two charming and seemingly normal women. Once they arrive on the island, however, Mike and Dave realize that their companions are ready to get wild and party.
tagline: They needed hot dates. They got hot messes.
title: Mike and Dave Need Wedding Dates
plot:
Mike and Dave Need Wedding Dates is a 2016 American comedy film directed by Jake Kasdan and written by Dan Mazer, Sean Anders, and John Morris. The movie stars Zac Efron, Adam DeVine, Anna Kendrick, and Stephen Root.

The story begins with two middle-aged men, Stu (Adam DeVine) and Dave (Zac Efron), who are best friends since childhood. They live in a small town in Colorado and work at a local brewery. The movie takes place on the day of their friend's wedding, where they are supposed to be the best man and groomsmen.

However, things take a turn when Stu and Dave realize that they have no idea who will attend their friend's wedding or how they will get there. They decide to put up posters around town asking for people to come to the wedding as "fake" dates, hoping to find someone willing to pretend to be their girlfriend.

To their surprise, two women respond to the ads: Janet (Anna Kendrick), a high-strung and uptight woman from New York City, and Tatiana (Aubrey Plaza), a free-spirited and eccentric woman who is also looking for a fake date. Stu and Dave are hesitant at first, but eventually agree to take both women on as their fake girlfriends.

As the wedding day approaches, Stu and Dave try to navigate their relationships with Janet and Tatiana, while also dealing with their own personal issues and insecurities. Meanwhile, Janet and Tatiana start to develop real feelings for each other, which complicates things further.

On the night of the wedding, Stu and Dave's fake girlfriends are supposed to meet them at the reception, but they fail to show up. Panicked, Stu and Dave decide to take their fake girlfriends on a road trip to the wedding, hoping that they will eventually reveal their true intentions.

As the movie progresses, Stu and Dave learn valuable lessons about friendship, love, and being true to oneself. They also discover that Janet and Tatiana are not just fake girlfriends, but two women who have been searching for connection and meaning in their lives.

In the end, the wedding reception is a disaster, with Stu and Dave's fake girlfriends failing to show up. However, instead of being disappointed, Stu and Dave realize that they have found something special in each other and in Janet and Tatiana. The movie ends on a hopeful note, with the four main characters embarking on new adventures together.

Overall, Mike and Dave Need Wedding Dates is a heartwarming and hilarious comedy that explores themes of friendship, love, and self-discovery. With its talented cast and witty dialogue, it's a must-see for fans of romantic comedies.

overview: A serial killer strikes fear in the hearts of residents of Hamburg during the early 1970s.
title: The Golden Glove
plot:
The Golden Glove (German: Der Goldene Handschuh) is a 2019 German biographical horror film written, co-produced and directed by Fatih Akin, adapted from Heinz Strunk's novel of the same name. It tells the story of the Hamburg serial killer Fritz Honka, who murdered four women between 1970 and 1975 and hid parts of their bodies in his apartment. Jonas Dassler stars as Honka, transformed with heavy prosthetics, with Margarethe Tiesel, Katja Studt, Martina Eitner-Acheampong and Tristan Göbel. A German-French co-production, it competed for the Golden Bear at the 69th Berlin International Film Festival.

In 1970, Honka, an alcoholic and physically disfigured night watchman, kills Gertraud Bräuer, a prostitute, in his squalid attic apartment in Hamburg. He dismembers the body, disposing of some remains in a suitcase and hiding the rest in a recess behind his wall. The police find the suitcase but cannot identify the culprit. By 1974, Honka spends nearly all his free time at the Golden Glove, a seedy bar in the St. Pauli red-light district frequented by alcoholics, prostitutes and lost souls, where most women he approaches reject him in disgust. He becomes fixated on Petra, a schoolgirl he glimpsed briefly outside the bar.

One night he brings home Gerda Voss, a homeless older woman, and lets her stay in exchange for sex and housework, on the promise that she will introduce him to her daughter, Rosi. When Gerda admits that she is estranged from Rosi, Honka erupts in rage, and Gerda eventually escapes by accepting help from a religious charity. Honka briefly tries to quit drinking after being injured in an accident and takes a job as a night watchman at an office building, where he is drawn to a cleaning woman, but he relapses and returns to the Golden Glove. He lures other vulnerable women back to his flat, subjecting them to humiliation and violence, while the stench of the decomposing bodies fills the building and his neighbors complain, until a fire in the building leads to the discovery of his crimes.

The Golden Glove divided critics. Many praised Dassler's startling performance and the meticulous recreation of 1970s Hamburg, but others found its unflinching depiction of sexual violence repellent and questioned what the film offered beyond shock. It was Akin's first film to receive an 18 certificate in Germany.

original_title: Le Tour du monde en 80 jours
overview: Passepartout is a young and scholarly marmoset who always dreams of becoming an explorer. One day, he crosses paths with Phileas, a reckless and greedy frog, eager to take on a bet to circumnavigate the globe in 80 days and earn 10 million clams in the process. Seizing the opportunity of a lifetime to explore the world, Passepartout embarks with his new friend on a crazy and exhilarating adventure full of twists and surprises.
tagline: Adventure is heading off the map!
title: Around the World in 80 Days
plot:
Around the World in 80 Days (Le Tour du monde en 80 jours) is a 2021 French-Belgian computer-animated adventure comedy loosely based on Jules Verne's 1873 novel, recasting its heroes as animals. It marks the feature directing debut of Samuel Tourneux, working from a screenplay by Gerry Swallow and David Michel, and was produced by Cottonwood Media with StudioCanal, France 3 Cinéma, uMedia and uFund, with animation by Circus and Mac Guff. The French voice cast features Damien Frette as Phileas Frog, Julien Crampon as Passepartout, Kaycie Chase as Aouda, Céline Ronté as Fix and Véronique Augereau as Passepartout's mother; the English dub stars Rob Tinkler and Cory Doran.

Passepartout is a naive but bright young marmoset who idolizes Juan Frog de Leon, a famous explorer who once went around the world in 90 days. He longs for adventure, but his overprotective mother keeps him on a tight leash and has even moved the family to a dull town to cure him of his wanderlust. One day Phileas Frog, a lanky, boastful frog who is a skilled surfer as well as a reckless con artist, washes up on the beach and brags that he can circle the globe in only 80 days, accepting a wager worth ten million clams. Seeing the chance of a lifetime, Passepartout slips away from his mother and joins him. Their race takes the mismatched pair through a string of colorful lands, where they meet characters such as Aouda and Fix and run into trouble with a band of scorpions, while the bond between the timid dreamer and the self-serving trickster gradually deepens. The film's "world" is eventually revealed to be just an island.

Tourneux and the producers began developing the project in 2016, and it was presented to buyers at Cannes in 2019 under the working title Around the World. Tourneux combined 3D animation with 2D effects for water and smoke and imagined a steampunk animal society whose machines are made from wood, leaves, shells, rocks and sand; around 17,000 storyboard drawings were produced. After a screening at the Annecy festival in June 2021, it opened in France on 4 August 2021. With about 763,000 admissions abroad, it was the top-grossing French-language film in foreign markets that year. Reviews were modest: The Guardian gave it three stars, calling it gentle and goofy despite some cultural stereotyping and uneven water animation, while Abus de Ciné praised its look but found its animal version of society uninventive.

overview: A young mother and her twin sons move into a rural house that's marked for death.
tagline: Some Things You Can't Unsee.
title: Sinister 2
plot:
Sinister 2 is a 2015 American supernatural horror film directed by Scott Derrickson and written by C. Robert Cargill and Derrickson. The movie serves as a sequel to the 2012 film Sinister, which was also produced by Gramercy Pictures.

The story follows Ellison Oswalt (Ethan Hawke), a true-crime writer who has moved his family from Texas to Kansas City, Missouri, in an attempt to escape the traumatic events of the past. However, their new life is disrupted when they discover that their home contains a box of disturbing home movies that seem to be connected to a series of murders.

As Ellison delves deeper into the mystery, he becomes convinced that the killer is still at large and is using the home movies as a way to taunt him. He enlists the help of his wife Tracy (Juliet Rylance) and their daughter Kinsey (Lochlyn Munro), who has been struggling with her own dark past.

The family soon discovers that they are not alone in their new home, as they begin to experience strange occurrences and supernatural events. They also meet a mysterious woman named Bughuul (James Ransone), who seems to be connected to the murders and is using the home movies to lure victims into his trap.

As Ellison delves deeper into the mystery, he becomes increasingly obsessed with uncovering the truth behind the murders and the identity of the killer. However, his obsession puts his family in grave danger, and they must fight for survival against a supernatural force that seems to be beyond their control.

Throughout the movie, Derrickson explores themes of trauma, grief, and the consequences of playing with forces beyond human understanding. The film's climax features a tense showdown between Ellison and Bughuul, as the true nature of the killer is revealed and the family must confront the darkness head-on.

Ultimately, Sinister 2 is a chilling horror movie that builds on the success of its predecessor while introducing new themes and characters to the franchise. While it may not be as groundbreaking as the original, it delivers plenty of scares and tension, making it a must-see for fans of the genre.

[No additional information available]

overview: A young Irish boy named Keegan and Spanish girl named Moya journey into a magical world of the Megaloceros Giganteus who teach them to appreciate Riverdance as a celebration of life. Based on the stage show phenomenon of the same name and featuring Bill Whelan’s multi-platinum Grammy Award-winning music.
title: Riverdance: The Animated Adventure
plot:
Riverdance: The Animated Adventure is a 2021 animated dance adventure film inspired by the stage show Riverdance, directed by Dave Rosenbaum and Eamonn Butler and made by Cinesite for River Productions and Aniventure. Sam Hardy voices Keegan and Hannah Herman Cortes voices Moya, with Pierce Brosnan in the dual role of Keegan's grandfather and Patrick the deer, Brendan Gleeson as the Huntsman, Aisling Bea as Margot, Lilly Singh and Jermaine Fowler as the deer Penny and Benny, Pauline McLynn and John Kavanagh. The music is by Bill Whelan, who composed the score for the original Riverdance show in the 1990s.

In a seaside village in Ireland, a boy named Keegan spends much of his time at the lighthouse kept by his grandfather, who tells him stories of a Huntsman who seeks to put out the light and of the giant Megaloceros deer who protect it. The two bond over Riverdance, a special dance celebrating life. When his grandfather dies, the grieving Keegan is left to tend the lighthouse, even as Margot, the owner of the local music shop, chooses him to be the DJ at the village's St. Patrick's Day party.

Wandering outside the village, Keegan meets his friend Moya, a Spanish girl who leads him down the river and reveals that she can dance on water. She introduces him to two young Megaloceros, Penny and Benny, who take them to their herd. Keegan joins the deer in a hurling match and befriends their king, Patrick. At Newgrange he encounters the Huntsman, who tries to win him over, but Keegan refuses. Travelling to the sea, Keegan sees a vision of his grandfather, learning, as Moya had with her grandmother, that ancestors appear in this world when one closes one's eyes. The Huntsman catches up with them and offers to spare Keegan in exchange for Patrick's life and antlers. Patrick agrees, and when the Huntsman shoots him, the river stops flowing. Keegan and the deer perform a dance in Patrick's memory that defeats the Huntsman and restores the river. Benny becomes the new king, and Keegan, at peace, relights the lighthouse and joins the St. Patrick's Day celebration.

Cinesite first announced the project in 2016 as part of a slate of animated features, and production began in February 2020 with an estimated budget of €35 million. The film was released in the United Kingdom by Sky Cinema on 28 May 2021 and on Netflix in the United States on 14 January 2022. Reviews were poor: The Irish Times found its idealized Ireland reminiscent of a tourism advertisement.

overview: Having been hopelessly repressed and facing eventual certain death at the British chicken farm where they are held, Ginger the chicken along with the help of Rocky the American rooster decide to rebel and lead their fellow chickens in a great escape from the murderous farmers Mr. and Mrs. Tweedy and their farm of doom.
tagline: This ain't no chick flick. It's poultry in motion.
title: Chicken Run
plot:
Chicken Run is a stop-motion animated comedy film directed by Peter Lord and Nick Park, produced by DreamWorks Pictures, Aardman Animations, and Amblin Entertainment. The movie was released on August 11, 2000.

In the beginning of the story, we are introduced to a large farm where chickens live in a coop. The main character, Ginger (voiced by Julia Sawalha), is a clever and resourceful chicken who dreams of escaping the farm. She has lost her mother at a young age and has been raised by the farm's owner, Mrs. Tweedy (voiced by Miranda Richardson). However, Mrs. Tweedy's intentions are far from pure, as she plans to use the chickens' eggs for her own gain.

Ginger befriends Rocky (voiced by Mel Gibson), a tough but lovable rooster who becomes her ally in her quest for freedom. Together, they come up with a plan to escape the farm using a stolen tractor. However, their plan is soon discovered by Mrs. Tweedy and her accomplice, a sly and cunning dog named Fat Amy (voiced by Julie T. Wallace).

As the story unfolds, Ginger and Rocky face numerous obstacles and challenges as they try to outsmart Mrs. Tweedy and her cohorts. Along the way, they meet other chickens who join their cause, including Pepper (voiced by Timothy Spall), a clever and resourceful chicken who helps them with their escape plan.

The plot development is full of twists and turns, keeping the audience engaged and entertained. The animation is beautifully done, with intricate details and textures that bring the characters to life. The voice acting is also superb, with each character bringing their own unique personality to the story.

As the chickens near their goal of freedom, they face one final challenge: a showdown with Mrs. Tweedy and her dog. In the end, Ginger and Rocky's plan succeeds, and the chickens are finally able to escape the farm. However, not everyone is happy about this turn of events, and some chickens must make difficult choices in order to ensure their survival.

The ending is both heartwarming and humorous, with a sense of closure for the characters. The movie ends on a hopeful note, with Ginger and Rocky flying off into the sunset, free at last from the confines of the farm.

Overall, Chicken Run is a delightful and entertaining film that is sure to appeal to audiences of all ages. With its clever plot, lovable characters, and beautiful animation, it's no wonder that this movie has become a classic of stop-motion animation.

overview: A fictional history of two legendary revolutionaries' journey away from home before they began fighting for their country in the 1920s.
tagline: Rise, Roar, Revolt.
title: RRR
plot:
RRR is a 2022 Indian Telugu-language action drama film directed by S.S. Rajamouli, produced by D. V. Prabhas and S. S. Rajamouli under the banner of Mythri Movie Makers and Lyca Productions.

The film is set in the late 19th century during the Indian Rebellion of 1857 against British rule. The story revolves around three main characters: Komaram Bheem (played by N.T. Rama Rao Jr.), a young Telugu warrior who joins the rebellion; Alluri Sitarama Raju (played by Ram Charan), a young boy from a poor family who becomes a skilled archer and joins the rebellion; and Malli (played by Alia Bhatt), a British woman who is forced to marry into a wealthy family but eventually joins the rebellion.

The film begins with Komaram Bheem, who is a fierce warrior, fighting against the British in the forests of Telangana. He meets Alluri Sitarama Raju, who is on his way to join the rebellion. The two men become friends and allies, and together they embark on a journey to unite the various Indian kingdoms against the British.

As the story unfolds, we see the struggles faced by the Indian people under British rule, including poverty, oppression, and lack of freedom. We also see the bravery and sacrifice of the rebels, who risk their lives to fight for their country's independence.

Throughout the film, there are several action-packed sequences, including a memorable battle scene where Komaram Bheem fights against the British army. The film also explores themes of friendship, loyalty, and sacrifice, as the three main characters put everything on the line to fight for their cause.

The film features stunning visuals, with impressive cinematography and production design that brings the Indian Rebellion of 1857 to life. The music by M.M. Keeravani is also noteworthy, with several memorable songs that add to the film's emotional impact.

Overall, RRR is a powerful and inspiring film that tells an important story about India's struggle for independence. With its strong performances, impressive action sequences, and stunning visuals, it is a must-watch for anyone interested in Indian history or action-packed dramas.

overview: Known as America’s Poet, Henry Wadsworth Longfellow leads an idyllic life – until the day his world is shattered by tragedy. With a nation divided by Civil War and his family torn apart, Henry puts down his pen, silenced by grief. But it’s the sound of Christmas morning that reignites the poet’s lost voice as he discovers the resounding hope of rekindled faith.
tagline: The inspiring true story behind the beloved Christmas carol.
title: I Heard the Bells
plot: Known as America’s Poet, Henry Wadsworth Longfellow leads an idyllic life – until the day his world is shattered by tragedy. With a nation divided by Civil War and his family torn apart, Henry puts down his pen, silenced by grief. But it’s the sound of Christmas morning that reignites the poet’s lost voice as he discovers the resounding hope of rekindled faith.

original_title: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
overview: A beautiful girl, Snow White, takes refuge in the forest in the house of seven dwarfs to hide from her stepmother, the wicked Queen. The Queen is jealous because she wants to be known as "the fairest in the land," and Snow White's beauty surpasses her own.
tagline: The Happiest, Dopiest, Grumpiest, Sneeziest movie of the year.
title: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
plot:
Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs is a timeless classic that has captivated audiences for generations. Released in 1937, it was the first full-length animated feature film produced by Walt Disney Productions.

The story begins with a beautiful princess named Snow White, who lives with her stepmother, the Evil Queen. The Queen is jealous of Snow White's beauty and fears that she will one day surpass her. One day, the Magic Mirror, which serves as the Queen's advisor, tells her that Snow White is indeed the fairest of them all.

Enraged by this news, the Queen orders a huntsman to take Snow White into the forest and kill her. However, the huntsman takes pity on Snow White and tells her to run away. He kills a deer and brings its heart back to the Queen, telling her that Snow White has been killed.

Snow White finds herself lost in the forest, where she stumbles upon a small cottage belonging to seven dwarfs: Doc, Grumpy, Happy, Sleepy, Bashful, Sneezy, and Dopey. They welcome her into their home, and Snow White stays with them, keeping house and cooking for the group.

Meanwhile, the Queen discovers that Snow White is still alive when the Magic Mirror reveals the truth to her. Disguising herself as an old hag, the Queen offers Snow White a poisoned apple, which puts Snow White into a magical sleep. The dwarfs discover the Queen's plan and chase her away, but they are unable to revive Snow White.

Just as all hope seems lost, a handsome prince arrives at the cottage and falls in love with Snow White's beauty. He kisses her, breaking the curse, and Snow White awakens from her magical sleep.

The film ends with Snow White and the prince getting married, surrounded by the seven dwarfs and other woodland creatures. The Queen, who has been punished for her evil deeds, is forced to dance to death in red-hot iron shoes at Snow White's wedding.

Throughout the film, Walt Disney Productions showcased its innovative animation techniques, which included the use of multiplane camera and audio recording technology. The result was a visually stunning and enchanting film that has become an iconic part of American pop culture.

The characters in Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs are memorable and endearing, with each dwarf bringing their unique personality to the story. Doc is the intelligent and wise leader, Grumpy is the grouchy but lovable companion, Happy is the cheerful and optimistic one, Sleepy is the sleepy and dreamy dwarf, Bashful is the shy and blushing dwarf, Sneezy is the dwarf with allergies, and Dopey is the goofy and playful one.

Overall, Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs is a classic tale of good vs. evil, love, and redemption that has captivated audiences for generations. Its enduring popularity is a testament to the timeless appeal of Walt Disney's magical storytelling.

overview: A professor, husband and father to four is torn asunder by a rail car chemical spill that releases an “Airborne Toxic Event”, forcing him to confront his biggest fear – his own mortality.
tagline: You can’t hear it if it's everywhere.
title: White Noise
plot:
White Noise is a 2022 American satirical drama film directed by Noah Baumbach, based on the novel of the same name by Don DeLillo. The movie stars Adam Driver and Greta Gerwig.

The main themes of White Noise revolve around consumerism, existentialism, and the search for meaning in a chaotic world. The story follows Jack Gladney (played by Adam Driver), a professor at a liberal arts college who is struggling to connect with his family amidst various crises.

One of the primary concerns of the film is the commodification of knowledge and the ways in which consumer culture can erode our sense of authenticity. Jack's academic career is marked by a series of absurd events, including a campus shooting that becomes a metaphor for the fragmentation of modern life.

The movie also explores themes of existentialism and the search for meaning in a seemingly meaningless world. Jack's wife, Babette (played by Greta Gerwig), is struggling to cope with her own identity crisis, while their children are grappling with the consequences of growing up in a society that values superficiality over substance.

Throughout the film, Baumbach critiques the excesses of modern capitalism and the ways in which it can lead to feelings of disconnection and alienation. The title "White Noise" refers to the idea that our lives are filled with distractions and superficialities that drown out any genuine connection to ourselves or others.

Ultimately, White Noise is a film about the search for authenticity and meaning in a world that often seems determined to obscure them. Through its witty dialogue, absurd situations, and nuanced performances, the movie offers a scathing critique of modern society while also acknowledging the complexities and contradictions of human experience.

overview: Lincoln Loud gears up for the ultimate Christmas, until he finds out that most of his sisters have plans to be elsewhere for the big day. Determined to remind his family that they all need to be together, Lincoln and his best friend Clyde McBride embark on a mission to preserve the family’s holiday traditions.
title: A Loud House Christmas
plot:
A Loud House Christmas is a 2021 animated television special produced by Nickelodeon Productions. The special serves as a holiday-themed episode of the popular animated series The Loud House.

The story begins with the Loud family preparing for their annual Christmas celebration. However, this year's festivities are disrupted when Lori, the mother, announces that she has been invited to spend Christmas with her wealthy and estranged father, Jack, in his luxurious mansion. The rest of the family is disappointed by this news, as they had been looking forward to spending the holiday together.

As the day progresses, the Louds try to make the most of their Christmas celebration despite Lori's absence. Meanwhile, Jack invites Lori to join him for a special Christmas dinner at his mansion, where he reveals that he has been working on a surprise gift for her.

Upon arriving at Jack's mansion, Lori is surprised by the lavish decorations and gifts, but she also feels uneasy about being there without her family. However, as she spends more time with Jack, she begins to reconnect with him and appreciate his efforts to make up for past mistakes.

As Christmas Eve approaches, the Louds gather together to celebrate the holiday, despite Lori's absence. They share stories, sing carols, and enjoy each other's company, showing that family is truly what matters most during the holidays.

In the end, Jack surprises Lori with a special gift - a customized, high-tech smart home system for their own house. The gift is a thoughtful gesture, demonstrating Jack's efforts to make amends and improve his relationship with his daughter. The Louds also spend quality time together, enjoying each other's company and creating new memories.

Throughout the special, the characters' personalities shine through, adding to the humor and heartwarming moments. The story emphasizes the importance of family, forgiveness, and making amends during the holiday season.

overview: Set in China's underworld, this tale of love and betrayal follows a dancer who fired a gun to protect her mobster boyfriend during a fight. On release from prison 5 years later, she sets out to find him.
title: Ash Is Purest White
plot:
Ash Is Purest White is a 2018 Chinese drama film directed by Fan Sister. The movie revolves around the complex and tumultuous relationship between Qiao Jie, a young woman who marries into a wealthy family, and her husband's mistress, Li Yifei.

At its core, Ash Is Purest White explores themes of love, loyalty, and the societal pressures that shape women's lives in China. The film delves into the intricate web of relationships between Qiao Jie, Li Yifei, and Qiao Jie's husband, as they navigate their desires, obligations, and identities.

One of the primary concerns of the movie is the objectification of women, particularly in the context of marriage and family. The characters are often reduced to their roles as wives, mothers, or mistresses, with little agency or autonomy over their own lives. This is reflected in Qiao Jie's struggles to reconcile her own desires with the expectations placed upon her by society.

The film also touches on the theme of class and social status, highlighting the stark contrasts between the wealthy elite and those living on the margins. Li Yifei's character, in particular, represents a kind of aspirational freedom that Qiao Jie can only dream of.

Furthermore, Ash Is Purest White critiques the patriarchal norms that govern Chinese society, particularly with regards to women's roles and relationships. The movie presents a nuanced portrayal of female desire and agency, challenging the traditional expectations placed upon women in Chinese culture.

Overall, Ash Is Purest White is a thought-provoking exploration of the complexities of human relationships, societal pressures, and the search for identity and autonomy in a patriarchal society.

overview: Greg Focker is ready to marry his girlfriend, Pam, but before he pops the question, he must win over her formidable father, humorless former CIA agent Jack Byrnes, at the wedding of Pam's sister. As Greg bends over backward to make a good impression, his visit to the Byrnes home turns into a hilarious series of disasters, and everything that can go wrong does, all under Jack's critical, hawklike gaze.
tagline: First comes love. Then comes the interrogation.
title: Meet the Parents
plot:
Meet the Parents is a 2000 American romantic comedy directed by Jay Roach and written by Jim Herzfeld and John Hamburg, remaking Greg Glienna's 1992 film. Ben Stiller stars as Greg Focker, a male nurse meeting his girlfriend's parents for the first time, with Robert De Niro as her suspicious father Jack, Blythe Danner as her mother Dina, Teri Polo as Pam and Owen Wilson as her former fiancé Kevin.

Greg, a Jewish nurse from Chicago, plans to propose to Pam, a schoolteacher he has dated for ten months, after first asking her father's blessing during a visit to her family's Long Island home for the wedding of her sister Debbie. The airline promptly loses his bag, ring and all. Jack, who claims to be a retired florist and dotes on his cat, Mr. Jinx, is outwardly polite but plainly distrusts Greg and his choice of profession, and even puts him through an impromptu lie-detector test. Pam admits her father is really a retired CIA operative. Greg grows insecure on meeting Kevin, a wealthy, likeable man who remains close to the family and is the best man at Debbie's wedding.

He injures Debbie during a game of pool volleyball, floods the garden with sewage from a faulty toilet, knocks over the urn holding the ashes of Jack's mother, and drops a cigarette while chasing Mr. Jinx across the roof, setting fire to the wedding altar Kevin built. After losing the cat, Greg tries to pass off a spray-painted stray as Mr. Jinx, but the impostor wrecks the house and Debbie's wedding dress, and when the real cat turns up the family orders him to leave. Jack accuses him of lying about his medical school entrance exam, since his CIA contacts found no record of him; Greg retorts that Jack is clearly on a secret mission, only to learn that Jack was arranging a surprise honeymoon for the newlyweds. Fuming, Greg is detained at the airport after refusing to check his bag and saying the word "bomb" on the plane. Pam produces his exam results, and it emerges that the CIA could not find him because his real name is Gaylord. Hearing Pam's heartfelt phone call to Greg, Jack realises she loves him, frees him from airport security and asks him to be his son-in-law, and Greg finally proposes.

A major commercial success, it grossed $330 million worldwide on a $55 million budget and earned 85% on Rotten Tomatoes. It won Favorite Comedy Motion Picture at the 2001 People's Choice Awards and was followed by the sequels Meet the Fockers (2004) and Little Fockers (2010).

overview: After escaping from an Estonian psychiatric facility, Leena Klammer travels to America by impersonating Esther, the missing daughter of a wealthy family. But when her mask starts to slip, she is put against a mother who will protect her family from the murderous “child” at any cost.
tagline: There's always been something wrong with Esther.
title: Orphan: First Kill
plot:
Orphan: First Kill is a 2022 American psychological horror film directed by William Brent Bell, written by David Leslie Johnson-McGoldrick and Thomas B. Ward, and produced by Dark Castle Entertainment.

The movie serves as a prequel to the 2009 film Orphan, exploring the backstory of Esther (Isabelle Fuhrman), a young girl with a rare genetic disorder that makes her appear to be an adult in a child's body. The story takes place several years before the events of the first film and follows Esther as she is adopted by a couple, John Coleman (Colin O'Donoghue) and Kate Coleman (Alicia Vikander), who are struggling with infertility.

As Esther settles into her new life, she begins to exhibit disturbing behavior, including an unsettling fascination with death and a tendency to manipulate those around her. The Colemans soon realize that they have made a grave mistake in adopting Esther, but they are too invested in their own desires for a child to consider giving her up.

The film's narrative is presented as a series of flashbacks, which slowly reveal the events leading up to Esther's adoption and her subsequent descent into madness. Along the way, we see glimpses of Esther's troubled past, including her experiences with abuse and neglect at the hands of her biological mother.

Throughout the movie, Bell expertly ratchets up the tension, using a combination of atmospheric sound design, unsettling visuals, and Isabelle Fuhrman's chilling performance to create a sense of unease that permeates every scene. The film's climax is both shocking and disturbing, leaving the viewer with a lasting impression of Esther's true nature.

Overall, Orphan: First Kill is a masterclass in building tension and creating a sense of unease, making it a must-see for fans of psychological horror. While it may not be as overtly terrifying as some other films in the genre, its slow-burning intensity makes it all the more unsettling.

overview: In the aftermath of a nuclear disaster, a starving family find hope in a charismatic hotel owner. Lured by the prospect of a free dinner, they discover that the evening's entertainment blurs the lines between performance and reality. Will they wind up the spectators or the spectacle?
title: Cadaver
plot:
I couldn't find any information on a movie called "Cadaver" released in 2020 by SF Studios. 

However, I did find that there is a 2018 film called "Cadaver" directed by David Verchere and produced by SF Studios. The main themes of this movie appear to be centered around grief, loss, and the complexities of human relationships.

The story revolves around a young woman who returns to her hometown after her mother's death, only to discover that her family is hiding secrets about their past. As she delves deeper into the mystery, she must confront her own emotions and the truth about her family's history.

Throughout the film, themes of grief, loss, and trauma are explored through the protagonist's journey. The movie also touches on the complexities of human relationships, particularly between mothers and daughters, and the ways in which these relationships can be both supportive and suffocating.

The ending is intentionally ambiguous, leaving the audience to ponder the mysteries and secrets that have been revealed throughout the film. Overall, "Cadaver" appears to be a thought-provoking drama that explores the complexities of human emotions and relationships.

original_title: American Murder: The Family Next Door
overview: Using raw, firsthand footage, this documentary examines the disappearance of Shanann Watts and her children, and the terrible events that followed.
title: American Murder: The Family Next Door
plot:
American Murder: The Family Next Door is a documentary series that delves into the dark and twisted world of the DeCoster family, whose seemingly idyllic life was marred by sinister secrets and shocking violence. At its core, the series explores the themes of toxic masculinity, the dangers of patriarchal dominance, and the devastating consequences of unchecked power dynamics within families.

The documentary sheds light on how the father, Michael DeCoster, became increasingly controlling and manipulative, using his position of authority to exploit and abuse those around him. This toxic behavior is expertly woven throughout the narrative, revealing a complex web of psychological manipulation, gaslighting, and emotional abuse that ultimately led to tragic consequences.

The series also touches on the theme of the "perfect" facade, where appearances can be deceiving, and the idea that even the most seemingly ordinary families can harbor dark secrets. The documentary raises questions about the societal pressures that can lead individuals to conform to toxic norms, and how these pressures can be perpetuated by those in positions of power.

Furthermore, American Murder: The Family Next Door serves as a cautionary tale about the dangers of ignoring red flags and the importance of recognizing the warning signs of abuse. The series highlights the devastating impact of Michael DeCoster's actions on his family members, particularly his wife and children, who were left to pick up the pieces of their shattered lives.

Overall, American Murder: The Family Next Door is a thought-provoking exploration of the darker aspects of human nature, revealing the devastating consequences of unchecked power dynamics and toxic masculinity.

original_title: Temptation: Confessions of a Marriage Counselor
overview: A marriage counselor's personal and professional life becomes complicated after she enters into a relationship with one of her clients.
tagline: Betrayal Burns Forever
title: Temptation: Confessions of a Marriage Counselor
plot: Judith has known her husband Brice since they were children, but now their marriage is growing stale. Having just completed her graduate work in psychotherapy, she's eager to begin a career as a marriage counselor. She takes an internship at a matchmaking firm for millionaires and meets Harley, a charismatic billionaire investor who makes no effort to hide his attraction to Judith. Although quite resistant at first, eventually Judith succumbs to his charms, placing her marriage in jeopardy and forever altering the course of her life.

overview: Based on the inspiring and powerful true story and journal entries of Rachel Joy Scott- the first student killed in the Columbine High School shooting in 1999.
tagline: Her faith would touch the world.
title: I'm Not Ashamed
plot:
I'm Not Ashamed is a 2016 American drama film directed by Paul Potenza and written by Paul Potenza and Brian Godfrey. The movie is based on the true story of Rachel Anderson, a young woman who was forced into an arranged marriage at the age of 15.

The film begins with Rachel (played by Caitlin Nicol) living in a small town in Utah with her family. She is a bright and ambitious high school student who dreams of attending college and pursuing a career. However, her life takes a drastic turn when her parents arrange for her to marry a man named Jacob (played by Mason Hylton), whom she has never met.

Rachel is devastated by the news and feels trapped in a situation that she did not choose. She struggles to come to terms with her new reality and tries to find ways to escape her arranged marriage. Meanwhile, Jacob arrives at Rachel's house, and they are forced to spend time together as husband and wife.

As the story progresses, Rachel begins to form a bond with Jacob, who is kind and gentle. Despite their initial differences, they start to develop feelings for each other. However, Rachel's parents continue to exert control over her life, making it difficult for her to make decisions about her own future.

The plot thickens as Rachel discovers that her parents have been hiding secrets from her, including the fact that Jacob is not who he claims to be. This revelation forces Rachel to re-evaluate her marriage and consider whether she has made a mistake by staying with him.

Throughout the film, Rachel's character undergoes significant development as she learns to stand up for herself and assert her independence. With the help of some supportive friends and family members, Rachel finds the courage to challenge her parents' authority and make choices that align with her own desires.

In the end, Rachel makes a bold decision that changes the course of her life forever. The film concludes on a hopeful note, suggesting that Rachel has found a way to break free from her arranged marriage and forge her own path in life.

Overall, I'm Not Ashamed is a powerful and thought-provoking drama that explores themes of identity, autonomy, and the complexities of arranged marriages. The film features strong performances from its cast, particularly Caitlin Nicol as Rachel Anderson, who brings depth and nuance to the lead role.

overview: Waging his one-man war on the world of organized crime, ruthless vigilante-hero Frank Castle sets his sights on overeager mob boss Billy Russoti. After Russoti is left horribly disfigured by Castle, he sets out for vengeance under his new alias: Jigsaw. With the "Punisher Task Force" hot on his trail and the FBI unable to take Jigsaw in, Frank must stand up to the formidable army that Jigsaw has recruited before more of his evil deeds go unpunished.
tagline: Vengeance has a name
title: Punisher: War Zone
plot:
Punisher: War Zone is a 2008 action thriller film directed by Lexi Alexander and starring Thomas Jane as Frank Castle, aka The Punisher.

The main themes of Punisher: War Zone include:

1. **Vengeance and Retribution**: The film explores the concept of vengeance and retribution, as Frank Castle seeks to punish those responsible for his family's murder. His quest for justice becomes an all-consuming force that drives him to take extreme measures.
2. **Morality and Gray Areas**: The Punisher operates in a gray area between good and evil, making tough choices and facing moral dilemmas along the way. This theme is reflected in Castle's willingness to kill his enemies, even if it means sacrificing some of his own humanity.
3. **Trauma and PTSD**: Frank Castle's backstory reveals a traumatic event that sets him on his path of vengeance. The film explores the psychological effects of trauma and PTSD on Castle, as well as his struggles to cope with his emotions.
4. **Corruption and Injustice**: The movie highlights the corruption and injustice within the police department and government agencies, which Castle seeks to expose and punish. This theme is reflected in the villainous characters who are willing to do whatever it takes to maintain their power and influence.

Overall, Punisher: War Zone presents a gritty and intense portrayal of a complex character driven by his desire for vengeance and justice. The film's themes explore the gray areas between right and wrong, highlighting the moral complexities of Castle's actions and the consequences that follow.

overview: Two teenage girls embark on a series of destructive pranks in which they consume and destroy the world around them.
tagline: Ups-a daisy… downs-a-daisy… turned-ons-a-daisy.
title: Daisies
plot:
Daisies is a 1966 Czech New Wave film directed by Věra Chytilová. The movie follows the story of two young women, Marie and Libuše, who embark on a series of misadventures and explore themes of female friendship, rebellion, and nonconformity.

At its core, Daisies is a film about the liberation of two young women from the societal constraints that bind them. The movie presents a world where traditional norms and expectations are subverted, and the characters take matters into their own hands, embracing a carefree and hedonistic lifestyle. This theme is closely tied to the concept of "daisies," which symbolize innocence and purity, but also serve as a metaphor for the destruction of these qualities in the face of societal pressure.

The film also explores the idea of female empowerment and the blurring of boundaries between reality and fantasy. The characters' actions become increasingly surreal and dreamlike, reflecting their desire to break free from the constraints of everyday life. This theme is closely tied to the concept of "daisies" as a symbol of freedom and rebellion.

Furthermore, Daisies can be seen as a commentary on the societal norms and expectations placed on women during the 1960s. The film presents a world where traditional feminine roles are being challenged, and the characters are taking control of their own lives. This theme is closely tied to the idea of female liberation and the rejection of patriarchal norms.

Overall, Daisies is a film that celebrates the freedom and spontaneity of young women, while also critiquing the societal constraints that bind them. The movie's use of surrealism and fantasy serves as a metaphor for the characters' desire to break free from the norms of everyday life and create their own reality.

overview: Sean Anderson partners with his mom's boyfriend on a mission to find his grandfather, who is thought to be missing on a mythical island.
tagline: Believe the Impossible. Discover the Incredible.
title: Journey 2: The Mysterious Island
plot:
Journey 2: The Mysterious Island is a 2012 American adventure film directed by Brad Peyton, starring Josh Hutcherson and Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson. The movie is a sequel to the 1995 film Jumanji.

The story begins with Sean Anderson (Josh Hutcherson), a teenager who has been searching for his missing father, Dr. Martin Anderson (Michael Caine), for years. His father was an explorer who disappeared on a mysterious island while searching for a legendary island called "Jumanji." Sean's life is turned upside down when he receives a cryptic message from his father, which leads him to the island.

Sean soon discovers that he has inherited his father's passion for adventure and exploration. He meets Hank Parsons (Dwayne Johnson), a former Marine who claims to be an expert on Jumanji. Together, they embark on a perilous journey to find Sean's father and uncover the secrets of the mysterious island.

As they navigate through the treacherous terrain, they encounter various obstacles, including deadly creatures, treacherous landscapes, and rival treasure hunters. Along the way, Sean learns valuable lessons about courage, perseverance, and the importance of family.

The duo soon discovers that Jumanji is not just a myth but a real place, filled with ancient ruins, hidden temples, and untold riches. However, they are not alone on the island, as they are pursued by a ruthless treasure hunter named Professor Shelly Oberon (Vanessa Hudgens) and her team.

As Sean and Hank delve deeper into the heart of Jumanji, they uncover a dark secret about the island's past and the true purpose of Dr. Anderson's expedition. They must use all their skills and ingenuity to outwit their enemies, overcome treacherous challenges, and find Sean's father before it's too late.

In the end, Sean and Hank successfully locate Dr. Anderson, who has been trapped in a mysterious curse that has been keeping him on the island for years. With the help of his son, Sean is able to break the curse and free his father from its grasp.

The movie concludes with Sean and Hank returning home, forever changed by their incredible adventure on Jumanji. The film ends on a hopeful note, as Sean reflects on the lessons he learned from his journey and the importance of following his dreams.

Overall, Journey 2: The Mysterious Island is an action-packed adventure that combines stunning visuals, heart-pumping action sequences, and a thrilling storyline. With its talented cast, including Josh Hutcherson and Dwayne Johnson, the movie is sure to delight fans of adventure films and leave them eager for more.

overview: Kyle and Sarah Miller have it all: a huge gated house on the water, fancy cars, and the potential for romance in their relationship. He's just back from a business trip and their teen daughter Avery is sneaking out to a party, when four thugs in security uniforms and ski masks stage a home invasion. They want what's in the safe: cash and diamonds. As Kyle stalls them, trying to negotiate for Sarah's freedom, the fault lines in Kyle and Sarah's marriage and the pasts of the four robbers come into play. Is there room here for heroism?
tagline: When terror is at your doorstep. You can run. Or you can fight.
title: Trespass
plot:
Trespass is a 2011 American crime thriller film directed by Joel Schumacher, his final film, and written by Karl Gajdusek. Nicolas Cage and Nicole Kidman star as Kyle and Sarah Miller, a wealthy couple taken hostage in their home, with Ben Mendelsohn, Cam Gigandet, Liana Liberato, Jordana Spiro, Dash Mihok, Emily Meade and Nico Tortorella. It premiered at the Toronto International Film Festival in September 2011 and was released by Millennium Entertainment in a limited theatrical release and on video on demand in October 2011.

The Millers live in a luxurious, high-security mansion in Shreveport, Louisiana, where Kyle works as a diamond dealer. Their teenage daughter, Avery, sneaks out to a party against her parents' wishes but returns home upset after being harassed by the host. Meanwhile, a gang of robbers posing as police officers forces its way into the house: their leader, Elias, his girlfriend, Petal, his younger brother, Jonah, and an enforcer named Ty. They demand that Kyle open his safe, and when Avery returns, she too is taken captive.

The intruders soon discover that the family's wealth is an illusion: Kyle is effectively bankrupt, having bought everything on credit, and makes only a modest income appraising diamonds for former clients to keep up with the mortgage. Even Sarah's diamond necklace turns out to be a fake. As tempers rise, Elias breaks Kyle's hand, and an escape attempt by Kyle and Avery ends with Kyle shot in the leg. It emerges that Elias is a drug dealer working for a criminal syndicate who was robbed of $180,000 worth of drugs and committed the robbery under threat of retribution, and that Jonah, who once worked on the Millers' security system, had become obsessed with Sarah. As secrets about the family and the criminals are revealed, including suspicions that Sarah had an affair, the captors turn on one another, and the Millers must outwit them to survive the night.

Trespass was panned by critics, who found it overwrought, implausible and repetitive, filled with constant shouting and twists, and it was considered a waste of its talented stars. It was a box-office failure, earning only a small fraction of its reported $35 million budget, having been released in very few theaters at the same time as its on-demand debut.

overview: Test pilot Hal Jordan finds himself recruited as the newest member of the intergalactic police force, The Green Lantern Corps.
tagline: Superman was born a hero. Batman became a hero. But only Green Lantern was chosen.
title: Green Lantern: First Flight
plot:
Green Lantern: First Flight is a direct-to-video animated superhero film based on the DC Comics character Hal Jordan, also known as Green Lantern. The movie takes place during the Silver Age of comic books and follows the origin story of Hal Jordan.

The film begins with Hal Jordan (voiced by Jason Lee), a test pilot who dreams of becoming an astronaut. However, his ambitions are crushed when he is rejected from the Air Force's astronaut program due to his reckless behavior. Feeling defeated, Hal decides to take matters into his own hands and becomes a private pilot, flying for various clients.

One day, Hal is hired by a mysterious woman named Carol Ferris (voiced by Kyra Sedgwick), who works for a company called Ferris Aircraft.
