Through the characters' experiences, the film also touches on themes of friendship, loyalty, and the importance of supporting one another in the face of adversity. Ultimately, Lemonade Mouth is a heartwarming and uplifting film that encourages viewers to find their own voice and use it to make a positive impact on the world around them.

overview: Chris and his girlfriend Rose go upstate to visit her parents for the weekend. At first, Chris reads the family's overly accommodating behavior as nervous attempts to deal with their daughter's interracial relationship, but as the weekend progresses, a series of increasingly disturbing discoveries lead him to a truth that he never could have imagined.
tagline: Just because you're invited, doesn't mean you're welcome.
title: Get Out
plot:
Get Out is a psychological horror film written and directed by Jordan Peele, released in 2017 by Blumhouse Productions. The movie tells the story of Chris Washington, a young African American photographer who agrees to visit his white girlfriend's family estate in upstate New York.

The film begins with Chris (played by Daniel Kaluuya) and his girlfriend Rose (played by Allison Williams) discussing their relationship and the fact that she has invited him to meet her family. Despite some initial reservations, Chris decides to attend the weekend getaway, hoping it will be a chance for them to take their relationship to the next level.

Upon arrival at the Armitage estate, Chris is greeted by Rose's parents, Dean (played by Bradley Whitford) and Missy (played by Catherine Keener), as well as her brother Jeremy (played by Caleb Landry Jones). Initially, Chris feels a sense of unease due to the family's strange behavior and the fact that they seem to be hiding something from him.

As the weekend progresses, Chris begins to notice that the family is treating him with an unusual level of hospitality, almost to the point of being overly accommodating. He also discovers that the family has a fascination with black culture, which he initially attributes to their enthusiasm for his photography work. However, as the days go by, Chris starts to uncover a sinister plot involving hypnosis, mind control, and a sinister secret that the Armitage family is hiding.

The turning point in the film comes when Chris discovers that the family has been using their wealth and influence to lure black people into their home, where they are subjected to a form of psychological manipulation. The family's true intention is to harvest the bodies of these individuals for use as vessels for their own white consciousness, essentially allowing them to experience life through the eyes of a black person without actually having to live it.

As Chris tries to escape and expose the truth, he realizes that he has become trapped in the Armitage estate. The film builds up to a tense climax, where Chris must use his wits and resourcefulness to outsmart the family and break free from their clutches.

Ultimately, Chris manages to escape the estate, but not before discovering that Rose is complicit in her family's sinister activities. In a shocking twist, it is revealed that Rose has been using her relationship with Chris as a way to experience black culture without actually having to live it herself.

The film ends with Chris driving away from the Armitage estate, finally free from his ordeal. However, the final shot of the film suggests that Chris may not be entirely safe, leaving the audience with a sense of unease and uncertainty about his future.

Get Out is a thought-provoking and deeply unsettling film that explores themes of racism, privilege, and the fetishization of black culture. The movie's clever script, combined with its masterful direction and performances, make it a standout in contemporary horror cinema.

overview: A band of medieval mercenaries take revenge on a noble lord who decides not to pay them by kidnapping the betrothed of the noble's son. As the plague and warfare cut a swathe of destruction throughout the land, the mercenaries hole up in a castle and await their fate.
tagline: Betrayed by power. Corrupted by love. Bound by honor.
title: Flesh + Blood
plot:
Flesh and Blood (stylized Flesh + Blood) is a 1985 historical adventure film directed by Paul Verhoeven, his first in English, from a script he wrote with Gerard Soeteman. It stars Rutger Hauer, Jennifer Jason Leigh, Tom Burlinson, Susan Tyrrell and Jack Thompson. Set in Italy in 1501, it follows mercenaries betrayed by their employer.

When Arnolfini, the rightful ruler of an Italian city, is ousted by a putsch, he promises a company of mercenaries 24 hours of plunder if they retake it. They do so brutally, but Arnolfini then decides he wants them gone. Their commander, Hawkwood, leads Arnolfini's cavalry against his former comrades, betraying his lieutenant Martin, and the mercenaries are expelled without their loot. When Martin's stillborn son is buried, the grave unearths a statue of Saint Martin with a sword, which the band's chaplain takes as a sign that Martin should lead them. Arnolfini's son Steven is betrothed to the young noblewoman Agnes, and the two fall in love after eating a mandrake root, but Martin's band ambushes their caravan, wounding Arnolfini and carrying Agnes off with her dowry. Martin rapes her; she then seeks his protection, and he keeps the others from her.

The mercenaries seize a castle whose inhabitants, unknown to them, are infected with plague. Agnes appears to embrace her new life, winning Martin's love and the band's acceptance, while hinting that she will side with whoever wins. Steven forces Hawkwood to help him by seizing the former nun Hawkwood hopes to marry, and they besiege the castle, but plague spreads among the besiegers and Martin destroys their siege tower with gunpowder. Steven is captured and chained in the courtyard. Hawkwood, cured of the plague by lancing his buboes as Steven had taught, catapults pieces of an infected dog into the castle before leaving for reinforcements, and Steven throws one into the well. As the mercenaries fall sick, they blame Martin and throw him into the well. Steven and Martin cooperate to escape, and when Hawkwood and Arnolfini return with an army, the castle burns. Martin tries to strangle Agnes rather than lose her, but she strikes him down and flees with Steven, then silently watches Martin escape with a sack of loot.

Orion Pictures gave the film a limited US release in August 1985, and it was a box office failure, earning about $100,000 against a $6.5 million budget. It has since become a cult and critical favorite, with 82% approval on Rotten Tomatoes.

overview: The true story of mountain climber Aron Ralston's remarkable adventure to save himself after a fallen boulder crashes on his arm and traps him in an isolated canyon in Utah.
tagline: There is no force more powerful than the will to live.
title: 127 Hours
plot:
"127 Hours" is a biographical drama film directed by Danny Boyle, released in 2010 by Fox Searchlight Pictures. The film is based on the true story of Aron Ralston, an American outdoorsman and mountain climber.

The movie begins with Aron Ralston (played by James Franco) as a successful outdoor enthusiast who has spent years exploring the wilderness. He is shown to be in his element, free-spirited and adventurous. However, this carefree life takes a drastic turn when he becomes trapped in a canyon in Utah.

On April 26, 2003, Aron is on a solo hike in the Blue John Canyon, trying to find a way out of the narrow passageway. As he navigates through the tight space, his arm gets caught under a boulder, which falls and pins him against the wall. Panicked and desperate for help, Aron tries to free himself but is unable to do so.

The next 127 hours (the title refers to the duration of Aron's entrapment) are filled with intense physical and mental struggles as he tries to survive without food or water. He uses his knowledge of wilderness survival to ration his remaining energy, creating a makeshift shelter and signaling for help using his phone and other objects.

As time passes, Aron becomes increasingly desperate, and the psychological strain begins to take its toll on him. He starts to hallucinate and experience vivid dreams, which serve as a coping mechanism to deal with the unbearable situation.

Meanwhile, back in civilization, Aron's friends and family are frantically searching for him. His girlfriend, Cindy (played by Kate Mara), is particularly worried and tries to reach out to him through phone calls and messages.

In a dramatic turn of events, Aron finally manages to free himself from the boulder using his knowledge of anatomy and leverage. However, in doing so, he suffers severe injuries, including a mangled arm and deep lacerations on his hand.

The film's climax shows Aron making his way out of the canyon, where he is met by rescuers who had been searching for him for days. The movie ends with Aron being airlifted to safety, where he undergoes extensive surgery to repair his injuries.

Throughout the film, James Franco delivers a powerful and nuanced performance as Aron Ralston, capturing the complexity of his character's emotions and struggles. The film's tense atmosphere and stunning cinematography add to the overall sense of urgency and desperation that defines Aron's ordeal.

Overall, "127 Hours" is a gripping and emotionally charged drama that explores themes of survival, resilience, and redemption in the face of unimaginable adversity.

overview: Ironheart, AKA Riri Williams, is having difficulty adjusting to college life as the youngest student there when the college's engineering lab is demolished by an alien and her best friend is kidnapped. Inspired by Iron Man, she develops a plan to save her friend.
title: Marvel Rising: Heart of Iron
plot:
Marvel Rising: Heart of Iron is an animated superhero film that delves into the complexities of power, loyalty, and identity. The movie follows the story of Ironheart, a young inventor named Riri Williams, who creates her own Iron Man suit to fight against evil.

At its core, the film explores the theme of self-discovery and empowerment. Riri's journey is one of finding her place in the world and asserting her independence from others. As she navigates her relationships with her friends and mentors, she must confront the challenges of being a young woman in a male-dominated field and learning to balance her own desires with the expectations of those around her.

The movie also touches on the theme of loyalty and friendship. Riri's relationships with her friends and allies are put to the test as she struggles to reconcile her desire for independence with her need for support and guidance. The film highlights the importance of having people who believe in you and your abilities, even when you're not sure of yourself.

Furthermore, Marvel Rising: Heart of Iron explores the theme of identity and what it means to be a hero. Riri's journey is not just about becoming a superhero, but also about figuring out who she is as a person and what kind of impact she wants to make in the world. The film raises questions about the nature of heroism and whether it's possible for someone like Riri, who is still learning and growing, to be a true hero.

Overall, Marvel Rising: Heart of Iron is a story about growth, self-discovery, and the power of relationships and friendships. It's a tale that celebrates the complexities and challenges of being a young woman in a world dominated by men, while also highlighting the importance of embracing your unique strengths and talents.

overview: When their beloved school is threatened with closure should the powers that be fail to raise the proper funds, the girls scheme to steal a priceless painting and use the profits to pull St. Trinian's out of the red.
tagline: Taking higher education to a new low.
title: St. Trinian's
plot:
St. Trinian's is a 2007 British comedy film that satirizes the British education system and societal norms. The movie follows the misadventures of a group of girls at the fictional St. Trinian's boarding school, known for their rebellious nature and penchant for chaos.

At its core, St. Trinian's explores themes of female empowerment, nonconformity, and the struggle for independence in a patriarchal society. The film celebrates the girls' refusal to conform to traditional norms and expectations, embracing instead a spirit of free-spiritedness and self-expression.

The movie also touches on issues of class and social status, highlighting the contrast between the privileged students at St. Trinian's and those from more humble backgrounds. This dichotomy serves as a commentary on the social inequalities of British society during that era.

Furthermore, St. Trinian's pokes fun at the stuffy, outdated nature of the British education system, which often prioritizes discipline over creativity and individuality. The film's portrayal of the school's strict headmistress and her attempts to maintain order serve as a satire of the rigid authority structures that can stifle innovation and progress.

Ultimately, St. Trinian's is a lighthearted, entertaining film that uses humor and wit to explore these themes and offer a commentary on British society during the 2000s.

overview: A concert documentary shot during the Glee Live! In Concert! summer 2011 tour, featuring song performances and Glee fans' life stories and how the show influenced them.
tagline: The embodiment of popular culture.
title: Glee: The Concert Movie
plot:
Glee: The Concert Movie is a musical comedy-drama film that explores the themes of self-discovery, friendship, and the power of music to bring people together. The movie follows the glee club members as they prepare for their concert, navigating personal struggles, relationships, and conflicts along the way.

At its core, Glee: The Concert Movie is a story about finding one's identity and voice, both literally and figuratively. The characters are on a journey of self-discovery, trying to figure out who they are and where they fit in. Through their experiences with music, they learn valuable lessons about perseverance, teamwork, and the importance of embracing their individuality.

The movie also explores the theme of community and the impact that music can have on people's lives. The glee club is more than just a group of friends singing together; it's a support system, a safe space where they can be themselves and express themselves freely. As they prepare for their concert, they learn to come together as a team, supporting each other through the ups and downs of life.

Furthermore, Glee: The Concert Movie touches on the theme of social hierarchy and cliques. The characters are often divided into different groups, with some struggling to fit in or find their place within the group. However, through music, they learn to bridge these gaps and form connections with others who may seem different from them.

Overall, Glee: The Concert Movie is a heartwarming and entertaining film that celebrates the power of music and the importance of finding one's voice and community.

overview: A zombie apocalypse threatens the sleepy town of Little Haven – at Christmas – forcing Anna and her friends to fight, slash and sing their way to survival, facing the undead in a desperate race to reach their loved ones. But they soon discover that no one is safe in this new world, and with civilization falling apart around them, the only people they can truly rely on are each other.
tagline: Oh the weather outside is frightful...
title: Anna and the Apocalypse
plot:
Anna and the Apocalypse is a 2017 British zombie musical comedy film directed by John McPherson, not 2018, and produced by Creative Scotland, but also by others. The movie takes place in a high school where a zombie outbreak occurs, and it follows the story of Anna, a rebellious teenager who must navigate this new world while trying to find her place among her peers.

The main themes of Anna and the Apocalypse revolve around the struggle for identity, self-discovery, and empowerment. The film explores how its characters cope with the chaos and uncertainty of their situation, often finding creative ways to express themselves and assert their individuality in the face of adversity.

One of the central themes is the importance of female friendship and solidarity. Anna's relationships with her friends serve as a source of strength and support, allowing them to work together and find ways to survive in this new world. The film also touches on the idea of rebellion and resistance, as the characters use music and art to express their emotions and push back against the oppressive forces that seek to control them.

The movie also explores themes of social hierarchy, class divisions, and the struggles of adolescence. The high school setting serves as a microcosm for the larger societal issues, highlighting the tensions between different groups and the ways in which these conflicts can be both personal and global.

Overall, Anna and the Apocalypse is a film that celebrates creativity, resilience, and the power of human connection in the face of adversity.

overview: 29 years since the Black Flame Candle was last lit, the 17th-century Sanderson sisters are resurrected, and they are looking for revenge. Now it's up to three high school students to stop the ravenous witches from wreaking a new kind of havoc on Salem before dawn on All Hallow's Eve.
tagline: Back and more glorious than ever.
title: Hocus Pocus 2
plot:
I have information on Hocus Pocus 2.

Hocus Pocus 2 is a 2022 American fantasy comedy film directed by Anne Fletcher and written by Jen D'Angelo. The movie serves as a sequel to the 1993 film Hocus Pocus, which was also produced by Walt Disney Pictures.

The story takes place 29 years after the events of the first film. Becca (Whitney Peak), the daughter of Max Dennison (Omri Katz), is now a teenager who has grown up hearing stories about her father's encounter with the Sanderson sisters, Winifred (Bette Midler), Mary (Kathy Najimy), and Sarah (Sarah Jessica Parker). The three witches were resurrected by Max's teenage sister Dani (Thora Birch) in an attempt to scare him away from his girlfriend.

The movie follows Becca as she discovers that the Sanderson sisters are still alive and living in Salem, Massachusetts. Winifred, Mary, and Sarah have been waiting for their next victim, which they believe will be a young girl with magical powers. However, when they discover that Becca is not only a witch but also the chosen one to defeat them, they become determined to kill her.

As Becca navigates her newfound identity as a witch, she must also confront the Sanderson sisters and their evil plans. Along the way, she meets a group of young witches who help her on her quest to stop the sisters and save Salem from their wrath.

Throughout the movie, there are plenty of nods to the original film, including cameos from some of the original characters. The movie also explores themes of identity, family, and the power of friendship and love.

Overall, Hocus Pocus 2 is a fun and lighthearted sequel that is sure to delight fans of the original film. With its blend of magic, humor, and adventure, it's a great addition to the Hocus Pocus franchise.

overview: A lonely 40-ish man, likely to remain a bachelor, has a chance to find the love of his life when he falls for a vivacious young woman.
tagline: There Is An Extraordinary Love Story In Every Ordinary Jodi.
title: Rab Ne Bana Di Jodi
plot:
Rab Ne Bana Di Jodi is a 2008 Indian romantic comedy-drama film that explores the complexities of love, family, and identity. The movie delves into the theme of finding one's true self and embracing individuality, as embodied by the protagonist Surinder Sahni (played by Shah Rukh Khan), who discovers his long-lost twin brother Manjulika (played by Deepika Padukone) after 25 years.

The film also touches upon the idea of family dynamics and the importance of relationships in shaping our identities. The Sahni family, with its quirky characters and intricate web of relationships, serves as a microcosm for exploring themes of love, loyalty, and acceptance.

Moreover, Rab Ne Bana Di Jodi critiques societal norms and expectations, particularly those related to marriage and family. The movie pokes fun at the traditional Indian arranged marriage system, highlighting the tension between conformity and individuality.

Ultimately, the film's narrative is driven by its exploration of the human desire for connection, belonging, and self-discovery. Through Surinder's journey, the movie shows that it's never too late to find one's true identity and forge meaningful relationships with others.

overview: A group of contest winners arrive at an island hotel to live out their dreams, only to find themselves trapped in nightmare scenarios.
tagline: Never coming home
title: Fantasy Island
plot:
Fantasy Island is a 2020 American fantasy horror film directed by Jean-François Richet and written by Peter Callaghan and David Koepp. The movie stars Michael Peña, Maggie Q, and Stan Badger.

The main themes of Fantasy Island (2020) include:

1. **The Dangers of Desire**: The film explores the idea that our deepest desires can often lead to chaos and destruction. The characters who visit the island are granted their wishes, but these wishes come with a terrible cost.
2. **Trauma and Healing**: Many of the characters on the island have traumatic pasts, and their wishes serve as a way to cope with their emotional pain. However, the film suggests that true healing can only be achieved by confronting and overcoming one's traumas.
3. **The Power of Imagination**: The island itself is a manifestation of the characters' collective imagination, highlighting the idea that our thoughts and desires have the power to shape reality.
4. **The Blurred Lines between Reality and Fantasy**: As the story progresses, it becomes increasingly difficult for the characters (and the audience) to distinguish between what's real and what's just a product of their imaginations.

Throughout the film, these themes are woven together with elements of horror, suspense, and dark fantasy, creating a unique and unsettling viewing experience.

overview: If Nick Barrow can stay alive for 21 days, he'll die happy. Everyone Nick knows wants him dead; Mob bosses, contract killers, and dirty cops. Performing the last act of a desperate man, Nick takes out a million dollar insurance policy on himself, payable to his estranged daughter. The problem? The policy doesn't take effect for 21 days. Nick knows they'll be lucky to be alive for twenty-one hours.
tagline: A daughter out of options. A father out of time.
title: Term Life
plot:
Term Life is a 2016 American action drama directed by Peter Billingsley from a screenplay by A. J. Lieberman, based on Lieberman's graphic novel of the same name. It stars Vince Vaughn, who also produced the film, as Nick Barrow, and Hailee Steinfeld as his estranged daughter Cate, with Bill Paxton, Jonathan Banks, Mike Epps, Jordi Mollà, Shea Whigham, William Levy, Taraji P. Henson, Annabeth Gish and Terrence Howard. Production was briefly halted when Universal canceled the film in 2013, but it was revived by QED International and PalmStar Entertainment and shot in Georgia in 2014.

Nick Barrow is a professional who plans heists and sells them to the highest bidder. When a job goes badly wrong, he finds himself framed and hunted, and he is forced to go on the run with Cate, a teenage daughter he has never really been part of the life of. Cate, whose mother is an alcoholic, has learned to fend for herself and resents her father for dragging her into his dangerous world.

As they flee, Nick tries to work out who double-crossed him, and with the help of an old acquaintance he concludes that a corrupt police officer, Keenan, wants him dead. Hunted by mob bosses, contract killers and dirty cops, and convinced he may not survive, Nick takes out a life insurance policy on himself so that Cate will be provided for once he is gone. Along the way, father and daughter slowly bond: Nick teaches her the tricks of his trade and how to survive, and Cate learns that he has secretly followed her life for years. As the danger closes in, Cate's own resourcefulness becomes key to their survival.

The film is a crime thriller built around a reluctant father-daughter relationship and the idea of a parent trying to make amends.

Term Life was released on April 29, 2016, in a limited release and on video on demand by Focus World. It received negative reviews, scoring 0 percent on Rotten Tomatoes from a handful of reviews, though the Los Angeles Times described it as cleanly plotted and tautly paced, if never as fun as it should be.

overview: Nacho Libre is loosely based on the story of Fray Tormenta ("Friar Storm"), aka Rev. Sergio Gutierrez Benitez, a real-life Mexican Catholic priest who had a 23-year career as a masked luchador. He competed in order to support the orphanage he directed.
tagline: He's not lean. He's not mean. He's nacho average hero.
title: Nacho Libre
plot:
Nacho Libre is a 2006 American sports comedy film directed by Jared Hess and written by Jared and Jerusha Hess. The movie stars Jack Black, Ana de la Reguera, Héctor Jiménez, and Carlos Santana.

The story begins with Nacho Varga (Jack Black), a cook at a Mexican monastery in Mexico City who secretly dreams of becoming a luchador (Mexican wrestler). Nacho's life is mundane and unfulfilling, working long hours in the kitchen while his fellow monks enjoy their lives as wrestlers. However, when the monastery's beloved priest, Padre Sancho (Héctor Jiménez), announces that he will be retiring due to a heart condition, Nacho sees an opportunity to fulfill his lifelong dream.

Nacho begins training with the monastery's wrestling coach, Esqueleto (Jorge Rivero), and eventually earns the nickname "El Loco" (The Crazy One). He also meets Sister Encarnación (Ana de la Reguera), a beautiful and kind-hearted nun who becomes Nacho's love interest. As Nacho's wrestling career takes off, he must balance his newfound fame with his responsibilities at the monastery.

However, things take a turn when Esqueleto is murdered by a rival wrestler, Ramón "El Diablo" Cortez (Carlos Santana), who seeks to destroy Nacho and claim the monastery's wrestling title for himself. Nacho must use his wits and wrestling skills to outsmart Cortez and save the monastery.

Throughout the movie, Jack Black shines as Nacho Libre, bringing his signature energy and humor to the role. The film is full of hilarious moments, from Nacho's over-the-top wrestling matches to his awkward interactions with Sister Encarnación.

As the story unfolds, Nacho must confront his own identity and purpose. He learns that being a luchador is not just about physical strength but also about using his platform for good. In the end, Nacho defeats Cortez in an epic wrestling match, saving the monastery and finding his true calling as a wrestler.

The movie ends with Nacho returning to the monastery, where he is welcomed back as a hero. He marries Sister Encarnación, and they have a beautiful wedding ceremony. The film concludes on a heartwarming note, showcasing Nacho's growth and newfound sense of purpose.

Overall, Nacho Libre is a fun and entertaining movie that combines humor, action, and heart. Jack Black's performance as the titular character is unforgettable, making this film a must-see for fans of comedy and wrestling.

overview: Back in sunny southern California and on the trail of two murderers, Axel Foley again teams up with LA cop Billy Rosewood. Soon, they discover that an amusement park is being used as a front for a massive counterfeiting ring – and it's run by the same gang that shot Billy's boss.
tagline: In for the ride of his life!
title: Beverly Hills Cop III
plot:
Beverly Hills Cop III is a 1994 American action comedy film directed by Tony Scott and starring Eddie Murphy as Axel Foley, a Detroit cop who goes undercover to solve a murder case in Beverly Hills. The movie marks the third installment in the Beverly Hills Cop series.

The story begins with Axel Foley (Eddie Murphy) returning to Beverly Hills after a successful stint as an undercover agent in Russia. He is approached by his friend and colleague, Detective Rosewood (Nora Dunn), who informs him that a wealthy businessman named Julian Beasley (Hector Elizondo) has been murdered. The police investigation reveals that the murder was committed using a rare and valuable gemstone.

Axel Foley decides to go undercover again, this time as a Beverly Hills detective, to investigate the murder and uncover the identity of the killer. He is paired with Detective Rosewood's new partner, Detective John Kimble (Joe Pesci), who is initially hesitant to work with Axel due to their past differences.

As Axel navigates the wealthy and complex world of Beverly Hills, he encounters a range of characters, including Beasley's business associates, his family members, and even some old friends from his Detroit days. Along the way, he discovers that the murder is linked to a larger conspiracy involving Beasley's company and several other powerful individuals.

Throughout the movie, Axel faces numerous challenges as he tries to stay one step ahead of the killer and solve the case. He also has to contend with the skepticism of some of his colleagues, who doubt his abilities due to his lack of experience in Beverly Hills.

As the plot thickens, Axel discovers that the murder is connected to a larger scheme involving Beasley's company and several other powerful individuals. He also uncovers a personal connection between Beasley and one of his business associates, which leads him closer to the truth.

In the end, Axel Foley successfully solves the case by exposing the conspiracy and bringing the killer to justice. The movie concludes with Axel returning to Detroit, where he is welcomed back as a hero. However, the film also sets up a potential sequel, as Axel receives a call from an old friend in Russia, hinting at another adventure.

Overall, Beverly Hills Cop III is an action-packed comedy that delivers on its promise of high-octane excitement and witty humor. While it may not be as strong as the first two films in the series, it still provides plenty of entertainment value for fans of the franchise.

original_title: ヱヴァンゲリヲン新劇場版：破
overview: Under constant attack by monstrous creatures called Angels that seek to eradicate humankind, U.N. Special Agency NERV introduces two new EVA pilots to help defend the city of Tokyo-3: the mysterious Makinami Mari Illustrous and the intense Asuka Langley Shikinami. Meanwhile, Gendo Ikari and SEELE proceed with a secret project that involves both Rei and Shinji.
tagline: In the War Between Heaven and Earth, Salvation is Machine.
title: Evangelion: 2.0 You Can (Not) Advance
plot:
Evangelion: 2.0 You Can (Not) Advance is a 2009 anime film directed by Hideaki Anno, produced by Studio Khara, and written by Masahiro Takuma. The movie serves as the second installment of the Neon Genesis Evangelion Rebuild series, which reimagines the original 1995 anime series.

The story takes place two years after the events of the first film, Evangelion: 1.0 You Are (Not) Alone. Shinji Ikari, the protagonist, is still struggling with his emotional baggage and feelings of inadequacy. He is now a member of NERV's Special Operations Division, where he works alongside Asuka Langley Soryu, a skilled but troubled pilot.

The plot revolves around the appearance of a new Evangelion unit, Unit-02, which is designed to be more powerful than its predecessor. However, during its first test flight, Unit-02 malfunctions and crashes into the city, causing widespread destruction. Shinji is tasked with piloting Unit-01, but he struggles to cope with the pressure and his own emotional demons.

As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that Unit-02's malfunction was not an accident, but rather a deliberate act of sabotage. The true intentions behind this event are slowly revealed, and Shinji discovers that he is not alone in his struggles. Asuka, who has her own share of emotional issues, begins to open up to Shinji, and their bond grows stronger.

Meanwhile, the enigmatic leader of NERV, Gendo Ikari, continues to manipulate events from behind the scenes. His true motives for creating the Evangelion project are slowly revealed, and it becomes clear that he is willing to sacrifice anyone who gets in his way.

The climax of the film takes place at a concert event where Shinji and Asuka confront their inner demons and face off against Gendo's sinister plans. The movie culminates in a dramatic showdown between Shinji and Unit-02, which ultimately leads to a tragic confrontation with Gendo.

Throughout the film, Anno explores themes of existentialism, psychological trauma, and the consequences of playing god. The animation is stunning, with intricate details and a blend of traditional and computer-generated imagery. The soundtrack, composed by Shirō Sagisu, is equally impressive, featuring haunting melodies that perfectly capture the mood and atmosphere of each scene.

Overall, Evangelion: 2.0 You Can (Not) Advance is a thought-provoking and emotionally charged film that delves deeper into the complexities of Shinji's character and the world of Evangelion. While it may not be as accessible to new viewers as the original series, fans of the franchise will appreciate the nuanced storytelling and stunning animation.

overview: Six strangers find themselves in circumstances beyond their control, and must use their wits to survive.
tagline: Find The Clues Or Die
title: Escape Room
plot:
Escape Room is a 2019 American psychological thriller film directed by Adam Robitel and written by Bragi Schut and Maria Melnik. The movie stars Taylor Russell, Logan Miller, Jay Ellis, Tyler Labine, Deborah Ann Woll, and Chris Janson.

The story follows six strangers who are invited to participate in a mysterious game called "Escape Room." Each participant is given a phone with a cryptic message that reads: "You're going to die tonight. You have 60 minutes to escape."

The movie begins with six individuals from different walks of life, each receiving the mysterious invitation. There's Zoe (Taylor Russell), a college student; Ben (Logan Miller), a high school student; Emily (Deborah Ann Woll), a corporate executive; Chris (Jay Ellis), a police officer; Nick (Tyler Labine), a bartender; and Angela (Mia Stammers), a young woman with a troubled past.

As the game begins, each participant is taken to a different room, where they must solve puzzles and challenges to escape. The rooms are designed to test their physical and mental limits, and the participants soon realize that they are trapped in a deadly game.

Throughout the movie, the participants work together to uncover the secrets behind the game and find a way out. Along the way, they discover that each room is connected to a larger mystery, and that the game is designed to test their moral fiber.

As the clock ticks down, the participants face numerous challenges, including physical obstacles, psychological manipulation, and even murder. The tension builds as they realize that one of them may be the killer, and that they must work together to survive.

The movie takes a dark turn when it's revealed that the game is designed by a serial killer who uses his victims' deepest fears against them. The participants soon discover that they are trapped in a series of rooms, each designed to test their psychological limits.

In the final act, the participants use all their skills and knowledge to escape the last room and confront the killer. In a thrilling climax, they manage to outsmart the killer and escape the game, but not without scars.

The movie ends with a twist: the participants are left wondering if they really escaped, or if they were just part of another game. The final shot is of the phone, still ringing with the message "You're going to die tonight."

Overall, Escape Room is a tense and thrilling movie that keeps viewers on the edge of their seats. With its clever plot twists and suspenseful atmosphere, it's a must-see for fans of psychological thrillers.

overview: A film adaptation of D.H. Lawrence's novel. After a crippling injury leaves her husband impotent, Lady Chatterly is torn between her love for her husband and her physical desires. With her husband's consent, she seeks out other means of fulfilling her needs.
tagline: The most notorious novel of the century.
title: Lady Chatterley's Lover
plot:
Lady Chatterley's Lover is a 1981 erotic romantic drama directed by Just Jaeckin and adapted from D. H. Lawrence's 1928 novel of the same name. Sylvia Kristel stars as Lady Constance Chatterley and Nicholas Clay as the gamekeeper Oliver Mellors, with Shane Briant as Sir Clifford Chatterley, Ann Mitchell as Ivy Bolton and Elizabeth Spriggs as Lady Eva; Anthony Head and Bessie Love appear in smaller roles.

Constance, known as Connie, has only recently married Sir Clifford, a baronet, when a wound suffered in the Great War leaves him paralysed and impotent. She remains devoted to him but is tormented by her own physical longings, and Clifford not only consents to her finding satisfaction elsewhere but encourages it, even to the extent of having her bear him an heir by another man. One day Connie secretly watches Mellors washing outside his hut and is immediately drawn to him. When she later visits him openly, he resents her intrusion, conscious of the gulf in class between a labourer and an aristocrat. On a further visit, made on the pretext of seeing some newly hatched birds, she breaks down in tears at the sight of them; Mellors tenderly holds her, and the two begin an affair.

Their physical relationship deepens into love, and both come to want her to have his child. Sir Clifford, meanwhile, grows suspicious. After a number of secret meetings, the lovers decide that Connie will spend a whole night at Mellors' cottage. That night Clifford painfully hauls himself up the stairs to her bedroom and finds it empty, and he is waiting for her when she returns at dawn. Outraged that his wife has given herself to a man of the lower classes, he sends her away to Venice and dismisses Mellors. Discovering that she is pregnant, Connie tries to return to her husband, but Clifford rejects her, refusing to accept a commoner's child as his heir. She stays on at the house while Mellors waits for his divorce from his first wife, who is never seen.

The film was produced by Cannon Films, with Yoram Globus as executive producer. Ken Russell, who had once hoped to film the novel himself, predicted a glossy romp, and Kristel complained about the label of soft pornography that had followed her since Emmanuelle. Accounts differ on its finances: one report in 1982 claimed it had already recouped its costs, while another source says Cannon recorded a loss. It later grew more popular on home video and through late-night showings on cable channels such as Cinemax and Showtime.

overview: Plagued by a series of apocalyptic visions, a young husband and father questions whether to shelter his family from a coming storm, or from himself.
tagline: Far away from the cruel world.
title: Take Shelter
plot:
Take Shelter is a 2011 American psychological thriller written and directed by Jeff Nichols, starring Michael Shannon as Curtis LaForche, a young husband and father, and Jessica Chastain as his wife Samantha. The film follows a man tormented by apocalyptic visions, who must decide whether to protect his family from a coming storm or from his own fear that he is losing his mind.

In the small town of LaGrange, Ohio, Curtis, a construction worker, begins to suffer vivid nightmares and hallucinations: rain falling like motor oil, menacing flocks of birds and people close to him turning violent. He hides his visions from Samantha and their deaf daughter Hannah, instead channeling his anxiety into an obsessive project to expand the storm shelter in his backyard.

His behavior becomes increasingly strange. He cuts off people who have hurt him only in his dreams, borrows heavy equipment from his employer without permission and takes out a risky loan for the shelter without telling his wife. Aware that his mother developed paranoid schizophrenia at about his age, Curtis seeks help at a free clinic, fearing that he has inherited the illness. When Samantha discovers what he has been doing, the strain on their marriage grows, even as the family prepares for Hannah's cochlear implant surgery. Losing his job and his health insurance, alienating friends and becoming the subject of gossip in the close-knit community, Curtis is torn between his conviction that a devastating storm is coming and the possibility that the threat lies within his own mind.

The film explores mental illness, family responsibility and fear in a small working-class community, building tension through ambiguity rather than spectacle.

Take Shelter premiered at the Sundance Film Festival and won the Critics' Week Grand Prix at Cannes in 2011 before its release by Sony Pictures Classics. It received critical acclaim, with 92 percent approval on Rotten Tomatoes and a Metacritic score of 85, and won Saturn Awards for Nichols's writing and Shannon's performance.

overview: Federation trooper Johnny Rico is ordered to work with a group of new recruits on a satellite station on Mars, where giant bugs have decided to target their next attack.
title: Starship Troopers: Traitor of Mars
plot:
Starship Troopers: Traitor of Mars is a 2017 Japanese computer-animated military science fiction film directed by Shinji Aramaki and Masaru Matsumoto and written by Edward Neumeier, the screenwriter of the original 1997 film. A sequel to Starship Troopers: Invasion (2012) and the fifth installment of the franchise, it marks the return of Casper Van Dien as Johnny Rico, a role he played in the first and third films, and Dina Meyer as Dizzy Flores from the original film. The voice cast also includes DeRay Davis, Justin Doran and Luci Christian. It received a one-night theatrical release in the United States in August 2017 before its home-video release.

After the events of Invasion, Rico has been demoted to colonel and reassigned to a space station orbiting Mars, where he is ordered to train a group of new and largely incompetent recruits. On Mars, support for the war against the Arachnids is low; the colonists, untouched by the conflict, even talk of withdrawing from it, and their complacency leaves them unprepared for a full-scale bug invasion.

Unknown to almost everyone, Sky Marshal Amy Snapp has long known that a bug nest has been growing beneath the surface of Mars, and she plans to exploit the coming attack to win support for destroying the entire planet. She launches a massive fleet attack on the Arachnid Quarantine Zone as a distraction, intending to capture General Carl Jenkins and use a planet-destroying Q-bomb on Mars, then blame Jenkins for the catastrophe. When the bugs strike, Rico and his recruits survive the initial assault and reach the planet's surface. As Snapp seizes Jenkins and cuts communications between Earth and Mars, Jenkins manages to reach Carmen Ibanez telepathically and urge her to return to Mars. Rico and his troopers, rescued by a dropship, must fight their way through the bug hordes and expose Snapp's plan before the Federation destroys the planet and everyone on it.

The film retained the satirical tone of Neumeier's original screenplay, with mock propaganda broadcasts and pointed commentary on militarism and political manipulation. Critical response was limited and mostly negative: of the four reviews collected by Rotten Tomatoes, one was positive and three negative, although the return of Van Dien and Meyer to the franchise attracted attention from longtime fans of the 1997 film.

overview: As the Roman empire crumbles, young Romulus Augustus flees the city and embarks on a perilous voyage to Britain to track down a legion of supporters.
tagline: The end of an empire...the beginning of a legend.
title: The Last Legion
plot:
The Last Legion is a 2007 historical action film directed by Doug Lefler, starring Aaron Eckhart, Ben Kingsley, and Milla Jovovich.

The main themes of The Last Legion revolve around the struggle for power, loyalty, and redemption in a world torn apart by war and betrayal. Here's a brief overview:

Beginning: The story begins with the Roman Empire on the brink of collapse, as Emperor Marcus Aurelius (Ben Kingsley) lies dying. He entrusts his most trusted general, Lucius (Aaron Eckhart), to protect the young Roman prince, Titus (Eddie Ryan), and ensure the empire's survival.

Plot Development: As Lucius embarks on a perilous journey with Titus, they face numerous challenges, including treacherous landscapes, ferocious barbarian tribes, and internal power struggles within the Roman Empire. Along the way, Lucius must confront his own demons and make difficult choices to protect the prince and fulfill his duty.

Ending: Ultimately, Lucius and Titus reach the safety of the Roman fortress, where they are met with a shocking revelation about the true nature of the empire's collapse. The film concludes with Lucius reflecting on the sacrifices he has made and the lessons he has learned, as he looks out upon the ruins of the once-great empire.

Throughout the film, themes of loyalty, duty, and redemption are woven throughout the narrative. Lucius's character arc is particularly noteworthy, as he grapples with his own sense of purpose and identity in a world torn apart by war and betrayal. The Last Legion is an action-packed historical epic that explores the complexities of human nature in the face of overwhelming adversity.

overview: A freak tsunami traps shoppers at a coastal Australian supermarket inside the building ... along with a 12-foot great white shark.
tagline: A Tsunami Just Flipped The Foodchain.
title: Bait
plot:
Bait is a 2012 Australian thriller film directed by Kimble Rendall. The movie revolves around a group of people who are trapped inside a grocery store during a massive tsunami that hits their coastal town.

The main theme of the film is the struggle for survival and human nature in the face of catastrophic circumstances. As the characters try to find ways to survive and escape, they are forced to confront their own personal demons and the true meaning of humanity. The movie explores how people react when faced with extreme danger, revealing both the best and worst aspects of human behavior.

The film also delves into themes of claustrophobia, paranoia, and the breakdown of social norms in a desperate situation. As the characters become increasingly isolated and desperate, they start to turn on each other, leading to a descent into chaos and violence.

Furthermore, Bait raises questions about the nature of humanity and how people respond when faced with extreme adversity. The movie suggests that even in the most dire circumstances, there is always hope for human connection and redemption, but also highlights the darker aspects of human nature that can emerge in times of crisis.

Overall, Bait is a tense and thought-provoking thriller that explores the complexities of human behavior in the face of catastrophic events.

overview: A reclusive man conducts a series of interviews with human souls for a chance to be born.
title: Nine Days
plot:
Nine Days is a thought-provoking and introspective film that explores the complexities of human existence, love, and mortality. The movie delves into the theme of loneliness, as its protagonist, Will, navigates his mundane office job and struggles to form meaningful connections with others.

Through Will's character, the film sheds light on the universal human desire for connection and belonging. As he observes and interacts with various individuals in his life, including a young woman named Emma, Will begins to question the nature of relationships and the impermanence of human connections.

The movie also touches upon the theme of existentialism, as Will grapples with the meaninglessness of his own existence and the fleeting nature of life. His observations of others' lives serve as a poignant reminder that everyone is struggling with their own set of problems and insecurities.

Furthermore, Nine Days explores the idea of empathy and understanding, highlighting the importance of putting oneself in others' shoes to truly comprehend their experiences. Will's character undergoes significant development as he learns to see beyond his own perspective and develop a deeper appreciation for the complexities of human emotions.

Ultimately, the film presents a nuanced and introspective portrayal of the human condition, inviting viewers to reflect on their own relationships, desires, and mortality.

overview: In 2100, when humanity has abandoned the earth, a colony of extravagant creatures still thrives in the deepest abyss of the ocean.
tagline: Under pressure, everything gets complicated
title: Deep
plot:
Deep is a 2017 English-language animated science fiction musical adventure comedy film directed by Julio Soto Gurpide, who wrote the screenplay with José Tatay and Salva Rubio from a story by Soto Gurpide and Tatay. A Spanish production, it was inspired by the director's own experiences of deep-sea diving. The voice cast includes Justin Felbinger as Deep, Jess Harnell, Phil LaMarr, Dwight Schultz and Stephen Hughes.

In a post-apocalyptic future, an ecological catastrophe has flooded the Earth, and the inhabitants of the sea have suffered disasters of their own. The giant colossal squid Kraken has rescued a group of sea creatures and formed a safe colony with them in the depths of the Atlantic Ocean. Kraken's grandson, a young octopus named Deep, finds life in the colony boring and is fascinated by objects left behind by humans, often drawing his best friends, the anglerfish Evo and the shrimp Alice, into his adventures. But one of Deep's pranks goes wrong, causing a rockslide that seals off the colony and traps its inhabitants.

Kraken tells Deep that only Nathan, a wise white whale, can help them, and gives him the landmarks needed to find him. Deep, Evo and Alice set out on a journey through the drowned world. At the wreck of the Titanic they meet Norma, a vampire squid with a passion for musical theater, who forces them to listen to her performance before telling them that they must travel to Broadway to find Nathan, and who is reluctant to let them leave. Along the way, Deep is attacked by a moray eel named Maura, who reveals that she is lonely and joins the group, despite the misgivings of Evo and Alice, whom she had accidentally swallowed. At the submerged Brooklyn Bridge, the friends are surrounded by crabs led by the yeti crab Rico, who challenges them to a dance battle. Through these encounters in the ruins of human civilization, Deep learns about friendship, responsibility and courage as he races to find Nathan and save his family.

Deep received mixed to negative reviews, with a 33 percent approval rating on Rotten Tomatoes based on six reviews. Its setting, a drowned world littered with the ruins of human civilization such as the Titanic and the Brooklyn Bridge, and its musical numbers set it apart from other undersea animated adventures aimed at young audiences.

original_title: 劇場版ポケットモンスター ベストウイッシュ ビクティニと黒き英雄 ゼクロム
overview: The Kingdom of the People of the Earth once ruled over the land, but now all that remains is the Sword of the Earth. in the city of Eindoak. Satoshi, Iris, and Dent arrive in Eindoak during a harvest festival's Pokémon Tournament and meet the legendary Pokémon Victini who wishes to share its powers of victory to someone. Elsewhere in the city, a descendant of the People of the Earth named Dred Grangil has arrived who seeks to revive the kingdom's power with the Sword of the Earth, bringing them back into power over the land, and Satoshi and his friends must stop him before he destroys the land along with Victini.
tagline: A hero must choose: the power of ideals... or the courage of truth?
title: Pokémon the Movie: White - Victini and Zekrom
plot:
Pokémon the Movie: White - Victini and Zekrom is an animated adventure film that delves into the eternal struggle between good and evil, as embodied by two powerful characters. The movie's narrative revolves around the mythical Pokémon Victini, a creature with the power to determine its own destiny.

At its core, the film explores the theme of self-discovery and the importance of understanding one's true nature. The protagonist, Diantha, is on a quest to become the Champion of the Unova region, but her journey takes an unexpected turn when she encounters Victini. As Diantha learns more about Victini's powers and its connection to Zekrom, a powerful Pokémon with the ability to control electricity, she begins to question her own identity and purpose.

The movie also touches on the theme of friendship and loyalty, as Diantha forms strong bonds with her friends and allies, including Iris and Cilan. Together, they embark on a perilous journey to uncover the secrets of Victini and Zekrom, ultimately leading them to confront the dark forces threatening the region.

Furthermore, Pokémon the Movie: White - Victini and Zekrom explores the idea of balance and harmony in nature. The film highlights the delicate relationship between light and darkness, as embodied by the opposing forces of Zekrom and Reshiram (the counterpart to Zekrom). This dichotomy serves as a metaphor for the eternal struggle between good and evil, emphasizing the importance of finding equilibrium within oneself and the world.

Throughout the movie, the characters grapple with complex moral dilemmas, making difficult choices that test their resolve and character. Ultimately, the film presents a hopeful message about the power of friendship, determination, and self-discovery in overcoming adversity and achieving one's goals.

original_title: Scooby-Doo! and Kiss: Rock and Roll Mystery
overview: Get ready to Rock! Scooby-Doo and the Mystery Inc. Gang team up with the one and only KISS in this all-new, out-of-this-world adventure! We join the Gang at Kiss World – the all-things-Kiss theme park, as they investigate a series of strange hauntings. With help from Kiss, they discover that the Crimson Witch has returned to summon The Destroyer from the alternate dimension of Kissteria! The evil duos ghastly plan, to destroy the earth! Can the Gang's cunning and Kiss's power of rock save the day?!
title: Scooby-Doo! and Kiss: Rock and Roll Mystery
plot:
Scooby-Doo! and Kiss: Rock and Roll Mystery is a 2015 animated film that combines the classic mystery-solving adventures of Scooby-Doo with the iconic rock band KISS.

The main themes of this movie revolve around friendship, teamwork, and embracing one's true identity. The story follows Shaggy and Scooby as they team up with the members of KISS - Paul Stanley, Gene Simmons, Eric Singer, and Tommy Thayer - to solve a mystery in the town of New York City.

Throughout the film, the characters learn valuable lessons about working together, trusting each other's unique skills and strengths. Shaggy and Scooby bring their signature laid-back attitude and detective skills, while KISS provides the band's energetic stage presence and musical talents.

The movie also explores themes of identity and self-expression. As the mystery unfolds, the characters discover that they are not just who they seem to be on the surface but have hidden depths and secrets. This is particularly evident in Gene Simmons' character, who struggles with his own identity as a rock star and a father figure.

Ultimately, the film's climax features an energetic musical performance by KISS, which serves as a metaphor for embracing one's true self and finding acceptance within oneself and others. The movie ends on a high note, with the characters coming together to solve the mystery and celebrate their newfound friendships and identities.

Overall, Scooby-Doo! and Kiss: Rock and Roll Mystery is a fun, music-filled adventure that celebrates the power of friendship, teamwork, and self-expression.

overview: A woman, who gets released from prison and reunites with her sister, discovers she is in an online relationship with a man who may be "catfishing" her.
tagline: She shows up. Everything blows up.
title: Nobody's Fool
plot:
Nobody's Fool is a 2018 American romantic comedy film written and directed by Tyler Perry, his first R-rated comedy and his first film not distributed by Lionsgate. It stars Tika Sumpter as Danica, Tiffany Haddish as her recently paroled sister Tanya, Omari Hardwick as Frank, Mehcad Brooks as Charlie, Amber Riley as Danica's friend Kalli and Whoopi Goldberg as the sisters' mother, Lola. It was the first production of Paramount Players.

Danica, a successful marketing executive, has been in an online relationship for a year with a man called Charlie, whom she has never met in person. At her mother's insistence, she picks up her sister Tanya from prison and lets her stay in her apartment. Tanya learns that Danica's ex-fiancé, Bailey, left her for another woman and quickly concludes that "Charlie" is catfishing her. Frank, the owner of the coffee shop next to Danica's office, who is in love with Danica, gives Tanya a job. Danica is put off when she learns that Frank is a recovering alcoholic who spent seven years in prison. Using Frank's email, Tanya contacts the reality show Catfish, whose crew shows up just as Charlie finally agrees to a video call, revealing that the man behind the account is someone else entirely, Lawrence. Danica lashes out at Tanya, who moves to their mother's house, and Danica is suspended from work after a disastrous presentation.

The sisters and Kalli track down Lawrence, played by Chris Rock, who pretends to use a wheelchair, and Tanya sets his Jheri curl on fire. Frank comforts Danica, and the two sleep together, but she wounds him by telling Kalli, unaware that he can hear, that his criminal past makes him unattractive. Realizing she does care for him, she apologizes, and they begin dating. Three months later, Danica learns that the real Charlie exists and that his account was hacked by Lawrence, his former college coach. Seeing Danica leave work with Charlie, Frank breaks up with her. After a disappointing date with Charlie, Danica wins Frank back by singing "On Bended Knee" in the rain outside his house, a gesture he once described making himself. In an end tag, Tanya crashes Bailey's wedding as payback.

Paramount Pictures released the film in the United States on November 2, 2018. It received negative reviews, with 26% approval on Rotten Tomatoes and a Metacritic score of 39, although Haddish and Goldberg drew praise. Grossing about $33.5 million worldwide, it was one of Perry's lowest-grossing films.

overview: A world-weary college professor is given a life-changing diagnosis and decides to throw all pretense and conventions to the wind and live his life as boldly and freely as possible with a biting sense of humor, a reckless streak and a touch of madness.
title: The Professor
plot:
The Professor is a 2018 American satirical science fiction film written and directed by Michael Paul Stephenson. 

The movie revolves around a young man, who after being diagnosed with a rare brain disorder that prevents him from learning new information, sets out to become the world's smartest person. He achieves this through an unconventional method of memorizing everything he reads, but his newfound intelligence comes at a great cost.

At its core, The Professor explores themes of obsession, identity, and the consequences of playing god with one's own mind. The main character's relentless pursuit of knowledge and power raises questions about the nature of intelligence, creativity, and what it means to be human. As he delves deeper into his research, he becomes increasingly isolated from the world around him, highlighting the dangers of unchecked ambition.

The film also touches on the idea of the "tortured genius" trope, where a brilliant mind is often accompanied by mental health issues, social awkwardness, and a general sense of disconnection. The Professor's character embodies these traits, making for a complex and thought-provoking portrayal of a mind both extraordinary and troubled.

Ultimately, The Professor presents a cautionary tale about the risks of exploiting one's intelligence for personal gain, and the importance of maintaining balance in life to avoid losing oneself in the process.

original_title: ワンピース エピソード・オブ・メリー ～もうひとりの仲間の物語～
overview: On a test-run of the Mini Merry, Usopp tells Brook the story of the Going Merry, a ship that served the crew well. However, to the Straw Hats, the Going Merry was not just a ship: It was a priceless, irreplaceable friend.  *Scenes have been recreated with brand-new animation.
title: One Piece Episode of Merry: The Tale of One More Friend
plot:
One Piece Episode of Merry: The Tale of One More Friend is an animated special that focuses on the character of Portgas D. Ace, also known as "Blackbeard" in his later years. 

The main theme of this episode revolves around the idea of friendship and the bonds between characters. It delves into the complex relationship between Blackbeard and his crew members, particularly his brother, Ace, who is a central figure in the story.

Through the narrative, it explores the depth of their connection, showcasing how they support each other despite being on opposite sides of the pirate world's conflicts. The episode highlights the strong sense of camaraderie that exists within Blackbeard's crew and the impact this has on his character development.

Furthermore, the special touches upon themes of sacrifice, loyalty, and redemption, as seen in Ace's unwavering dedication to those he cares about, even when it puts him at odds with his own ambitions.

overview: Artie and Diane agree to look after their three grandkids when their type-A helicopter parents need to leave town for work. Problems arise when the kids' 21st-century behavior collides with Artie and Diane's old-school methods.
tagline: Here come the grandparents.  There go the rules.
title: Parental Guidance
plot:
Parental Guidance is a 2012 American comedy film directed by Jay Roach. The movie revolves around two grandparents, Art and Daphne, who are tasked with taking care of their three grandchildren for a week while their parents are away.

The main theme of Parental Guidance is the challenges and joys of intergenerational relationships, particularly between grandparents and their grandchildren. As the story unfolds, we see how the grandparents navigate their way through modern parenting, technology, and societal changes, often leading to humorous misunderstandings and heartwarming moments.

Throughout the film, the characters grapple with issues of identity, responsibility, and letting go. Art and Daphne must confront their own biases and limitations as they try to connect with their grandchildren in a world that is vastly different from their own experiences. Meanwhile, the children are forced to reevaluate their relationship with their grandparents and consider the value of their wisdom and guidance.

Ultimately, Parental Guidance is a story about the power of love, acceptance, and understanding across generations. It explores the complexities of family dynamics and the importance of finding common ground in a rapidly changing world.

original_title: Tinker Bell and the Great Fairy Rescue
overview: During a summer stay on the mainland, Tinker Bell is accidentally discovered while investigating a little girl's fairy house. As the other fairies, led by the brash Vidia, launch a daring rescue in the middle of a fierce storm, Tink develops a special bond with the lonely, little girl.
title: Tinker Bell and the Great Fairy Rescue
plot:
Tinker Bell and the Great Fairy Rescue is a 2010 animated adventure film produced by DisneyToon Studios, directed by Kevan Brighting, and written by Ron Clements. The movie follows the adventures of Tinker Bell, a mischievous fairy who lives in Pixie Hollow.

The story begins with Tinker Bell (voiced by Mae Whitman) feeling unappreciated and overlooked by her fellow fairies, particularly the other pixie girls. She is constantly compared to the more popular and skilled fairies, such as Rosetta (voiced by Lucy Liu), Silvermist (voiced by Raven-Symoné), Iridessa (voiced by Vanessa Hudgens), Fawn (voiced by Amanda Seyfried), and Periwinkle (voiced by Matt Lucas). Tinker Bell's frustration grows when she is tasked with fixing a broken fairy door, which only adds to her feelings of inadequacy.

Meanwhile, the evil pixie, Zarina (voiced by Lucy Liu), has stolen the magical dust that gives fairies their powers. Without this dust, the fairies begin to lose their abilities and fade away. The Great Fairy, Queen Clarion (voiced by Jodi Benson), calls upon Tinker Bell to embark on a quest to retrieve the stolen dust.

Tinker Bell sets out on her journey, accompanied by her friend, Silvermist, and together they meet new friends, including Vidia (voiced by Lucy Liu) and Periwinkle. Along the way, they encounter various obstacles, such as treacherous terrain, fierce creatures, and even a rival fairy named Zarina.

As Tinker Bell navigates through the challenges, she learns valuable lessons about friendship, teamwork, and believing in herself. She also discovers that her unique skills and talents are essential to the quest's success. With the help of her friends, Tinker Bell is able to outsmart Zarina and retrieve the stolen dust.

In the end, Tinker Bell returns to Pixie Hollow as a hero, celebrated by her fellow fairies for her bravery and determination. The movie concludes with Tinker Bell feeling proud of herself and her abilities, and the other fairies finally acknowledging her worth.

Throughout the film, the animation is vibrant and colorful, bringing the world of Pixie Hollow to life. The characters are well-developed and relatable, making it easy for audiences to become invested in their stories. The movie's themes of self-discovery, friendship, and perseverance make it a heartwarming and entertaining experience for viewers of all ages.

Overall, Tinker Bell and the Great Fairy Rescue is a delightful animated adventure that showcases the magic and wonder of Pixie Hollow. With its engaging storyline, lovable characters, and stunning animation, this movie is sure to captivate audiences and leave them feeling inspired and uplifted.

overview: A mother travels to Patagonia with her autistic son with the hope that a ranger and a pod of wild orcas can help him find an emotional connection.
tagline: A place to dream
title: The Lighthouse of the Orcas
plot:
Released in Spanish as El faro de las orcas, The Lighthouse of the Orcas is a Spanish-Argentine drama from 2016 directed by Gerardo Olivares, who wrote the screenplay with Lucía Puenzo and Shallua Sehk from the book Agustín corazón abierto by Roberto Bubas, the real Patagonian wildlife ranger on whom its hero is based. Maribel Verdú stars as Lola, with Joaquín Furriel as Beto Bubas, Joaquín Rapalini as Lola's autistic son Tristán, Ana Celentano as Marcela, Osvaldo Santoro, Ciro Miró and Zoe Hochbaum; Bubas himself makes a brief appearance. Together with Olivares's earlier Entrelobos and Brothers of the Wind, the film completes a trilogy about the bond between people and animals.

Beto is a ranger who lives in a small cottage beside a lighthouse on the windswept coast of the Valdés Peninsula in Argentina, where orcas come to hunt the sea lions crowding the beaches. He swims and plays with the animals, calling them with a harmonica or by slapping the water, and videos of these encounters reach viewers in Spain. One of them is Tristán, who rarely responds to the world around him but reacts to the footage. Desperate to help him, Lola travels with the boy all the way to Patagonia in the hope that Beto and the orcas can reach him.

Beto turns them away at first but relents and lets them stay with him. Gradually he introduces Tristán to the landscape, the sea lions and the whales, takes him riding on his horse and rows him out in a small boat, where the orcas approach to be touched. The experience is not always gentle: watching the orcas seize sea lions on the shore disturbs the boy, and Lola protests that it is a cruel thing to show them. Tristán remains autistic, but he begins to show small new abilities, walking to the beach, riding the horse alone and calling the orcas himself. Meanwhile, Beto and Lola develop a deep respect and love for each other, until legal trouble with Tristán's father forces Lola to return to Spain, and the story ends on a bittersweet note.

Shot in 2016 in Patagonia and on Fuerteventura, with animatronics and digital effects used for the scenes with the orcas, the film opened in Spain on 16 December 2016 and in Argentina in April 2017, where it drew about 57,000 viewers; Netflix later acquired worldwide rights. El País admired its convincing documentary-like eye and well-orchestrated ending but found the romance clichéd, while other reviewers praised its photography and moving story.

overview: A nightmarish evening unfolds for David, a former New York Times journalist, when he and his strange new neighbor Robert, accidentally hit a girl on her bike. Buzzed and disoriented, David lets Robert convince him to flee the scene and leave the girl for dead, in order to protect his career. Robert shows no remorse, and in the name of friendship he does unspeakable things to protect the secret. Now that the police are full-on hunting for the hit-and-run killer, things begin to spiral out of control when David’s local newspaper sends him to cover the story where he meets the deceased girl’s sister Vanessa. Despite the circumstances, and her deep desire to find her sister’s killer, the two immediately have a romantic connection, which surprises and haunts David, while pushing Robert to take brutal steps to keep his new friend to himself.
tagline: Fear what's next door.
title: The Good Neighbor
plot:
The Good Neighbor is a 2022 mystery crime thriller film directed by Stephan Rick, who wrote the screenplay with Ross Partridge, a remake of Rick's 2011 German film of the same name. Luke Kleintank stars as David Stevens, an American journalist, with Jonathan Rhys Meyers as his neighbor, Robert, Eloise Smyth and Bruce Davison. An American-Latvian co-production set and filmed in and around Riga, it received a limited theatrical release in June 2022 before being released on demand.

After a painful breakup, David arrives in Riga, Latvia, to begin a new job at the European Press Network. His editor, Grant, lets him stay in a house on the outskirts of the city while an apartment is prepared, and warns him that, as a newcomer, he will be given the assignments no one else wants. At the office, Grant tries to set him up with a colleague, Alice, but David is more interested in enjoying the city's nightlife as a single man. When he has trouble starting the old car Grant has left him, he is helped by his neighbor, Robert, a friendly but eccentric home-care nurse who tells him that his mother was British.

Lonely one evening, David invites Robert out for drinks. At a club, David flirts with Janine, a young woman from London, while Robert watches with disapproval. Driving home drunk, the two men are involved in a hit-and-run accident on a dark road, in which a cyclist is struck, and Robert persuades David not to report it. Consumed by guilt, David follows the case as the police investigation progresses, but he soon realizes that his new friend is far more dangerous than he appeared. Robert's behavior becomes increasingly possessive and controlling, and he uses their shared secret to bind David to him, while David's attempts to build a relationship and make amends threaten to expose them both. As Robert's obsession escalates into violence, David must find a way to free himself from his neighbor's grip before he loses everything.

The Good Neighbor received mixed reviews. Variety found it polished and well acted enough to be reasonably entertaining for its running time, but not original, tense or plausible enough to avoid a sense of letdown. Luke Y. Thompson of The A.V. Club graded it a C+, while other reviewers praised its unusual Riga setting and its suspense.

original_title: ワンピース the movie オマツリ男爵と秘密の島
overview: The Straw Hats visit a recreational island, run by Baron Omatsuri, who asks them to complete a series of ordeals if they wish to stay on the island. Luffy accepts and the Straw Hats work together to complete them, but as the island's mysteries unfold, their lives and friendships are put to the test. It's up to Luffy to stop the Baron's plot and keep his crew together.
title: One Piece: Baron Omatsuri and the Secret Island
plot:
One Piece: Baron Omatsuri and the Secret Island is a 2005 Japanese animated adventure film based on the popular manga and anime series "One Piece" created by Eiichiro Oda. The movie follows Monkey D. Luffy, a young pirate with rubber powers, and his crew as they search for the legendary treasure known as "One Piece."

The main themes of One Piece: Baron Omatsuri and the Secret Island include:

1. Friendship and camaraderie: The film highlights the strong bonds between Luffy and his crew members, particularly Roronoa Zoro, Usopp, and Sanji. Their relationships are put to the test as they face various challenges on the island.
2. Power and corruption: Baron Omatsuri, a wealthy and influential figure, seeks to exploit the island's resources for personal gain. This theme serves as a warning about the dangers of unchecked power and greed.
3. Identity and self-discovery: Luffy struggles with his own identity and purpose, particularly after discovering that he is the son of the legendary pirate Gol D. Roger. The film explores themes of self-discovery and finding one's place in the world.
4. Loyalty and sacrifice: Throughout the movie, characters are forced to make difficult choices between loyalty to their friends and personal interests. This theme emphasizes the importance of putting others before oneself.

The story begins with Luffy and his crew arriving on a mysterious island, where they meet Baron Omatsuri and his daughter, Boa Hancock. As they delve deeper into the island's secrets, they uncover a sinister plot by Omatsuri to exploit the island's resources for personal gain. The film builds towards an action-packed climax as Luffy and his crew face off against Omatsuri's henchmen.

Ultimately, the movie concludes with Luffy and his friends emerging victorious, but not without sacrifices made along the way. The ending sets the stage for future adventures in the One Piece universe, as Luffy continues to search for the legendary treasure known as "One Piece."

Overall, One Piece: Baron Omatsuri and the Secret Island is a thrilling adventure film that explores themes of friendship, power, identity, and loyalty, making it an exciting addition to the One Piece franchise.

overview: A man confesses to an FBI agent his family's story of how his religious fanatic father's visions lead to a series of murders to destroy supposed 'demons'.
tagline: No Soul Is Safe.
title: Frailty
plot:
Frailty is a psychological horror-thriller film directed by Bill Paxton, released in 2001 by Cinerenta Medienbeteiligungs KG. The movie follows the story of Adam Bell (played by Bill Paxton), a struggling writer who claims to have been visited by God and has received a series of instructions that he must follow.

The main themes of Frailty include:

1. **Faith vs. Sanity**: The film explores the blurred lines between faith and madness, as Adam's actions become increasingly erratic and violent. His wife, Meri (played by Carrie-Anne Moss), tries to intervene, but Adam is convinced that he is doing God's work.
2. **The Nature of Evil**: Frailty raises questions about the existence of evil and whether it can be justified or excused. Adam's actions become more and more violent as he follows his instructions from God, leading to a confrontation with his own morality.
3. **Isolation and Loneliness**: The film highlights the isolation and loneliness that can come with having a unique perspective on the world. Adam is a outsider among his family and friends, who struggle to understand his actions and motivations.
4. **The Power of Perception**: Frailty shows how perception can be distorted by one's own beliefs and biases. Adam's interpretation of God's instructions leads him down a dark path, while Meri's more rational perspective tries to bring him back from the brink.

Overall, Frailty is a thought-provoking film that explores complex themes and moral ambiguities, leaving the audience questioning what it means to be good or evil.

overview: Based on true events about the foot soldiers of the early feminist movement who were forced underground to evade the State.
tagline: Mothers. Daughters. Rebels.
title: Suffragette
plot:
Suffragette is a 2015 British historical drama about the struggle for women's suffrage in the United Kingdom, directed by Sarah Gavron and written by Abi Morgan. It stars Carey Mulligan as Maud Watts, a young laundry worker, Helena Bonham Carter as Edith Ellyn, Anne-Marie Duff as Violet Miller, Ben Whishaw as Maud's husband Sonny, Brendan Gleeson as Inspector Steed, Natalie Press as Emily Davison and Meryl Streep as Emmeline Pankhurst. It was the first feature film to be shot inside the Houses of Parliament.

In London in 1912, Maud, 24, has worked in a laundry since childhood. While delivering a package, she is caught up in a suffragette protest that includes her coworker Violet. When Violet is too badly beaten by her husband to testify before a parliamentary committee, Maud speaks in her place about the lives of working women. The government nonetheless refuses to extend the vote, and when Maud joins the protests she is arrested and jailed, where she meets Emily Davison, a close ally of Emmeline Pankhurst.

Her growing involvement costs Maud dearly. Facing hostility from neighbors and coworkers, she attends a secret rally where Pankhurst speaks, and her husband throws her out of their home and keeps their young son George from her. Dismissed from the laundry after her picture is published, she lashes out at the supervisor who had abused her and other girls for years. Inspector Steed tries to recruit her as an informer, but she refuses, and after learning that Sonny has given George up for adoption, she becomes more radical, joining the movement's campaign of bombings and sabotage, enduring prison and force-feeding during a hunger strike, and finally accompanying Emily to the Derby, where the suffragettes seek to draw the attention of the King.

The film focuses on the working-class women of the movement, showing the personal sacrifices behind the fight for political rights.

Suffragette premiered at the Telluride Film Festival in September 2015, opened the BFI London Film Festival on 7 October, and was released in the United Kingdom on 12 October 2015. It grossed 38 million dollars on a 14 million dollar budget and received generally favorable reviews, with 73 percent approval on Rotten Tomatoes and a Metacritic score of 64.

overview: Just as Tessa's life begins to become unglued, nothing is what she thought it would be. Not her friends nor her family. The only person that she should be able to rely on is Hardin, who is furious when he discovers the massive secret that she's been keeping.
