When his editor says Lucía probably believes he is dead, Lorenzo guesses where she has gone and travels to the island, where the three finally face what connects them.

Sogecine produced the film, shooting in Fuerteventura and Madrid. The lighthouse at Cap de Barbaria on Formentera became a central image. Critics were generally favorable: Rotten Tomatoes' consensus said that beneath its gratuitous nudity lies a complex and visually striking film.

original_title: Batman and Superman: Battle of the Super Sons
overview: After discovering he has powers, 11-year-old Jonathan Kent and assassin-turned-Boy-Wonder Damian Wayne must join forces to rescue their fathers (Superman & Batman) and save the planet from the malevolent alien force known as Starro.
title: Batman and Superman: Battle of the Super Sons
plot:
Batman and Superman: Battle of the Super Sons is a 2022 American animated superhero film released direct to video by Warner Bros. Animation. Based on the comic books of the same name, it is the 50th DC Universe Animated Original Movie and the first DC animated feature made entirely in CGI. Matt Peters directed from a screenplay by Jeremy Adams. Jack Dylan Grazer voices Jonathan Kent and Jack Griffo voices Damian Wayne, with Troy Baker as Batman, Travis Willingham as Superman and Laura Bailey as Lois Lane.

The prologue shows Krypton about to explode. Jor-El and Lara send their infant son Kal-El to Earth, unaware that Starro, an alien parasite that escaped from Jor-El's lab, has stowed away on the ship. Starro falls off during the journey. Kal-El grows up in Kansas as Clark Kent, becomes Superman and marries Lois Lane, and they have a son, Jon. Years later, Jon resents his father's constant absences without knowing that Clark is Superman. After a mysterious impact hits the Justice League Watchtower, Green Arrow is attacked aboard the station by a creature.

When Jon develops heat vision on his birthday, Clark tells him the truth and takes him to Gotham City to ask Batman for advice. There Jon meets Batman's arrogant son, Damian Wayne, who is Robin. Batman and Superman go up to the silent Watchtower, where a possessed Martian Manhunter infects them with Starro spores. Back in the Batcave, Damian destroys the spore meant for him and learns that Starro now controls the Justice League and the Teen Titans and is after Jon next.

Damian rescues Jon, and Jon's heat vision frees Lois. At the Fortress of Solitude, a hologram of Jor-El tells them that the spores answer to a central Starro on the Watchtower. The boys fly there in Kal-El's old ship and fight their possessed heroes, and Jon's invulnerability appears as he shields Damian from an arrow. When heat alone fails, they evacuate the heroes and send the station down to burn up on re-entry. This kills the spores, and the freed Superman catches the falling Watchtower. The two fathers and their sons then defeat Starro on the ground, and the boys call themselves the Super-Sons.

The film premiered at New York Comic Con on October 7, 2022, and came out on home video on October 18. Reviews were positive, and IGN said it was fairly predictable but captured the fun of the young heroes' friendship.

overview: At the height of the Cold War, a Soviet spacecraft crash lands after a mission gone awry, leaving the commander as its only survivor. After a renowned Russian psychologist is brought in to evaluate the commander’s mental state, it becomes clear that something dangerous may have come back to Earth with him…
tagline: The only survivor did not come back alone
title: Sputnik
plot:
Sputnik (Russian: Спутник) is a 2020 Russian science fiction horror film directed by Egor Abramenko in his feature debut. Oksana Akinshina stars as Tatyana Klimova, a young doctor recruited by the Soviet military to examine a cosmonaut who has returned from a space accident with a dangerous organism living inside him, with Pyotr Fyodorov as the cosmonaut, Konstantin Veshnyakov, and Fyodor Bondarchuk as Colonel Semiradov. It was due to premiere at the Tribeca Film Festival in April 2020, but the festival was postponed due to the COVID-19 pandemic, and the film was released on video on demand in Russia that month and internationally by IFC Midnight in August.

In 1983, two Soviet cosmonauts hear something moving outside their spacecraft, which then crashes in Kazakhstan. The sole survivor, Veshnyakov, is taken to a secret military research facility run by Semiradov, but he remembers nothing of the crash. When the facility's scientist, Yan Rigel, fails to cure his amnesia, Semiradov recruits Klimova, a controversial psychiatrist facing disciplinary action for her unorthodox methods. Klimova concludes that Veshnyakov is suffering from post-traumatic stress, but Semiradov then shows her the facility's secret: each night, an alien creature emerges from the cosmonaut's mouth while he sleeps.

The creature is symbiotically bonded to Veshnyakov, keeping him alive, and any attempt to separate them would kill both. Klimova agrees to find a way to separate them permanently, to Rigel's resentment. To study how the cosmonaut's hormones respond to stress, she provokes him with accusations about abandoning his son and causing his colleague's death, then apologizes, learning that he had only discovered he had a son shortly before his mission. Spending time with the creature at night, Klimova discovers its true nature and how it feeds, and uncovers Semiradov's real intentions: the military hopes to use the organism as a weapon, and has been feeding it prisoners. As she becomes closer to Veshnyakov, Klimova must decide how far she will go to protect him and stop the creature from being exploited, even at a terrible cost.

Sputnik received generally positive reviews, with critics praising its atmosphere, its Cold War setting, Akinshina's commanding performance and its creature design, comparing it favorably to Alien and other classic science-fiction horror films.

overview: State-of-the-art security system creator, Jack Stanfield has cemented his reputation as a man who's thought of everything. But when a criminal finds a way into Jack's personal life, everything Jack holds dear is suddenly at stake.
tagline: Nothing Is More Dangerous Than A Man With Everything To Lose.
title: Firewall
plot:
Firewall is a 2006 American action thriller film directed by Richard Loncraine and starring Harrison Ford, Virginia Madsen, and Karl Urban.

The movie begins with Jack Stanfield (Harrison Ford), a former FBI agent who has retired to a quiet life in the suburbs. He works as an insurance investigator for a company called First National Insurance Company, where he is responsible for investigating claims related to arson and other forms of property damage.

One day, Jack's wife, Kate (Virginia Madsen), is kidnapped by a group of professional thieves who are led by Robert 'The Ghost' Devereaux (Ben Kingsley). The kidnappers demand that First National Insurance Company pay $10 million in exchange for Kate's safe return. They also threaten to kill her if their demands are not met.

As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that Jack is being forced back into action by his former colleagues at the FBI, who believe that he has valuable skills and knowledge that can help them track down The Ghost and his team. However, Jack is reluctant to get involved, as he wants to protect his family and live a peaceful life.

Despite his initial reluctance, Jack agrees to work with the FBI to track down The Ghost and rescue Kate. He uses his expertise to analyze clues and follow leads, which ultimately lead him to a warehouse where The Ghost's team is hiding.

As Jack gets closer to rescuing Kate, he realizes that The Ghost has set a trap for him. The Ghost reveals that he has been playing a cat-and-mouse game with Jack all along, using his knowledge of Jack's past and his skills as an investigator to manipulate him into doing his bidding.

In the end, Jack is able to outsmart The Ghost and rescue Kate. However, not before realizing that The Ghost was actually working for a larger organization that had been manipulating events from behind the scenes. The movie ends with Jack reflecting on the experience and realizing that he has been given a second chance to make things right.

Throughout the movie, Harrison Ford delivers a strong performance as the protagonist, bringing depth and nuance to the character of Jack Stanfield. The supporting cast, including Virginia Madsen and Karl Urban, also deliver solid performances that add to the tension and suspense of the film.

Overall, Firewall is an action-packed thriller that keeps viewers on the edge of their seats from start to finish. With its strong performances, clever plot twists, and tense action sequences, it's a must-see for fans of the genre.

overview: Famous and wealthy funnyman George Simmons doesn't give much thought to how he treats people until a doctor delivers stunning health news, forcing George to reevaluate his priorities with a little help from aspiring stand-up comic Ira.
tagline: George Simmons was prepared to die, but then a funny thing happened.
title: Funny People
plot:
Funny People (2009) is a comedy-drama film directed by Judd Apatow, starring Adam Sandler and Seth Rogen. The movie follows the life of George Simmons (played by Adam Sandler), a successful comedian who announces that he has terminal cancer.

The main themes of Funny People include:

1. Mortality and the meaning of life: As George's health deteriorates, he is forced to confront his own mortality and re-evaluate his priorities in life. The film explores the idea that we all have limited time on this earth, and it's up to us to make the most of it.

2. Friendship and relationships: The movie highlights the importance of genuine friendships and relationships in our lives. George's friendship with Ira Wright (played by Seth Rogen) is a central theme, as they navigate their way through life's ups and downs together.

3. Identity and purpose: As George struggles to come to terms with his own mortality, he begins to question the purpose of his life and career. The film explores the idea that our sense of identity and purpose can be shaken by unexpected events, and it's up to us to find new meaning in life.

4. Comedic legacy: The movie also touches on the theme of comedic legacy, as George grapples with the idea of leaving a lasting impact on the world through his comedy. This theme is particularly relevant for Adam Sandler, who has built a career on making people laugh.

5. Existentialism and the search for meaning: Throughout the film, George's existential crisis serves as a catalyst for exploring deeper questions about the human condition. The movie raises questions about the nature of existence, the meaning of life, and our place in the world.

Overall, Funny People is a thought-provoking comedy-drama that explores complex themes through the lens of humor and satire.

overview: A family of sadistic butchers lives deep inside the backcountry. From the dead of winter to the dog days of summer, anyone who crosses their path is dead meat.
tagline: Rest in pieces
title: Butchers
plot:
Butchers is a 2020 Canadian slasher film directed by Adrian Langley, who co-wrote it with Daniel Weissenberger. Simon Phillips and Michael Swatton star as Owen and Oswald Watson, two sadistic brothers living in the backcountry, with Julie Mainville, Anne-Carolyne Binette, James Hicks, Frederik Storm and Samantha De Benedet. Filmed in Ontario, it was released in select theaters and on demand in January 2021. The film features the 1919 recording of "A Good Man Is Hard to Find" by Marion Harris.

Divided into three chapters, titled "The Beginning of the End," "The Middle of Nowhere" and "The End Is Here," the film opens in the dead of winter, as Owen and Oswald bury their mother on the grounds of their remote home in rural North Dakota. As they finish, they notice that a car carrying a young couple, Steven and Celeste, has broken down on the nearby country road. Owen's chillingly casual reaction makes it clear that the brothers view the stranded travelers as a stroke of luck, and the couple fall into their hands.

The story then jumps forward to the height of summer. The Watsons have kept Celeste captive, abusing her and making her pregnant, and she has been reduced to a state of helpless despair. On the same lonely road, another car breaks down, carrying four friends: Jenna, Taylor, Mike and Chris. With no phone signal and no help in sight, they split up to look for assistance, and soon find their way to the Watson property, where the brothers run a makeshift slaughterhouse in which anyone who crosses their path is treated as meat. Captured and terrorized, the young people must fight to survive the brothers' twisted games, while Celeste's presence raises the question of whether anyone can escape the farm alive.

Butchers received mixed reviews. Martin Unsworth of Starburst gave it three stars out of five, calling it an unoriginal but fun watch for viewers with strong stomachs, and Chris Cummings of Nerdly rated it two and a half stars, finding it enjoyable if not groundbreaking. Phuong Le of The Guardian gave it two stars, describing it as relying on worn-out horror tropes. Critics widely praised Phillips and Swatton's menacing performances as the brothers, while finding the victims thinly written.

overview: After one short date, a brilliant crossword constructor decides that a CNN cameraman is her true love. Because the cameraman's job takes him hither and yon, she crisscrosses the country, turning up at media events as she tries to convince him they are perfect for each other.
tagline: A Comedy That Clings
title: All About Steve
plot:
All About Steve is a 2009 American romantic comedy film directed by Phil Traill and written by Kim Barker. Sandra Bullock stars as Mary Horowitz, an eccentric crossword constructor, with Bradley Cooper as Steve Miller, the object of her obsession, Thomas Haden Church as a self-serving television reporter, Ken Jeong and DJ Qualls. Bullock also produced the film, which was released by 20th Century Fox on 4 September 2009.

Mary, a crossword puzzle writer for the Sacramento Herald, is socially awkward, highly intelligent and talkative, and considers her pet hamster her only true friend. When her parents set her up on a blind date, she is delighted to find that her date is Steve, a handsome and charming cameraman for the news network CCN. Their first attempt at intimacy fails, partly because Mary cannot stop talking about vocabulary, and Steve fakes a call about an out-of-town assignment. Trying to get her out of his truck, he politely tells her that he wishes she could come along. Mary takes him at his word and decides to follow him.

Her infatuation costs her her job when she publishes a crossword titled "All About Steve." Unemployed, Mary pursues Steve across the country as he covers breaking news stories, encouraged by his colleague, the ambitious reporter Hartman Hughes, who sees her as a useful source of encyclopedic knowledge in his bid to become an anchor. On the road, Mary annoys her fellow bus passengers so much that the driver leaves her behind, and she hitchhikes with a trucker before joining a pair of protesters, Elizabeth and Howard, who become her friends. When Mary ends up at the scene of a mine collapse where a group of deaf children has become trapped, her pursuit of Steve takes an unexpected turn, and she discovers that she must accept herself and the people who appreciate her for who she is.

All About Steve was panned by critics, receiving a 7 percent approval rating on Rotten Tomatoes and a Metacritic score of 17, with the consensus describing it as an oddly creepy and sour film whose heroine is more likely to be pitied than rooted for. Although it was a modest commercial success, it won two Golden Raspberry Awards, for Worst Actress and Worst Screen Couple for Bullock and Cooper. Bullock collected her Razzie in person the night before she won the Academy Award for Best Actress for The Blind Side.

overview: Rick and Evelyn O’Connell, along with their 8-year-old son Alex, discover the key to the legendary Scorpion King’s might: the fabled Bracelet of Anubis. Unfortunately, a newly resurrected Imhotep has designs on the bracelet as well, and isn’t above kidnapping its new bearer, Alex, to gain control of Anubis’s otherworldly army.
tagline: The most powerful force on earth is about to be unleashed by the two people who should know better.
title: The Mummy Returns
plot:
The Mummy Returns is a 2001 American action-adventure horror film directed by Stephen Sommers and produced by Sean Daniel. The movie serves as a sequel to the 1999 film The Mummy.

Beginning:
The film starts with Rick O'Connell (Brendan Fraser), Evelyn Carnahan (Rachel Weisz), Jonathan Carnahan (John Hannah), and their friend Ardeth Bay (Oded Fehr) on an expedition in Egypt. They discover a hidden tomb, but it's too late; the Scorpion King (Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson) has already found it first.

Plot Development:
The Scorpion King is revealed to be Imhotep's (Arnold Vosloo) half-brother and the ruler of the Nubian kingdom. He seeks revenge against the world that wronged him, particularly the pharaoh who killed his father. The group soon learns that the Scorpion King has been resurrected by the power of the Staff of Ra.

As the story unfolds, Evelyn becomes pregnant with the son of Imhotep, and the Scorpion King's resurrection sets off a chain reaction of events that threaten to destroy the world. The group must navigate treacherous tombs, fight against the Scorpion King's army, and prevent the Staff of Ra from falling into the wrong hands.

The Mummy Returns features an array of memorable characters, including the Scorpion King, who becomes a fan favorite for his charisma and action-packed sequences. The film also explores themes of identity, power, and redemption as the characters grapple with their own destinies.

Ending:
In the climactic final battle, Rick O'Connell and Evelyn must face off against the Scorpion King to save the world from destruction. Along the way, they discover that Imhotep's resurrection is tied to the Staff of Ra, which has the power to bring about a new era of peace and prosperity.

Ultimately, the Scorpion King is defeated, but not before he reveals his true intentions: to use the Staff of Ra to resurrect Imhotep and rule the world. The film concludes with Rick O'Connell and Evelyn embracing their newfound love for each other, while Jonathan Carnahan finds redemption by sacrificing himself to save the day.

The Mummy Returns received mixed reviews from critics but was a commercial success, grossing over $415 million worldwide. Despite its flaws, the film remains a beloved entry in the Mummy franchise, thanks to its memorable characters, action-packed sequences, and epic scope.

overview: A beautiful and mysterious woman helps an inept scam artist get his game together... but is their meeting purely coincidence?
title: Angel-A
plot:
Angel-A is a 2005 French drama film directed by Luc Besson. The movie revolves around Zed (played by Jamel Debbouze), a young man who falls in love with an angel, Angel A (played by Monica Bellucci). 

The main theme of the film explores the idea of redemption and the human desire for connection and intimacy. Through Zed's relationship with Angel A, the movie delves into the complexities of human emotions, highlighting the longing for transcendence and the search for meaning in life.

Moreover, the film touches upon the concept of loneliness and isolation, as both Zed and Angel A struggle with their own emotional scars. The movie also explores the theme of love as a transformative force that can heal emotional wounds and bring people together.

The narrative is woven around the idea of an angel who has been sent to Earth to help a troubled soul find redemption. As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that both Zed and Angel A are on a journey of self-discovery, navigating their own personal demons in order to find peace and connection with each other.

Ultimately, the film presents a poignant exploration of the human condition, highlighting the universal desire for love, acceptance, and redemption.

overview: Feature film adaptation of Shakespeare's Scottish play about General Macbeth whose ambitious wife urges him to use wicked means in order to gain power of the throne over the sitting king, Duncan.
tagline: All hail Macbeth that shall be king
title: Macbeth
plot:
Macbeth is a 2015 historical drama directed by Justin Kurzel and adapted from William Shakespeare's tragedy by Todd Louiso, Jacob Koskoff and Michael Lesslie. A British and French co-production, it stars Michael Fassbender as the Scottish lord and Marion Cotillard as Lady Macbeth, with Paddy Considine, Sean Harris, David Hayman, Jack Reynor, Elizabeth Debicki and David Thewlis in supporting roles. Kurzel and Fassbender reimagined Macbeth as a soldier scarred by war and grief, adding a prologue, absent from the play, in which the couple bury their young child.

After leading King Duncan's army to a costly victory in a civil war, in which even boy soldiers die, Macbeth and his comrade Banquo meet three mysterious women who hail Macbeth as Thane of Cawdor and future king, and Banquo as the father of kings. When Duncan grants Macbeth the title of the executed traitor Cawdor, Lady Macbeth urges her husband to make the rest of the prophecy come true while the king is their guest. Guided by the ghost of a dead boy soldier, Macbeth murders Duncan in his tent; the king's son Malcolm flees, and Macbeth kills the servants framed for the crime and is crowned.

Haunted by the prophecy that Banquo's heirs will rule, Macbeth has his friend murdered, but Banquo's son Fleance escapes, and at a feast the king raves at Banquo's ghost. The witches warn him to beware Macduff but promise that he will reign until Birnam Wood comes to Dunsinane and that no man born of woman can harm him. When Macduff flees to join Malcolm, Macbeth has his wife and children burned alive. Consumed by guilt, Lady Macbeth dies, and Macbeth descends into despair. Malcolm's forces set fire to Birnam Wood, sending its smoke towards the castle, and Macduff, who reveals that he was cut from his mother's womb, kills Macbeth in single combat. As Malcolm is hailed king, Fleance takes up Macbeth's sword and runs into the smoke.

Filmed in Scotland and England, including the Isle of Skye, Bamburgh Castle and Ely Cathedral, Macbeth competed for the Palme d'Or at the 2015 Cannes Film Festival and was released by StudioCanal that autumn. Critics praised its visual style, its battle scenes and the performances of Fassbender and Cotillard, although some found the accents and diction hard to follow. It grossed about $16 million worldwide against a budget of around $20 million.

overview: In a time of superstition and magic, when wolves are seen as demonic and nature an evil to be tamed, a young apprentice hunter comes to Ireland with her father to wipe out the last pack. But when she saves a wild native girl, their friendship leads her to discover the world of the Wolfwalkers and transform her into the very thing her father is tasked to destroy.
tagline: Be fierce. Be wild. Be free.
title: Wolfwalkers
plot:
Wolfwalkers is a 2020 Irish-French-Belgian animated fantasy drama film directed by Tomm Moore and Ross Stewart, produced by Cartoon Saloon and Canal+. The film takes place in 17th-century Ireland and follows the story of a young girl named Robyn, who lives with her grandfather, Eira, on the outskirts of a village.

The story begins with Robyn's fascination with wolves, which is forbidden by the villagers. According to local legend, wolves are evil creatures that roam the forest, preying on humans. However, Robyn believes that there is more to the wolves than meets the eye. She spends most of her days exploring the forest and learning about the wolves from her grandfather.

One day, a wolfwalker, a person who can communicate with and control wolves, arrives in the village. The wolfwalker's name is Aisling, and she is on a mission to protect the wolves from being hunted by humans. Robyn is immediately drawn to Aisling and becomes fascinated with the idea of becoming a wolfwalker herself.

As Robyn spends more time with Aisling, she learns about the ancient traditions and rituals that are necessary for a wolfwalker to communicate with the wolves. She also discovers that there is a dark force at work in the forest, threatening the balance between humans and wolves.

The plot thickens as Robyn and Aisling embark on a journey to uncover the source of the darkness and put an end to it. Along the way, they encounter various obstacles and challenges, including treacherous terrain, hostile villagers, and even a group of ruthless hunters who are determined to destroy the wolves.

As the story unfolds, Robyn learns valuable lessons about courage, loyalty, and the importance of respecting the natural world. She also discovers that she has a special connection with the wolves, which sets her on a path towards becoming a wolfwalker in her own right.

The film's climax features an epic battle between the forces of light and darkness, with Robyn and Aisling at the forefront. In the end, they succeed in defeating the dark force and restoring balance to the forest ecosystem.

Throughout the film, the animation is stunning, with beautifully rendered landscapes and characters that bring the story to life. The voice acting is also superb, with Saoirse Ronan delivering a standout performance as Robyn.

Overall, Wolfwalkers is a beautifully crafted film that explores themes of environmentalism, conservation, and the importance of respecting the natural world. With its stunning animation and engaging storyline, it's a must-see for fans of animated films and fantasy adventures.

overview: Jigsaw has disappeared. Along with his new apprentice Amanda, the puppet-master behind the cruel, intricate games that have terrified a community and baffled police has once again eluded capture and vanished. While city detective scramble to locate him, Doctor Lynn Denlon and Jeff Reinhart are unaware that they are about to become the latest pawns on his vicious chessboard.
tagline: Suffering? You Haven't Seen Anything Yet...
title: Saw III
plot:
Saw III is a 2006 American horror film directed by Darren Lynn Bousman and written by Leigh Whannell and Josh Stolberg. The film stars Tobin Bell, Angus Macfadyen, Shawnee Smith, and Bahar Soomekh.

The story begins with Dr. Lawrence Gordon (Cary Elwes), a successful surgeon who is being held captive in a run-down industrial bathroom by Jigsaw (Tobin Bell). Jigsaw forces Gordon to play a deadly game of survival, where he must use his medical skills to save the life of Adam Faulkner (Angus Macfadyen), a young man with a terminal illness. The catch is that Gordon's own life is also at stake, and if he fails to save Adam's life within 60 minutes, he will die.

As the game progresses, it becomes clear that Jigsaw has set up a series of traps and puzzles for Gordon to solve in order to save Adam's life. However, things take a dark turn when it is revealed that Adam is not who he claims to be. In reality, Adam is actually Jeff Denlon (Angus Macfadyen), the son of Detective Eric Matthews (Bahar Soomekh).

Meanwhile, Detective Matthews is investigating a series of gruesome murders linked to Jigsaw's games. As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that Jigsaw has set up a complex web of traps and puzzles for Matthews to solve in order to rescue his son.

As the game reaches its climax, Gordon discovers that Adam is actually Jeff Denlon, and that he has been playing a deadly game with his own father. In the end, Gordon manages to save Adam's life by solving the final puzzle, but not before Jigsaw reveals that he has one last trick up his sleeve.

The film ends with Jigsaw's iconic twist: Dr. Gordon is actually the one who will die, and not Adam. The camera pans out to reveal a new game board, as Jigsaw's voiceover says "You're next." The final shot of the film shows Jigsaw's face, as he reveals that he has been manipulating events from behind the scenes all along.

Throughout the film, the tension builds as the characters navigate the deadly traps and puzzles set by Jigsaw. The film's climax is both shocking and terrifying, leaving the audience on the edge of their seats until the very end.

Overall, Saw III is a masterclass in building tension and suspense, with a complex web of plot twists and turns that keep the viewer guessing until the very end.
